At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us.

At Lilly, we believe in the talent of our workforce. One of the best ways to utilize and develop that talent is to use our existing workforce to fill new and/or open positions. If you are looking for a new position within Lilly, you can view and apply to open roles posted in the internal job posting system. You must meet the minimum qualifications outlined in the job description and have/obtain work authorization in the country the position is located in order to be considered. When applying internally for a position, your current supervisor will receive notification that you have applied to the position. We encourage employees to discuss the opportunity with their supervisor prior to applying.

Every patient or consumer record that Lilly Direct creates in an International Business Unit (IBU) market has to be matched, merged, governed, and shared under that market's privacy law. You will design the architecture that makes that happen: profile master data on Reltio, consent and preference data on Syrenis, curated data products on Databricks, and the integration layer on AWS that ties them to the Lilly Direct experiences. You will also build the first version of it with your own hands.

This is a hands-on architecture seat. You own the data model, the match and survivorship rules, the consent model, and the event and API patterns that move data between systems. You write the reference implementations and review what engineers build against them. You are also the person who gets asked why the design is the way it is. Each new IBU market tests whether the architecture bends or breaks. Your job is to make sure it bends.

Why You'll Love This Role

  • Whole-stack ownership: You own the design from the Reltio entity model through Syrenis consent records to the Databricks tables analysts actually query. Not one layer of it.
  • Hard problems: One profile model, one consent model, many legal regimes. You design for data residency, lawful basis, and retention rules that change at every border.
  • You still build: Reference pipelines, match rules, API contracts, and proof-of-concept work are yours to write, not just to review.
  • Room to grow: The role is built to expand from domain architect for consumer data into a lead architect seat as Lilly Direct scales internationally.
  • Purpose: Getting this right means patients can reach Lilly medicines and services safely, and their data is handled the way they were told it would be.


What You'll Be Doing

  • Design the Architecture
  • Profile MDM: design and maintain the consumer and patient entity model on Reltio, including match rules, survivorship, golden record definition, and reference data, so a single standard holds across IBU markets while allowing for local variation
  • Consent: design the consent and preference model on Syrenis, covering consent types, lawful basis, purpose, channel, and retention, and define how consent state is exposed to every system that needs it
  • Lakehouse: design the curated profile and consent data products on Databricks, including the medallion layers, data quality checks, and access controls that keep personal data where it is allowed to be
  • Integration: define the API and event patterns on AWS that keep Reltio, Syrenis, Databricks, and the Lilly Direct experiences in sync, including which system is the source of truth for each attribute
  • Market onboarding: define the repeatable technical pattern for bringing a new IBU market onto the platform, from data residency and pseudonymization through consent configuration and integration
  • Standards: write architecture decision records and design standards, then run design reviews against them
  • Build and Prove It
  • Reference implementations: build the first version of new patterns yourself, including Reltio configuration, Databricks pipelines, and integration code, then hand them to engineers to scale
  • Data quality: design and implement the match tuning and quality monitoring that keep the golden record trustworthy as volume grows
  • Privacy engineering: implement the technical controls behind Protect Lilly and local privacy requirements, such as pseudonymization and consent-driven access
  • Technical direction: set direction for engineers and contractors, review their work, and own the technical quality of what ships


Where This Role Is Headed (2026-2028)

  • Evolve: grow from domain architect into a lead architect for consumer data in IBU as more of the execution work is automated and the market footprint expands
  • Encode the domain: document profile and consent domain knowledge as data contracts and reusable patterns so other teams, and where it makes sense automated pipelines, can rely on them
  • Governance as code: move privacy and consent controls out of manual review and into the platform as enforceable policy


Your Minimum Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, information technology, management information systems, or a related technical field
  • 7+ years in data engineering or data architecture, with demonstrated ownership of a production data platform


What Sets You Apart

  • Hands-on experience designing and configuring a master data management platform, including data modeling, match and merge rules, and survivorship
  • Hands-on experience with Databricks or a comparable lakehouse platform, including pipeline development and data quality implementation
  • Experience building on AWS, including integration patterns such as APIs and event streaming
  • Strong SQL and Python; you write production code, not just read it
  • Experience applying quality, compliance, and data governance requirements in a regulated environment
  • Direct experience with Reltio, including entity modeling, match rule tuning, and the Reltio APIs
  • Experience with a consent and preference management platform such as Syrenis, and an understanding of how consent state should flow to downstream systems
  • Experience with event streaming platforms such as Kafka for near real-time data synchronization
  • Experience with privacy engineering: pseudonymization, data residency, retention enforcement, and consent-driven access control
  • Experience with consumer or patient data in more than one country, and a working understanding of how privacy requirements differ
  • A track record of writing architecture decisions that engineers followed and leaders understood
  • Comfort with ambiguity; the operating model here is still being built


About The Team

This role sits with Consumer Data team supporting Lilly Direct in International Business Units. The team owns the profile and consent data that Lilly Direct experiences depend on in International Business Units markets. As Lilly Direct grows across those markets, the architect in this seat sets the technical patterns that later markets inherit.

Our tech team builds and maintains capabilities using the same technology as the most prominent tech companies in the world, and every solution we deliver serves one purpose: creating medicines that make life better for people around the world. We hire technology professionals from a range of backgrounds so that diverse thinking shapes every product we build, from data-driven drug discovery to connected clinical trials.

Ready to design the data architecture patients trust us with, in markets where the rules are all different? We'd love to hear from you.

Lilly is dedicated to helping individuals with disabilities to actively engage in the workforce, ensuring equal opportunities when vying for positions. If you require accommodation to submit a resume for a position at Lilly, please complete the accommodation request form (https://careers.lilly.com/us/en/workplace-accommodation) for further assistance. Please note this is for individuals to request an accommodation as part of the application process and any other correspondence will not receive a response.

Lilly is proud to be an EEO Employer and does not discriminate on the basis of age, race, color, religion, gender identity, sex, gender expression, sexual orientation, genetic information, ancestry, national origin, protected veteran status, disability, or any other legally protected status.

Our employee resource groups (ERGs) offer strong support networks for their members and are open to all employees. Our current groups include: Africa, Middle East, Central Asia (AMECA), Black Employees at Lilly (BE@Lilly), Chinese Culture Network (CCN), EnAble, Evolve, Lilly Indian Network (LIN), Organization of Latinx at Lilly (OLA), Pride (LGBTQ+ Allies), Veterans Leadership Network (VLN) and Women’s Initiative for Leading at Lilly (WILL).

Actual compensation will depend on a candidate’s education, experience, skills, and geographic location. The anticipated wage for this position is

$129,000 - $231,000

Full-time equivalent employees also will be eligible for a company bonus (depending, in part, on company and individual performance). In addition, Lilly offers a comprehensive benefit program to eligible employees, including eligibility to participate in a company-sponsored 401(k); pension; vacation benefits; eligibility for medical, dental, vision and prescription drug benefits; flexible benefits (e.g., healthcare and/or dependent day care flexible spending accounts); life insurance and death benefits; certain time off and leave of absence benefits; and well-being benefits (e.g., employee assistance program, fitness benefits, and employee clubs and activities).Lilly reserves the right to amend, modify, or terminate its compensation and benefit programs in its sole discretion and Lilly’s compensation practices and guidelines will apply regarding the details of any promotion or transfer of Lilly employees.

Tata Consultancy Services (TCS) is the technology partner of choice for industry-leading organizations worldwide. Since its inception in 1968, TCS has upheld the highest standards of innovation, engineering excellence, and customer service.

It has set an aspiration to become the world's largest AI-led technology services company and is enabling its clients to transform themselves across the full AI stack, from infrastructure to intelligence.

Rooted in the heritage of the Tata Group, TCS is focused on creating long term value for its clients, its investors, its employees, and the community at large. With a highly skilled workforce spread across 56 countries and 194 service delivery centers across the world, the company has been recognized as a top employer in six continents. With the ability to rapidly apply and scale new technologies, the company has built long-term partnerships with its clients. Many of these relationships have endured into decades and navigated every technology cycle, from mainframes in the 1970s to artificial intelligence today.

TCS sponsors 14 of the world’s most prestigious marathons and endurance events, including the TCS New York City Marathon, TCS London Marathon, Tata Mumbai Marathon, and TCS Sydney Marathon with a focus on promoting health, sustainability, and community empowerment.

Position Summary

We are seeking an experienced Data Architect to define, govern, and evolve the enterprise data architecture that supports analytics, reporting, operational intelligence, artificial intelligence, and emerging data-driven business capabilities. This role provides architectural leadership across Microsoft Fabric, OneLake, Data Warehouses, Lakehouses, Azure Data Factory, Fabric Data Factory, SQL Server, and enterprise integration platforms. Our engineering organization has adopted Specification-Driven Development (SDD) as a core delivery discipline, and AI is a strategic priority.

Position Purpose

Define enterprise data architecture strategy, design scalable and governable platforms, establish standards and best practices, provide architectural leadership for Microsoft Fabric adoption, support modernization initiatives, and enable AI-ready data foundations.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain the enterprise data architecture roadmap.
  • Establish target-state architectures for analytics, reporting, AI, and operational workloads.
  • Lead Microsoft Fabric architecture and governance including OneLake, Lakehouse, Data Warehouse, Fabric Data Factory, semantic models, and security.
  • Define standards for dimensional modeling, Data Vault, fact and dimension design, and slowly changing dimensions.
  • Establish ETL/ELT architecture standards across Azure Data Factory, Fabric Data Factory, SSIS, and Pentaho.
  • Create governance frameworks for data quality, lineage, metadata, security, privacy, and compliance.
  • Define AI-ready data architecture patterns and support AI, machine learning, and generative AI initiatives.
  • Conduct architecture reviews, mentor engineers, and establish reference architectures.
  • Promote Specification-Driven Development and architecture-first practices.


Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Mathematics, or related field.
  • 8+ years of experience in data architecture, data engineering, data warehousing, or analytics.
  • 3+ years in a senior architecture or technical leadership role.
  • Experience designing enterprise-scale cloud data platforms and modernization initiatives.


Required Technical Skills

  • Microsoft Fabric
  • Azure Data Factory
  • Fabric Data Factory
  • SQL Server
  • Azure Data Lake Storage
  • OneLake
  • Enterprise Data Architecture
  • Dimensional Modeling
  • Data Vault
  • ETL/ELT Architecture
  • CDC
  • Data Governance
  • Metadata Management
  • Advanced SQL and T-SQL


Preferred Qualifications

  • Azure Synapse Analytics
  • Spark and PySpark
  • Power BI
  • Infrastructure as Code
  • CI/CD for data platforms
  • AI and machine learning platform experience
  • Enterprise architecture governance experience
  • Specification-Driven Development experience


Legacy Platform Experience (Beneficial)

  • Qlik Replicate
  • Qlik Compose
  • SSIS
  • Pentaho Data Integration
  • Legacy data warehouse modernization
  • Hybrid cloud and on-premises architectures


Knowledge & Competencies

  • Enterprise architecture principles
  • Data platform modernization
  • Data products and data mesh concepts
  • Lakehouse architectures
  • Hybrid cloud architectures
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills
  • Strategic technology planning and roadmap development


Success Criteria

  • Define and execute enterprise data architecture strategy.
  • Establish Microsoft Fabric as the strategic analytics platform.
  • Create reusable architecture patterns.
  • Improve enterprise data quality, governance, security, and reliability.
  • Standardize warehousing, ETL/ELT, and analytics architecture practices.
  • Enable scalable AI and advanced analytics solutions.
  • Deliver architecture standards through disciplined SDD practices.
  • Lead modernization from legacy environments to Microsoft Fabric.
  • Work on a team leading in the adoption of Microsoft Fabric and AI-enabled data engineering capabilities.


Preferred Certifications

  • Microsoft Fabric Analytics Engineer Associate
  • Azure Solutions Architect Expert
  • Azure Data Engineer Associate (DP-203)
  • Azure Fundamentals (AZ-900)
  • TOGAF
  • CDMP


Job Family

Data & Analytics Architecture

Level

Principal / Lead Individual Contributor

Reports To

Director, Product Software Engineering

Our Interview Practices

To maintain a fair and genuine hiring process, we kindly ask that all candidates participate in interviews without the assistance of AI tools or external prompts. Our interview process is designed to assess your individual skills, experiences, and communication style. We value authenticity and want to ensure we’re getting to know you—not a digital assistant. To help maintain this integrity, we ask to remove virtual backgrounds and include in-person interviews in our hiring process. Please note that use of AI-generated responses or third-party support during interviews will be grounds for disqualification from the recruitment process.

Applicants may be required to appear onsite at a Wolters Kluwer office as part of the recruitment process.

Compensation:

$107,500.00 - $188,400.00 USD

This role is eligible for Bonus.

Compensation range listed is based on primary location of the position. Actual base salary offer is influenced by a wide array of factors including but not limited to skills, experience and actual hiring location. Your recruiter can share more information about the specific offer for the job location during the hiring process.

Additional Information:

Wolters Kluwer offers a wide variety of competitive benefits and programs to help meet your needs and balance your work and personal life, including but not limited to: Medical, Dental, & Vision Plans, 401(k), FSA/HSA, Commuter Benefits, Tuition Assistance Plan, Vacation and Sick Time, and Paid Parental Leave. Full details of our benefits are available upon request.

Job Title: Enterprise Data Architect – Customer Data Platform (Azure Databricks Lakehouse)

  • This position follows a hybrid work schedule and requires working on-site three (3) days per week and remotely two (2) days per week.

Why this role

Our Azure Databricks Lakehouse is the system of record for replicated Customer Information System (CIS) data for approximately 4.6 million electric utility customers. It feeds billing, rates, credit management, payments, service orders, and metering and usage reporting, and it is the foundation for our analytics, data science, and AI work.

As the technical authority for this platform, you will set the architecture, standards, and roadmap, and you will serve as the final architectural approval authority for the Customer Data Platform ecosystem. This is a highly visible, cross-functional role where reliability and auditability matter, and where your decisions shape how a major utility uses its customer data for years to come.

About The Role

You will lead the design, governance, and evolution of the Lakehouse, working at the intersection of enterprise architecture, data engineering, and utility business operations. You will define how CIS data is replicated, secured, and consumed across the enterprise, supporting both batch and near-real-time needs, and you will partner with enterprise architects, application teams, cybersecurity, vendors, and business stakeholders to turn business priorities into scalable solutions.

What You Will Do

  • Own the end-to-end architecture and strategic direction of the Lakehouse, from ingestion through consumption, including medallion design patterns and Delta Lake implementation.
  • Architect near-real-time and batch replication of CIS data, and lead decisions on Change Data Capture (CDC), streaming, and integration technologies to meet defined service level objectives.
  • Guide data engineers who are defining logical and physical data models and the standards that support operational reporting, business intelligence, advanced analytics, data products, and regulatory needs.
  • Establish standards for data quality, lineage, cataloging, observability, and metadata management using Unity Catalog and enterprise metadata tools.
  • Design and govern the integration patterns that downstream operational, analytical, and regulatory applications use to consume customer, billing, metering, and premise data.
  • Partner with cybersecurity, privacy, and compliance teams on access control, encryption, masking, and regulatory controls, and design for high availability, disaster recovery, and operational resilience.
  • Work with data engineers, and data science and analytics teams to create architectural patterns for machine learning, generative AI, and advanced analytics that stay within governance and security standards.
  • Provide technical governance for vendor, consulting, and system integration partners, building collaborative relationships grounded in shared accountability.
  • Lead and mentor data engineering teams through architecture reviews and design guidance, and maintain reference architectures, architecture decision records, and multi-year roadmaps.
  • Optimize platform capacity and cost across Databricks and Azure, support major incident investigations and root cause analysis, and evaluate emerging technologies that improve the platform.

What Success Looks Like

  • A trusted, governed, and highly available CIS data ecosystem.
  • A scalable Lakehouse architecture that supports enterprise reporting, analytics, and operational workloads.
  • Consistent data standards, quality controls, and architectural governance across data domains.
  • Reusable architecture patterns that reduce integration complexity.
  • Clear roadmaps that align technology investment with business priorities, with platform performance and cost kept in check.

What You Bring (required)

  • Experience: Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Systems, or a related discipline, and at least 8 years of progressive experience in data architecture, data engineering, or analytics platform engineering, including at least 3 years in a senior architecture or technical leadership role.
  • Platform: You have led the architecture of a production, enterprise-scale Azure Databricks Lakehouse, with hands-on depth in Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, and Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2.
  • Data movement: You have designed and delivered CDC and replication from a transactional source system into a lakehouse or warehouse, supporting batch and near-real-time loads (for example, with Qlik Replicate, HVR, Fivetran, Debezium, GoldenGate, or equivalent tools).
  • Modeling and governance: You are strong in data modeling (dimensional, Data Vault, or canonical models) and in governing data quality, metadata, lineage, and security controls such as role-based access, classification, and masking.
  • Standards leadership: You have established architecture standards, run architecture reviews, and driven adoption of engineering practices across multiple delivery teams.
  • Communication: You communicate and influence effectively with executives, engineers, vendors, and business stakeholders, and you can balance business priorities, risk, and cost in your decisions.

What Sets You Apart (preferred)

  • Experience with a utility CIS such as Oracle Customer to Meter (C2M), Oracle CC&B, SAP IS-U, or Cayenta. Experience with comparable high-volume customer or billing platforms in telecom, financial services, healthcare, or retail also translates well.
  • Knowledge of utility processes such as billing, collections, meter-to-cash, revenue assurance, rates, and regulatory reporting, and familiarity with NERC CIP and state public utility commission requirements.
  • Experience with Apache Spark, Delta Live Tables, Structured Streaming, Databricks Workflows, Event Hubs, or Kafka.
  • Experience with platform resiliency, FinOps, and capacity planning on Azure and Databricks.
  • Experience with Agile, SAFe, and product-oriented delivery models.
  • Master’s degree, or Azure, Databricks, or architecture certifications.

What We Value

  • Business value mindset. You deliver business outcomes, not just technical solutions.
  • Ownership and accountability. You take personal responsibility for commitments and follow through without needing close oversight.
  • Collaborative leadership. You build trust across business and technology teams and influence constructively at every level.
  • Constructive courage. You challenge assumptions and raise concerns early, with diplomacy and candor, even when it is unpopular.
  • Stewardship and integrity. You act as a trusted steward of enterprise data, holding to high standards of security, compliance, and integrity.

First 12 months

  • Close the highest-risk gaps in data quality, latency, lineage, and access control.
  • Stand up a working architecture-review practice so new pipelines and data products follow the standard.
  • Baseline platform reliability and cost and use that baseline in capacity and design decisions.
  • Craft a written roadmap that ties the next platform investments to customer and revenue priorities.

Job Description

As a Data Architect, you will play a foundational role in the design and implementation of Unified Data, a net-new, greenfield enterprise data ecosystem for NBCUniversal Operations & Technology. Built primarily on Microsoft Fabric, Unified Data will establish a centralized, governed data foundation that brings together real-time operational events and historical data across enterprise technology domains to support reporting, analytics, automation, AI, and reusable data products.

You will define the target-state architecture, data organization and modeling standards, integration patterns, security and governance framework, and engineering practices for the platform. Operating within a complex and evolving technical environment, you will exercise independent judgment to evaluate multiple architectural approaches, assess interdependencies and technical tradeoffs, and determine solutions where established patterns or precedent may be limited. The data landscape spans areas including IT service management, employee and workplace technology, endpoints and assets, identity and access, infrastructure and network services, collaboration platforms, operational telemetry, and enterprise master and reference data.

In addition to serving as the lead architect, you will act as a technical leader for the delivery team, providing guidance and translating architecture and business requirements into actionable engineering work, helping create and refine epics, stories, and tasks, identifying dependencies and sequencing, and ensuring work is aligned to the appropriate resources and teams while providing technical guidance throughout implementation.

Responsibilities:

  • Microsoft Fabric Architecture & Strategy: Independently define the end-to-end architecture for Microsoft Fabric, including OneLake, Lakehouse, Warehouse, Data Factory, Real-Time Intelligence, Eventstream/Eventhouse, notebooks, and semantic models to support cross-domain Operations & Technology use cases.
  • Greenfield Platform Architecture: Develop and establish the foundational architecture, standards, environment strategy, workspace organization, security boundaries, deployment patterns, and operating principles for a net-new enterprise data platform.
  • Technical Leadership & Delivery Enablement: Serve as the technical leader for the delivery team by translating architecture and program objectives into epics, stories, tasks, dependencies, and implementation sequencing while helping route work to the appropriate resources and teams.
  • Enterprise Data Centralization: Drive the consolidation of fragmented operational data into a centralized and discoverable ecosystem using domain-aligned data products, authoritative data sources, reusable shared datasets, and common data contracts.
  • Operational Data Architecture: Design solutions spanning IT service management, workplace technology, endpoints and assets, identity, infrastructure, networks, collaboration platforms, telemetry, events, logs, and enterprise reference data. Evaluate cross-domain dependencies and technical tradeoffs to determine architectural approaches that address complex and evolving requirements.
  • Real-Time & Historical Data Design: Architect solutions that combine streaming and event-driven operational data with historical, transactional, master, and reference data to support operational visibility, analytics, automation, and AI-enabled use cases.
  • Lakehouse & Warehouse Patterns: Establish scalable patterns for raw, enriched, and curated data layers, Delta-based lakehouse designs, warehouse workloads, OneLake shortcuts, virtualization, partitioning, optimization, retention, and performance management.
  • Data Modeling & Semantic Standards: Define enterprise modeling principles, canonical entities, conformed dimensions, shared business definitions, and semantic standards using dimensional, normalized, domain-oriented, or hybrid approaches as appropriate.
  • Integration & Pipeline Architecture: Define resilient and reusable ingestion, transformation, and orchestration patterns across APIs, databases, SaaS platforms, files, CDC, batch processing, and event streams.
  • Data Governance, Security & Quality: Partner with security, privacy, and governance teams to establish access controls, metadata, lineage, classification, data ownership, data contracts, quality standards, retention policies, and lifecycle controls.
  • Architecture Standards & Documentation: Independently develop and maintain target-state architectures, reference architectures, architecture decision records, data flow diagrams, technical standards, reusable patterns, and implementation roadmaps.
  • DevOps & Engineering Standards: Establish expectations for source control, CI/CD, environment promotion, infrastructure and configuration automation, testing, monitoring, deployment controls, and release management.
  • Architecture Review & Technical Governance: Lead reviews and advise teams on solution designs and major technical decisions to ensure implementations remain aligned with Unified Data architecture, security requirements, performance expectations, and engineering standards.

Qualifications

Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
  • 8+ years of experience in data engineering, data architecture, solution architecture, or related roles, including responsibility for designing, establishing, or materially evolving enterprise-scale data platforms.
  • Demonstrated experience translating architecture and technical strategy into executable roadmaps, epics, stories, tasks, and implementation plans.
  • Experience serving as a technical lead across multidisciplinary engineering teams or complex technical programs.
  • Strong experience designing lakehouse and/or warehouse architectures, including layered data patterns from raw ingestion through curated and consumable datasets.
  • Strong expertise in SQL and proficiency with Python and/or PySpark for data engineering, automation, prototyping, and technical validation.
  • Experience architecting data solutions on Microsoft Fabric, Microsoft Azure, or comparable enterprise cloud data platforms.
  • Experience designing both batch and real-time/event-driven data solutions.
  • Strong understanding of APIs, data integration, distributed data processing, and enterprise integration patterns.
  • Experience designing secure, scalable, observable, and supportable production data platforms.
  • Strong understanding of data modeling, metadata, lineage, governance, and data quality principles.
  • Ability to independently evaluate complex technical tradeoffs across scalability, reliability, maintainability, security, cost, and business requirements, and exercise judgment in determining appropriate architectural approaches.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate architectural concepts to engineers, product teams, stakeholders, and senior leadership.
  • Ability to operate effectively in a greenfield environment where standards, processes, and technical patterns are being established.

Desired Characteristics:

  • Experience designing or leading a greenfield enterprise data platform or significant modernization of an existing data ecosystem.
  • Deep hands-on experience with Microsoft Fabric, including OneLake, Lakehouse, Warehouse, Data Factory, notebooks, Real-Time Intelligence, Eventstream/Eventhouse, semantic models, and Power BI.
  • Experience establishing Microsoft Fabric workspace, domain, environment, security, capacity, and deployment strategies.
  • Experience with Microsoft Azure data technologies and services.
  • Experience with event streaming and messaging architectures such as Kafka, Azure Event Hubs, Kinesis, or equivalent technologies.
  • Experience designing change data capture (CDC) and near-real-time ingestion architectures.
  • Experience with data governance practices and tooling, including cataloging, lineage, classification, data contracts, retention, and privacy controls.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD and infrastructure automation technologies such as GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, Terraform, or Bicep.
  • Experience establishing engineering standards and technical delivery practices across multiple teams.
  • Experience building platform and pipeline observability, including logging, monitoring, alerting, SLAs/SLOs, and data quality monitoring.
  • Experience developing architecture decision records, reference architectures, and reusable technical patterns.
  • Experience designing data foundations that support advanced analytics, machine learning, generative AI, or agentic applications.
  • Background supporting large-scale Operations & Technology environments such as service operations, workplace technology, infrastructure, endpoint management, identity, security, or network services.
  • Media, entertainment, or consumer technology experience, particularly in environments where reliability, scale, and cross-domain data integration are critical.
  • Strong facilitation and presentation skills, including the ability to lead technical design discussions and communicate complex architecture decisions to technical and non-technical audiences.

Additional Requirements:

  • Fully Remote: This position has been designated as fully remote, meaning that the position is expected to contribute from a non-NBCUniversal worksite, most commonly an employee’s residence.

NBCUniversal is a subsidiary of Comcast Corporation. Visit www.nbcuniversal.com for more information.


Our impact is rooted in improving the communities where our employees, customers, and audiences live and work. We have a rich tradition of giving back and ensuring our employees have the opportunity to serve their communities. We champion an inclusive culture and strive to attract and develop a talented workforce to create and deliver a wide range of content reflecting our world.



Job Description


As a Data Architect, you will play a foundational role in the design and implementation of Unified Data, a net-new, greenfield enterprise data ecosystem for NBCUniversal Operations & Technology. Built primarily on Microsoft Fabric, Unified Data will establish a centralized, governed data foundation that brings together real-time operational events and historical data across enterprise technology domains to support reporting, analytics, automation, AI, and reusable data products.


You will define the target-state architecture, data organization and modeling standards, integration patterns, security and governance framework, and engineering practices for the platform. Operating within a complex and evolving technical environment, you will exercise independent judgment to evaluate multiple architectural approaches, assess interdependencies and technical tradeoffs, and determine solutions where established patterns or precedent may be limited. The data landscape spans areas including IT service management, employee and workplace technology, endpoints and assets, identity and access, infrastructure and network services, collaboration platforms, operational telemetry, and enterprise master and reference data.


In addition to serving as the lead architect, you will act as a technical leader for the delivery team, providing guidance and translating architecture and business requirements into actionable engineering work, helping create and refine epics, stories, and tasks, identifying dependencies and sequencing, and ensuring work is aligned to the appropriate resources and teams while providing technical guidance throughout implementation.


Responsibilities:



- Microsoft Fabric Architecture & Strategy: Independently define the end-to-end architecture for Microsoft Fabric, including OneLake, Lakehouse, Warehouse, Data Factory, Real-Time Intelligence, Eventstream/Eventhouse, notebooks, and semantic models to support cross-domain Operations & Technology use cases. 
- Greenfield Platform Architecture: Develop and establish the foundational architecture, standards, environment strategy, workspace organization, security boundaries, deployment patterns, and operating principles for a net-new enterprise data platform. 
- Technical Leadership & Delivery Enablement: Serve as the technical leader for the delivery team by translating architecture and program objectives into epics, stories, tasks, dependencies, and implementation sequencing while helping route work to the appropriate resources and teams. 
- Enterprise Data Centralization: Drive the consolidation of fragmented operational data into a centralized and discoverable ecosystem using domain-aligned data products, authoritative data sources, reusable shared datasets, and common data contracts. 
- Operational Data Architecture: Design solutions spanning IT service management, workplace technology, endpoints and assets, identity, infrastructure, networks, collaboration platforms, telemetry, events, logs, and enterprise reference data. Evaluate cross-domain dependencies and technical tradeoffs to determine architectural approaches that address complex and evolving requirements. 
- Real-Time & Historical Data Design: Architect solutions that combine streaming and event-driven operational data with historical, transactional, master, and reference data to support operational visibility, analytics, automation, and AI-enabled use cases. 
- Lakehouse & Warehouse Patterns: Establish scalable patterns for raw, enriched, and curated data layers, Delta-based lakehouse designs, warehouse workloads, OneLake shortcuts, virtualization, partitioning, optimization, retention, and performance management. 
- Data Modeling & Semantic Standards: Define enterprise modeling principles, canonical entities, conformed dimensions, shared business definitions, and semantic standards using dimensional, normalized, domain-oriented, or hybrid approaches as appropriate. 
- Integration & Pipeline Architecture: Define resilient and reusable ingestion, transformation, and orchestration patterns across APIs, databases, SaaS platforms, files, CDC, batch processing, and event streams. 
- Data Governance, Security & Quality: Partner with security, privacy, and governance teams to establish access controls, metadata, lineage, classification, data ownership, data contracts, quality standards, retention policies, and lifecycle controls. 
- Architecture Standards & Documentation: Independently develop and maintain target-state architectures, reference architectures, architecture decision records, data flow diagrams, technical standards, reusable patterns, and implementation roadmaps. 
- DevOps & Engineering Standards: Establish expectations for source control, CI/CD, environment promotion, infrastructure and configuration automation, testing, monitoring, deployment controls, and release management. 
- Architecture Review & Technical Governance: Lead reviews and advise teams on solution designs and major technical decisions to ensure implementations remain aligned with Unified Data architecture, security requirements, performance expectations, and engineering standards. 

Qualifications


Requirements:



- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience. 
- 8+ years of experience in data engineering, data architecture, solution architecture, or related roles, including responsibility for designing, establishing, or materially evolving enterprise-scale data platforms. 
- Demonstrated experience translating architecture and technical strategy into executable roadmaps, epics, stories, tasks, and implementation plans. 
- Experience serving as a technical lead across multidisciplinary engineering teams or complex technical programs. 
- Strong experience designing lakehouse and/or warehouse architectures, including layered data patterns from raw ingestion through curated and consumable datasets. 
- Strong expertise in SQL and proficiency with Python and/or PySpark for data engineering, automation, prototyping, and technical validation. 
- Experience architecting data solutions on Microsoft Fabric, Microsoft Azure, or comparable enterprise cloud data platforms. 
- Experience designing both batch and real-time/event-driven data solutions. 
- Strong understanding of APIs, data integration, distributed data processing, and enterprise integration patterns. 
- Experience designing secure, scalable, observable, and supportable production data platforms. 
- Strong understanding of data modeling, metadata, lineage, governance, and data quality principles. 
- Ability to independently evaluate complex technical tradeoffs across scalability, reliability, maintainability, security, cost, and business requirements, and exercise judgment in determining appropriate architectural approaches. 
- Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate architectural concepts to engineers, product teams, stakeholders, and senior leadership. 
- Ability to operate effectively in a greenfield environment where standards, processes, and technical patterns are being established. 
Desired Characteristics:



- Experience designing or leading a greenfield enterprise data platform or significant modernization of an existing data ecosystem. 
- Deep hands-on experience with Microsoft Fabric, including OneLake, Lakehouse, Warehouse, Data Factory, notebooks, Real-Time Intelligence, Eventstream/Eventhouse, semantic models, and Power BI. 
- Experience establishing Microsoft Fabric workspace, domain, environment, security, capacity, and deployment strategies. 
- Experience with Microsoft Azure data technologies and services. 
- Experience with event streaming and messaging architectures such as Kafka, Azure Event Hubs, Kinesis, or equivalent technologies. 
- Experience designing change data capture (CDC) and near-real-time ingestion architectures. 
- Experience with data governance practices and tooling, including cataloging, lineage, classification, data contracts, retention, and privacy controls. 
- Familiarity with CI/CD and infrastructure automation technologies such as GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, Terraform, or Bicep. 
- Experience establishing engineering standards and technical delivery practices across multiple teams. 
- Experience building platform and pipeline observability, including logging, monitoring, alerting, SLAs/SLOs, and data quality monitoring. 
- Experience developing architecture decision records, reference architectures, and reusable technical patterns. 
- Experience designing data foundations that support advanced analytics, machine learning, generative AI, or agentic applications. 
- Background supporting large-scale Operations & Technology environments such as service operations, workplace technology, infrastructure, endpoint management, identity, security, or network services. 
- Media, entertainment, or consumer technology experience, particularly in environments where reliability, scale, and cross-domain data integration are critical. 
- Strong facilitation and presentation skills, including the ability to lead technical design discussions and communicate complex architecture decisions to technical and non-technical audiences.

- Fully Remote: This position has been designated as fully remote, meaning that the position is expected to contribute from a non-NBCUniversal worksite, most commonly an employee’s residence.

Job Description Summary

The Supply Chain Lead Data Architect will own the supply chain data model and the data-product architecture that enables trusted analytics, decision intelligence and data science across the North America Operating Unit. This leader will treat data as a product: defining the business purpose, consumers, ownership, quality expectations, access patterns, lifecycle and measurable value of the data assets the organization depends on. The role combines supply-chain domain mastery with enterprise data modeling, platform product strategy and modern engineering fluency. Partnering with supply chain, product, analytics, data science, Global Data and AI, Enterprise Architecture, Security, Governance and platform teams, the successful candidate will translate business decisions into interoperable, secure, governed and reusable data capabilities that improve performance and deliver measurable business value.

This is a Director-level role.

About The Role

Own Supply Chain Data Products and Enterprise Data Models

  • Define and execute the supply chain data-product strategy and multi-year architecture roadmap that enables analytics, reporting, decision intelligence and data science.
  • Develop and own the canonical supply chain data model, including conceptual, logical and physical models, shared business definitions and semantic layers for domains such as demand, supply, inventory, manufacturing, logistics, customer service and performance.
  • Establish reusable patterns for data products, ingestion, integration, lakehouse and warehouse platforms, APIs, events and streaming, master and reference data, semantic models, analytics and data-science consumption.
  • Lead architecture reviews and technology decisions, balancing decision value, interoperability, scalability, security, quality, reliability, performance, cost and speed to market.

Enable Integration Interoperability and Modern Data Engineering

  • Connect supply chain data requirements with enterprise platforms, applications and standards, reducing duplicate data, fragmented definitions, point-to-point integrations and technical debt.
  • Define integration and interoperability standards across ERP, manufacturing, warehouse, transportation, planning, customer and external-partner systems using APIs, events, common identifiers and governed data contracts.
  • Set engineering standards for CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, automated testing, orchestration, observability, metadata, lineage, data quality, reliability and operational support.
  • Drive reusable frameworks, platform capabilities and product operating practices that accelerate delivery and make data easy to discover, understand, access and use responsibly. Improve workload performance, resilience and cost efficiency across cloud data, analytics and data-science platforms.

Translate Business Decisions into Data Requirements

  • Work with supply-chain leaders to identify the decisions that matter most, the measures that define success and the data required to improve planning, service, cost, inventory, capacity, resilience and sustainability outcomes.
  • Convert business priorities into clear data requirements, data-product backlogs, domain models, data contracts, acceptance criteria and delivery roadmaps that technical teams can execute.
  • Define patterns that enable data scientists and analysts to use governed, explainable and fit-for-purpose data, including feature-ready data, semantic models and secure self-service access.
  • Partner with data science and engineering teams to move analytical and predictive solutions from prototypes to secure, observable and reliable production capabilities.
  • Establish architecture guardrails for privacy, security, governance, model use, explainability, evaluation and appropriate human oversight where AI is applied.

Lead Cross Functional Delivery and Augmented Teams

  • Serve as a trusted partner to supply-chain, product, finance, operations, data science and technology leaders; communicate architecture choices, dependencies, tradeoffs, value, cost and risk in clear business language.
  • Lead cross-functional teams and augmented resources, setting clear outcomes, architectural guardrails, delivery expectations and quality standards while building capability in internal teams.
  • Facilitate alignment across organizational boundaries, resolve design decisions and sequence investments to deliver the highest-value data products first.
  • Improve the discoverability, accessibility, quality and usability of trusted supply-chain data so teams can move from questions to decisions more efficiently.

Drive Governance Quality Value and Enterprise Alignment

  • Establish data-product governance with clear ownership, stewardship, quality rules, service expectations, metadata, lineage, retention and least-privilege access from design through operations.
  • Partner with NAOU Digital and Data, Global Data and AI, Enterprise Architecture, Cybersecurity, Privacy, Governance and platform organizations to align supply-chain solutions with enterprise direction.
  • Establish measures and operating reviews for data quality, adoption, reuse, time to insight, delivery speed, reliability, cost, risk reduction and realized supply-chain value.
  • Build a high-performing culture focused on accountability, product thinking, value creation, inclusion, quality and continuous improvement; mentor technical talent and augmented team members.
  • Enable teams to make decisions within clear architectural guardrails and continuously improve the data-product portfolio based on stakeholder feedback and performance evidence.

What You Will Need

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Data Science or a related field, or equivalent professional experience; advanced degree is a plus.
  • 7+ years of progressive experience in data architecture, enterprise data modeling, data engineering or analytics platforms, including leadership of complex enterprise-scale transformations.
  • 7+ years of experience leading architects, engineers, technical leaders, augmented resources or multidisciplinary platform teams, including responsibility for talent development and delivery outcomes.
  • Demonstrated supply-chain domain expertise and experience translating supply-chain processes and decisions into data requirements, business definitions, data models and analytical products.
  • Demonstrated expertise designing enterprise conceptual, logical and physical data models; canonical data models; master and reference data; semantic models; and data products for analytics and data science.
  • Demonstrated experience designing cloud-native architectures spanning lakehouse and warehouse platforms, data products, streaming, APIs, events, semantic models and analytical consumption.
  • Experience with enterprise cloud data platforms such as Microsoft Azure, Microsoft Fabric, OneLake, Power BI and Azure Databricks, or comparable technologies.
  • Strong understanding of integration and interoperability patterns, including APIs, event-driven architecture, data contracts, common identifiers and operational-system integration.
  • Strong understanding of CI/CD, DevOps, DataOps, Infrastructure as Code, automated testing, orchestration, observability and cloud cost-management practices.
  • Deep understanding of data governance, security, privacy, metadata, lineage, data quality, stewardship, access control and data-product operating practices.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence senior business and technology leaders, lead decisions across organizational boundaries, manage augmented resources and communicate complex topics in clear business language.
  • Experience translating technology investments into measurable outcomes across data quality, reliability, adoption, reuse, speed, cost, risk and realized business value.
  • Proven track record of working independently, applying platform product strategy and fostering a growth mindset culture in a data-product environment.

Job ID: req4526

Employee Type: exempt full-time

Division: Enterprise Information Technology

Facility: Frederick: Ft Detrick

Location: PO Box B, Frederick, MD 21702 USA

The Frederick National Laboratory is operated by Leidos Biomedical Research, Inc. The lab addresses some of the most urgent and intractable problems in the biomedical sciences in cancer and AIDS, drug development and first-in-human clinical trials, applications of nanotechnology in medicine, and rapid response to emerging threats of infectious diseases.

Accountability, Compassion, Collaboration, Dedication, Integrity and Versatility; it's the FNL way.

Program Description

The Enterprise Solutions group (BES) is part of the Enterprise IT directorate, overseeing the strategic vision and implementation plan of IT systems and solutions that the support Frederick National Laboratory for Cancer Research (FNL) operational and scientific organizations. The BES scope includes development, integration and optimization of the enterprise business systems used by the FNL operator, Leidos Biomedical Research, as well as logical and automation solutions for the scientific community.

This is a hybrid position in Frederick, MD requiring working on site a minimum of one (1) day per week.

Key Responsibilities

Deltek Costpoint Data & Reporting Architecture. Serve as a subject matter expert for Deltek Costpoint data architecture, deeply understanding Admin, System, Transactional, Time & Expense, and Project schemas, and translating them into optimized analytical models.

Enterprise Data Modeling Leadership. Lead the design and governance of enterprise-grade data models (conceptual, logical, and physical), including dimensional and relational models, to support Costpoint analytics, financial reporting, and executive BI.

Enterprise BI Modernization. Lead the conversion of legacy databases, converting Oracle Stored Procedures to reduced and OOTB transformation model.

Performance & Scalability Engineering. Drive performance optimization across data models, SQL logic, and integration pipelines, ensuring solutions scale with business growth and reporting demand.

Advanced Data Integration Architecture. Architect and implement complex, high-volume data integration solutions using SSIS, Azure Data Factory, and cloud-native patterns, integrating Deltek Costpoint with downstream analytics platforms.

Cloud Data Platform Design. Design and evolve cloud-based data architectures leveraging Azure SQL Database, Azure Data Lake Storage, Azure Synapse Analytics, and related services to support scalable, future-state analytics.

Data Governance & Integrity. Establish and enforce data quality, integrity, security, and lineage standards across all integration and modeling layers.

Technical Leadership & Standards. Define and manage transformation project/tasks; Provide technical guidance and mentorship to developers and analysts; Define operational approach for ETL/ELT.

Basic Qualifications

To be considered for this position, you must minimally meet the knowledge, skills, and abilities listed below:

Possession of Bachelor’s degree from an accredited college/university according to the Council for Higher Education Accreditation (CHEA) or four (4) years relevant experience in lieu of degree. Foreign degrees must be evaluated for U.S. equivalency.

In addition to the education requirement, a minimum of eight (8) years of experience in data integration, ETL, and data modeling roles.

Demonstrated experience designing enterprise analytics platforms, not just developing pipelines.

Proven ability to translate complex ERP data structures into clean, business-friendly analytical models.

Experience leading cloud migration or modernization initiatives for data platforms.

Deltek Costpoint / ERP. Extensive experience working with Deltek Costpoint (or other ERP), with strong understanding of Accounting, Projects, People, and related financial/process data flows.

Business Intelligence Integration. Familiarity integrating modeled data with Cognos and other enterprise BI platforms.

Data Modeling, Expert Level. Proven expertise in enterprise data modeling, including star/snowflake schemas, financial and project accounting models, slowly changing dimensions, and fact table design.

Database Platforms. Advanced mastery of SQL Server and/or Oracle databases, including query optimization, indexing strategies, and large-scale data transformations.

Strong communication skills with the ability to collaborate across IT, finance, and business stakeholders.

Ability to work on site in Frederick, MD a minimum of one (1) day per week.

Ability to obtain and maintain a security clearance.

Preferred Qualifications

Candidates with these desired skills will be given preferential consideration:

Azure Data Ecosystem. Strong knowledge of Azure SQL DB, ADLS, Synapse Analytics, and modern cloud data architecture patterns.

Integration & ETL Architecture. Deep, hands-on expertise with SSIS and Azure Data Factory (or similar technologies), including complex orchestration, dependency management, error handling, and monitoring at scale.

Overview

Since our founding in 1924, we've cut cardiovascular disease deaths in half, but there is still so much more to do. To overcome today’s biggest health challenges and accelerate this progress, we need passionate individuals like you. Join our movement, be part of the progress, and help ensure a healthier future for all. You matter, and so does the impact you can make with us.

The American Heart Association has an excellent opportunity for a Data Architect based at our National Center in Dallas, TX. This role can be home-based.

This is a full-time, benefits-eligible, grant-funded opportunity. Current funding will expire 12/31/2030 with the possibility of extension.

The Association offers many resources to help you maintain work-life harmonization through your changing needs and life situations. To help you be successful, you will have access to Heart U, our award-winning corporate university, as well as additional training and support, locally.

\#TheAHALife is more than a company culture; it is our way of life. It embodies our commitment to work-life harmonization and is guided by our core values where our employees can thrive both personally and professionally. Discover why you will Be Seen. Be Heard. Be Valued at the American Heart Association by following us on LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, X, and at heart.jobs.

Responsibilities

  • Designs integration architectures, defines clinical data mappings from electronic health record data including imaging, develops data models, and consults with the infrastructure team on server and data storage services.
  • Formulates and recommends standards for achieving maximum performance, compliance and efficiency of the database and delivery to researchers in the American Heart Association Precision Medicine Platform.
  • Ensures accuracy and integrity of service-oriented architecture through analysis, coding, writing clear documentation and problem resolution. Reviews issues and enhancements documented in the incident management and project management system for consideration of business needs.
  • Maintains in-depth current knowledge of standards, guidelines, and industry trends for Data Warehouse Architecture as it relates to reporting and operations. Attends and interacts with user groups and researches new software vendors in the market. Evaluates new data sources for adherence to the organization's quality standards and ease of integration.
  • Fosters use of self-service analytics, data governance and visual discovery while guiding changes and limited reliance on manual data processes. Builds proof of concept and tangible results by sharing testing data.
  • Participates in the planning for retirement of systems programs, and migration of systems infrastructure by providing current state and future state architectural diagrams.
  • Works closely with Chief of Data Science and business groups within American Heart Association to ensure prioritization of corporate and department objectives within the portfolio management system.
  • Provides guidance on Data Governance as it applies to enterprise data architecture choices.
  • Champions data quality, integrity, and reliability throughout the department by designing data flow models and promoting development best practices with best of breed automation tools, working cross-functionally to ensure that data is made available timely and securely.
  • Provides mentoring to Extract/Transform/Load (ETL) team members with technical expertise, complex systems, and/or programming knowledge. Provides on-the-job training for new or less experienced ETL team members.
  • Provides technical training to external team members to encourage cross-department connections including the development and maintenance of standard operating procedures.
  • Provides a methodology for the ongoing assessment of database performance and the identification of problem areas by holding regularly scheduled reviews of code and monitoring software.
  • Develops business cases, impacts evaluation and ROI for department to get buy-in from senior management.
  • Performs other duties as required or assigned which are reasonably within the scope and responsibility of the job level and family.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's Degree or equivalent work experience.
  • Minimum of eight (8) years of experience (ten years of experience preferred) of Data Mapping and Extract/Transform/Load (ETL) design and development experience with clinical electronic health record data and images.
  • Minimum of eight (8) years of experience with:
  • Data modeling with an emphasis on ODS and Star schema models.
  • Integration architecture design and implementation with electronic health records and images.
  • Experience with Data Virtualization tools.
  • Comprehensive knowledge in software development lifecycles/methodologies, i.e. agile.
  • Strong presentation and collaboration skills, and can communicate all aspects of the job requirements, including the creation of formal documentation.
  • Fluent in relational database concepts and flat file processing concepts.
  • Strong problem-solving, time management, and organizational skills.

Here are some of the preferred skills we are looking for:

  • Experience with Electronic health records and image mapping.
  • Experience with Python, R, SQL.
  • Experience with Cloud offerings.
  • Experience with Amazon Web Services: S3, Glue, SageMaker, Lake Formation, Lambda, Athena, RedShift, EMR, etc.
  • ETL Technology: AWS Glue, SSIS, DataStage, Informatica.
  • Time series analysis, clustering, decision trees, and neural networks.
  • Database/Data Virtualization Technology: Apache Spark, Databricks, Snowflake, Hadoop, Cloudera, SQL Server, Oracle, Alteryx, Denodo.
  • Business Intelligence Technology: SSRS, Power BI, Tableau, MicroStrategy.

Compensation & Benefits

The expected pay range will be $126,000 - $146,000. Pay is commensurate with experience; geographic differentials to the pay range may apply. The American Heart Association reserves the right to pay more or less than the posted range. The American Heart Association invests in its people. Here are the main components of our total rewards package. Visit Rewards & Benefits to see more details.

  • Compensation – Our goal is to ensure you have a competitive base salary. That’s why we regularly review the market value of jobs and make adjustments, as needed.
  • Performance and Recognition – You are rewarded for achieving success through annual salary planning and incentive programs; eligibility for an incentive program is based on the type of position.
  • Benefits – We offer a wide array of benefits including medical, dental, vision, disability, and life insurance, along with a robust retirement program that includes an employer match and automatic contribution. As a mark of our commitment to employee well-being, we also offer an employee assistance program, employee wellness program and telemedicine, and medical consultation.
  • Professional Development – You can join one of our many Employee Resource Groups (ERG) or be a mentor/mentee in our professional mentoring program. Heart U is the Association’s national online university, with more than 100,000 resources designed to meet your needs and busy schedule.
  • Work-Life Harmonization – The Association offers Paid Time Off (PTO) at a minimum of 16 days per year for new employees. The number of days will increase based on seniority level. You will also have a total of 12 paid holidays off each year, which includes several days off at the end of the year.
  • Tuition Assistance - We support the career development of all employees. This program provides financial assistance to employees who wish to further their education and career in relation to their current duties and responsibilities, or for potential future positions in the organization.

The American Heart Association’s 2028 Goal: Building on over 100 years of trusted leadership in cardiovascular and brain health, by 2028 the Association will drive breakthroughs and implement proven solutions in science, policy, and care for healthier people and communities. The greatest discoveries in health must reach everyone where they are.

At American Heart Association | American Stroke Association, our mission is to be a relentless force for a world of longer, healthier lives, regardless of race, ethnicity, gender, gender identity, religion, age, language, sexual orientation, national origin and physical or cognitive abilities.

Location Designation: Hybrid - 3 days per week

Senior Associate - Data Architect

We are seeking an energetic and passionate Senior Data Architect to design and execute our company’s modern data management strategy. As a key member of Enterprise Data team, you will collaborate with Data Product Owners, Data Scientists, Data Engineers, and end-users to reimagine, design, and build the next generation of cloud-based insurance solutions using cutting-edge technologies like AWS, APIs, and AI.

 

What You’ll Do

  • Design scalable and efficient Logical and Physical data models for enterprise data products storage solutions and lines of businesses
  • Design operational and analytical data models
  • Develop data management frameworks and standards to ensure data integrity, quality, and security.
  • Works closely with Data Product Managers, Value Stream architects, Data engineers to understand the business problems, desired outcomes using data strategy and translating these requirements into data solutions.
  • Create and maintain inventory and designs of current state data capabilities
  • Ensure alignment of data models with end-to-end data architecture including performance tuning to adhere to SLAs.
  • Demonstrated experience as a change agent, successfully leading and implementing organizational change initiatives that drive transformation and improve business outcomes.
  • Identify and frame opportunities for consolidation / simplification of legacy technologies, data stores, and applications.
  • Build subject matter expertise to be able to answer business questions as well as support new initiatives from a data knowledge perspective
  • Enforce data governance policies and procedures as part of the data model
  • Stay up to date with the latest industry trends and technologies in data management.
  • Identify opportunities for improvement and innovation within the existing data infrastructure.
  • Ensure data solutions comply with relevant data privacy and security regulations.
  • Implement data security measures to protect sensitive information.

 

What You’ll Bring

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience as a Data Modeler for large-scale enterprise solutions, with a strong focus on agile practices.
  • Deep understanding of modern data architecture, including experience with data lakes, data warehouses, data marts, relational and dimensional modeling, data quality, and master data management.
  • Strong background in Operational Data Stores, Dimensional Modeling, and supporting application data architecture. Experience with Oracle, Postgres, MySQL, and understanding of best practice architectural concepts for relational data models.
  • Experience in designing, deploying, and evaluating tools, frameworks, and patterns for scalable data platforms.
  • Extensive experience with industry-leading data platform technologies such as Data Lake, Databricks, Snowflake
  • Experience with database technologies for both structured and unstructured data, ensuring optimal storage and retrieval.
  • Extensive hands-on experience in creating STMs
  • Proficient in cloud architecture and best practices, particularly with AWS Cloud tools such as Amazon RDS, Redshift, AWS DMS, AWS Glue, Amazon S3, AWS Lambda, and more.
  • Proficient in managing large datasets, cloud computing, open-source tools, and optimization techniques.
  • Expertise in overall solution architecture for data platforms built on the cloud.
  • Strong experience in data integration, data processing, data streaming, and message queuing techniques
  • Familiarity with relevant code repository and project tools like GitHub, JIRA, Confluence.
  • Experience with Continuous Integration and Continuous Deployment (CI/CD) processes.
  • Detail-oriented with strong analytical, problem-solving, and organizational skills.
  • Excellent communication skills, capable of effectively conveying complex concepts both technical and business teams.

 

Desired Skills

  • Solid understanding of the insurance, wealth management or financial services industry
  • Extensive hands-on development experience with Cloud (AWS, Azure) and Storage services are desirable.
  • Knowledge of machine learning pipelines and frameworks is a plus.
  • Experience supporting AI solutions with data product strategy and enabling solutions.
  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science or an Engineering discipline
  • Certification in data management (structure and unstructured), and/or cloud architecture or engineering a plus
  • Certification in delivery methodologies such as Scaled Agile a plus.

Pay Transparency

Salary Range: $124,000-$177,000

Overtime eligible: Exempt

Discretionary bonus eligible: Yes

Sales bonus eligible: No

Actual base salary will be determined based on several factors but not limited to individual’s experience, skills, qualifications, and job location. Additionally, employees are eligible for an annual discretionary bonus. In addition to base salary, employees may also be eligible to participate in an incentive program.

Our diverse business portfolio creates opportunities to make a difference across industries and communities—inviting bold thinking, collaborative problem-solving, and purpose-driven innovation. Our Benefits

Based on feedback from our employees, we continue to refine and add benefits to our offering, so that you can flourish both inside and outside of work. Our Commitment to Inclusion

At New York Life, fostering an inclusive workplace is fundamental to who we are and how we serve our communities. descriptionHtml:
About ParetoHealth

ParetoHealth is redefining the way employers fund healthcare. As the largest and fastest-growing benefits captive in the United States, we help thousands of small and midsize employers take control of healthcare costs through a smarter, more sustainable model.

Our mission is simple: give small and midsize employers the scale and protection they need to eliminate volatility and lower healthcare costs.

By combining data-driven insights, innovative risk management, and the collective purchasing power of our community, we enable employers to reduce volatility, improve long-term outcomes, and reinvest savings into their businesses and their people.

Headquartered in Philadelphia, ParetoHealth is growing rapidly and transforming one of the country's largest industries. Our success is fueled by talented people who are united by our four core values: Fire in the Belly, For the Greater Good, See the Field, and Get It Done Right. These values shape how we innovate, collaborate, make decisions, and deliver exceptional results for our clients and one another.

If you're energized by solving complex challenges, thrive in a high-growth environment, and want to help reshape the future of healthcare, we'd love to meet you.

Please note that ParetoHealth does not provide employment visa sponsorship for this position. Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States without sponsorship both now or in the future.

Position Summary:

As Principal Data Architect, you will define and drive the enterprise data architecture strategy across ParetoHealth, enabling trusted, connected, secure, and AI-ready data products that power business intelligence, advanced analytics, and intelligent automation.

You will work across business, product, engineering, analytics, and AI teams to translate complex business needs into scalable data platforms and architectures. You will bring deep expertise in modern data architecture, strong technical judgment, and the ability to navigate complex data ecosystems, ideally within healthcare, health insurance, employee benefits, or financial services.

This is a hands-on architecture leadership role for someone who can think strategically, influence across the organization, and drive implementation from vision to execution.

Key Responsbilities:

Enterprise Data Architecture & Strategy

  • Define and evolve the enterprise data architecture, data models, integration patterns, and technology standards to support ParetoHealth’s business and technology strategy.
  • Design scalable, resilient, and cost-effective data architectures across operational systems, analytical platforms, and data products.
  • Establish canonical data models and shared business entities across domains, enabling consistent definitions and reliable data exchange.
  • Drive architectural decisions that balance immediate business needs with long-term scalability, flexibility, and maintainability.

Modern Data Platforms & Engineering

  • Architect modern cloud-based data platforms and lakehouse or warehouse solutions that support batch, streaming, and near-real-time data processing.
  • Establish patterns for data ingestion, transformation, orchestration, data quality, metadata management, lineage, and observability.
  • Enable interoperable data products and APIs that make trusted data accessible to applications, analytics, and AI systems.
  • Partner with engineering teams to establish best practices for data modeling, platform reliability, performance, security, and cost optimization.

Healthcare & Insurance Data

  • Design data architectures that integrate complex, fragmented data across healthcare, health insurance, employee benefits, employer groups, claims, eligibility, provider networks, and financial systems, as applicable.
  • Develop a strong understanding of healthcare benefits and insurance business processes, data entities, and industry-specific interoperability requirements.
  • Enable secure and governed access to sensitive healthcare and personally identifiable information, incorporating HIPAA and other applicable regulatory and privacy requirements.
  • Translate complex healthcare and insurance data into consistent, usable models that support business operations, financial analysis, cost transparency, and better decision-making.

AI, Analytics & Data Products

  • Build an AI-ready data foundation that enables machine learning, generative AI, agentic workflows, and intelligent automation.
  • Define architectures for high-quality, contextual, discoverable, and governed data that can be safely consumed by AI applications.
  • Partner with data science, analytics, product, and engineering teams to enable predictive insights, operational intelligence, and data-driven product innovation.
  • Establish data product principles that emphasize business ownership, trusted metrics, reusability, and measurable business outcomes.

Technical Leadership & Governance

  • Serve as a trusted technical advisor to engineering, product, business, security, and executive stakeholders.
  • Define architectural standards, reference architectures, design principles, and technical roadmaps.
  • Drive alignment across teams and influence decisions without relying solely on formal authority.
  • Mentor senior engineers and data architects, raise the bar for technical excellence, and foster a culture of accountability and continuous improvement.
Required Qualifications / Skills: 
  • 12+ years of experience in data architecture, data engineering, data platforms, or related technical disciplines, with demonstrated experience leading enterprise-scale architecture.
  • Proven track record designing and implementing modern cloud data platforms and complex data integration architectures.
  • Strong expertise in data modeling, dimensional and relational modeling, distributed data processing, data pipelines, and data platform design.
  • Experience with modern data technologies such as Snowflake, Databricks, cloud-native data services, Kafka or equivalent streaming technologies, dbt, and contemporary orchestration tools.
  • Strong understanding of data governance, metadata, lineage, data quality, access controls, privacy, and security.
  • Experience architecting data platforms that support enterprise analytics, operational applications, and AI/ML use cases.
  • Ability to communicate complex technical concepts clearly and influence senior technical and business stakeholders.
  • Demonstrated ability to move from architecture strategy to practical implementation and measurable outcomes.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience in healthcare, health insurance, employee benefits, healthcare technology, or payer/provider ecosystems.
  • Familiarity with healthcare data standards and interoperability frameworks such as FHIR, HL7, X12, and relevant claims and eligibility data formats.
  • Experience working with sensitive healthcare or insurance data in regulated environments, including HIPAA compliance requirements.
  • Knowledge of healthcare economics, medical and pharmacy claims, stop-loss insurance, self-funded employer health plans, or benefits administration.
  • Experience building governed data products and AI-ready platforms that enable advanced analytics and intelligent automation.
  • Experience modernizing legacy data ecosystems and integrating data across acquisitions, multiple platforms, or fragmented enterprise systems.

Perks & Benefits:

  • Fully paid medical, dental, and vision benefits.
  • Flexible PTO
  • 401k company contribution
  • Tuition reimbursement
  • Professional development allowance
  • Transportation allowance and daily parking reimbursement 
  • Engaging hybrid work environment

Fire in the belly

The drive to learn, to improve, and to deliver outstanding value every day.

See the field

The ability to see the big picture and prepare to meet tomorrow’s needs.

Get it done right

The passion to produce at higher rates and to the highest standards.

For the greater good

A united community creating better health benefit solutions for all.
