Job Description

The Senior Data Architect is responsible for the design and implementation of enterprise data architecture, including databases, data platforms, data integration, data governance, security, analytics enablement, and intelligent automation solutions. This role provides technical leadership for modern data architectures that support business intelligence, advanced analytics, machine learning, and emerging AI-enabled capabilities.

What You Will Do

  • Develop strategies for data acquisitions, archive recovery and implementation of a data lakehouse.
  • Design and conceptual and logical fata models and flowcharts.
  • Design and develop a strategy for Data Archiving.
  • Develop database solutions to store and retrieve information.
  • Migrate data from legacy systems to new solutions.
  • Develops data lakehouse solutions by designing proposed system; defining database physical structure and functional capabilities, security, backup and recovery specifications.
  • Provides database support by coding utilities, responding to user questions and resolving problems.
  • Architect enterprise data platforms that support analytics, machine learning, intelligent automation, and emerging AI use cases.
  • Design and implement scalable data integration, metadata management, and governance solutions supporting enterprise data products.
  • Collaborate with business, analytics, engineering, and technology teams to translate business requirements into secure and scalable data architecture solutions.
  • Evaluate emerging technologies and architectural patterns related to data platforms, analytics, automation, and AI-enabled business solutions.
  • Provide technical leadership, architectural governance, and mentorship to data engineering and analytics teams.

What You Will Need

Education and Experience

  • 10 years of experience in database design and analysis including 6 years of experience in cloud-based data platform development.
  • Experience in Enterprise Database development with at least 3 years of data lakehouse design experience.
  • Typically requires a bachelor’s degree or recognized equivalent, from an accredited university, in a data processing discipline or equivalent industry experience.
  • Possesses a deep understanding of tools used throughout the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC).
  • Experience designing enterprise data platforms, data warehouses, data lakes, and modern cloud-based architecture solutions.
  • Hands-on experience with data integration, ETL/ELT, data pipeline, and data orchestration technologies.
  • Experience supporting business intelligence, advanced analytics, machine learning, and AI-enabled solutions.
  • Proficient in SQL and modern data engineering practices.
  • Experience with cloud platforms and large-scale data processing technologies is preferred.
  • Databricks Certified Generative AI Engineer Associate
  • Databricks Certified Context Engineering Associate
  • Databricks Certified Machine Learning Professional

Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities Required

  • Demonstrated ability to work well with others.
  • Proven capability to train employees in technically complex areas.
  • Proactive, energetic self-starter with good problem-solving skills.
  • Experience with modern cloud-based data platforms, data architecture frameworks, and Agile delivery methodologies.
  • Knowledge of enterprise data governance, metadata management, data security, and data quality practices.
  • Familiarity with analytics, machine learning, and AI-related data architecture requirements.
  • Ability to communicate complex technical concepts to both technical and business stakeholders.
  • Proven ability to provide architectural leadership and mentor technical teams.
  • Working knowledge of the ABS Health, Safety, Quality & Environmental Management System.

Reporting Relationships

This position reports to a Senior Manager, Director, or Executive level position.

We set out more than 160 years ago to promote the security of life and property at sea and preserve the natural environment. Today, we remain true to our mission and continue to support organizations facing a rapidly evolving seascape of challenging regulations and new technologies. Through it all, we are anchored by a vision and mission that help our clients find clarity in uncertain times.

We’re at the forefront of supporting the global energy transition at sea, the application of remote and autonomous marine systems, cutting-edge technical solutions, and many more exciting advancements. Our commitment to safety, reliability, and efficiency is ever-present, guiding our clients to safer and more efficient operations.

descriptionHtml:
Who We Are

At Kyndryl, we design, build, manage and modernize the mission-critical technology systems that the world depends on every day. So why work at Kyndryl? We are always moving forward – always pushing ourselves to go further in our efforts to build a more equitable, inclusive world for our employees, our customers and our communities.

The Role

Are you ready to join a team that is passionate about solving complex business problems with cutting-edge technology? Kyndryl is seeking a talented Data Architect who will take charge of all things data and information, transforming them into remarkable solutions that drive our customers’ success. Get ready to unleash your creative prowess and shape the future of data management. As a Data Architect with Kyndryl, you will play a vital role in managing all aspects of data and information, from understanding business requirements to translating them into data models scheme design and data architectures. Your expertise will be critical in guiding the full IT data lifecycle governance , including acquisition, transformation, classification, storage, presentation, distribution, security, privacy, and archiving to ensure data is accurate, complete and secure. You will work closely with our customers to design solutions and data architectures that address their unique business problems, considering their needs and constraints while applying your industry knowledge and expertise. You will have the opportunity to work with diverse technologies, like databases (relational, hierarchical and object-oriented), file systems and storage management, document imaging, knowledge and content management, taxonomies and business intelligence. All relevant for designing business-driven IT solutions that meet data requirements and incorporate cloud solutions for different types of storage needs. As a Data Architect, you will have the chance to develop and design centralized or distributed systems that both address user requirements and perform efficiently and effectively. You will ensure the viability of proposed solutions by conducting solution assurance assessments and work closely with the project team and key stakeholders to ensure that the final solution meets all customer requirements and expectations. At Kyndryl, you'll be part of a dynamic, forward-thinking team where creativity knows no bounds. Together, we'll shape the future of data architecture and revolutionize the way businesses thrive. Apply now and take the first step towards an exciting and rewarding career with Kyndryl. Your Future at Kyndryl Every position at Kyndryl offers a way forward to grow your career, from a Junior Architect to Principal Architect – we have opportunities for that you won’t find anywhere else, including hands-on experience, learning opportunities, and the chance to certify in all four major platforms.

Kyndryl currently does not require employees to be fully vaccinated against COVID-19, however, if you are hired to work at a client, customer, or partner location, you may be required to show proof of vaccination to align with their respective COVID-19 vaccination policies. Those who believe they are eligible may apply for a medical or religious accommodation prior to the start of employment.

Who You Are

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.

Required Technical And Professional Expertise

  • 7+ years of strong knowledge in data modeling, database design and data management best practice
  • Ability to architect, design and implement infrastructure and platforms from a data and storage perspective
  • Experience with programming languages, such as Python, C, C++ and Java

Preferred Technical And Professional Experience

  • Experience working with cloud based data platforms, data integration and governance framework with one of the three cloud technologies (Azure, AWS, or GCP)
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Security, or a related field

Job Description

Job summary

As a Senior Principal Data Architect at JPMorganChase within the IAM - Data Services Organization, you provide specialized expertise to influence the target state architecture and strategy. Work across teams to implement and advance the adoption of complex, strategic, global data architecture solutions that will give JPMorganChase a competitive advantage.

You will build a Data Services platform that connects scattered assurance data into one governed model. That model runs from control objectives through to evidence, findings and verified closure. In 2027 it will prove few use cases on a shared data foundation and semantic model before scaling firmwide . We're looking for an architect who has designed, built and operated semantic models for large-scale applications. You will own the enterprise semantic model at the center of this platform.

Job responsibilities

  • Own the design of the enterprise semantic model. This means stable entity identities, typed relationships, constraints and versioning across the chain Control Objective → Procedure → Application → Platform → Evidence → Finding → Closure.
  • Set and enforce firmwide standards for modelling, identity resolution, taxonomy and ontology. Work with function SMEs (for example IGA and PAM) to register domain taxonomies against a common core.
  • Decide when to use graph-native processing and when to use lakehouse/SQL processing, for traversal, impact analysis and graph analytics at scale.
  • Design how the semantic layer fits with the data lakehouse (Databricks bronze, silver and gold layers). That includes how gold contracts feed the graph and how lineage and provenance carry through.
  • Define data contract and schema evolution patterns so changes never surprise consumers.
  • Build point-in-time history into the model so audit evidence packs can be reproduced, and separate configuration evidence from operating evidence.
  • Make sure every output carries entitlements, data minimization and quality state (freshness, coverage, completeness, and whether a value was observed, inferred or derived). This applies to dashboards, APIs, data shares and conversational access.
  • Design deterministic, auditable context for AI agents, with clear control boundaries and human approval checkpoints.
  • Guide producer teams on silver and gold modelling and contract design, and deliver the 2027 proof points.
  • Present architecture decisions and trade-offs to senior technology, Risk and Audit stakeholders.

Required Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills

  • A proven record of designing, building and operating semantic models or knowledge graphs for large-scale enterprise applications: many source systems, high-volume entities and relationships, and multiple consuming applications in production.
  • Deep expertise in graph and semantic data modelling, covering entity and relationship design, ontology and taxonomy design, identity and entity resolution, constraint design, and temporal or bitemporal (point-in-time) modelling.
  • Hands-on experience with graph technologies and query languages, such as a property graph or RDF/OWL. You understand where recursive SQL breaks down for traversal, cycles and graph analytics.
  • Strong cloud-native data platform architecture experience, ideally on Databricks or another lakehouse with a bronze/silver/gold (medallion) layout. You can design how a lakehouse and a semantic layer work together.
  • Experience setting and running data contracts, schema versioning and change management across many producer teams.

This role requires deep expertise in distributed data systems, application and workflow integration, and analytic platforms, along with the ability to translate current-state constraints into forward-looking architectures. Experience using both traditional development and AI-assisted engineering tools is key. Act as an advisor to senior leadership to develop the architectural framework & delivery for highly complex business and technical needs across multiple groups

Lead the strategy and resolution of highly complex and unique challenges requiring in-depth evaluation across multiple areas or the enterprise, delivering products and solutions that are long-term, large-scale, and require vision, creativity, innovation, advanced analytical and inductive thinking

Provide vision, direction, and expertise to senior leadership on implementing the transformation strategy describing the current state, target state, and transition architecture

Develop and influence strategic plans, investment planning, and execution on cutover strategies to target

Strategically engage with all levels of professionals and managers across the enterprise and serve as an architectural domain expert advisor to leadership 

Drive target investments towards target technologies and rationalize spend, total cost of ownership, and return on investment

Ensure applications adhere to established Wells Fargo standards, policies, methodologies, and industry best practices as it transforms toward target state architecture

Drive the definition, establishment, selection of strategic tools, and application of architecture frameworks

Maintain knowledge of industry best practices and new technologies and recommends innovations that enhance operations or provide a competitive advantage to the organization and can influence internal and vendor roadmaps in a significant capacity

  • Expertise in data modeling, including conceptual, logical, physical, dimensional, canonical, domain-driven, and event-based models
  • Strong knowledge of data security architecture, including encryption, tokenization, masking, access controls, entitlement models, secrets management, and audit logging
  • Ability to define and evaluate non-functional technical requirements, including latency, throughput, scalability, availability, resiliency, recovery, observability, security, and maintainability
  • Familiarity with designing data architectures that support AI, machine learning, feature engineering, model training, retrieval-augmented generation, vector search, and analytical workloads

Standard Job Description

Join Lockheed Martin’s Data & AI Enablement organization and accelerate the company’s AI transformation. As a lead data architect, you will drive the creation of logical data models that underpin our next‑generation data products and enterprise ontology. You will partner with Data Product Owners by architecting data models, data pipelines and ontologies, and ensure consistent semantic definitions across the Enterprise Data Ecosystem (EDE). The role operates in a Databricks‑centric environment, integrating source systems such as SAP and Apriso upstream, and powering AI agents and analytics applications downstream. By governing and expanding the semantic layer of the corporate data foundation, you will play a key role in the company’s AI transformation.

Key Responsibilities

  • Partner with Data Product Owners to capture business requirements and create robust logical data models.
  • Design federated ontologies and knowledge‑graph structures that enrich data products and support AI agents, AI reasoning, and analytics applications.
  • Ensure models deliver clean, well‑documented feature sets for machine‑learning pipelines; work with data scientists to embed model‑ready attributes (feature stores, lineage metadata).
  • Define logical representations for SAP, Apriso, and other source systems and guide ingestion patterns that preserve semantic integrity.
  • Produce architecture artifacts (diagrams, data dictionaries, ontology catalogs) and enforce data‑quality, security, and lineage standards.
  • Design data entities in a way so that they can be productized to ensure they meet the requirements of their documented use cases.
  • Collaborate with the Lead Data Engineer to validate designs.
  • Continuously improve modeling processes, promote ontology reuse, and stay current on semantic‑modeling and Databricks advancements.
  • Advise on the technology stack used in team operations.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s (or higher) in Computer Science, Systems Engineering, Information Management, or a related field.
  • 10 + years of large-scale data architecture/engineering experience, with at least 5 years focused on productizing data assets for enterprise consumption.
  • Significant experience designing/operationalizing ontologies.
  • Demonstrated ability to probe for and understand core customer needs as opposed to surface-level needs.
  • Strong programming skills in Python and SQL; proficient with Spark (PySpark/Scala) and deep experience with AI-assisted development.
  • Experience with data‑integration/orchestration tools (e.g., NiFi, Airflow) for pipeline development.
  • Must be a US Citizen.

Desired Skills

  • Experience with Databricks (Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, Jobs/Workflows).
  • Experience with federated data models and ontologies.
  • Excellent interpersonal and collaboration skills for cross‑functional teamwork and internal‑customer support.
  • Master’s degree or advanced technical training (optional).
  • Databricks certifications (Data Engineer Associate/Professional) or comparable big‑data credentials.
  • Experience developing applications leveraging genAI.

  • Competitive compensation and equity options
  • Health, dental, and vision insurance coverage
  • Short-term disability and basic life coverage
  • Flexible Spending Accounts (FSAs)

  • These benefits are available to full-time, regular employees, and not to independent contractors, part-time employees, temporary employees, or interns.

We are proud to be an equal-opportunity workplace committed to building a team culture that celebrates diversity and inclusion. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions. Title: Enterprise Data Architect

Reports to: Director of Information Systems

Supervises: NA

Status: Exempt

Objective

The Enterprise Data Architect is responsible for defining, designing, implementing, and governing the organization's enterprise data architecture. This role serves as the technical authority for data architecture, integration, governance, quality, reporting, and analytics enablement.

The Enterprise Data Architect establishes enterprise standards and best practices to ensure data is secure, accurate, accessible, consistent, and aligned with business objectives. Working closely with business leaders, technology teams, information security, compliance, and third-party partners, this position supports enterprise reporting, analytics, operational decision-making, and strategic initiatives.

The ideal candidate combines hands-on technical expertise with strategic thinking and demonstrated experience designing scalable data solutions, advancing data governance practices, and enabling enterprise business intelligence and analytics capabilities.

Duties And Responsibilities

Enterprise Data Architecture

  • Designs, implements, and maintains enterprise data architectures, including logical and physical data models, data warehouses, reporting layers, data marts, analytics environments, and integration platforms
  • Develops and maintains enterprise data architecture roadmaps aligned with organizational strategy, technology modernization, security requirements, compliance obligations, and business priorities
  • Establishes standards and best practices for data modeling, naming conventions, business definitions, metadata, lineage, master and reference data, integration, and data quality
  • Evaluates existing data environments and recommends improvements that increase scalability, reliability, performance, maintainability, and usability
  • Translates business requirements into logical data designs, physical models, source-to-target mappings, data structures, and technical specifications
  • Partners with application, infrastructure, security, compliance, and business teams to ensure data solutions are effectively designed, documented, integrated, and governed

Data Governance and Data Management

  • Supports and advances enterprise data governance policies, standards, processes, and decision rights
  • Defines and documents data ownership, stewardship responsibilities, business rules, critical data elements, system-of-record decisions, retention, classification, and access standards
  • Improves data accuracy, completeness, consistency, timeliness, and trust through measurable data quality rules and controls
  • Develops monitoring, issue identification, escalation, and remediation processes for data quality concerns
  • Supports audit, regulatory, privacy, and compliance requirements related to enterprise data management

Data Integration and Platform Architecture

  • Designs ETL/ELT frameworks, data pipelines, APIs, batch and real-time integrations, and enterprise data exchange patterns
  • Architects and reviews data movement among core systems, third-party applications, reporting environments, data warehouses, and analytics platforms
  • Optimizes data structures, queries, pipelines, and reporting layers for performance, resilience, and scalability
  • Evaluates and recommends enhancements to cloud data platforms, data warehouses, data lakes, lakehouses, BI semantic layers, and integration tools
  • Establishes standards for pipeline monitoring, logging, error handling, recovery, documentation, and operational support

Business Intelligence and Analytics Enablement

  • Designs and supports enterprise reporting, dashboards, key performance indicators, semantic models, and analytics solutions
  • Ensures reporting and analytics products are built on governed, validated, and well-documented data sources
  • Defines standards for metrics, measures, calculations, dashboard design, semantic modeling, and self-service analytics
  • Partners with business stakeholders to identify reporting and analytics needs and translate them into scalable solutions
  • Reduces redundant reporting and inconsistent definitions by promoting shared metrics and governed data assets

Security, Risk, and Compliance

  • Ensures enterprise data architectures and reporting solutions align with information security, privacy, audit, and regulatory requirements
  • Partners with Information Security and Compliance teams to establish role-based access, data classification, encryption, retention, monitoring, and auditing controls
  • Supports the secure handling of sensitive, confidential, member or customer, financial, and operational data
  • Maintains documentation required for audits, examinations, regulatory reviews, risk assessments, and internal controls

Core Expectations

  • Maintains compliance with applicable laws, regulations, and KEMBA policies, procedures, and standards
  • Demonstrates a comprehensive understanding of KEMBA's mission, values, organizational structure, products, services, policies, and operational procedures
  • Pursues continuous professional development through ongoing training, education, certification programs, and industry learning opportunities
  • Fosters professional and collaborative working relationships with members, associates, leaders, and business partners
  • Exhibits professionalism, accountability, adaptability, and a commitment to excellence in all responsibilities and interactions
  • Supports KEMBA's commitment to service excellence, collaboration, continuous improvement, and operational effectiveness
  • Contributes to organizational initiatives and successfully executes additional responsibilities as assigned

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Management, Analytics, Engineering, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Seven or more years of experience in data architecture, data engineering, data warehousing, business intelligence, analytics, enterprise data management, or related disciplines, including experience designing enterprise-scale data architecture and data solutions.
  • Demonstrated expertise in enterprise data architecture, including logical and physical data modeling, data warehousing, data integration, metadata management, data lineage, master and reference data management, and reporting architecture.
  • Experience designing and supporting ETL/ELT frameworks, data pipelines, APIs, and batch or real-time integration solutions.
  • Strong understanding of data governance, stewardship, data quality frameworks, security controls, privacy requirements, and regulatory compliance practices.
  • Experience working with relational databases, SQL, cloud data platforms, business intelligence tools, and modern analytics environments.
  • Ability to translate business requirements into scalable architecture, integration, reporting, and analytics solutions while effectively communicating technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Experience supporting enterprise reporting, semantic modeling, KPI development, dashboard solutions, and self-service analytics capabilities.
  • Experience in financial services, banking, credit unions, fintech, or other regulated industries preferred.
  • Relevant certifications in data architecture, cloud platforms, database technologies, data governance, or analytics are desirable.

Working Conditions

  • Primarily office-based or hybrid work environment.
  • Occasional evening or weekend work may be required to support implementations, testing, upgrades, or production issues.

Physical Demands

The physical demands listed below represent those necessary to perform the essential functions of this role. Reasonable accommodation may be provided to enable individuals with disabilities to perform these functions.

The employee is regularly required to sit, use their hands, reach with arms, and communicate verbally and orally. Occasional standing, walking, and lifting of objects up to 25 pounds are required. Vision requirements include close, distance vision, and focus adjustment.

Laptop: Yes

Hybrid Work: Yes

Cell Phone Reimbursement: Yes

Vehicle Reimbursement: No

Incentive(s): No

Equal Opportunity Employer/Vet/Disabled

descriptionHtml:
About Egen:

Egen is a fast-growing and entrepreneurial company with a data-first mindset. We bring together the best engineering talent working with the most advanced technology platforms, including Google Cloud and Salesforce, to help clients drive action and impact through data and insights. We are committed to being a place where the best people choose to work so they can apply their engineering and technology expertise to envision what is next for how data and platforms can change the world for the better. We are dedicated to learning, thrive on solving tough problems, and continually innovate to achieve fast, effective results. If this describes you, we want you on our team.

Want to learn more about life at Egen? Check out these resources in addition to the job description.

Meet Egen

Life at Egen

Culture and Values at Egen

Career Development at Egen

Benefits at Egen

Responsibilities

  • Lead the end-to-end architecture, design, and implementation of scalable Data Lakehouse solutions on Google Cloud Platform (GCP) using BigQuery, GCS, BigLake, and Dataplex
  • Collaborate directly with customers to understand business goals, data challenges, and technical requirements; translate them into robust architectural blueprints and actionable plans
  • Design and implement data pipelines supporting both real-time and batch ingestion using modern orchestration and streaming frameworks
  • Establish and enforce best practices for data cataloging, metadata management, lineage, and data quality across multiple systems
  • Define and implement data security, access control, and governance models in compliance with enterprise and regulatory standards
  • Serve as the technical lead for project teams - mentoring engineers, reviewing solutions, and ensuring architectural consistency across deliverables
  • Balance strategic architecture discussions with hands-on solutioning, POCs, and deep dives into data pipelines or performance tuning
  • Partner with stakeholders, cloud architects, and delivery leads to drive solution adoption, scalability, and long-term maintainability
  • Represent the company as a trusted technical advisor in client engagements - clearly articulating trade-offs, best practices, and recommendations


Qualifications

  • Must be willing to go on-site at least 1-2 times per month
  • 8-10 years of progressive experience in Software Engineering and Data Platform development, with 5+ years architecting data platforms on GCP and/or Databricks
  • Proven hands-on experience designing and deploying Data Lakehouse platforms with data products and medallion architectures
  • Strong understanding of data ingestion patterns (real-time and batch), ETL/ELT pipeline design, and data orchestration using tools such as Airflow, Pub/Sub, or similar frameworks
  • Expertise in data modeling, storage optimization, partitioning, and performance tuning for large-scale analytical workloads
  • Experience implementing data governance, security, and cataloging solutions (Dataplex, Data Catalog, IAM, or equivalent)
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills - able to confidently engage with technical and non-technical stakeholders and guide clients through solution decisions
  • Demonstrated ability to lead by example in mixed teams of engineers, analysts, and architects, balancing architectural vision with hands-on delivery
  • Nice to have: Experience with Databricks (Delta Lake, Unity Catalog) and hybrid GCP-Databricks data architectures
  • Strong problem-solving mindset, curiosity to explore new technologies, and ability to “zoom out” for architecture discussions and “zoom in” for code-level troubleshooting


Compensation & Benefits:

This role is eligible for our competitive salary and comprehensive benefits package to support your well-being:

  • Comprehensive Health Insurance
  • Paid Leave (Vacation/PTO)
  • Paid Holidays
  • Sick Leave
  • Parental Leave
  • Bereavement Leave
  • 401 (k) Employer Match
  • Employee Referral Bonuses


Check out our complete list of benefits here - >https://egen.ai/people/#benefits

Important: All roles are subject to standard hiring verification practices, which may include background checks, employment verification, and other relevant checks.

EEO and Accommodations:

Egen is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to inclusion, diversity, and equity in the workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veterans’ status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. Egen will also consider qualified applications with criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. Egen welcomes and encourages applications from individuals with disabilities. Reasonable accommodations are available for candidates during all aspects of the selection process. Please advise the talent acquisition team if you require accommodations during the interview process.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

This position may be hired at multiple levels. Final leveling is determined during the interview process based on a candidate's experience, skills, and interview outcomes, and the applicable salary range will align with the final level assigned.

Compensation is determined based on factors including experience, expertise, interview performance, and geographic location, where applicable.

Total compensation also includes an annual bonus, on top of the base salary.

descriptionHtml:
This is OUR story... and YOUR next chapter

At HCA Healthcare, our Digital Transformation and Innovation (DT&I) team is redefining what’s possible inpatient care. By leveraging the power of artificial intelligence, automation, and digital technologies, DT&I is helping drive meaningful improvements in clinical outcomes, reduce manual workload, and expand the reach of our care teams. If you're passionate about using technology to improve human life, this is where your work truly matters

What you will accomplish in this role

Job Summary

HCA Healthcare is looking for an experienced and innovative Data Modeler to lead the design and implementation of scalable, secure, and high-performance data products on Google Cloud. In this role, you will be at the forefront of transforming raw data into actionable insights by creating robust architectures that integrate seamlessly into our enterprise ecosystem.

The Data Modeler will play a critical role in bridging the gap between business needs and technical solutions. You will work closely with Data Product Owners to understand product requirements, ensure alignment with business goals, and design solutions that meet operational and analytical needs.

This position requires a deep understanding of the architecture of business data source systems, their structures, communication protocols, and interfaces. The ideal candidate will demonstrate a mastery of data analysis, logical data modeling, and the ability to identify opportunities for data reuse and transformation. You will design data architectures that address gaps, optimize performance, and enforce enterprise standards in cybersecurity, governance, and compliance.

As a key contributor to HCA’s data strategy, you will also develop and maintain a comprehensive data architecture roadmap, ensuring alignment with business priorities and evolving technology trends. By integrating advanced analytics and machine learning capabilities, you will help HCA Healthcare maximize the value of its data to improve clinical outcomes and operational efficiency.

What you will do:

Perform advanced data analysis to inform design decisions and ensure alignment with business needs. Create logical data models or object models of moderate complexity to address business challenges. Identify redundant data objects and reusable data items across systems and applications. Define data transformation requirements and implement efficient solutions. Implement enterprise data management practices, standards, and frameworks for Data Integration Ensure data governance and security best practices are followed. Participate in code reviews and provide feedback on SQL queries and ETL pipelines

Build automated validation processes for data integrity checks

What qualifications you will need:

  • Bachelor's degree Computer Science or a related field required
  • Master's degree Computer Science or a related field preferred
  • 3+ years of experience in data management, data products, or analytics required
  • Service and Quality Excellence: Ability to demonstrate an uncompromising commitment to delivering exceptional care to create an unmatched value proposition for our patients required
  • Proficiency in SQL and database design
  • Ability to write, tune, and interpret SQL queries; Experience GCP Big Query is a plus
  • Experience with GIT and GitHub version control.
  • Extensive experience in architecture, construction, and implementation of data-intensive solutions
  • Strong understanding of metadata management and data cataloging
  • Adeptness to learn new assignments, technologies and applications quickly and manage multiple assignments simultaneously
  • Ability to troubleshoot, maintain, reverse engineer and optimize existing ETL pipelines.
  • Familiarity with Python, GCP Dataflow and Cloud Composer is a plus
  • Ability to analyze and interpret complex data, and offer solutions to complex clinical problems.
  • Ability to work independently on assigned tasks.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills including the ability to explain complex technical issues in a way that non-technical people may understand.
  • Excellent problem-solving and critical thinking skills.
  • Knowledge of IT governance and operations.
  • Honor our Mission and Values: Ability to build trust and act with authenticity to cultivate a culture of integrity, inclusion, and mutual respect required
  • Effective Decision Making: Ability to make timely, informed decisions that are in the best interest of our patients, employees, providers, community and HCA required

Work Location/Schedule:

  • Nashville, TN (near Centennial Park)
  • Onsite M-F for the fist 6 months, then Hybrid with 2 days onsite/wk.

Travel Required:

  • The job may require travel from time- to-time, but not on a regular basis

At HCA Healthcare, we are committed to fostering a culture of growth that allows you to build the career of a lifetime. We encourage you to apply for our Data Modeler today. We review all applications promptly, and qualified candidates will be contacted to continue the process. Join us!

We are an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

descriptionHtml:
Modernizing and scaling enterprise data infrastructure requires sophisticated architecture that bridges traditional data modeling with contemporary lakehouse frameworks. This role resolves complex data fragmentation, storage tiering inefficiencies, and compute cost overruns across cloud environments to establish performant, enterprise-grade data assets. Crucially, this work unlocks advanced AI capabilities by designing architectures for unstructured data, vector databases, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and semantic layers. Through cross-functional governance and technical leadership, enterprise data assets become securely managed, highly scalable, and fully aligned with strategic goals.

What Success Looks Like (Objectives)

  • Establish and maintain corporate data model design principles; integrating Kimball and Inmon methodologies with Medallion Lakehouse patterns to deliver performant data assets
  • Architect scalable frameworks and storage tiering to support AI initiatives; including vector databases, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and enterprise semantic layers
  • Lead efforts in optimizing query execution, cluster compute, and cloud warehouse costs across enterprise platforms
  • Partner with enterprise architects, data engineering, and business analysis teams to enforce data governance standards and execute data SDLC phases
  • Define data integration solutions and mitigate infrastructure risks to deliver scalable, highly available enterprise data architecture

Core Skills, Competencies, and Key Experiences (What you’ll bring)

  • Advanced AI Application expertise; leveraging unstructured data frameworks, vector databases, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) within modern data architectures
  • Critical experience in designing multi-tier enterprise data structures, Medallion patterns, and high-performance data lakehouse architectures
  • Strong skills in data modeling, schema design, and versioning within multi-modeler repository environments
  • Critical experience in cloud warehouse cost optimization, cluster compute tuning, and query performance enhancement
  • Expertise in data governance, fine-grained access control (ABAC), data lineage, and compliance standards such as CPNI, CCPA, and SOC2
  • Exceptional problem solving, collaboration, and cross-functional decision-making capabilities across technical and business stakeholders

Additional Qualifications

  • Preferred industry certifications including Snowflake Certified Architect, Databricks Professional, or AWS Data Engineer

Candidates must be willing to participate in at least one in-person interview.

Minimum Requirements

  • Minimum Education: Bachelor's degree in a technical discipline, preferably in Computer Science or Software Engineering, or equivalent combination of education and experience
  • Minimum Experience: 10 years of continuous data architecture and data modeling experience; with at least 3 recent years leading primary data architecture design and implementation in a VLDB / MPP environment
  • Required Technical Skills:
    • 2 years of experience with Azure, AWS, or GCP cloud environments
    • 1 year of experience with Databricks & Genie and/or Snowflake & Cortex
    • 1 year of experience with orchestration tools such as Apache Airflow or Control-M
Visa sponsorship not available for this position

Salary Range

Compensation: $127,050.00/Year - $181,500.00/Year

descriptionHtml:
Job Requisition ID: 94704

Location Designation: Hybrid - 3 days per week

Business Unit

Technology, Data, AI and Ventures (TDAV)

Within the Tech, Data, AI, Ventures (TDAV) organization, our work is guided by a shared vision: deploying the power of technology, data, AI and ventures to accelerate sustainable competitive advantage for New York Life's businesses. We build solutions that power how we serve policy owners, agents, advisors and employees while delivering measurable business outcomes.

Across technology, data, AI, cyber, product, digital experience, architecture and infrastructure, TDAV combines the scale and investment of an industry leader, access to leading-edge technologies and the opportunity to help shape how a world-class financial services company competes in the AI era — all backed by the stability and purpose of a mutual company built to last.

Corporate Vice President - Data Architect

We are seeking an energetic and passionate Senior Data Architect to design and execute our company’s modern data management strategy. As a key member of Enterprise Data team, you will collaborate with Data Product Owners, Data Scientists, Data Engineers, and end-users to reimagine, design, and build the next generation of cloud-based insurance solutions using cutting-edge technologies like AWS, APIs, and AI.

What You’ll Do

  • Design scalable and efficient Logical and Physical data models for enterprise data products storage solutions and lines of businesses
  • Design operational and analytical data models
  • Develop data management frameworks and standards to ensure data integrity, quality, and security.
  • Works closely with Data Product Managers, Value Stream architects, Data engineers to understand the business problems, desired outcomes using data strategy and translating these requirements into data solutions.
  • Create and maintain inventory and designs of current state data capabilities
  • Ensure alignment of data models with end-to-end data architecture including performance tuning to adhere to SLAs.
  • Demonstrated experience as a change agent, successfully leading and implementing organizational change initiatives that drive transformation and improve business outcomes.
  • Identify and frame opportunities for consolidation / simplification of legacy technologies, data stores, and applications.
  • Build subject matter expertise to be able to answer business questions as well as support new initiatives from a data knowledge perspective
  • Enforce data governance policies and procedures as part of the data model
  • Stay up to date with the latest industry trends and technologies in data management.
  • Identify opportunities for improvement and innovation within the existing data infrastructure.
  • Ensure data solutions comply with relevant data privacy and security regulations.
  • Implement data security measures to protect sensitive information.

What You’ll Bring

  • 8+ years of hands-on experience as a Data Architect for large-scale enterprise solutions, with a strong focus on agile practices.
  • Deep understanding of modern data architecture, including experience with data lakes, data warehouses, data marts, relational and dimensional modeling, data quality, and master data management.
  • Strong background in Operational Data Stores, Dimensional Modeling, and supporting application data architecture. Experience with Oracle, Postgres, MySQL, and understanding of best practice architectural concepts for relational data models.
  • Experience in designing, deploying, and evaluating tools, frameworks, and patterns for scalable data platforms.
  • Extensive experience with industry-leading data platform technologies such as Data Lake, Databricks, Snowflake
  • Experience with database technologies for both structured and unstructured data, ensuring optimal storage and retrieval.
  • Extensive hands-on experience in creating STMs
  • Proficient in cloud architecture and best practices, particularly with AWS Cloud tools such as Amazon RDS, Redshift, AWS DMS, AWS Glue, Amazon S3, AWS Lambda, and more.
  • Proficient in managing large datasets, cloud computing, open-source tools, and optimization techniques.
  • Expertise in overall solution architecture for data platforms built on the cloud.
  • Strong experience in data integration, data processing, data streaming, and message queuing techniques
  • Familiarity with relevant code repository and project tools like GitHub, JIRA, Confluence.
  • Experience with Continuous Integration and Continuous Deployment (CI/CD) processes.
  • Detail-oriented with strong analytical, problem-solving, and organizational skills.
  • Excellent communication skills, capable of effectively conveying complex concepts both technical and business teams.

Desired Skills

  • Solid understanding of the insurance, wealth management or financial services industry
  • Extensive hands-on development experience with Cloud (AWS, Azure) and Storage services are desirable.
  • Knowledge of machine learning pipelines and frameworks is a plus.
  • Experience supporting AI solutions with data product strategy and enabling solutions.
  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science or an Engineering discipline
  • Certification in data management (structure and unstructured), and/or cloud architecture or engineering a plus
  • Certification in delivery methodologies such as Scaled Agile a plus.

Pay Transparency

Salary Range: $147,500-$211,000

Overtime eligible: Exempt

Discretionary bonus eligible: Yes

Sales bonus eligible: No

Actual base salary will be determined based on several factors but not limited to individual’s experience, skills, qualifications, and job location. Additionally, employees are eligible for an annual discretionary bonus. In addition to base salary, employees may also be eligible to participate in an incentive program.

Company Overview

At New York Life, our 180-year legacy of purpose and integrity fuels our future. As we evolve into a more technology-, data-, and AI-enabled organization, we remain grounded in the values that drive lasting impact.

Our diverse business portfolio creates opportunities to make a difference across industries and communities—inviting bold thinking, collaborative problem-solving, and purpose-driven innovation. Here, you’ll find the rare balance of long-standing stability and forward momentum, supported by an inclusive team that honors tradition while embracing progress.

As a Fortune 100 mutual company, we offer a place to grow your skills, contribute to meaningful work, and deliver solutions that matter. Your ideas drive what’s next, and your growth powers it.

Our Benefits

We provide a full package of benefits for employees – and have unique offerings for a modern workforce, including leave programs, adoption assistance, and student loan repayment programs. Based on feedback from our employees, we continue to refine and add benefits to our offering, so that you can flourish both inside and outside of work. Click here to discover more about our comprehensive benefit options or visit our NYL Benefits Site.

Our Commitment to Inclusion

At New York Life, fostering an inclusive workplace is fundamental to who we are and how we serve our communities. We have a longstanding commitment to creating an environment where individuals can contribute their best and succeed together. This foundation is rooted in our core values of humanity and integrity, ensuring that every employee feels valued and supported. Corporate Vice President - Data Architect

We are seeking an energetic and passionate Senior Data Architect to design and execute our company’s modern data management strategy. As a key member of Enterprise Data team, you will collaborate with Data Product Owners, Data Scientists, Data Engineers, and end-users to reimagine, design, and build the next generation of cloud-based insurance solutions using cutting-edge technologies like AWS, APIs, and AI.

What You’ll Do



- Design scalable and efficient Logical and Physical data models for enterprise data products storage solutions and lines of businesses
- Design operational and analytical data models
- Develop data management frameworks and standards to ensure data integrity, quality, and security.
- Works closely with Data Product Managers, Value Stream architects, Data engineers to understand the business problems, desired outcomes using data strategy and translating these requirements into data solutions.
- Create and maintain inventory and designs of current state data capabilities
- Ensure alignment of data models with end-to-end data architecture including performance tuning to adhere to SLAs.
- Demonstrated experience as a change agent, successfully leading and implementing organizational change initiatives that drive transformation and improve business outcomes.
- Identify and frame opportunities for consolidation / simplification of legacy technologies, data stores, and applications.
- Build subject matter expertise to be able to answer business questions as well as support new initiatives from a data knowledge perspective
- Enforce data governance policies and procedures as part of the data model
- Stay up to date with the latest industry trends and technologies in data management.
- Identify opportunities for improvement and innovation within the existing data infrastructure.
- Ensure data solutions comply with relevant data privacy and security regulations.
- Implement data security measures to protect sensitive information.

What You’ll Bring



- 8+ years of hands-on experience as a Data Architect for large-scale enterprise solutions, with a strong focus on agile practices.
- Deep understanding of modern data architecture, including experience with data lakes, data warehouses, data marts, relational and dimensional modeling, data quality, and master data management.
- Strong background in Operational Data Stores, Dimensional Modeling, and supporting application data architecture. Experience with Oracle, Postgres, MySQL, and understanding of best practice architectural concepts for relational data models.
- Experience in designing, deploying, and evaluating tools, frameworks, and patterns for scalable data platforms.
- Extensive experience with industry-leading data platform technologies such as Data Lake, Databricks, Snowflake
- Experience with database technologies for both structured and unstructured data, ensuring optimal storage and retrieval.
- Extensive hands-on experience in creating STMs
- Proficient in cloud architecture and best practices, particularly with AWS Cloud tools such as Amazon RDS, Redshift, AWS DMS, AWS Glue, Amazon S3, AWS Lambda, and more.
- Proficient in managing large datasets, cloud computing, open-source tools, and optimization techniques.
- Expertise in overall solution architecture for data platforms built on the cloud.
- Strong experience in data integration, data processing, data streaming, and message queuing techniques
- Familiarity with relevant code repository and project tools like GitHub, JIRA, Confluence.
- Experience with Continuous Integration and Continuous Deployment (CI/CD) processes.
- Detail-oriented with strong analytical, problem-solving, and organizational skills.
- Excellent communication skills, capable of effectively conveying complex concepts both technical and business teams.

Desired Skills



- Solid understanding of the insurance, wealth management or financial services industry
- Extensive hands-on development experience with Cloud (AWS, Azure) and Storage services are desirable.
- Knowledge of machine learning pipelines and frameworks is a plus.
- Experience supporting AI solutions with data product strategy and enabling solutions.
- Bachelor’s degree in computer science or an Engineering discipline
- Certification in data management (structure and unstructured), and/or cloud architecture or engineering a plus
- Certification in delivery methodologies such as Scaled Agile a plus.

descriptionHtml:
The Data Architect III designs, develops, and implements scalable enterprise data architectures that support business operations, analytics, reporting, artificial intelligence, and digital transformation initiatives. This role serves as a senior technical contributor responsible for data modeling, integration architecture, data governance enablement, and cloud data platform design across enterprise systems. Partners with business stakeholders, enterprise architects, data engineers, and technology teams to ensure data solutions are secure, scalable, governed, and aligned with business strategy.

As a Data Architect III on Generac’s Industrial Cloud team, you will play a critical role in designing and evolving cloud-scale data platforms that power our industrial IoT solutions. This role sits at the intersection of architecture, data engineering, and platform strategy—owning the design of highly available, high‑volume data systems that ingest and serve telematics data from industrial energy assets in the field.

At Generac, we are committed to building sustainable, cleaner energy technology at scale. You’ll join a collaborative, high‑impact team working on cloud-hosted services that monitor and optimize large‑scale generators, battery storage, and microgrid systems—software that is used, valued, and makes a real difference.

Responsibilities

  • Define and own the architecture for cloud-based data solutions, ensuring scalability, reliability, and high availability
  • Lead data architecture discussions and collaborate closely with engineering, product, ML, and cross‑functional stakeholders
  • Design, build, and maintain production datastores supporting high‑speed, high‑volume industrial IoT and telematics data
  • Translate business and product requirements into conceptual, logical, and physical data models
  • Drive best practices for data reliability, performance tuning, partitioning, indexing, and data quality
  • Analyze how customers and systems use data, identify inefficiencies, and propose architectural improvements
  • Coach and mentor engineers on data architecture best practices through design reviews, code reviews, and technical guidance
  • Clearly explain complex technical solutions to both technical and non‑technical audiences, including leadership

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience
  • 8+ years of experience working across the data tier, from design through development and production support
  • 5+ years of experience in a data architect role with strong grounding in enterprise data architecture concepts
  • Proven experience leading data architecture in production cloud environments (Azure preferred)

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working with high‑speed, high‑volume telematics or time‑series data
  • Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code, preferably Terraform
  • Programming or scripting experience in Python, PowerShell, and/or T‑SQL
  • Experience supporting or enabling AI/ML projects
  • Knowledge of data governance, data privacy, and compliance (e.g., GDPR)
  • Enterprise‑level expertise with Microsoft SQL Server or similar relational databases
  • Hands‑on experience with at least one NoSQL database (e.g., key‑value, document, graph, or column store)
  • Strong experience with data warehouse, data lake, and lakehouse design patterns
  • Experience designing and maintaining data pipelines
  • Deep knowledge of data modeling (conceptual, logical, physical)
  • Strong understanding of performance tuning, indexing, and partitioning strategies
  • Passion for modern data architecture, microservices, and cloud-native data platforms
  • A naturally curious, growth‑oriented mindset with a desire to mentor and elevate others
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence and collaborate across teams

Great Reasons to work for Generac

  • Competitive Benefits: Health, Dental, Vision, 401k and many more
  • Make a positive impact. Generac has always been community-minded and dedicated to giving back. The company proudly offers a Volunteer Time Off program, inviting team members to participate in charitable volunteer opportunities on company time.
  • Build technology that matters: Be part of Generac’s transformation into an energy technology leader—designing cloud and data platforms that support cleaner, more sustainable power solutions at scale, including generators, battery storage (BESS), and microgrid systems.
  • Own meaningful architecture at scale: This role isn’t maintenance-only—you’ll lead re‑architecture efforts for high‑volume, industrial IoT and telematics data systems, shaping the future of Generac’s Industrial Cloud and Generac Link platforms.
  • Work with strong engineering talent in a collaborative culture: Join a team known for deep technical expertise, thoughtful design discussions, and a startup‑like mindset within a large, stable organization—where autonomy, curiosity, and collaboration are truly valued.
  • Grow your impact and influence: As the senior data architecture leader, you’ll mentor engineers, influence platform strategy, and expand your reach across product, ML, and engineering teams while helping define how data powers Generac’s next generation of services.

Physical Demands: While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to talk and hear; and use hands to manipulate objects or controls. The employee is regularly required to stand and walk. On occasion, the incumbent may be required to stoop, bend, or reach above the shoulders. The employee must occasionally lift up to 25 pounds. Specific conditions of this job are typical of frequent and continuous computer-based work requiring periods of sitting, close vision, and the ability to adjust focus. Occasional travel.

Location: Arnold AFB , TN

Job Family Code : O - Engineer ing

Salary Range or Starting Hourly Rate : L10: $148,000 - $197,500; L11: $171,000 - $228,000 / per year

Overview

BNH is seeking a Senior Data Architect that serves as the primary technical architect leading the design and deployment of a modern, greenfield data ecosystem in support of the TOS II contract at Arnold Engineering Development Complex (AEDC). Partnering directly with the Data Product Manager, this role translates functional product roadmaps and aerospace test modernization requirements into scalable, secure, and resilient data architectures.

The architect establishes enterprise data models, unified ingestion frameworks for high-frequency telemetry and sensor data, and secure data Lakehouse infrastructures to support the contract mandate of doubling aerospace testing throughput.

Open to internal & external candidates. The selected candidate for this requisition may be required to occasionally ( e.g. application upgrades) work outside normal business hours.

Job not sponsored.

Job Summary

The successful candidate will be a strategic, business-oriented data leader responsible for defining the enterprise data product architecture and partnering with the Data Product Manager to establish the long-term product roadmap, manage and prioritize the feature backlog, and optimize resource investments—ensuring BNH’s data assets deliver measurable business value and directly support the modernization goals of the TOS II contract.

Responsibilities

 Job Duties and Key Responsibilities :

  • Greenfield Architecture & System Design: Architect scalable, high-throughput data pipelines and hybrid cloud/ on-premise storage repositories for aerospace test telemetry, operational diagnostics, and business intelligence workloads.
  • Product Manager Partnership & Technical Roadmap: Translate product vision, feature backlogs, and user stories into technical system designs, architecture blueprints, schema definitions, and interface control documents (ICDs).
  • Data Ingestion & Telemetry Pipelines: Design real-time and batch ingestion architectures capable of handling massive telemetry, instrumentation, and sensor data feeds across legacy and modernized test facilities.
  • Data Modeling & Governance Integration: Create and enforce enterprise-level conceptual, logical, and physical data models, master data schemas, and data dictionaries ensuring full lineage and cataloging.
  • Security, IA & Contract Compliance: Implement DoD Zero-Trust data access principles, NIST SP 800-171/DoD 8570 controls, and role-based access control (RBAC) to protect Controlled Unclassified Information (CUI).
  • Technical Mentorship & Agile Execution: Lead technical spikes, guide data engineers on implementation patterns, conduct architecture peer reviews, and actively participate in sprint planning and backlog grooming.
  • Data Governance and Quality Management: Oversee enterprise data governance, data quality, master data management, and data security; Ensure data collection, storage, and sharing comply with internal data governance standards , security policies and compliance with all regulatory and privacy requirements ; Anticipate and mitigate technical, ethical, or financial hurdles while ensuring data accuracy ; Champion best practices in data architecture and data management.
  • It is a condition of employment to wear company issued PPE (Personal Protective Equipment) in accordance with supervisory direction and company policy.
  • Perform other duties as required .

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science , Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or a related STEM field plus ten ( 10 ) years of progressive experience in data architecture, data modeling, and enterprise data engineering; OR Master’s degree in a related STEM field plus eight ( 8 ) years of experience; OR Bachelor’s degree in any field plus ten ( 10 ) years of direct enterprise data architecture experience.
  • Minimum of four (4) years designing distributed data storage systems, data lakehouses , or enterprise data warehouses (e.g., Snowflake, Databricks, Redshift, Big Query , or on-premises equivalents).
  • Must be able to obtain and maintain an active security clearance and maintain authorized user access to the AEDC local area network.
  • U.S. Citizenship is required due to federal government contract compliance requirements and the necessity to access secure federal databases and networks on Arnold Air Force Base.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Modern Data Stack & Orchestration Practical experience with Apache Spark, Kafka, dbt , Apache Airflow, or similar real-time event streaming and pipeline orchestration technologies.
  • Cloud & Hybrid Infrastructure Proven track record deploying GovCloud (AWS GovCloud or Azure Government) secure infrastructure under FedRAMP High / IL5/IL6 guidelines.
  • Certified Data Management Professional (CDMP), AWS Certified Data Analytics, Databricks Certified Solutions Architect, or equivalent.
  • Data Science & Big Data Concepts: Working knowledge of how machine learning models, big data frameworks, and analytics workflows operate .
  • Hands-on exposure to data governance and cataloging platforms such as Collibra, Alation, Apache Atlas, or Microsoft Purview.
  • Collaboration Frameworks: Experience running agile or hybrid project frameworks (such as Scrum or Kanban).
  • Problem-Solving & Critical Thinking: Aptitude for troubleshooting data bottlenecks, missing variables, or shifting project requirements.

What We Offer

  • Competitive salaries
  • Continuing education assistance
  • Multiple healthcare benefits packages
  • 401K with employer matching
  • Paid time off (PTO) along with a federally recognized holiday schedule

Who We Are

Beyond New Horizons (BNH) is a fully populated joint venture of Astrion and Fluor Federal Services, Inc. formed to provide unmatched Test Operations and Sustainment services for the Arnold Engineering Development Complex.

We chose our name to serve as an enduring reminder of our commitment to AEDC’s rich aerospace research and development legacy anchored in AEDC’s Toward New Horizons founding study and the unprecedented opportunities to greatly expand AEDC’s capabilities and capacity Beyond those existing today. Leveraging the capabilities of our parent companies, BNH specializes in testing and evaluation for military and space systems combined with proven capability in large-scale Government program management, integration, engineering, and construction services for specialized and technically advanced high-hazard facilities.

Join our Team!

U.S. Citizenship is required . At this time BNH will not sponsor any applicants for employment authorization or offer any immigration related support for this position (i.e. H1b, F1 OPT, F-1 STEM OPT, F-1 CPT, J-1, E-2, E-3, L-1, or other forms of work authorization that require immigration support from an employer).

The minimum and maximum full-time annual salaries for this role are listed below, by location. Please note that this salary information is solely for candidates hired to perform work within one of these locations and refers to the amount BNH is willing to pay at the time of this posting. Salaries for part-time jobs will be adjusted based upon the number of hours agreed to work at location Tennessee: Arnold Air Force, TN.

HMP Global is a leading healthcare event and education company, with a dominant position in several therapeutic areas including Oncology, Psychiatry & Behavioral Health, Cardiovascular, Wound Care and Public Safety. With a mission to improve patient care, we deliver information and education to healthcare professionals through 400+ global, regional, and local events and reach over 2 million users through digital networks and social channels.


About the role

Our Enterprise Data & Analytics team runs a Snowflake-based data platform serving healthcare provider, finance, marketing and sales data. This role designs the data architecture for assigned projects: it starts from the upstream business process, designs for how the data is consumed downstream, and hands clear, documented designs to Data Engineering and BI.


Responsibilities

  • Work with business teams to understand requirements for assigned projects, and own each project's design from discovery through handoff.
  • Study the upstream business processes that create the data and translate them into a data design.
  • Raise data quality issues with business teams and recommend process improvements, with support from the Staff Data Architect.
  • Understand how the data will be consumed downstream (reporting, analytics) and design for it before any build starts.
  • Produce the design artifacts for each project: architecture diagrams, blueprints, source-to-target mappings (STTM), data models and a data dictionary, following team standards.
  • Apply design best practices: layered (medallion) design, dimensional and star schema modeling, naming standards and privacy by design.
  • Hand off to Data Engineering with a clear design package, and answer questions during implementation.
  • Hand off mart designs to BI with clear documentation: grain, measures, dimensions, definitions and business rules.
  • Use AI tools responsibly to speed up research and design work, such as drafting diagrams, STTM and option comparisons, while validating everything before it is shared and keeping sensitive data protected.


Qualifications & Skills

Required

  • 4 to 5 years in Analytics Engineering, data modeling or data architecture, including 2+ years designing for a cloud data warehouse (Snowflake).
  • Experience with data from at least one of these domains: healthcare provider, finance, marketing or sales, and willingness to learn the others.
  • Hands-on source-to-target mapping (STTM) and architecture diagram skills, producing design documents that engineers can build from.
  • Strong dimensional modeling (star schema) and medallion layering, strong SQL, and working knowledge of dbt.
  • Ability to translate business processes and requirements into data designs.
  • Experience designing for downstream consumption (BI, analytics) and handing off to engineering and BI teams.
  • Has delivered the design of a project end to end, with guidance from a senior architect or lead.
  • Working knowledge of data governance and of handling PII.
  • Strong written communication, with clear and complete documentation.
  • Uses AI tools responsibly to improve speed and research, with sound judgment on checking output and protecting sensitive data.
  • Bachelor's degree in a quantitative or technical field, or equivalent experience.


Preferred

  • Healthcare provider data experience.
  • Familiarity with Snowflake Cortex and semantic layers.
  • Familiarity with Power BI semantic models.
  • Experience supporting a warehouse or platform migration.
  • SnowPro certification (Core or Advanced Architect).


HMP Global is not accepting resumes or inquiries from staffing or recruiting agencies for this position. Unsolicited resumes submitted by agencies will be considered the property of HMP Global, and no fees will be paid.


Please follow HMP Global on LinkedIn for news and updates

Calling all innovators - find your future at Fiserv.

We're Fiserv, a global leader in Fintech and payments, and we move money and information in a way that moves the world. We connect financial institutions, corporations, merchants and consumers to one another millions of times a day - quickly, reliably, and securely. Any time you swipe your credit card, pay through a mobile app, or withdraw money from the bank, we're involved. If you want to make an impact on a global scale, come make a difference at Fiserv.

Job Title

Data Architect

About Your Role

At Fiserv, we are dedicated to transforming financial services technology to benefit our clients. As an Architect – Data Products, you will define and lead the architecture of scalable, secure, and reliable data products that power analytics, reporting, and data delivery for our clients. You will partner with product, engineering, and business stakeholders to design modern cloud data platforms, set technical standards, and ensure our data products meet quality, performance, and SLA commitments.

What You’ll Do

  • Define the end-to-end architecture for data products, including ingestion, transformation, storage, governance, and delivery on cloud data platforms.
  • Partner with product owners and business stakeholders to translate requirements into data models, technical designs, and delivery roadmaps.
  • Design and oversee scalable batch and streaming pipelines using Databricks, Spark, and Azure data services.
  • Design AI-ready data products and platform capabilities that support machine learning and generative AI use cases, including feature engineering, vector search, and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines.
  • Establish standards for data quality, security, access control, lineage, and metadata management across data products.
  • Lead platform modernization and migration initiatives, ensuring client data delivery meets performance and SLA commitments.
  • Conduct architecture and design reviews, and drive engineering best practices, automation (including AI-assisted development), and release quality controls.
  • Mentor data engineers and provide technical guidance to cross-functional and vendor teams.

Experience You’ll Need To Have

  • 8+ years of experience in data engineering, data architecture, or software development
  • 5+ years of experience designing and building data platforms or data products at enterprise scale
  • 4+ years of experience with Databricks, Apache Spark, and Delta Lake or similar lakehouse technologies
  • 4+ years of experience with Azure, AWS, or GCP data services
  • 4+ years of experience with SQL, Python or Scala, and data modeling (dimensional, relational, and lakehouse)
  • 3+ years of experience with data governance, security, and access control practices
  • 3+ years of experience with CI/CD pipelines, DevOps practices, and Agile methodologies
  • Bachelor’s degree in data science, Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics or an equivalent combination of education, work, and/or military experience.

Experience That Would Be Great To Have

  • Experience in the financial services industry
  • Experience with Unity Catalog, data mesh, or streaming technologies such as Kafka or Spark Structured Streaming
  • Experience enabling AI/ML and generative AI solutions on Databricks or similar platforms, such as feature stores, vector databases, or RAG pipelines
  • Experience leading large-scale data platform migrations and client data delivery with SLA commitments
  • Databricks, Azure, or AWS architecture certifications

How You’ll Work

  • This role is on-site Monday through Friday. Fiserv considers in-person collaboration to be an essential part of this role as in-person office experiences help you with your overall onboarding experience and leads to stronger productivity.

Travel

  • Approximately 10% travel off-site or to other office locations is expected.

Sponsorship

  • You must currently possess valid and unrestricted U.S. work authorization to be considered for this role. Individuals with temporary visas including, but not limited to, F-1 (OPT, CPT, STEM), H-1B, H-2, or TN, or any candidate requiring sponsorship, now or in the future, will not be considered.

$145,000.00 - $240,000.00

We are CNN. The world’s most essential and engaging source of digital news. We are in the midst of rapid transformation and are looking for the next generation of innovators, makers, and dreamers to help lead our growth and shape the future of news.

Your New Role…
The Staff Data Architect plays a critical, hands‑on role in evolving and strengthening CNN’s modern data ecosystem. This is a platform‑focused role for a senior technologist who thrives at scale—designing and implementing robust, performant, and governed data architecture that powers analytics, reporting, and decision‑making across the organization.


You’ll combine deep technical expertise with practical leadership, helping define architecture and modeling standards, mentoring engineers and analysts, and partnering closely with platform and analytics teams to deliver reliable, scalable data systems. This role is ideal for someone passionate about improving time‑to‑insight, driving metric consistency, and building trusted semantic data models across a high‑impact analytics platform.

Your Role Accountabilities…

  • Design and implement scalable data architecture patterns on Snowflake to support high‑volume event and analytics workloads, with a strong focus on performance, security, and cost efficiency through query optimization, warehouse sizing, storage management, and governance best practices.

  • Lead the technical design and implementation of complex data systems and platform enhancements, establishing and maintaining architecture and data modeling standards that promote consistency, scalability, and reliability across Snowflake and dbt workflows.

  • Define and implement secure, scalable data access patterns, leveraging role‑based access control and managed access schemas to ensure data is governed, auditable, and accessible to the right audiences.

  • Design and operate data quality and observability frameworks, using dbt tests and monitoring tools to track pipeline health, latency, and freshness, and to continuously improve platform reliability and operational visibility.

  • Partner closely with platform engineering and analytics teams to improve system reliability, scalability, and operational efficiency, contributing to platform architecture planning and technical roadmaps.

  • Translate complex analytics and business requirements into clean, well‑governed semantic data models that enable trusted self‑service analytics and consistent metrics across BI tools.

  • Define and implement data lifecycle and retention strategies that balance performance, cost efficiency, compliance, and data availability across the analytics platform.

  • Act as a technical mentor and thought leader, helping grow the skills of engineers and analysts and raising the overall bar for data architecture and engineering practices.



Qualifications & Experience…
