Job Description:

What You’ll Do

Enterprise Information Architect & BIDW Leader will establish and deliver upon the enterprise information architecture vision for enterprise-level solutions. This role is responsible for the delivery of business Intelligence & data warehouse solutions to the firm, including the information architecture and management processes of the BI data warehouse and leading the BI function and team.

Responsibilities

LEADERSHIP

  • Ownership of and accountability for successful results of the Data Warehouse & Business Intelligence teams within Data Transformation.
  • Thought leadership in matters of enterprise data architecture, staying abreast of new technologies, patterns and methods which c an be applicable to Crowe data
  • Development of team strategy, creation and socialization of roadmaps, establishing and ensuring adherence to timelines, and resource assignment for the BIDW team
  • Seek opportunities to bring value to the Crowe business and/or its customers through innovative enterprise data and BI strategies to support strategic business goals
  • Develop quantifiable goals for the team which are aligned with Data Transformation’s strategic goals as well as Crowe’s strategic business initiatives
  • Mentor and coach developers, data engineers, managers, and other roles within team, intentionally managing career growth via mentorship and proactive planning
  • Actively participate in and collaborate with technical guilds to further expose and align the firm on best practices
  • Understand when to delegate; this role manages resources and owns the entire team’s success
  • Responsibility to track and maintain clear visibility into the value and delivery timing of BIDW team initiatives for Head of Data and business stakeholders

DEMAND MANAGEMENT & BUSINESS ENGAGEMENT

  • Collaboration with Head of Data and/or other firm leaders to understand strategic business needs and requirements, and planning team and technology capacity accordingly
  • Communication and engagement to ensure the business sees maximum value from its data warehouse and business intelligence investments
  • Develop and maintain an understanding of business needs, technical architecture and systems landscape, and the technology strategy of the business
  • Collaborate with both BIDW team and Data Transformation leaders to establish goals, plan capacity, support other Data Transformation initiatives, and leave margin for learning and unexpected shifts

PROGRAM DESIGN, DEVELOPMENT & DEPLOYMENT

  • Ultimate ownership for team delivery quality and schedule
  • Work closely with technology and business personnel to deliver value in a timely manner
  • Accountability for team using best practices for development and quality assurance aligned with firmwide standards, seeking opportunities to automate and improve
  • CONTINUOUS IMPROVEMENT
  • Champion a culture and mindset of excellence, collaboration, continuous improvement, design thinking and positivity
  • Establish metrics to monitor and tangibly demonstrate the value provided to the business via effectiveness, quality metrics, sensitive data monitoring as well as alert to any negative trends in these areas
  • Work with stakeholders to prioritize continuous improvement
  • Assess and recommend opportunities to retire/consolidate redundant legacy system assets
  • ADOPTION & VALUE REALIZATION
  • Work with team and business users to ensure successful adoption, usage, and benefit realization from solutions
  • Define and track KPIs and success metrics for adoption and value creation

Specific responsibility expectations by the components listed below –

Information Architecture Vision: Establish the Enterprise Information Architecture vision within the context of business strategy and in alignment with overall Technology & Strategy direction.

  • Translate strategic requirements into a usable enterprise information architecture, which may include an enterprise data model, common business vocabulary, ontology, and taxonomies, to guide enterprise solution development and achieve consistency of information assets.
  • Create an information architecture consistent with the business, application, and technical architectures.
  • Facilitate the mapping and traceability of information assets as they flow from source datastores to targets, thus ensuring optimal transparency, quality, consistency, and controlled redundancy.

Information Architecture Delivery: Work with and mentor delivery teams to provide data solutions that are in keeping with the enterprise information architecture. This may include:

  • Assessing suitability of vendor solutions to meet enterprise information requirements.
  • Construct, refine and maintain information models, as needed, to meet business requirements and drive data designs for operational and analytical solutions.
  • Facilitate the definition of integrative and canonical views of data or information across multiple content types to support convergence of information asset migration planning or impact analysis.
  • Ensure new development is consistent and well-integrated with the established enterprise information architecture, using metadata management and/or a repository to promote reuse and standards adoption.
  • Review corporate data sources for new business information and better data sources. Assist in post-implementation improvement efforts to enhance performance and provide increased functionality.
  • Participate in key project design reviews as part of the methodology process to ensure application designs adhere to enterprise information architecture guidelines.
  • Provide oversight for the BI Data Warehouse. Design an enterprise-wide integrated Data Warehouse for
  • Business Intelligence by modeling new and enhancing existing BIDW datamarts. Establish logical and physical models, maintain metadata, and guide integration engineers for the physical datamart schema and logical integration (ETL) processes. Assist, as required, with testing and issue resolution. Establish and enhance governance processes for the BI Data Warehouse (naming conventions, conformed dimensions and facts, meta-models, security configuration) to ensure a consistent implementation across all datamarts.
  • On large implementation projects, deliver project artifacts including: Data Integration Inventory, 360 Data Integration Diagram, Core structures diagram, Data Integration Requirements document and Test Plans, Report Inventory, Reporting Gap Analysis and Strategy, and Historical Data Strategy

Business Intelligence Team Leadership: Provide leadership, oversight, and quality assurance for BI Team and team deliverables. This may include:

  • Manage and coach BI team members in delivery of high-quality business intelligence solutions. Assist to estimate effort / duration for new requests and change orders. Track work queue, assign and adjust priorities and due dates based on client requirements and DT Leadership direction. Provide BI team with visibility to DT projects and project pipeline. Provide a forum for BI team collaboration on BI and Data Warehouse design and technical challenges.
  • Establish, document, and maintain best practices for Business Intelligence and Data Warehousing.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Analytics, Data/Information Science, Information Systems, Mathematics (or other related fields)
  • 6+ years of experience with SQL
  • 4+ years of experience in Business Intelligence, data analysis, and reporting
  • 4+ years of experience with Microsoft Power BI, including DAX, Power Query, and M language.
  • 2+ years of experience with Python (or other programming languages)
  • 4+ years of experience managing projects from inception to execution.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Microsoft Fabric Analytics Engineer certifications preferred.
  • Strong understanding of Data Warehousing and Business Intelligence concepts, Data Quality, and the related technology landscape, processes, and design principles
  • Proven track record in operating large data warehouse and business intelligence programs
  • Experience in managing enterprise data assets in a large, complex organization
  • Should be familiar with cloud and data management trends and methodologies
  • Ability to analyze complex situations and to derive workable actions
  • Ability to constructively challenge requirements and current state to increase overall value to the firm
  • Strong relationship building skills
  • Flexibility to adjust to multiple demands, shifting priorities, ambiguity, and rapid change
  • Good written and verbal communication
  • Strong analytical and time management skills
  • Strong facilitation skills with the ability to drive issues to closure
  • Self-motivated and able to handle tasks with minimal supervision or questions
  • Ability to compare technologies and make recommendations to senior members of the team
  • Understanding of privacy laws and regulations

Job Description:

What You’ll Do

Enterprise Information Architect & BIDW Leader will establish and deliver upon the enterprise information architecture vision for enterprise-level solutions. This role is responsible for the delivery of business Intelligence & data warehouse solutions to the firm, including the information architecture and management processes of the BI data warehouse and leading the BI function and team.

Responsibilities

LEADERSHIP



- Ownership of and accountability for successful results of the Data Warehouse & Business Intelligence teams within Data Transformation. 
- Thought leadership in matters of enterprise data architecture, staying abreast of new technologies, patterns and methods which c an be applicable to Crowe data
- Development of team strategy, creation and socialization of roadmaps, establishing and ensuring adherence to timelines, and resource assignment for the BIDW team
- Seek opportunities to bring value to the Crowe business and/or its customers through innovative enterprise data and BI strategies to support strategic business goals
- Develop quantifiable goals for the team which are aligned with Data Transformation’s strategic goals as well as Crowe’s strategic business initiatives
- Mentor and coach developers, data engineers, managers, and other roles within team, intentionally managing career growth via mentorship and proactive planning
- Actively participate in and collaborate with technical guilds to further expose and align the firm on best practices
- Understand when to delegate; this role manages resources and owns the entire team’s success
- Responsibility to track and maintain clear visibility into the value and delivery timing of BIDW team initiatives for Head of Data and business stakeholders

DEMAND MANAGEMENT & BUSINESS ENGAGEMENT



- Collaboration with Head of Data and/or other firm leaders to understand strategic business needs and requirements, and planning team and technology capacity accordingly
- Communication and engagement to ensure the business sees maximum value from its data warehouse and business intelligence investments
- Develop and maintain an understanding of business needs, technical architecture and systems landscape, and the technology strategy of the business
- Collaborate with both BIDW team and Data Transformation leaders to establish goals, plan capacity, support other Data Transformation initiatives, and leave margin for learning and unexpected shifts

PROGRAM DESIGN, DEVELOPMENT & DEPLOYMENT



- Ultimate ownership for team delivery quality and schedule
- Work closely with technology and business personnel to deliver value in a timely manner
- Accountability for team using best practices for development and quality assurance aligned with firmwide standards, seeking opportunities to automate and improve
- CONTINUOUS IMPROVEMENT
- Champion a culture and mindset of excellence, collaboration, continuous improvement, design thinking and positivity
- Establish metrics to monitor and tangibly demonstrate the value provided to the business via effectiveness, quality metrics, sensitive data monitoring as well as alert to any negative trends in these areas
- Work with stakeholders to prioritize continuous improvement
- Assess and recommend opportunities to retire/consolidate redundant legacy system assets
- ADOPTION & VALUE REALIZATION
- Work with team and business users to ensure successful adoption, usage, and benefit realization from solutions
- Define and track KPIs and success metrics for adoption and value creation

Specific responsibility expectations by the components listed below –

Information Architecture Vision: Establish the Enterprise Information Architecture vision within the context of business strategy and in alignment with overall Technology & Strategy direction.



- Translate strategic requirements into a usable enterprise information architecture, which may include an enterprise data model, common business vocabulary, ontology, and taxonomies, to guide enterprise solution development and achieve consistency of information assets. 
- Create an information architecture consistent with the business, application, and technical architectures. 
- Facilitate the mapping and traceability of information assets as they flow from source datastores to targets, thus ensuring optimal transparency, quality, consistency, and controlled redundancy. 

Information Architecture Delivery: Work with and mentor delivery teams to provide data solutions that are in keeping with the enterprise information architecture. This may include:



- Assessing suitability of vendor solutions to meet enterprise information requirements. 
- Construct, refine and maintain information models, as needed, to meet business requirements and drive data designs for operational and analytical solutions. 
- Facilitate the definition of integrative and canonical views of data or information across multiple content types to support convergence of information asset migration planning or impact analysis. 
- Ensure new development is consistent and well-integrated with the established enterprise information architecture, using metadata management and/or a repository to promote reuse and standards adoption. 
- Review corporate data sources for new business information and better data sources. Assist in post-implementation improvement efforts to enhance performance and provide increased functionality. 
- Participate in key project design reviews as part of the methodology process to ensure application designs adhere to enterprise information architecture guidelines. 
- Provide oversight for the BI Data Warehouse. Design an enterprise-wide integrated Data Warehouse for
- Business Intelligence by modeling new and enhancing existing BIDW datamarts. Establish logical and physical models, maintain metadata, and guide integration engineers for the physical datamart schema and logical integration (ETL) processes. Assist, as required, with testing and issue resolution. Establish and enhance governance processes for the BI Data Warehouse (naming conventions, conformed dimensions and facts, meta-models, security configuration) to ensure a consistent implementation across all datamarts. 
- On large implementation projects, deliver project artifacts including: Data Integration Inventory, 360 Data Integration Diagram, Core structures diagram, Data Integration Requirements document and Test Plans, Report Inventory, Reporting Gap Analysis and Strategy, and Historical Data Strategy

Business Intelligence Team Leadership: Provide leadership, oversight, and quality assurance for BI Team and team deliverables. This may include:



- Manage and coach BI team members in delivery of high-quality business intelligence solutions. Assist to estimate effort / duration for new requests and change orders. Track work queue, assign and adjust priorities and due dates based on client requirements and DT Leadership direction. Provide BI team with visibility to DT projects and project pipeline. Provide a forum for BI team collaboration on BI and Data Warehouse design and technical challenges. 
- Establish, document, and maintain best practices for Business Intelligence and Data Warehousing. 

Qualifications



- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Analytics, Data/Information Science, Information Systems, Mathematics (or other related fields)
- 6+ years of experience with SQL
- 4+ years of experience in Business Intelligence, data analysis, and reporting
- 4+ years of experience with Microsoft Power BI, including DAX, Power Query, and M language. 
- 2+ years of experience with Python (or other programming languages)
- 4+ years of experience managing projects from inception to execution. 

Preferred Qualifications



- Microsoft Fabric Analytics Engineer certifications preferred. 
- Strong understanding of Data Warehousing and Business Intelligence concepts, Data Quality, and the related technology landscape, processes, and design principles
- Proven track record in operating large data warehouse and business intelligence programs
- Experience in managing enterprise data assets in a large, complex organization
- Should be familiar with cloud and data management trends and methodologies
- Ability to analyze complex situations and to derive workable actions
- Ability to constructively challenge requirements and current state to increase overall value to the firm
- Strong relationship building skills
- Flexibility to adjust to multiple demands, shifting priorities, ambiguity, and rapid change
- Good written and verbal communication
- Strong analytical and time management skills
- Strong facilitation skills with the ability to drive issues to closure
- Self-motivated and able to handle tasks with minimal supervision or questions
- Ability to compare technologies and make recommendations to senior members of the team
- Understanding of privacy laws and regulations

Job Description

The Senior Data Architect will design and implement scalable data solutions using the latest and advanced technology and toolsets. This role offers the right candidate the rare opportunity to leverage their extensive background to design and architect scalable, secure, and modern cloud-native data solutions. The role will also be responsible for working closely with business partners and IT leadership to understand the organization's business requirements and work with the broader IT team to enable/build new capabilities in our data platform that will support the current needs and scale to accommodate future growth.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the design and architecture of end-to-end data solutions, translating business strategy and requirements into scalable, secure, high-performing architectures.
  • Define target-state data architectures and blueprints, including data flows, integration patterns, storage strategies, data processing, and consumption layers.
  • Establish and govern standard architecture patterns for data ingestion, transformation (ETL/ELT), integration, interoperability, and data sharing across platforms and domains.
  • Architect scalable and resilient data pipelines and workflows, optimizing for performance, cost, reliability, and operational efficiency.
  • Design cloud-native data architectures that leverage modern data platforms for elasticity, resilience, modularity, and scalability.
  • Enable AI/ML capabilities through data architectures that support experimentation, feature engineering, model development, deployment, and production consumption.
  • Incorporate data governance, security, privacy, and compliance by design, including access controls, data classification, masking, lineage, and regulatory requirements.
  • Design for interoperability and seamless data exchange across applications, data domains, platforms, and external systems.
  • Lead the evaluation and selection of data technologies and platforms in partnership with IT, Enterprise Architecture, and business stakeholders, ensuring alignment with enterprise capabilities and strategy.
  • Collaborate with Enterprise Architecture, Infrastructure, Application Development, Data Engineering, and business teams to define technology roadmaps, capabilities, and solution strategies.
  • Provide architectural oversight and governance for data solutions and cloud-native data platforms, ensuring adherence to enterprise standards and addressing risks, gaps, dependencies, and architectural trade-offs.
  • Drive innovation through feasibility assessments, POCs, and pilots, evaluating emerging technologies and validating new architectural approaches.
  • Provide architectural oversight for vendor and third-party data solutions, ensuring alignment with enterprise architecture, security, integration, and data standards.
  • Participate in architecture governance forums, contributing to design reviews, architecture decisions, approvals, and continuous improvement of enterprise data architecture.
  • Mentor and guide data architects and engineers, promoting architecture best practices, design excellence, and continued capability development.

Qualifications

  • 4+ years of experience in modern cloud data architecture or related fields, with a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related discipline.
  • Deep understanding of modern data and analytics platforms and technologies, including Snowflake, Matillion, Microsoft Fabric, Power BI, Tableau, and other industry-leading solutions.
  • Proven experience designing and delivering enterprise data solutions, including data warehousing, data lakes, lakehouse architectures, data management, integration, and analytics platforms.
  • Extensive experience architecting end-to-end, scalable data platforms using modern cloud technologies, preferably Microsoft Azure, with experience in cloud-native, hybrid, or multi-cloud architectures.
  • Strong ability to translate business requirements into scalable data architectures and solutions, with excellent communication skills to articulate complex technical concepts to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Strong understanding of data architecture patterns and technology capabilities across ingestion, storage, processing, analytics, APIs, and microservices, with the ability to evaluate and select appropriate technologies.
  • Experience collaborating with vendors and third-party partners to deliver solutions aligned with enterprise architecture, security, and data standards.
  • Strong foundation in data governance, data quality, security, privacy, and regulatory compliance within enterprise data environments.
  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to influence decisions, facilitate collaboration, and drive alignment across cross-functional teams.
  • Experience architecting data platforms that enable advanced analytics, AI/ML, MCP, and Generative AI use cases, while maintaining appropriate governance, security, scalability, and performance.

Base Pay Information

Actual pay may vary based on Delta Dental’s assessment of the candidate’s knowledge, skills, abilities (KSAs), related experience, education, certifications and ability to meet required minimum job qualifications. Other factors impacting pay include prevailing wages in the work location and internal equity.

Behind the smile! We are dedicated to safeguarding the health and financial stability of our employees and their loved ones. This commitment extends beyond the workplace to foster personal growth and holistic wellbeing. Our life-changing rewards package includes:

  • Competitive base and incentive pay
  • 401(k) with robust matching and non-matching contributions
  • Rich medical & pharmacy benefits
  • 100% employer-paid dental and vision benefits
  • Holistic wellbeing program with deep financial incentives
  • Generous paid time off plus 12 paid holidays and your birthday off

The group you’ll be a part of

Global Information Systems

The impact you’ll make

As a Data Architect, you will design and deliver scalable, governed, and AI-ready enterprise data solutions that support analytics, digital transformation, and emerging AI use cases. Job Title: Lead Data Architect

Job Category: Information Technology

Time Type: Full time

Minimum Clearance Required to Start: Secret

Employee Type: Regular

Percentage of Travel Required: Up to 10%

Type of Travel: Local

* * *

The Opportunity

CACI is seeking a Lead Data Architect to serve as the trusted advisor to the Chief Data and AI Officer (BCDAO) at Diplomatic Security (DS) and to own the technical vision, strategy, roadmap, and implementation of the DS data platform. The environment is built on Microsoft Azure, with future expansion to AWS planned.

In this role, you will translate BCDAO and DS data and AI priorities into a secure, scalable, and cost-effective Azure data platform, shaping its architecture across ingestion, integration, storage, transformation, and analytics. You will work with engineering, cloud, cybersecurity, and mission teams to turn requirements into supportable solutions, and lead the data engineering team in delivering them from design through operations across unclassified and classified environments.

Responsibilities

  • Serve as the trusted advisor to the BCDAO and DS leadership on data architecture, technical options, risks, and trade-offs.
  • Own the technical vision, strategy, standards, and roadmap for the DS data platform, including data warehouse, data lake, lakehouse, analytics, and AI/ML solutions.
  • Lead implementation of the data platform through the data engineering team, providing direction, design reviews, proof-of-concept work, and troubleshooting.
  • Architect secure data management and movement across security domains, including unclassified, Secret, and Top Secret environments, in coordination with cybersecurity and cross-domain teams.
  • Lead data integration and ETL/ELT design across diverse and disparate source systems, and drive migration of legacy on-premises and IaaS solutions to Azure PaaS and SaaS services.
  • Establish data governance, data quality, metadata, lineage, and access control practices that drive data standardization across DS and prepare data for analytics and AI/ML use.
  • Embed security and compliance requirements into the architecture, including identity, network isolation, encryption, auditability, and automated compliance controls.
  • Evaluate solutions for reliability, performance, scalability, resilience, maintainability, and cost, and document key designs and architecture decisions.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Active Secret clearance required to start.
  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information systems, engineering, data management, or another technical discipline.

10+ years of experience in data architecture, data engineering, data warehousing, BI, or data platform delivery, including 3+ years in an architect or technical lead role.

  • Extensive hands-on experience architecting and delivering Microsoft Azure data solutions, including Azure Data Factory, ADLS Gen2, Synapse Analytics, Databricks, and Azure SQL.
  • Expert knowledge of data architecture, integration, ETL/ELT, data modeling, data warehousing, and data lifecycle management.
  • Experience with classified/restricted environments and data management across Unclassified, Secret, and Top Secret domains, including cross-domain solution (CDS) concepts.
  • Proven experience owning a data platform roadmap, leading implementation, and driving cloud migration/modernization.
  • Demonstrated ability to advise senior executives and lead technical teams.

Desired

  • Experience supporting U.S. federal, law enforcement, diplomatic, or national security missions, particularly in Azure Government or classified Azure environments.
  • Experience designing data platforms that support AI/ML, advanced analytics, or real-time data processing.
  • Experience with Microsoft Purview, Event Hubs, Cosmos DB, Power BI, Azure DevOps/CI/CD, and infrastructure as code.
  • Experience with data platform monitoring, performance optimization, disaster recovery, and cloud cost management.
  • Familiarity with AWS data services and multi-cloud architectures.
  • Relevant certifications such as Azure Solutions Architect Expert or DAMA CDMP.

What You Can Expect

 A culture of integrity.

At CACI, we place character and innovation at the center of everything we do. As a valued team member, you’ll be part of a high-performing group dedicated to our customer’s missions and driven by a higher purpose – to ensure the safety of our nation.

An environment of trust.

CACI values the unique contributions that every employee brings to our company and our customers - every day. You’ll have the autonomy to take the time you need through a unique flexible time off benefit and have access to robust learning resources to make your ambitions a reality.

A focus on continuous growth.

Together, we will advance our nation's most critical missions, build on our lengthy track record of business success, and find opportunities to break new ground — in your career and in our legacy.

Pay Range

There are a host of factors that can influence final salary including, but not limited to, geographic location, Federal Government contract labor categories and contract wage rates, relevant prior work experience, specific skills and competencies, education, and certifications. Our employees value the flexibility at CACI that allows them to balance quality work and their personal lives. We offer competitive compensation, benefits and learning and development opportunities. Our broad and competitive mix of benefits options is designed to support and protect employees and their families. At CACI, you will receive comprehensive benefits such as; healthcare, wellness, financial, retirement, family support, continuing education, and time off benefits.

The Proposed Salary Range For This Position Is

$120,800 - $265,800

CACI is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other protected characteristic.

Job Overview

We're looking for a Senior Data Platform Architect to design, administer, and secure the Azure Databricks platform that powers digital and marketing, finance, revenue management, and booking and reservations. You will lead North America platform administration, including Unity Catalog governance, access, pipeline reliability, and cost. You will also set the standard for safe, AI-assisted coding across the data team.

This is a hybrid position based in our Woodland Hills, Los Angeles office. You will be required to adhere to our hybrid work policy, working from our office Monday and Thursday plus one additional weekday on a weekly basis.

Job Responsibilities

 Platform Architecture

  • Design the medallion architecture, including catalog and schema design, layer contracts, and the promotion path.
  • Align platform design with enterprise security and networking standards.
  • Bridge Data Solutions and Infrastructure so BI, AI, data science, and activation teams can build on your decisions.

Databricks and Unity Catalog Administration

  • Administer Unity Catalog: catalog, external locations, credentials, grants, and service principals.
  • Set workspace and compute standards.
  • Manage identity: users, groups, SCIM provisioning from Entra ID, secret scopes, and token governance.

Ingestion, Orchestration, and Integration

  • Design pipelines across Azure Data Factory and Databricks Workflows.
  • Maintain source integrations and their credential lifecycles.
  • Establish data contracts with upstream owners.
  • Land a SQL Server to Databricks modernization decision without breaking existing reporting.

AI-Assisted Engineering Standards

  • Set and enforce the AI coding standard.
  • Build and maintain the AI coding harness.
  • Establish review practices for generated code and SQL, correctness, cost and performance impact

Security, Access, and Governance

  • Define the security posture: network isolation, private connectivity, and storage firewalls.
  • Run credential hygiene: secrets in Key Vault, scheduled rotation, and no long-lived plaintext tokens.
  • Design the access model: roles, and privileged access.
  • Partner with Infrastructure to manage configuration in Terraform and CI/CD.

Reliability, Quality, and Cost

  • Define SLAs for critical pipelines and build the monitoring and alerting to prove they are met.
  • Lead incident response through triage, root cause, remediation, and a written RCA that drives change.
  • Monitor platform spend: cluster right-sizing, storage lifecycle, and cost per workload.

Job Requirements

  • Strong end-to-end data platform experience across architecture, administration, and production operations.
  • Databricks Design and Administration (Expert): hands-on with Unity Catalog , cluster policy, workspace configuration, and identity federation, beyond notebook development.
  • SQL (Expert): complex analytical queries, optimization, and performance tuning.
  • Python (Advanced): production-grade PySpark with strong data quality and testing practices.
  • Azure (Strong): ADLS Gen2, Data Factory, Entra ID, Key Vault, private connectivity, and RBAC design.
  • Infrastructure as Code (Working Knowledge): Terraform and Git-based CI/CD.
  • Proven ownership of a production platform.
  • Data governance and access control experience, including privacy or consent handling across multiple markets.
  • Ability to explain design trade-offs to engineers and business stakeholders.
  • This hybrid position requires in-person collaboration to support teamwork within the department and with other departments across the organization.

Nice To Have

  • Snowflake, Synapse, or Microsoft Fabric operated alongside Databricks.
  • MLOps with Databricks Asset Bundles, plus drift and quality monitoring over inference tables.
  • Experience retiring a legacy SQL Server estate without breaking downstream reports.
  • dbt or a similar framework for layered models and testing.
  • Databricks or Azure certification (Data Engineer Professional, Azure Solutions Architect Expert).
  • Prior platform owner or technical lead experience.

What We Offer You

  • Highly competitive compensation plan.
  • Salary range $220,000-$250,000 annually determined by a myriad of factors including, but not limited to, years of experience, depth of experience, and other relevant business considerations.
  • Employees are eligible for annual discretionary bonus.
  • 401(k) plan with company match.
  • Employee Share Purchase Plan (ESPP) Viking full-time regular employees working in the United States can purchase Viking shares through payroll deductions.
  • Full benefits including medical, dental, vision, life and disability insurance at a highly subsidized rate (some plans are fully paid by Viking).
  • Accrue 15 paid vacation days, sick time accrual by state, and 6 paid holidays per year.
  • Opportunity to take a free and/or discounted cruise.
  • Highly subsidized gym membership.
  • Discounts on theatres, theme parks, movie tickets, travel discounts through IATA membership and too many more discounts to name.

Viking is a certified Great Place to Work company. This certification is a result of our commitment to excellence, integrity and our teams’ outstanding contributions.

About Viking

Viking (NYSE: VIK) is a global leader in experiential travel with a fleet of more than 100 ships, exploring 21 rivers, five oceans and all seven continents. Designed for curious travelers with interests in science, history, culture and cuisine, Chairman and CEO Torstein Hagen often says Viking offers experiences For The Thinking Person™. Viking has more than 450 awards to its name, including being rated #1 for Rivers and #1 for Oceans five years in a row by Condé Nast Traveler in the 2025 Readers’ Choice Awards. Viking is also rated a “World’s Best” by Travel + Leisure—no other travel company has simultaneously received such honors by both publications.

Senior AWS Data Architect

Locations: REMOTE

We are seeking an experienced Sr. AWS Data Architect to provide architectural leadership for the design, modernization, governance and evolution of enterprise data platforms, with a strong focus on establishing a trusted, scalable, secure, governed and reusable data foundation that enables enterprise analytics, BI, machine learning, generative AI and agentic AI.

This role combines enterprise architecture ownership with hands on technical expertise to deliver scalable, secure, resilient and cost effective data solutions aligned with business objectives and the enterprise data strategy.

The ideal candidate will define the future state data architecture, reference architectures, technology standards, design patterns, and strategic roadmaps while providing architectural oversight across analytical, operational, API based, event driven, and real time data workloads.

Major Responsibilities

  • Enterprise Data Architecture and Strategy
  • Define and own enterprise data architecture strategies, future state architectures, architectural principles, technology standards and modernization roadmaps aligned with business and enterprise objectives.
  • Lead architecture assessments, technical feasibility studies, design reviews and Architectural Review Board activities, providing recommendations on technology selection, solution design, architectural risks and exceptions.
  • Evaluate emerging technologies and architectural patterns, ensuring tactical implementation decisions support long term enterprise goals, and communicate technical recommendations and trade-offs to business and technology leadership.
  • AI Ready Data Foundation & Architecture
  • Define the architecture and roadmap for an AI ready enterprise data foundation that supports analytics, ML, GenAI and agentic AI solutions, enabling secure and scalable consumption of structured, semi-structured and unstructured data
  • Define reusable architecture patterns for RAG, embeddings, vector search, enterprise knowledge integration and governed model access.
  • Partner with Data Governance, Security, Engineering and AI teams to establish responsible AI data controls and standards.
  • Architect scalable, secure, highly available, resilient, and cost-effective data platforms using AWS native services, including Amazon S3, Redshift, RDS, AWS Glue, Lambda, Kinesis, EventBridge, API Gateway, SQS, SNS, IAM, and CloudWatch.
  • Design end-to-end architectures for data ingestion, integration, storage, processing, transformation and consumption across batch, streaming, event driven, API based, analytical and operational workloads.
  • Establish architectural best practices for performance optimization, disaster recovery, cloud security, observability and cost management
  • Define secure by design architecture standards covering IAM, least privilege access, encryption, network connectivity, data protection and compliance requirements.
  • Establish standards for monitoring, logging, alerting, fault tolerance, high availability, backup and recovery, disaster recovery and operational readiness using appropriate AWS services.
  • Technical Leadership and Engineering Excellence
  • Provide hands on technical leadership through architecture walkthroughs, code reviews, POC development, implementation guidance and design reviews, with strong expertise in Python and AWS data engineering patterns.
  • Guide engineering teams in developing maintainable, production ready solutions using reusable components, infrastructure as code, CI/CD, Git, and modern DevOps practices.
  • Lead technical problem resolution for critical systems, participate in incident response and root cause analysis, and recommend corrective actions to improve platform reliability, performance and operational maturity.
  • Define and promote modern data architecture patterns, including data warehouses, lakehouse architectures, Data Mesh, and domain-oriented data products, supporting analytics, reporting and AI/ML use cases.
  • Lead data modeling across analytical domains, defining standards for data structures, schema design, data contracts and structured and semi structured formats such as relational data, JSON, and Parquet.
  • Stakeholder Collaboration and Innovation
  • Partner with business stakeholders, enterprise architects, data engineers, analysts, application teams, and integration partners to translate business requirements into scalable enterprise data solutions.
  • Mentor engineers and influence cross functional technical decisions and foster architecture discipline, collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement.

Preferred Skills & Qualifications

  • 12+ years of progressive technology experience, with significant experience in enterprise data architecture, cloud architecture, and data engineering.
  • Deep understanding of modern data architecture patterns, including data lakes, data warehouses, lakehouse architectures, Data Mesh, data products, and event driven architectures.
  • Proven experience designing and operating enterprise-scale data platforms on AWS, with hands on expertise in Redshift, RDS, AWS Glue, Lambda, Kinesis, EventBridge, API Gateway, SQS, SNS, IAM, and CloudWatch.
  • Proven experience designing and operating enterprise scale data platforms on AWS.
  • Solid experience with data modeling, including designing scalable data structures for analytical and operational workloads.
  • Experience leading architecture and technical design reviews for complex enterprise solutions.
  • Experience with Data Mesh, domain-oriented architecture, data products or data contracts is preferred.
  • Self-driven to stay current with emerging technologies, industry standards, and architectural best practices through continuous research and professional development
  • Demonstrated experience developing architecture strategies, reference architectures, technical designs, enterprise standards and technology roadmaps
  • Strong understanding of scalability, resiliency, high availability, disaster recovery, performance optimization, cloud security, networking fundamentals, IAM, and cloud cost management.
  • Experience with agentic AI or AI driven data ingestion using LLMs for data product creation and developer enablement.
  • Experience with infrastructure as code using AWS CDK or Terraform, CI/CD pipelines, Git and modern DevOps practices.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead and influence highly technical teams, mentor engineers, build consensus across stakeholders and communicate architecture recommendations effectively to technical and executive audiences.

The salary range for this opportunity is $175,000 - $215,000. Base pay offered may vary depending on geographic region, internal equity, job related knowledge, skills and experience, among other factors. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

descriptionHtml:
Overview

Are you looking for a highly rewarding opportunity that provides extensive career growth opportunity? Gilbane is seeking a Data Architect to provide strategic and technical leadership in the design, evaluation, and governance of enterprise technology capabilities. This role translates business objectives into scalable, secure, reliable, and sustainable architectures while ensuring alignment with enterprise strategy, standards, and roadmaps. This role can be located near any Gilbane office or remote.

Who are we?

As a Top-10 ENR Contractor, Gilbane is a family-owned business with 45 offices that has been shaping communities since 1870. Consistently recognized as one of the most reputable construction management firms in the country, Gilbane is committed to delivering projects safely and on-time. You will have the opportunity to build schools, labs, hospitals, corporate offices, sports arenas and more!

We are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

Who are you?

You are someone who acts inclusively, showing empathy and treating others with respect and dignity in order to uphold Gilbane’s core value of Caring and “People First” workplace culture. You seek to listen in order to understand and can convey information clearly. You’re a strong problem solver who can identify, prioritize, and implement alternatives for solutions, and you demonstrate adaptability by collaborating with others and supporting team members to achieve excellence. A self-starter who shows passion, commitment, and ownership all while delivering on business outcomes and driving results. You’re someone who identifies opportunities for new and improved ways of doing things that result in value-add solutions.

Your core values match Gilbane’s: Integrity, Caring, Teamwork, Toughmindedness, Dedication to Excellence, Discipline, Loyalty, and Entrepreneurship.

What’s in it for you?

Gilbane offers employees multi-dimensional training opportunities through a number of resources. While managing your responsibilities to projects, you will be able to enroll in trainings through our award-winning Gilbane University to build leadership and technical skills. In addition, you would work with an experienced team which provides you with the opportunity to learn new industry skills every day. You will protect and promote the interests of both Gilbane and the client in all matters as well as demonstrating the personal characteristics of a developing leader.

Responsibilities

  • Defines and maintains architecture principles, standards, reference architectures, reusable patterns, and technical guidance for assigned domains
  • Leads architecture and high-level design activities for strategic business and technology initiatives
  • Translates business capabilities, requirements, and constraints into practical architectures
  • Ensures architectures address key attributes such as scalability, security, reliability, interoperability, performance, maintainability, and supportability
  • Supports enterprise strategies and roadmaps by developing current-state, target-state, and transition architectures
  • Identifies relevant dependencies, risks, gaps, and opportunities across technology domains
  • Participates in architecture reviews, governance processes, portfolio planning, and the development of technology roadmaps
  • Provides architecture guidance throughout the delivery lifecycle to maintain alignment with approved designs and enterprise standards
  • Partners with business and technology stakeholders to understand strategic objectives, operational needs, and technology requirements; aligns architecture decisions with business priorities, enterprise capabilities, and long-term technology strategies
  • Communicates critical decision points such as options, tradeoffs, risks, and recommendations to technical and non-technical audiences; facilitates collaboration across business teams, product teams, delivery teams, security, operations, and vendors
  • Services as a trusted advisor for technology strategy solution design, and architectural decision-making
  • Promotes consistency and reuse across Business Units, applications, and technology initiatives
  • Coaches and mentors less experienced team members
  • Supports a positive and inclusive work environment

Experience/Education

 Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field; advanced degree preferred but not required
  • ?5+ years of experience in Solution Architecture, Application Architecture, Data Architecture, Enterprise Architecture, or related technical leadership roles
  • Certification or familiarity with architecture frameworks such as The Open Group Architecture Framework (TOGAF) or Zachman preferred
  • Relevant architecture, cloud, application, data, or technology certifications such as Azure Solutions Architect Expert, Certified Data Management Professional (CDMP), or comparable certification preferred
  • Or equivalent combination of education and experience

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

  • Experience designing enterprise-scale solutions across applications, data platforms, integrations, analytics, and cloud services
  • Experience evaluating packaged applications, cloud services, platform capabilities, and custom-development approaches to determine appropriate technology solutions
  • Strong knowledge of enterprise and data architecture, including data modeling, governance, information management, APIs, integration patterns, ETL/ELT, data lineage, access controls, and security principles
  • Understanding of application architecture principles, including service boundaries, scalability, resiliency, observability, interoperability, and lifecycle management
  • Ability to define architecture patterns and standards for APIs, events, messaging, data exchange, workflow orchestration, and system integration
  • Ability to translate business requirements and long-term objectives into scalable, secure, and sustainable technology solutions
  • Ability to architect solutions that balance governance, security, compliance, and data controls with innovation and agility
  • Strong problem-solving and collaboration skills, with the ability to identify root causes and build alignment across business, technology, and cross-functional teams
  • Ability to evaluate emerging technologies and capabilities for their potential to improve business outcomes, delivery effectiveness, and technology sustainability

Salary to be determined based on factors such as geographic location, skills, education, and/or experience of the applicant, as well as the internal equity and alignment with the team.

The pay ranges from $110,000-$155,000.00 plus benefits and retirement program.

Gilbane offers an excellent total compensation package which includes competitive health and welfare benefits and a generous profit-sharing/401k plan. We invest in our employees’ education and have built Gilbane University into a top training organization in the construction industry. Qualified applicants who are offered a position must pass a pre-employment substance abuse test.

Gilbane is an Affirmative Action/Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, color, national origin, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, protected veteran status, or disability status. Click here to view the physical demands and working conditions required to perform this role. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential job functions.

Note to Recruiters, Placement Agencies, and Similar Organizations: Gilbane does not accept unsolicited resumes from agencies. Please do not forward unsolicited agency resumes to our jobs alias, website, or to any Gilbane employee. Gilbane will not pay fees to any third party agency or firm and will not be responsible for any agency fees associated with unsolicited resumes. Unsolicited resumes received will be considered property of Gilbane and will be processed accordingly.

descriptionHtml:
SNC can only hire in these states: AL, AK, AZ, CA, CO, FL, GA, HI, ID, IL, IN, KS, KY, LA, MD, MA, MI, MN, MS, MO, MT, NE, NV, NH, NJ, NM, NC, OH, OK, OR, PA, SC, TN, TX, UT, VA, WA, WV, WI.

As a Senior Data Product Architect, you will be responsible for shaping and guiding the enterprise data architecture strategy and its implementation. This role involves developing and supporting strategic data initiatives through blueprints and roadmaps, ensuring data is consistently available and shared across the organization. You will work closely with leadership, architects, SMEs, and the Enterprise PMO to support governance and alignment of IT products/projects with enterprise standards, reducing duplication and risk.

As SNC's corporate team, we provide the company and its business areas with strategic direction and business support spanning executive management, finance and accounting, operations, human resources, legal, IT, information security, facilities, marketing, and communications.

Responsibilities

  • Develop and implement the company’s enterprise data architecture strategy, ensuring alignment with business goals.
  • Lead the development and support of strategic data blueprints and roadmaps.
  • Collaborate with leadership, architects, SMEs, and the Enterprise PMO to ensure data architecture alignment and governance.
  • Identify and mitigate data redundancy and duplication across capabilities to reduce costs and risks.
  • Develop and maintain data models, reference architectures, and data management guidelines.
  • Facilitate the integration of enterprise data across various platforms and applications.
  • Monitor industry trends and advancements in data architecture and recommend adoption strategies.
  • Provide guidance and support to IT teams on data architecture best practices and implementation.
  • Ensure compliance with data governance policies and regulatory requirements.
  • Foster a culture of data-driven decision-making across the organization.

Qualifications You Must Have

  • Bachelors degree in Computer Science, or related field.
  • 8+ Years of Experience in Enterprise Architecture, or a related field.
  • Relevant experience can be considered as a substitute for the required educational qualifications. In the absence of a degree, a minimum of 12 years of related experience is required.
  • Higher level relevant degree may substitute for experience.
  • Expert proficiency in enterprise architecture frameworks (e.g., TOGAF, The Open Group Architecture Framework).
  • Extensive experience with enterprise architecture, capability planning, and alignment of IT to corporate and BU strategy.
  • Experience with drafting reference architecture.
  • Experience designing, developing, and integrating applications.
  • Vendor management experience.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and leadership skills.
  • Excellent communication and strategic thinking skills.
  • 5+ years of hands-on experience working with Data Management, including Data Ingestion, ETL, Data Modeling, Data Profiling, Data Quality, Metada Management, Master Data Management, and/or Business Intelligence and Analytics.
  • Experience building data and integration platforms.
  • Database management experience, on-prem or cloud.
  • Experience with data visualization and analytics tools.

Qualifications We Prefer

  • Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • Certification in Enterprise Architecture (e.g., TOGAF, Zachman).
  • Experience with cloud technologies and migrations.
  • Familiarity with Agile methodologies.
  • Advanced knowledge of Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) systems and application modernization.
  • Experience conceptualizing and developing abstract representations.
  • DevOps methodology experience.
  • Data Management experience, both on-prem and cloud.

Essential Functions

  • Perform desk-based computer tasks for extended periods.
  • Engage in repetitive motions, including typing on a keyboard.
  • Occasionally lift and move items up to 20 lbs.
  • Ability to work in an office or hybrid environment.
  • Ability to travel as required.

This posting will be open for application for a minimum of 5 days and may be extended based on business needs.

SNC offers annual incentive pay based upon performance that is commensurate with the level of the position.

SNC offers a generous benefit package, including medical, dental, and vision plans, 401(k) with 150% match up to 6%, life insurance, 3 weeks paid time off, tuition reimbursement, and more.

Important Notice

This position requires the ability to obtain and maintain a Secret U.S. Security Clearance. U.S. Citizenship status is required as this position needs an active U.S. Security Clearance for employment. Non-U.S. citizens may not be eligible to obtain a security clearance. The Department of Defense Consolidated Adjudications Facility (DoD CAF), a federal government agency, handles the adjudicative aspects of the security clearance eligibility process for industry applicants. Adjudicative factors which affect the outcome of the eligibility determination include, but are not limited to, allegiance to the U.S., foreign influence, foreign preference, criminal conduct, security violations and illegal drug use.

Learn more about the background check process for Security Clearances.

SNC is a global leader in aerospace and national security committed to moving the American Dream forward. We’re known and respected for our mission and execution focus, agility, and disruptive and rapid innovation. We provide leading edge technologies and transformative solutions that support our nation’s most critical security needs. If you are mission-focused, thrive in collaborative environments, and want to make our country stronger with state-of-the-art technologies that safeguard freedom, join our team!

SNC is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to an environment free of discrimination. Employment decisions are made based on merit without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran or other characteristics protected by law.

What You’ll Do

Enterprise Information Architect & BIDW Leader will establish and deliver upon the enterprise information architecture vision for enterprise-level solutions. This role is responsible for the delivery of business Intelligence & data warehouse solutions to the firm, including the information architecture and management processes of the BI data warehouse and leading the BI function and team.

Responsibilities

LEADERSHIP

  • Ownership of and accountability for successful results of the Data Warehouse & Business Intelligence teams within Data Transformation.
  • Thought leadership in matters of enterprise data architecture, staying abreast of new technologies, patterns and methods which c an be applicable to Crowe data
  • Development of team strategy, creation and socialization of roadmaps, establishing and ensuring adherence to timelines, and resource assignment for the BIDW team
  • Seek opportunities to bring value to the Crowe business and/or its customers through innovative enterprise data and BI strategies to support strategic business goals
  • Develop quantifiable goals for the team which are aligned with Data Transformation’s strategic goals as well as Crowe’s strategic business initiatives
  • Mentor and coach developers, data engineers, managers, and other roles within team, intentionally managing career growth via mentorship and proactive planning
  • Actively participate in and collaborate with technical guilds to further expose and align the firm on best practices
  • Understand when to delegate; this role manages resources and owns the entire team’s success
  • Responsibility to track and maintain clear visibility into the value and delivery timing of BIDW team initiatives for Head of Data and business stakeholders

DEMAND MANAGEMENT & BUSINESS ENGAGEMENT

  • Collaboration with Head of Data and/or other firm leaders to understand strategic business needs and requirements, and planning team and technology capacity accordingly
  • Communication and engagement to ensure the business sees maximum value from its data warehouse and business intelligence investments
  • Develop and maintain an understanding of business needs, technical architecture and systems landscape, and the technology strategy of the business
  • Collaborate with both BIDW team and Data Transformation leaders to establish goals, plan capacity, support other Data Transformation initiatives, and leave margin for learning and unexpected shifts

PROGRAM DESIGN, DEVELOPMENT & DEPLOYMENT

  • Ultimate ownership for team delivery quality and schedule
  • Work closely with technology and business personnel to deliver value in a timely manner
  • Accountability for team using best practices for development and quality assurance aligned with firmwide standards, seeking opportunities to automate and improve
  • CONTINUOUS IMPROVEMENT
  • Champion a culture and mindset of excellence, collaboration, continuous improvement, design thinking and positivity
  • Establish metrics to monitor and tangibly demonstrate the value provided to the business via effectiveness, quality metrics, sensitive data monitoring as well as alert to any negative trends in these areas
  • Work with stakeholders to prioritize continuous improvement
  • Assess and recommend opportunities to retire/consolidate redundant legacy system assets
  • ADOPTION & VALUE REALIZATION
  • Work with team and business users to ensure successful adoption, usage, and benefit realization from solutions
  • Define and track KPIs and success metrics for adoption and value creation

Specific responsibility expectations by the components listed below –

Information Architecture Vision: Establish the Enterprise Information Architecture vision within the context of business strategy and in alignment with overall Technology & Strategy direction.

  • Translate strategic requirements into a usable enterprise information architecture, which may include an enterprise data model, common business vocabulary, ontology, and taxonomies, to guide enterprise solution development and achieve consistency of information assets.
  • Create an information architecture consistent with the business, application, and technical architectures.
  • Facilitate the mapping and traceability of information assets as they flow from source datastores to targets, thus ensuring optimal transparency, quality, consistency, and controlled redundancy.

Information Architecture Delivery: Work with and mentor delivery teams to provide data solutions that are in keeping with the enterprise information architecture. This may include:

  • Assessing suitability of vendor solutions to meet enterprise information requirements.
  • Construct, refine and maintain information models, as needed, to meet business requirements and drive data designs for operational and analytical solutions.
  • Facilitate the definition of integrative and canonical views of data or information across multiple content types to support convergence of information asset migration planning or impact analysis.
  • Ensure new development is consistent and well-integrated with the established enterprise information architecture, using metadata management and/or a repository to promote reuse and standards adoption.
  • Review corporate data sources for new business information and better data sources. Assist in post-implementation improvement efforts to enhance performance and provide increased functionality.
  • Participate in key project design reviews as part of the methodology process to ensure application designs adhere to enterprise information architecture guidelines.
  • Provide oversight for the BI Data Warehouse. Design an enterprise-wide integrated Data Warehouse for
  • Business Intelligence by modeling new and enhancing existing BIDW datamarts. Establish logical and physical models, maintain metadata, and guide integration engineers for the physical datamart schema and logical integration (ETL) processes. Assist, as required, with testing and issue resolution. Establish and enhance governance processes for the BI Data Warehouse (naming conventions, conformed dimensions and facts, meta-models, security configuration) to ensure a consistent implementation across all datamarts.
  • On large implementation projects, deliver project artifacts including: Data Integration Inventory, 360 Data Integration Diagram, Core structures diagram, Data Integration Requirements document and Test Plans, Report Inventory, Reporting Gap Analysis and Strategy, and Historical Data Strategy

Business Intelligence Team Leadership: Provide leadership, oversight, and quality assurance for BI Team and team deliverables. This may include:

  • Manage and coach BI team members in delivery of high-quality business intelligence solutions. Assist to estimate effort / duration for new requests and change orders. Track work queue, assign and adjust priorities and due dates based on client requirements and DT Leadership direction. Provide BI team with visibility to DT projects and project pipeline. Provide a forum for BI team collaboration on BI and Data Warehouse design and technical challenges.
  • Establish, document, and maintain best practices for Business Intelligence and Data Warehousing.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Analytics, Data/Information Science, Information Systems, Mathematics (or other related fields)
  • 6+ years of experience with SQL
  • 4+ years of experience in Business Intelligence, data analysis, and reporting
  • 4+ years of experience with Microsoft Power BI, including DAX, Power Query, and M language.
  • 2+ years of experience with Python (or other programming languages)
  • 4+ years of experience managing projects from inception to execution.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Microsoft Fabric Analytics Engineer certifications preferred.
  • Strong understanding of Data Warehousing and Business Intelligence concepts, Data Quality, and the related technology landscape, processes, and design principles
  • Proven track record in operating large data warehouse and business intelligence programs
  • Experience in managing enterprise data assets in a large, complex organization
  • Should be familiar with cloud and data management trends and methodologies
  • Ability to analyze complex situations and to derive workable actions
  • Ability to constructively challenge requirements and current state to increase overall value to the firm
  • Strong relationship building skills
  • Flexibility to adjust to multiple demands, shifting priorities, ambiguity, and rapid change
  • Good written and verbal communication
  • Strong analytical and time management skills
  • Strong facilitation skills with the ability to drive issues to closure
  • Self-motivated and able to handle tasks with minimal supervision or questions
  • Ability to compare technologies and make recommendations to senior members of the team
  • Understanding of privacy laws and regulations

The United Nations Federal Credit Union (UNFCU), founded in 1947, is a member-owned, not-for-profit cooperative that offers a range of banking, investment and insurance products and services to the global UN community. We have more than 260,000 members in over 200 countries, assets in excess of USD $10B, and more than 700 employees. UNFCU is committed to social responsibility and we support causes worldwide. Headquartered in Long Island City - Queens, and with branches in New York City and offices in Washington, D.C. and McLean, VA, UNFCU also has representative offices in Geneva, Switzerland; Vienna, Austria; Nairobi, Kenya, Rome, Italy and Entebbe, Uganda. For more information, visit www.unfcu.org.

As an employer, our benefits are second to none, and include comprehensive medical, dental and vision; 401k with dollar for dollar matching contributions and immediate vesting; a generous defined benefit cash balance plan; tuition reimbursement; volunteer time off; company paid life & disability coverage; flexible spending accounts; and maternity/paternity leave to name a few!

We are committed to embedding diversity in all areas of our business. We promote an environment of equity and inclusion where we embrace and leverage our differences to drive organizational success. Our staff is representative of the global membership we serve.

Because of this diversity, we can understand, communicate, empathize, and connect with each and every member. Our employees, and the exceptional service they provide, are our core strength as we provide peace of mind to our members. 

UNFCU has a dedicated Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Belonging (DEIB) Council and several business resource groups (BRGs) comprised of staff volunteers. Each BRG hosts educational events and activities to empower their members and allies. The BRGs also identify and implement measurable best practices that further embed DEI in UNFCU’s corporate culture. 
 
An Equal Opportunity & Affirmative Action Employer

Why join this team

Establish and build out our long-term data strategy and architecture for the Data & Analytics Center of Excellence. Collaborate with various data management teams and business units in architecting and enhancing data warehouse & data lake solutions, ETL processes, and reports. Expand and maintain our data dictionaries, architecture design documents, and standards documentation and promote adherence to policy and best practices

This position is expected to be hybrid.

$140,000-$155,000 annually; compensation is commensurate to geographic location

What You'll Do

  • Regardless of seniority or role, uphold UNFCU’s mission, core values, and guiding principles by providing an exceptional service experience to colleagues and members alike through consistent demonstration of our service excellence behaviors.
  • Collaborate with data management teams to understand enterprise data requirements and contribute to data solution and architecture design.
  • Partner closely with business intelligence and analytics teams, product managers, and leadership to understand data needs, deliver precise and high-quality data solutions, and promote adherence to data policies and best practices.
  • Partner with other IT teams to ensure data platforms, architecture, and development practices meet IT standards and design requirements.
  • Expand and maintain data dictionaries, architecture design documents, standards documentation, and development frameworks.
  • Develop data objects and processes, including marts, tables, and ETL components, within data warehousing and data lake ecosystems according to business and technical specifications.
  • Provide data architecture and analysis support to business units for active projects and initiatives and propose effective solutions.
  • Troubleshoot data platform, pipeline, and architecture-related issues, providing maintenance and support as needed to ensure maintainable and scalable architecture.
  • Stay informed of industry trends and attend training, conferences, and seminars aligned with the organization’s business requirements.
  • Participate in Credit Union training and development programs.
  • Perform additional responsibilities as assigned.
  • Ensure compliance with applicable federal and state laws and regulations , as well as UNFCU’s Code of Ethics & Business Conduct.


What We're Seeking

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or related field
  • 3 years of experience in Data Architect Role
  • 5 years of working knowledge in Datawarehouse
  • 5 years of data engineering experience in MS SQL, Fabric, Snowflake or other equivalent data platforms
  • Experience in ETL development using Microsoft SQL Server Platform and Oracle DBMS
  • Proficiency in SQL, including query performance tuning, index maintenance, and understanding of database structures
  • Experience creating reports in tools like Tableau, Power BI, or Qlik
  • Experience using cloud technologies like Microsoft Fabric, Snowflake, or Databricks
  • Knowledge of various SQL data storage mechanisms and Big Data technologies
  • Experience in warehousing architecture techniques, including MOLAP, ROLAP, ODS, Data Marts, and Enterprise Data Warehouse


What Makes You Stand Out

  • Experience with Azure Devops, Github, and CI/CD development principles
  • Knowledge of financial/banking industry
  • Experience working in environments within various firewall layers


Who We Are

UNFCU is a global not-for-profit financial institution that serves the UN community. We are committed to providing peace of mind to our members and colleagues and strive to achieve service excellence in all that we do. The best part of UNFCU is the people. Those that choose to work with us often find personal fulfillment, professional growth and a purposeful culture.

UNFCU is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. UNFCU prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type. All applicants will be considered for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by country, federal, state or local laws.
