Reporting to the appropriate Supply Chain technology leader, you will provide senior technical leadership for data engineering, data architecture, and domain modeling across the Supply Chain Value Stream. You will translate business priorities into a practical data architecture roadmap and guide teams in delivering trusted, governed, reusable data products that support analytics, artificial intelligence, and data-driven decision-making. You will partner across Supply Chain, business analytics, and Information Technology Shared Services supporting Catalyst and other projects, while mentoring architects and engineers and influencing technical direction without formal people management responsibility.

A Taste Of Your Responsibilities

  • Define and maintain the Supply Chain data strategy and architecture roadmap in partnership with portfolio, business, analytics, and Information Technology Shared Services teams.
  • Serve as a technical lead for System Analysts, Data Engineers, and Senior Data Engineers supporting Supply Chain, providing guidance through design discussions, code reviews, hands-on prototyping, and technical mentorship.
  • Lead technical discussions and influence delivery approaches across portfolios while aligning execution with domain roadmaps and enterprise standards.
  • Coach solution and functional architects on data strategy, domain modeling, data-product design, architecture trade-offs, and the early incorporation of data requirements into solution designs.
  • Lead the design and evolution of conceptual, logical, and physical data models for Supply Chain.
  • Translate Supply Chain and Innovation business processes into curated, reusable data products by defining the business entities, relationships, and data required to represent those processes.
  • Provide technical guidance to build teams through design reviews and solution sign-off, validating approaches through hands-on prototyping.
  • Ensure data models align with enterprise definitions, key performance indicators, and governance standards.
  • Partner with Data Architects and governance teams to incorporate data lineage, metadata, data quality, security, and access requirements into data products.
  • Assess enterprise data standards and guardrails against Supply Chain needs, document gaps, and partner with Information Technology Shared Services to enhance or establish appropriate standards.
  • Lead the development and maintenance of scalable data pipelines supporting Supply Chain domain data products.
  • Guide implementation of SQL transformations, data-processing logic, and performance optimization.
  • Ensure pipelines and transformations are developed and operated as code using continuous integration, continuous delivery, and development operations practices.
  • Drive data-quality checks and observability to help teams identify data issues, monitor pipeline health, and support solutions after initial delivery.
  • Partner with Supply Chain, Analytics, and Data Science teams to align data products with business needs.
  • Partner closely with the business analytics group on a roadmap of technical requirement changes, including new features, capabilities, and guidance for the data and analytics ecosystem. Translate technology changes into actionable technical requirements and clear business impacts, and coordinate transition planning.
  • Collaborate with Automation and AI Enablement Engineers so AI solutions consume governed domain data.
  • Shape data products and pipelines for advanced analytics and AI use cases with appropriate quality, metadata, lineage, security, and access considerations.
  • Participate in domain-level planning, design reviews, and dependency-management discussions.
  • Evaluate alternative data designs based on data structure, performance, cost, and time to value, and recommend cost-aware solutions for Supply Chain data workloads.
  • Help drive measurable reuse of domain data products, adoption of the Supply Chain data roadmap, earlier consideration of data requirements in solution designs, and achievement of data-quality service levels for priority datasets.


Ingredients Required For Your Success

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field; advanced degree preferred.
  • Eight or more years of experience in data engineering, analytics engineering, or related roles, including three or more years in an architecture or technical-lead role.
  • Demonstrated experience guiding data engineers through technical mentorship and delivery leadership.
  • Demonstrated experience coaching architects and influencing technical decisions without formal authority.
  • Strong expertise in data modeling for complex operational domains; Supply Chain or Manufacturing experience is preferred.
  • Advanced proficiency with SQL, Python, and data-transformation techniques.
  • Deep, recent hands-on experience with cloud-based data platforms such as Databricks, Microsoft Fabric, and Palantir.
  • Experience developing curated datasets and domain-oriented data products.
  • Strong understanding of data governance, data quality, lineage, metadata management, security, and access controls.
  • Experience applying development operations and continuous integration and continuous delivery practices to data pipelines.
  • Experience preparing governed, reusable data for machine learning, generative artificial intelligence, or other advanced analytics use cases is preferred.
  • Experience evaluating data architectures based on performance, cost, maintainability, and time to value.
  • Strong communication skills for explaining technical concepts and trade-offs to engineering and business audiences.
  • Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills.


Compensation

Pay Range:$125,400-$182,900

The annual salary listed above is the expected offering for this position. An employee’s actual annual salary will be based on but not limited to: location, relevant experience/level and skillset, while balancing internal Conagra employees’ equity. Conagra Brands will comply with applicable law regarding minimum salaries for exempt employees.

Our Benefits

We care about your total well-being and will support you with the following, subject to your location and role:

  • Health: Comprehensive healthcare plans, wellness incentive program, mental wellbeing support and fitness reimbursement
  • Wealth: Great pay, bonus incentive opportunity, matching 401(k) and stock purchase plan
  • Growth: Career development opportunities, employee resource groups, on-demand learning and tuition reimbursement
  • Balance: Paid-time off, parental leave, flexible work-schedules (subject to your location and role) and volunteer opportunities


Our Company

At Conagra Brands, we have a rich heritage of making great food. We aspire to have the most impactful, energized and inclusive culture in food. As a member of our 18,000+ person team across 40+ locations, you are empowered to reach your potential, make an impact and own your career. We're in the business of building champions – within our people and our iconic brands like Birds Eye®, Slim Jim® and Reddi-Wip®.

Our focus on innovation extends beyond making great food, it also reflects our commitment to embracing new solutions that positively impact our team, the communities we serve and the health of our planet. Foodies Welcome.

As a Applied AI Health Data Architect you will shape data architecture solutions that support health services provider clients, bringing together data engineering, analytics, and AI to improve how information is structured, integrated, and used across cloud environments. As a Senior Manager you will lead large projects, bring strategic direction to complex data modernization efforts, and use sound judgment to guide teams and stakeholders through changing priorities and technical complexity. In this role at PwC, you will work within our Advisory practice and within our Data, Analytics & AI services to design data platforms, support cloud-native architecture decisions, and contribute to delivery across AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud Platform environments for health sector clients.

Responsibilities

  • Leading applied AI and health data architecture initiatives for provider data environments, translating business goals into scalable data solutions
  • Designing cloud-native data platforms, pipelines, and integration patterns across AWS, Azure, Databricks, and Snowflake
  • Developing data models, warehouse structures, and transformation logic that support analytics, AI workloads, and operational reporting
  • Guiding data modernization efforts that migrate legacy systems into modern architectures with improved performance, security, and usability
  • Overseeing data quality, validation, governance, and anonymization practices across sensitive health data domains
  • Applying data engineering methods to tune pipelines, optimize queries, and improve database and warehouse performance
  • Advising client stakeholders on data strategy, architecture decisions, and AI-ready platform design within complex provider environments
  • Leading teams through delivery planning, issue resolution, and technical coordination across multiple workstreams
  • Coaching practitioners on data engineering platforms, digital tooling, and AI-enabled solution delivery
  • Presenting solution options, tradeoffs, and implementation paths that support modernization priorities and future data capabilities

What You Must Have

  • At least a Bachelor's degree
  • At least 7 years of experience

What Sets You Apart

  • Preference for at least one of the following fields of study: Analytics/Data Science, Business Administration/Management, Computer Science/Information Systems, Economics, Engineering, Finance, Mathematics/Statistics, Operations/Supply Chain
  • Demonstrating data architecture leadership for healthcare provider modernization initiatives
  • Utilizing AWS, Azure, Databricks, or Snowflake for cloud data platforms
  • Applying AI fluency to data engineering and architecture decisions
  • Translating client needs into scalable data modernization roadmaps

Position Summary:

The Principal Cloud Data Solutions Architect is a senior individual contributor and technical leader who remains close to implementation. The role is accountable for turning enterprise data strategy into working platforms, reusable engineering capabilities, production-grade pipelines, and architecture decisions that improve delivery across teams.

This role combines hands-on data engineering leadership with ownership of enterprise cloud data solutions architecture. It designs, builds, and evolves scalable, secure, resilient, and cost-effective data platforms; establishes engineering standards and reusable patterns; and guides teams from architecture through production delivery. Operating with significant autonomy, the role partners with business, data, security, infrastructure, and application teams to modernize the enterprise data ecosystem, deliver trusted data products, and ensure solutions meet strategic, regulatory, operational, and reliability requirements.

Role Specific Essential Functions

  • Define, evolve, and govern modern cloud data solutions architecture principles, standards, reference architectures, and reusable patterns aligned with business and data strategy.
  • Design and evaluate end-to-end cloud data solution architectures spanning ingestion, streaming, storage, lakehouse and warehouse platforms, transformation, orchestration, analytics, AI/ML, and data consumption.
  • Design, build, and evolve end-to-end cloud data solutions spanning source acquisition, data contracts, batch and streaming ingestion, storage, lakehouse and warehouse platforms, transformation, orchestration, analytical modeling, APIs, and data consumption.
  • Own the technical direction and delivery quality of complex data initiatives, ensuring platforms, pipelines, and data products are scalable, resilient, observable, interoperable, secure, compliant, and operable in production.
  • Assess cloud data technology options and trade-offs, including performance, scalability, interoperability, security, vendor fit, total cost of ownership, and long-term value.
  • Establish and improve engineering practices for testing, deployment, monitoring, incident response, data quality, lineage, service-level objectives, fault tolerance, and cost optimization across production data pipelines and platforms.
  • Own critical data domains and their supporting pipelines end to end, from source-system engagement and data acquisition through modeling, delivery, operational support, and continuous improvement.
  • Partner with business, analytics, data governance, security, application, and platform teams to translate domain needs into governed data products, APIs, shared datasets, and trusted self-service capabilities.
  • Identify and lead opportunities to modernize and simplify the data ecosystem through cloud-native services, reusable ingestion and transformation frameworks, configuration-driven data pipelines, data mesh and data product practices, platform consolidation, automation, and legacy-data migration.
  • Serve as a cloud data solutions architecture thought leader and mentor, guiding architecture reviews, promoting data engineering best practices, and influencing teams without direct authority.
  • Shape cloud data platform and capability roadmaps by anticipating emerging technologies and practices, including real-time data, open table formats, semantic technologies, data observability, FinOps, and AI-ready architecture.

Role Specific Expectations And Qualifications

  • Anticipates internal and external business issues and recommends product, process, or service improvements, including opportunities to modernize cloud data platforms, engineering frameworks, governed data products, semantic layers, and data consumption capabilities.
  • Leads high-risk, complex initiatives across the cloud data ecosystem from technical strategy through implementation and operational adoption.
  • Analyzes complex business and data problems, makes sound architectural and engineering trade-offs, and delivers recommendations that improve scalability, reliability, delivery speed, data trust, and cost.Exercises independent judgment in methods, techniques and evaluation criteria to work on significant and unique issues involving cloud data solutions architecture, platform capabilities, data integration, modeling, governance, security, scalability, and cost.
  • Expert level knowledge in functional area and broad understanding of multiple disciplines. Applies innovative technical or industry knowledge to modern data solutions architecture and analytics practices. Communicates frequently with leadership.
  • Acts independently to determine methods and procedures and may supervise the activities of others. Works autonomously under general guidance and serves as a hands-on technical leader for cloud data solutions architecture and engineering.
  • Guides cross-functional teams on architecture standards, reference patterns, data contracts, engineering frameworks, semantic-layer approaches, modernization decisions, and production-readiness expectations. Manages multiple processes or programs and establishes operational plans.

Education & Experience

  • Required Education: Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics, information systems, or a related field; equivalent relevant experience may be considered.
  • Required Experience: 10+ years of data, software, or technology experience, including 5+ years architecting and implementing enterprise data and analytics solutions on AWS or an equivalent public cloud platform.
  • 7+ years designing, building, and operating modern data platforms and distributed data systems using technologies such as SQL, NoSQL, data lakes, lakehouses, cloud data warehouses, Spark, Kafka, and cloud-native batch and streaming services.
  • 5+ years of hands-on software and data engineering experience using SQL and at least one modern programming language, such as Python, Java, or Scala, with demonstrated use of version control, automated testing, continuous integration and delivery, infrastructure as code, and code-review practices.
  • 5+ years leading complex, large-scale, cross-functional data or cloud initiatives and working directly with internal or external customers and senior stakeholders.

Qualifications & Skills

  • Extensive experience architecting, building, and operating enterprise-scale data and analytics solutions on AWS or an equivalent public cloud platform, including hands-on implementation across data ingestion, transformation, orchestration, storage, modeling, platform engineering, migration, governance, and related technology domains.
  • Demonstrated experience building and operating highly available, distributed data ingestion and processing systems at scale, including performance tuning, failure recovery, schema evolution, data quality controls, lineage, observability, and cost management.
  • Strong ability to conceptualize modern data solutions architecture, data product, information-model, and semantic-layer patterns and translate them into actionable designs and implementation roadmaps.
  • Deep understanding of cloud-native data platforms and end-to-end data solutions architectures, including data lakes, lakehouses, warehouses, batch and streaming pipelines, data modeling, APIs, metadata, data quality, observability, security, governance, and performance optimization.
  • Proven skill in evaluating cloud data technologies and solution options from technical, operational, security, interoperability, vendor, and financial perspectives, including performance and FinOps considerations.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead technical workstreams and cross-functional project teams, influence technology and data decisions, drive alignment, and communicate complex cloud data solutions architecture concepts to business, engineering, security, governance, and executive audiences.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, troubleshooting, and decision-making capabilities, with the ability to provide technical guidance throughout delivery and balance scalability, resilience, governance, security, performance, delivery speed, cost, and long-term architectural outcomes.
  • Experience working independently on highly complex cloud data problems with broad organizational impact, leading cross-functional teams through platform modernization, and developing data and analytics migration strategies from current-state assessment through implementation.
  • Certification/License: Relevant cloud architecture, cloud data engineering, or data management.

Description

Position Summary:

The Principal Cloud Data Solutions Architect is a senior individual contributor and technical leader who remains close to implementation. The role is accountable for turning enterprise data strategy into working platforms, reusable engineering capabilities, production-grade pipelines, and architecture decisions that improve delivery across teams.

This role combines hands-on data engineering leadership with ownership of enterprise cloud data solutions architecture. It designs, builds, and evolves scalable, secure, resilient, and cost-effective data platforms; establishes engineering standards and reusable patterns; and guides teams from architecture through production delivery. Operating with significant autonomy, the role partners with business, data, security, infrastructure, and application teams to modernize the enterprise data ecosystem, deliver trusted data products, and ensure solutions meet strategic, regulatory, operational, and reliability requirements.

Role Specific Essential Functions



- Define, evolve, and govern modern cloud data solutions architecture principles, standards, reference architectures, and reusable patterns aligned with business and data strategy.
- Design and evaluate end-to-end cloud data solution architectures spanning ingestion, streaming, storage, lakehouse and warehouse platforms, transformation, orchestration, analytics, AI/ML, and data consumption.
- Design, build, and evolve end-to-end cloud data solutions spanning source acquisition, data contracts, batch and streaming ingestion, storage, lakehouse and warehouse platforms, transformation, orchestration, analytical modeling, APIs, and data consumption.
- Own the technical direction and delivery quality of complex data initiatives, ensuring platforms, pipelines, and data products are scalable, resilient, observable, interoperable, secure, compliant, and operable in production.
- Assess cloud data technology options and trade-offs, including performance, scalability, interoperability, security, vendor fit, total cost of ownership, and long-term value.
- Establish and improve engineering practices for testing, deployment, monitoring, incident response, data quality, lineage, service-level objectives, fault tolerance, and cost optimization across production data pipelines and platforms.
- Own critical data domains and their supporting pipelines end to end, from source-system engagement and data acquisition through modeling, delivery, operational support, and continuous improvement.
- Partner with business, analytics, data governance, security, application, and platform teams to translate domain needs into governed data products, APIs, shared datasets, and trusted self-service capabilities.
- Identify and lead opportunities to modernize and simplify the data ecosystem through cloud-native services, reusable ingestion and transformation frameworks, configuration-driven data pipelines, data mesh and data product practices, platform consolidation, automation, and legacy-data migration.
- Serve as a cloud data solutions architecture thought leader and mentor, guiding architecture reviews, promoting data engineering best practices, and influencing teams without direct authority.
- Shape cloud data platform and capability roadmaps by anticipating emerging technologies and practices, including real-time data, open table formats, semantic technologies, data observability, FinOps, and AI-ready architecture.

Role Specific Expectations And Qualifications



- Anticipates internal and external business issues and recommends product, process, or service improvements, including opportunities to modernize cloud data platforms, engineering frameworks, governed data products, semantic layers, and data consumption capabilities.
- Leads high-risk, complex initiatives across the cloud data ecosystem from technical strategy through implementation and operational adoption.
- Analyzes complex business and data problems, makes sound architectural and engineering trade-offs, and delivers recommendations that improve scalability, reliability, delivery speed, data trust, and cost.Exercises independent judgment in methods, techniques and evaluation criteria to work on significant and unique issues involving cloud data solutions architecture, platform capabilities, data integration, modeling, governance, security, scalability, and cost. 
- Expert level knowledge in functional area and broad understanding of multiple disciplines. Applies innovative technical or industry knowledge to modern data solutions architecture and analytics practices. Communicates frequently with leadership.
- Acts independently to determine methods and procedures and may supervise the activities of others. Works autonomously under general guidance and serves as a hands-on technical leader for cloud data solutions architecture and engineering. 
- Guides cross-functional teams on architecture standards, reference patterns, data contracts, engineering frameworks, semantic-layer approaches, modernization decisions, and production-readiness expectations. Manages multiple processes or programs and establishes operational plans.

Education & Experience



- Required Education: Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics, information systems, or a related field; equivalent relevant experience may be considered.
- Required Experience: 10+ years of data, software, or technology experience, including 5+ years architecting and implementing enterprise data and analytics solutions on AWS or an equivalent public cloud platform.
- 7+ years designing, building, and operating modern data platforms and distributed data systems using technologies such as SQL, NoSQL, data lakes, lakehouses, cloud data warehouses, Spark, Kafka, and cloud-native batch and streaming services.
- 5+ years of hands-on software and data engineering experience using SQL and at least one modern programming language, such as Python, Java, or Scala, with demonstrated use of version control, automated testing, continuous integration and delivery, infrastructure as code, and code-review practices.
- 5+ years leading complex, large-scale, cross-functional data or cloud initiatives and working directly with internal or external customers and senior stakeholders.

Qualifications & Skills



- Extensive experience architecting, building, and operating enterprise-scale data and analytics solutions on AWS or an equivalent public cloud platform, including hands-on implementation across data ingestion, transformation, orchestration, storage, modeling, platform engineering, migration, governance, and related technology domains.
- Demonstrated experience building and operating highly available, distributed data ingestion and processing systems at scale, including performance tuning, failure recovery, schema evolution, data quality controls, lineage, observability, and cost management.
- Strong ability to conceptualize modern data solutions architecture, data product, information-model, and semantic-layer patterns and translate them into actionable designs and implementation roadmaps.
- Deep understanding of cloud-native data platforms and end-to-end data solutions architectures, including data lakes, lakehouses, warehouses, batch and streaming pipelines, data modeling, APIs, metadata, data quality, observability, security, governance, and performance optimization.
- Proven skill in evaluating cloud data technologies and solution options from technical, operational, security, interoperability, vendor, and financial perspectives, including performance and FinOps considerations.
- Demonstrated ability to lead technical workstreams and cross-functional project teams, influence technology and data decisions, drive alignment, and communicate complex cloud data solutions architecture concepts to business, engineering, security, governance, and executive audiences.
- Strong analytical, problem-solving, troubleshooting, and decision-making capabilities, with the ability to provide technical guidance throughout delivery and balance scalability, resilience, governance, security, performance, delivery speed, cost, and long-term architectural outcomes.
- Experience working independently on highly complex cloud data problems with broad organizational impact, leading cross-functional teams through platform modernization, and developing data and analytics migration strategies from current-state assessment through implementation.

Job Summary

WHO ARE WE?

Live Nation Entertainment is the world’s leading live entertainment company, comprised of global market leaders: Ticketmaster, Live Nation Concerts, and Live Nation Media & Sponsorship. Ticketmaster is the global leader in event ticketing with over 620 million tickets sold annually and approximately 10,000 clients worldwide. Live Nation Concerts is the largest provider of live entertainment in the world promoting more than 50,000 events annually for nearly 7,000 artists in 40+ countries. These businesses allow Live Nation Media & Sponsorship to create strategic music marketing programs that connect more than 1,200 sponsors with the 145 million fans that attend Live Nation Entertainment events each year. For additional information, visit www.livenationentertainment.com.

WHO ARE YOU?

Passionate and motivated. Driven, with an entrepreneurial spirit. Resourceful, innovative, forward thinking and committed. At Live Nation Entertainment, our people embrace these qualities, so if this sounds like you then please read on!

THE TEAM

The Core Data Services (CDS) team is the backbone of our enterprise data and analytics initiatives. We are building a scalable, modern data platform that powers business intelligence, analytics, and AI across the organization. Our mission is to make trusted data accessible and actionable—enabling data-driven decision-making across all business functions.

You will be part of the Delivery Engineering and Architecture group within CDS, working alongside platform engineers, data engineers, and solution architects to design and deliver high-impact data solutions for the enterprise.

THE ROLE

As a Senior Solution Architect within the Core Data Services (CDS) team, you will be an individual contributor responsible for designing, implementing, and optimizing end-to-end data warehouse and analytics solutions. You will work closely with data engineers, platform teams, and business stakeholders to translate requirements into robust technical designs that support real-time, high-volume, and low-latency use cases.

This role sits at the intersection of architecture, engineering, and execution—you will define standards, build solutions, and guide teams on best practices in data platform design, ETL development, performance tuning, and cost optimization.

THE IDEAL CANDIDATE

You are a hands-on, technically strong Solution Architect who thrives on designing and delivering large-scale, high-performance data solutions. You have deep experience across the modern data stack — from ETL development and data modeling to cloud-scale architecture and API-based integrations. You are not just a strategist; you build, optimize, and get things done.

You communicate clearly, collaborate effectively across teams, and take pride in delivering reliable, scalable, and cost-efficient data platforms. If you enjoy solving complex data challenges and driving architecture decisions that shape enterprise-scale systems, this role is for you.

What This Role Will Do

  • Design & Architecture: Define and implement modern data warehouse architecture and frameworks, covering data modeling, ETL pipelines, orchestration, storage, and access patterns.
  • Build & Deliver: Develop scalable data solutions leveraging Databricks, AWS, and other modern tools to handle large-scale, high-frequency data workloads.
  • Integration & APIs: Design and build APIs and data integration layers to enable interoperability across systems and real-time data access.
  • Optimization & Reliability: Continuously improve performance, scalability, and cost efficiency across ETL processes, compute environments, and data delivery systems.
  • Collaboration: Work with cross-functional teams—including Data Engineering, Platform Engineering, and Analytics—to align technical solutions with business outcomes.
  • Data Governance & Standards: Champion best practices for data quality, lineage, metadata management, and compliance.
  • Documentation & Knowledge Sharing: Create architecture diagrams, technical documentation, and design templates to support reuse and consistency across the organization.

What This Person Will Bring

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field.
  • 10+ years of experience in data engineering or architecture roles, with strong expertise in data warehousing and distributed data systems.
  • Proven experience building large-scale, high-throughput data pipelines using Databricks, Spark, Delta Lake, S3, and related technologies.
  • Deep understanding of ETL/ELT design, data modeling, and data integration patterns (batch and streaming).
  • Strong programming skills in Python, SQL, and familiarity with API development and orchestration tools.
  • Experience working with cloud platforms (AWS preferred) and tools such as Snowflake, Redshift, or BigQuery.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a bias for action and ownership.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to simplify complex technical concepts for diverse audiences.
  • Knowledge of data governance, lineage, and security best practices.
  • Certifications in AWS, Databricks, or related technologies are a plus.

Why Join Us

  • Be part of a team that is building the next-generation enterprise data platform from the ground up.
  • Work on high-volume, low-latency data challenges that directly impact business performance.
  • Collaborate with talented peers across engineering, architecture, and product teams.
  • Have the autonomy to design, innovate, and implement best-in-class data solutions.

Benefits & Perks

Our motto is ‘Taking Care of Our Own’ through 6 pillars of benefits:

  • HEALTH: Medical, vision, dental and mental health benefits for you and your family, with access to a health care concierge, and Flexible or Health Savings Accounts (FSA or HSA)
  • YOURSELF: Free concert tickets, generous paid time off including paid holidays, sick time, and personal days
  • WEALTH: 401(k) program with company match, stock reimbursement program
  • FAMILY: New parent programs including caregiver leave and baby bonuses, plus fertility, adoption, foster, or surrogacy support
  • CAREER: Career and skill development programs with School of Live, tuition reimbursement, and student loan repayment
  • OTHERS: Volunteer time off, crowdfunding match

EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY

We aspire to build teams that reflect and support the fans and artists we serve. Every day we aim to promote environments where everyone can be themselves, contribute fully, and thrive within our company and at our events. As a growing business we will encourage you to develop your professional and personal aspirations, enjoy new experiences, and learn from the talented people you will be working with.

Live Nation strongly supports equal employment opportunity for all applicants regardless of age (40 and over), ancestry, color, religious creed (including religious dress and grooming practices), family and medical care leave or the denial of family and medical care leave, mental or physical disability (including HIV and AIDS), marital status, domestic partner status, medical condition (including cancer and genetic characteristics), genetic information, military and veteran status, political affiliation, national origin (including language use restrictions), citizenship, race, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding and medical conditions related to pregnancy, childbirth or breastfeeding), gender, gender identity, and gender expression, sexual orientation, intersectionality, or any other basis protected by applicable federal, state or local law, rule, ordinance or regulation.

We will consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the requirements of the Los Angeles Fair Chance Ordinance, San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance and the California Fair Chance Act and consistent with other similar and / or applicable laws in other areas.

We also afford equal employment opportunities to qualified individuals with a disability. For this reason, Live Nation will make reasonable accommodations for the known physical or mental limitations of an otherwise qualified individual with a disability who is an applicant consistent with its legal obligations to do so, including reasonable accommodations related to pregnancy in accordance with applicable local, state and / or federal law. As part of its commitment to make reasonable accommodations, Live Nation also wishes to participate in a timely, good faith, interactive process with a disabled applicant to determine effective reasonable accommodations, if any, which can be made in response to a request for accommodations. Applicants are invited to identify reasonable accommodations that can be made to assist them to perform the essential functions of the position they seek. Job Description

The Data Architect II is responsible for designing and implementing database architecture, design, analysis, migration, and security.

Preferred locations for this role are Houston, Texas or Knoxville, Tennessee.

What You Will Do

  • Develop strategies for data acquisitions, archive recovery, and implementation of a database.
  • Design and build relational databases, conceptual and logical data models, and flowcharts.
  • Develop Databases, Data Warehouses, and Multidimensional Databases.
  • Develop a strategy for Data Archiving, MDM, Reporting, and analytical needs.
  • Develop database solutions to store and retrieve information.
  • Act as a custodian of data and provide insights, assistance, and expertise in making business decisions based on data.
  • Migrate data from legacy systems to new solutions.
  • Define and enforce organizational-level data strategy.
  • Provide operational support for Management Information System (MIS)
  • Develops database solutions by designing the proposed system, defining the database’s physical structure and functional capabilities, and security, backup, and recovery specifications.
  • Provides database support by coding utilities, responding to user questions, and resolving problems.
  • Mentors junior team members and peers, providing expertise and guidance of tools and systems.

What You Will Need

Education and Experience

  • Typically requires a bachelor’s degree or recognized equivalent, from an accredited university, in a data processing discipline or equivalent industry experience.
  • Typically requires 12 years of experience in database design and analysis and 6 years of experience in Oracle 11g or above.

Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities

  • Experience in Enterprise Database development with at least 5 years of database design experience.
  • Possesses a deep understanding of tools used in the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC).
  • Experience in Oracle 11g, MS SQL Server.
  • Hands-on experience with ETL technologies. IBM info sphere DataStage knowledge is a plus.
  • Well-versed in designing and implementing Data Marts, Multi Data Models, Star, and Snowflake Schemas.
  • Knowledge and experience in MSBI technologies, and cloud exposure to Azure is a plus.
  • Proficient in programming languages such as PL/SQL code.
  • Demonstrated ability to work well with others.
  • Proven capability to train employees in technically complex areas.
  • Proactive, energetic self-starter with good problem-solving skills.
  • Prior experience with Oracle DBA and knowledge of AGILE development principles is preferred.
  • Ability to develop a working knowledge of ABS Rules, Guides, statutory regulations, and related instructions, as well as the ABS Employee Safety Policy.

Reporting Relationships

This position reports to a Manager, Director, or Executive level position.

About Us

About ABS Wavesight

ABS Wavesight is the new ABS Affiliate maritime software as a service (SaaS) company dedicated to helping shipowners and operators streamline compliance while maintaining competitive,more efficient, and sustainable operations. Our mission is to develop world-class software products that improve vessel performance for the health of our seas, environment and self. Backed by ABS’s 160-year legacy of maritime innovation and experience, our products are collectively installed on more than 5,000 vessels across the global fleet. Learn more about ABS Wavesight by visiting www.abswavesight.com .

Equal Opportunity

About Us

At Selective, we don't just insure uniquely, we employ uniqueness.

Selective is a midsized U.S. domestic property and casualty insurance company with a history of strong, consistent financial performance for nearly 100 years. Selective's unique position as both a leading insurance group and an employer of choice is recognized in a wide variety of awards and honors, including listing in Forbes Best Midsize Employers in 2025 and certification as a Great Place to Work® in 2025 for the sixth consecutive year.

Employees are empowered and encouraged to Be Uniquely You by being their true, unique selves and contributing their diverse talents, experiences, and perspectives to our shared success. Together, we are a high-performing team working to serve our customers responsibly by helping to mitigate loss, keep them safe, and restore their lives and businesses after an insured loss occurs.

Overview

The Sr. Data and Analytics Architect is responsible for the overall design of the data, platforms, and applications (batch/real time, cloud/hybrid) within our Information Management area (including Business Intelligence & Advanced Analytics). This will include the definition of standards, best practices, policies and procedures, integration patterns, data models, high level data flows and data services. This Architect will work in collaboration with IT Application Development teams, Enterprise Architecture, and business partners to establish data and analytics architecture patterns, evaluate new tools and technologies, provide recommendations, support POCs, and assist with implementation/adoption as appropriate. Through this activity, they will enable consistent business analysis, streamlined data acquisition and consumption, development of best-in-class analytical solutions, environment optimization, and compliance with applicable regulations and security standards.

Responsibilities

  • Works with Delivery Managers to balance rapid delivery of business solutions with sound technical solutions and on development team member competencies, skills, and overall productivity.
  • Collaborate with Delivery teams to define, select, and implement data, analytics, and information solutions that consider business objectives and meet non-functional requirements.
  • Assist the Enterprise Architect in the planning process for new business initiatives through buy/build recommendations, vendor solutions evaluations, assessing designs against company standards, evaluating technical risk and define and align technology and roadmaps with business strategies.
  • Monitor trends and evaluates emerging technologies that are candidates for the future state data and analytics architecture or evolving business strategy and supports vendor analysis and proofs-of-concept to validate new technologies, solutions, and designs as needed.
  • Provide mentorship and guidance to Junior Architects and Developers in data and analytics technologies, best practices, innovation, designs, and processes.
  • Assists with tier 2 application production issues and challenging issues in any phase of the development lifecycle. Supports continuous improvement by identifying and proposing tuning opportunities.
  • Identifies opportunities to increase efficiency, quality, and speed to market. Proposes actions to realize opportunities and advocates for DevOps/DataOps opportunities.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, or other related field, or equivalent work experience.
  • 10+ years of experience in Data and Analytics Architecture
  • P&C Insurance industry experience preferred.
  • Understanding of Data Design methodologies and their application in complex multi-tier systems.
  • Knowledge of Real Time, Service Oriented Architecture (SOA) and Web Oriented Architecture (WOA)
  • Strong understanding of Data warehouses, Data Marts and Data Lake.
  • Ability to develop and architect solutions based on non-functional requirements.
  • Experience with Power BI, Azure ML, Azure Databricks, IICS and/or Informatica PowerCenter is preferred.
  • Experience architecting and data modeling in Azure ecosystem is preferred.
  • Superior technical knowledge in Data Quality, Standards, Governance, and Design
  • Ability to effectively work well with people in other departments and/or outside of the enterprise.
  • Strong verbal, written, and interpersonal communication and the ability to communicate with audiences at varying technical levels.

Total Rewards

Selective Insurance offers a total rewards package that includes a competitive base salary, incentive plan eligibility at all levels, and a wide array of benefits designed to help you and your family stay healthy, achieve your financial goals, and balance the demands of your work and personal life. These benefits include comprehensive health care plans, retirement savings plan with company match, discounted Employee Stock Purchase Program, tuition assistance and reimbursement programs, and 20 days of paid time off. Additional details about our total rewards package can be found by visiting our benefits page.

The actual base salary is based on geographic location, and the range is representative of salaries for this role throughout Selective's footprint. Additional considerations include relevant education, qualifications, experience, skills, performance, and business needs.

Pay Range

USD $163,000.00 - USD $220,000.00 /Yr.

Additional Information

Selective is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. That means we respect and value every individual’s unique opinions, beliefs, abilities, and perspectives. We are committed to promoting a welcoming culture that celebrates diverse talent, individual identity, different points of view and experiences – and empowers employees to contribute new ideas that support our continued and growing success. Building a highly engaged team is one of our core strategic imperatives, which we believe is enhanced by diversity, equity, and inclusion. We expect and encourage all employees and all of our business partners to embrace, practice, and monitor the attitudes, values, and goals of acceptance; address biases; and foster diversity of viewpoints and opinions.

For Massachusetts Applicants

It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability.

descriptionHtml:
Job Description

 Rockland Trust is a full-service commercial bank and financial services company committed to helping our neighbors reach their financial goals. Founded in 1907 and headquartered in Massachusetts, we proudly serve individuals, families, and businesses throughout New England with a strong emphasis on personal relationships, local decision making, and community impact.

With a broad range of banking, wealth management, and investment solutions, Rockland Trust combines the resources of a growing financial institution with the personalized service of a community bank. Our long-standing philosophy, Where Each Relationship Matters®, guides how we work with our customers, colleagues, and communities every day.

At Rockland Trust, our employees are at the heart of our success. We foster a collaborative, inclusive, and values driven culture that encourages professional growth, innovation, and work life balance. We are deeply committed to community involvement, financial education, and creating a workplace where individuals can build meaningful, long-term careers.

The Data Architect at Rockland Trust is responsible for designing, implementing, and managing the bank’s enterprise data architecture. This role defines how data is stored, integrated, accessed, and governed across systems to support business strategy, regulatory compliance, and data-driven decision-making. This role is based in Rockland with a hybrid model.

Responsibilities

Enterprise Data Architecture

  • Design and implement modern, enterprise-wide data architecture frameworks and standards
  • Define how data is stored, integrated, accessed, and managed across systems
  • Develop and maintain an enterprise data strategy aligned with business objectives

Data Modeling & Systems Design

  • Lead the design and development of:
  • Data warehouses (DW) and operational data stores (ODS)
  • Logical and physical data models
  • Integration with data quality tools
  • Design scalable data structures to support analytics and reporting

Data Governance, Security & Compliance

  • Establish and enforce data governance frameworks, policies, and standards
  • Ensure compliance with regulatory requirements (e.g., GDPR, SOX, CCPA)
  • Maintain high standards of data quality, integrity, and security across the organization

Performance & Optimization

  • Monitor database performance and data workloads
  • Optimize systems for scalability, reliability, and efficiency
  • Recommend and implement performance tuning and improvement strategies

Leadership & Collaboration

  • Provide technical leadership to data engineers, analysts, and other stakeholders
  • Influence enterprise data initiatives and IT policies
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including business units and external vendors

Tools & Technology Strategy

  • Evaluate, select, and implement data platforms and tools
  • Work with technologies such as MS SQL Server, Oracle, Snowflake, and Azure data platforms
  • Stay current with emerging data technologies and industry trends

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field
  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in data architecture, database design, and data management (preferably in banking or financial services)
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to translate complex technical concepts into business-friendly language
  • Excellent leadership and communication skills

Technical Skills

  • Data modeling tools (e.g., ERwin, ER/Studio)
  • Strong proficiency in SQL and experience with NoSQL databases
  • Experience with Snowflake and modern data platforms
  • Cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, Google Cloud) and modern data architecture patterns
  • Knowledge of data governance and compliance frameworks

Benefits & Culture

Our goal is to offer our colleagues the most generous benefits package possible. We provide a comprehensive suite of benefits designed to support your health, financial security, and overall, well-being. Benefits include competitive compensation with performance-based incentive awards, health, and dental insurance, a 401(k) and DC retirement plan, LTD and life insurance, paid vacation, day care reimbursement, tuition assistance for undergraduate and graduate programs, an award-winning wellness program, and much more!

At Rockland Trust, you’ll find a respectful and inclusive environment where everyone has the opportunity to succeed. We are an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Pay Transparency

Compensation for this role will be based on a variety of factors, including skills, experience, education, and internal equity. The salary range posted reflects the company’s good faith estimate of the range for this position at the time of posting. Actual compensation may vary. In addition to base salary, certain positions may be eligible for additional compensation, including commissions, incentive awards, or stipends.

Accessibility & Accommodations

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodation to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of their roles.

  • Review existing solutions and identify opportunities for continuous improvement, scalability, optimization, and integration.

  • Hands-on experience with SAP ecosystems including SAP S/4HANA, SAP Datasphere, SAP Business Warehouse (BW), SAP Data Services, and SAP integration with Microsoft platforms.
  • Experience creating data modeling solutions leveraging SAP and Microsoft Azure data services, Microsoft Fabric, and Power BI.
  • Knowledge of conceptual, logical, and physical data modeling and database design.
  • TOGAF, DAMA, or related enterprise architecture or data management certifications.

Role

At Lubrizol, we’re committed to providing a safe, inclusive, and empowering environment where you can do your best work—whether in a lab, on the production floor, or in a hybrid office setting. Depending on your role, your work environment may include:

  • Working in a lab or manufacturing setting with appropriate PPE provided
  • Use of computers and digital tools in an office or hybrid environment
  • Occasional lifting or movement of materials
  • Adherence to rigorous safety protocols and ergonomic standards

We continuously invest in our facilities and technologies to ensure they support your well-being, productivity, and growth. If you require reasonable accommodation, we are committed to working with you to ensure an inclusive and accessible experience.

  • Competitive salary with performance-based bonus plans
  • 401(k) match + Age-Weighted Defined Contribution
  • Comprehensive medical, dental & vision coverage
  • Health Savings Account (HSA)
  • Paid holidays, vacation, and parental leave
  • Flexible work environment

  • Career and professional growth

Solution Architect – Data Solutions Architect

The Solution Architect - Data Solutions Architect owns enterprise data modeling standards and the integration architecture that bridges source systems to RSM's canonical data hub and downstream consumers. This role defines conceptual, logical, and physical data models, governs the canonical data model, and partners with the Solution Architect - Data Platforms and the Boomi iPaaS / API Gateway Architect on integration contracts, orchestration, and routing.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own enterprise data modeling standards: conceptual, logical, and physical models, conformed dimensions, and canonical data model governance.
  • Design and maintain the canonical data hub and integration contracts (e.g., hub-first CQRS pattern) bridging source systems (Workday, CRM, tax platforms) to downstream consumers.
  • Partner with the Boomi iPaaS / API Gateway Architect on orchestration, routing (e.g., YARP-based gateway), and contract versioning.
  • Evaluate and apply data modeling methodologies (Kimball, Inmon, Data Vault 2.0) appropriate to each initiative.
  • Define entity relationship diagrams (ERDs) and metadata-driven schema patterns (e.g., JSONB generic store) where applicable.
  • Partner with the Solution Architect - Data Platforms to ensure canonical models align to lakehouse/medallion consumption layers.
  • Establish integration standards for master/reference data synchronization and change-data-capture strategies.
  • Lead data model reviews as part of ARB submissions, producing architecture review reports with severity-rated findings and action items.
  • Maintain the data dictionary, model documentation, and integration interface catalogs.
  • Support hyper-care for new integrations, driving root cause analysis for data-model-related defects.

Qualifications & Experience

  • 8+ years of experience in data modeling and/or integration architecture, including at least 4 years in enterprise environments.
  • Deep hands-on expertise with conceptual, logical, and physical data modeling and ER modeling tools.
  • Experience designing canonical data models and API / iPaaS integration contracts (e.g., Boomi AtomSphere or comparable).
  • Familiarity with API gateway / reverse-proxy patterns (e.g., YARP) and CQRS architecture.
  • Knowledge of master data management and reference data governance.
  • Experience operating in regulated environments and adhering to SOC 2 / SOX control requirements.
  • Strong communication skills; ability to engage business stakeholders, integration developers, and platform architects.
  • Prior experience partnering with data platform architects on lakehouse/medallion consumption patterns.
  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science or related field, or equivalent experience.

Job Title / Role: Data Architect

Key Skills: Databricks, AWS, DBT, ETL

Experience: 12+

Location: Boston MA

Shift: General

Mode: Full-time


We at Coforge are seeking “Data Architect” with the following skill set:


Position Summary

  1. Bridge enterprise data engineering and advanced analytics by ensuring data readiness, building scalable data products, engineering analytical datasets, and contributing directly to modeling and statistical analysis. Build advanced ETL pipelines and use AI frameworks like Claude, Cursor AI etc. Should be able to define enterprise architecture, data flows and sourcing data from multiple systems. Should be able to guide the development team in building robust data management platforms on Databricks and AWS. Tie the data ingestion and modelling to delivery of KPIs and reports. Should be able to understand the lifesciences domain and be able to translate and understand the underlying data and how it relates to the metrics being delivered.


Key Responsibilities

  • Define data architecture and ETL flows for metrics and reporting
  • Bring the best practices on Databricks and latest features including AI/BI, Genie etc and implement within the customer platform.
  • Define the data model and Semantic model for sourcing data from multiple source systems.
  • Define Data Governance models and frameworks and tools.
  • Enable the Data Quality frameworks and data observability across the platforms,
  • Build the Databricks ETL pipelines source to target for metrics reporting
  • Build and maintain pipelines and analytical datasets using enterprise standards and CI/CD practices.
  • Engineer reusable features and analytical datasets that eliminate one-off extracts. Build automated and reusable Ingestion and Data Quality frameworks.
  • Implement automated quality checks for completeness, freshness, referential integrity, and data drift.
  • Serve as the technical bridge between analytics pods and enterprise data engineering teams.
  • Contribute to modeling, statistical validation, experimentation, and hypothesis testing activities.
  • Optimize semantic layers and data models for high-performance dashboards and analytics.
  • Document lineage, transformation logic, refresh schedules, and operational dependencies.


Required Qualifications

  • 18+ years of Data Engineering experience with demonstrable Data Science capability.
  • Experience in Data architecture and enterprise architecture.
  • Strong Data Modeling experience preferred.
  • Strong expertise in AI led development – Databricks Genie, Claude, Cursor AI etc.
  • Experience in MDM platforms and Master data management.
  • Strong Data Governance, Lineage and catalog experience – preferably Atlan.
  • Expert skills in Databricks – Need strong experience of atleast 7 + years.
  • Strong Skills in AI tools and accelerators
  • Experience preferred on Tableau and data visualization tools.
  • Working knowledge on lifescience, medical devices domain preferable.
  • Experience in Data and ETL accelerators development
  • Expert SQL and Python skills.
  • Production experience with modern cloud data platforms and orchestration solutions.
  • Hands-on experience with dbt or equivalent transformation tooling.
  • Strong knowledge of ETL/ELT, data modeling, analytics engineering, and statistical methods.
  • Excellent Communication skills and team leadership experience.
  • Should have managed agile scrums and projects for dashboarding and reporting.
  • Team Leadership and executive communication skills are a must.

Join Komatsu and Be Part of Something Big!

Job Overview

The Lead Data & AI Architect owns the enterprise Data and AI architecture strategy and roadmap. The role makes sure our operational, analytical, machine learning, and generative AI solutions are scalable, secure, reliable, and aligned with enterprise standards. Working closely with business leaders and with technology, data engineering, security, governance, and application teams, the Lead Architect builds cost-effective, high-performing data platforms that drive digital transformation, analytics, AI, and better business decisions.

Key Job Responsibilities

  • Establish architectural principles, data processing frameworks, standards, and reference architectures for enterprise data platforms.
  • Owns and evolves the Enterprise Data architecture and roadmap for multiple business domains, including data models, data flows, integration patterns, platform components, fin-ops efficiencies and technical-debt priorities.
  • Translates business and application requirements into scalable reference and solution designs for Lakehouse, streaming solutions, APIs, analytics, ML, GenAI, and agentic AI, and guides engineering teams through delivery.
  • Defines & drives adoption of domain standards for data models, data products and contracts encompassing technical standards for metadata, lineage, quality, security, privacy, responsible AI, and architecture documentation through design and implementation.
  • Designs AI-ready data and platform patterns, including feature pipelines, model-serving paths, RAG and vector or graph retrieval, agent orchestration, tool and MCP integration, evaluation, observability, and human-in-the-loop controls.
  • Defines and validates non-functional requirements for use experience, performance, availability, resilience, scalability, safety, and cost; tracks cloud consumption and drives FinOps improvements.
  • Designs domain data products with clear ownership, data contracts, service-level commitments and measurable performance targets, supported by monitoring and observability.
  • Leads proofs of concept, contributes reusable patterns to the Architecture Review Board and communities of practice, and mentors’ data engineers, AI engineers, and associate architects.

Qualifications/Requirements

  • Eight or more years of experience in data engineering or software development, including at least three years in Data, AI, Digital, or Domain architecture roles.
  • Demonstrated experience architecting, planning and delivering at least two production-scale data platforms migrations or modernizations
  • Cloud platforms (Azure, AWS or GCP): selects and designs cloud services for domain solutions; has hands-on implementation experience.
  • Data platforms (Palantir, Databricks, Snowflake or Fabric): designs and builds on them and has experience rationalizing on the right platform for each workload.
  • Lakehouse and open table formats (Delta, Iceberg, Hudi): selects formats and designs Lakehouse medallion architecture layers for the domain.
  • Data modeling (Conceptual, Logical, Physical, Dimensional, Data Vault): designs models for business domains, aligned to enterprise canonical models.
  • Data pipelines and integration (ELT/ETL, Spark, dbt, Airflow or ADF): builds frameworks, reusable pipelines and evangelizes best practices.
  • SQL and Python: strong hands-on coding for data solutions; Demonstrated experience with rapid prototyping and ability to scale to enterprise standards.
  • Data governance (catalog, lineage, data quality): Architects technical governance practices for data lake assets
  • Application and integration architecture (microservices, REST and GraphQL APIs, domain-driven design): designs data-heavy applications.
  • DevOps, DataOps and infrastructure as code (CI/CD, Terraform, Git, containers): sets up SDLC environment patterns for domain solutions.
  • Time-series, edge and OT data (historians, OPC UA, MQTT, ISA-95): designs ingestion patterns and event driven architectural solutions for equipment and site data.
  • Operational and NoSQL data stores (document, key-value, graph, time-series databases): selects the right store for each workload.
  • Data observability and reliability (freshness, volume and schema checks; SLAs and SLOs): builds monitoring into the data architecture and domain pipelines.
  • Performance, scalability and cost optimization: tunes data solutions for speed and cost and builds the mechanisms to track domain cloud spend.
  • ML and MLOps architecture (feature stores, model registry, model serving, MLflow): designs the data paths that feed and serve ML models.
  • LLMOps and AI observability (prompt and version management, LLM evaluation, tracing, cost and latency monitoring): designs how GenAI solutions are tested and monitored.
  • Data security principles application with identity and access management (IAM), role- and attribute-based access and encryption methodologies for democratized data solutions.
  • GenAI and LLM architecture (RAG, vector and graph databases, embeddings, agents, MCP): builds AI solution patterns and applies guardrails.
  • Proven ability to influence across business and technology teams, mentor technical talent, and explain complex trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders.

Additional Information

Preferred Skills:

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Systems, Engineering, Data Science, or a related field; a master’s degree is preferred. An equivalent combination of education and experience will be considered.
  • Cloud architecture certification (Azure, AWS, or GCP) or data platform certification (Databricks, Snowflake, or Palantir).
  • CDMP, TOGAF, C4 diagrams, ADR processes or comparable architecture and data-management credentials.
  • Industrial, manufacturing, mining, construction equipment, IoT related IT/OT experience.
  • Analytics and BI semantic layers (Power BI and/or other semantic models, metrics layers): designs data for reporting and analytics.

Hiring Range

At Komatsu, your base pay is one part of your total compensation package. This role pays $155,000. The actual offer will consider a wide range of factors, including experience and location.

Company Benefits

Komatsu provides an extensive and robust employee benefits package that is designed to enhance the well-being of our employees and family members. We embrace a positive and empowering employee experience with a culture that prides itself on a diverse and inclusive environment.

  • Health benefits: Medical, dental, vision, HSA, wellness programs, etc.
  • 401k and/or employee savings programs
  • Employee time off (vacation and designated holidays)
  • Employee and family assistance programs
  • Disability benefits
  • Life insurance
  • Employee learning and development programs

Diversity & Inclusion Commitment

At Komatsu, we come from diverse backgrounds, with unique perspectives, experiences and contributions. We believe that our people are part of our shared purpose. Connected by our core values of ambition, perseverance, collaboration and authenticity, we are committed to continually advancing in our support of diversity and inclusion. United, we are on a journey towards a sustainable future that creates value together. 

Company Information

Komatsu develops and supplies technologies, equipment and services for the construction, mining, forklift, industrial and forestry markets. Headquartered in Tokyo, Japan, Komatsu employs more than 64,000 people worldwide, operating in more than 140 countries. For more than a century, the company has been creating value for its customers through manufacturing and technology innovation, partnering with others to empower a sustainable future where people, business and the planet thrive together. Since the company’s founding in 1921, Komatsu has been committed to supporting individuals and communities through job training, skills development and giving back. As a Komatsu employee, you will be encouraged to grow alongside our global company, contributing to a more sustainable future for all. If you are looking for a company that values your talent and potential, join Komatsu to be a part of something big and help advance modern society. Learn more at www.komatsu.com.

EEO Statement

Komatsu is an Equal Opportunity Workplace and an Affirmative Action Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status.

Our culture is about our people, the ones in our communities and the ones that work with us.

Here, you’ll find opportunities to grow and learn, to connect with others, and build relationships with the people around you. You’ll have the space and resources to grow into the best version of yourself. Because our number one investment is you.

Creating an award-winning culture doesn't come easy. And after 160 years, we know Commerce Bank is only at its best when our people are. If this sounds interesting to you, keep reading and let’s talk.

Compensation Range

Annual Salary: $105,000.00 - $123,500.00 (Amount based on relevant experience, skills, and competencies.)

About This Job

The main purpose of this job is to collaborate with the Enterprise Architecture program and business data stakeholders to ensure that the technical architecture and information ecosystem would enable the organization to achieve business outcomes and generate meaningful value from its data assets. The Data Architect is responsible for discovering & documenting the data and analytics requirements for information for all uses and requires a deep understanding of data management, data modeling, data warehousing and emerging data integration technologies.

Work Schedule

  • Monday - Friday 8:00 AM - 5:00 PM

Essential Functions

  • Partner with business and technical leadership to provide strategic recommendations that maximize the value of data assets via their creation, access and use
  • Analyze and optimize data models for performance, scalability and cost effectiveness in the cloud. Collaborate with IT Architecture, Information Security, and Data Governance stakeholders to define standards and policies for data lifecycle management, data keying strategy, and data obfuscation strategy
  • Monitor and assess the benefits and risks of change impacting the data ecosystem (i.e. new system implementations, deployment of new tools and utilities, etc.) Actively work to mitigate the negative impact of change affecting the use of data architecture.
  • Provide the organization with a future-state view of the business data landscape that minimizes restrictions imposed by proprietary solutions or technologies. Collaborate in the process of architectural planning and influence decisions on data architectural design.
  • Assist data, analytic, business and IT leaders in developing data governance processes and structures.
  • Facilitate design sessions with business and technology stakeholders to understand business needs and requirements. Develop and manage data blueprints and information models (i.e. conceptual models, logical models, physical models, relational database designs, dimensional modeling, data vault, message models and others)
  • Proactively manage the classification and zoning of data assets sourced from systems, applications, and external third-party information providers to increase time to value
  • Aid efforts to improve business performance through enterprise information solutions and capabilities, such as master data management (MDM), metadata management, analytics, content management, data integration, and related information management or information infrastructure components
  • Analyze data and analytics security requirements and solutions, and partner with leadership to ensure that enterprise business data and analytics assets are protected.
  • Perform other duties as assigned

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities Required

  • Strong understanding of system integration, including interface design, and familiarity with web-oriented architecture techniques.
  • Strong understanding of data modeling and information classification expertise at the enterprise level and industry-specific knowledge of data security protocols, policies, and regulations
  • Strong understanding of common information architecture frameworks and information models
  • Strong understanding of metamodels, taxonomies and ontologies, as well as of the challenges of applying structured techniques (data modeling) to less-structured sources
  • Strong understanding of data science concepts, as well as MDM, business intelligence, and data warehouse design and implementation techniques
  • Strong understanding of a variety of data access and analytics approaches (for example, microservices and event-based architectures)
  • Strong understanding with enterprise architecture modeling languages or frameworks such as TOGAF, ArchiMate, Zachman or UML
  • Ability to develop positive relationships across business and technical domains to facilitate activity that produces mutually beneficial outcomes
  • Ability to assess rapidly changing technological trends and developments and apply them to business needs
  • Ability to understand problems from a broad perspective leveraging business and technical knowledge to anticipate the impact of issues and potential solutions
  • Strong business and technological acumen. Possesses the ability to communicate with executives, business domain stakeholders and technical partners alike.
  • Motivated and organized self-starter with strong attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple priorities
  • Inquisitive, agile, and strong team player with excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills
  • Ability to remain adaptable and resilient to all situations with an optimistic outlook and cast a positive shadow that is aligned with our culture and Core Values
  • Strong proficiency with Microsoft Office suite, Microsoft Project and Teams

Education & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Information Systems, Data Management, Data Science or equivalent combination of education and experience required. Master’s degree preferred.
  • 6+ years of experience in IT or a related field, with at least 5 years in information system design required
  • 4+ years of experience in data management, data modeling, data warehousing and emerging data integration technologies required
  • 2+ years of experience with distributed management and analytics in cloud and hybrid environments with hands-on experience building and designing Databricks Lakehouse Architecture and Delta Lake using tools such as Erwin or SqlDBM required
  • Experience in data analysis using PySpark, SQL, Python is preferred.
  • Professional training/industry certifications in PaaS cloud providers or specifically in Databricks preferred
  • Remote options available
  • Ideal candidate would live in Kansas City or St. Louis.
  • For individuals applying, assigned and/or hired to work in areas with pay transparency requirements, Commerce is required by law to include a reasonable estimate of the compensation range for some roles. This compensation range is for the Enterprise Data Architect job and contemplates a wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions, including but not limited to location, skill sets, education, relevant experience and training, licensure and certifications, and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for any applicable differentials (geographic, bilingual, or shift) that could be associated with the position or where it is filled. At Commerce, compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each situation. A reasonable estimate of the current base pay is $105,000 to $123,500 annually. This position will be eligible for additional compensation through performance-based incentive plan(s) that will correspond to meeting performance goals.

Must be eligible to work in the US without sponsorship now or in the future.

The candidate selected for this position may be eligible for the following employment benefits: employer sponsored health, dental, and vision insurance, 401(k), life insurance, paid vacation, and paid personal time. In addition, we offer career development, education assistance, and voluntary supplemental benefits. Click here to learn more.
