descriptionHtml:
The Aerospace Corporation is the trusted partner to the nation’s space programs, solving the hardest problems and providing unmatched technical expertise. As the operator of a federally funded research and development center (FFRDC), we are broadly engaged across all aspects of space— delivering innovative solutions that span satellite, launch, ground, and cyber systems for defense, civil and commercial customers. When you join our team, you’ll be part of a special collection of problem solvers, thought leaders, and innovators. Join us and take your place in space.

All roles require onsite presence a minimum of four days per week. Some roles may require five days onsite based on role responsibilities, business needs and manager discretion. Schedule flexibility may be available depending on the role and manager approval, including a 9/80 work schedule and compensatory time off (time off earned for hours worked beyond 40 per week) for eligible employees.

Aerospace is the trusted partner to the nation's space enterprise, solving the hardest problems with innovative solutions. We are at the forefront of advanced technology development, systems engineering, and research, providing trusted, objective technical expertise across the entire space enterprise. Within Aerospace’s Office of the CIO, the newly constructed Data and AI Services team provides advanced modeling, machine learning, and predictive analytics capabilities that inform enterprise services operations and facilitates strategic decision-making across the corporation.

As our enterprise data and knowledge management needs continue to grow in scale and complexity, we are looking for a Senior Data Architect. This role will design, implement, and govern enterprise-scale data solutions that support operations—including the integration of identity management, ERP, digital libraries, and AI-powered knowledge management systems. This position sits at the intersection of data engineering, AI/ML, and enterprise architecture, giving the selected candidate the opportunity to shape how the corporation manages and leverages data.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Design enterprise data architecture frameworks that integrate identity management, ERP, digital libraries, and AI/ML applications
  • Develop data models, schemas, and ontologies to enable semantic interoperability and knowledge graphs
  • Architect data pipelines and semantic layers supporting Graph RAG and AI-driven knowledge management systems
  • Lead integration architecture for enterprise systems, including the design of ETL/ELT pipelines, real-time synchronization, master data management (MDM), and data quality monitoring solutions
  • Define and enforce governance policies for CUI, proprietary, and classified information, including classification frameworks (CUI, ITAR, export control) and role-based access control architectures
  • Architect scalable solutions capable of supporting 90,000+ documents with ongoing growth, while optimizing cost-effectiveness across cloud, on-prem, and hybrid environments
  • Partner with IT, cybersecurity, library services, and mission teams while providing technical leadership and mentorship, and communicating architecture decisions to diverse stakeholders (Engages with Impact, Fosters Innovation)


    • What You Need to be Successful – Senior Data Architect IVs:

    Minimum Requirements

    • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Information Systems, or a related field
    • 8 - 10+ years of experience in data architecture or data engineering, including 5+ years designing enterprise-scale data solutions
    • Proven experience with cloud architectures (AWS, Azure, or GCP), data modeling, data governance, and API design
    • Hands-on experience with SQL/NoSQL databases (e.g., PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Neo4j) and pipeline orchestration tools (e.g., Airflow, Prefect)
    • Working knowledge of data formats and standards such as JSON, XML, Parquet, and RDF/OWL
    • Experience addressing AI/ML data requirements, including vector databases and semantic search
    • Familiarity with data security, encryption, and compliance frameworks
    • This position requires the ability to obtain and maintain a security clearance, which is issued by the U.S. government. U.S. citizenship is required to obtain a security clearance.


    • In addition to the above, the minimum requirements for the Senior Data Architect V include:

    • A minimum of 10 or more years data engineering, software engineering, or a related technical field
    • Familiarity with streaming data architectures and real-time data processing

    How You Can Stand Out

    It would be impressive if you have one or more of these:

    • Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Information Systems, or a related field
    • Experience with LLM/AI architecture, knowledge graphs, ontologies, and semantic web technologies (RDF, SPARQL, OWL)
    • Experience with SAP 4/HANA, Workday, ServiceNow
    • Background in aerospace, defense, or government environments
    • Relevant certifications (e.g., AWS Solutions Architect, Google Data Engineer)
    • Proficiency in Python, Java, or Scala, along with DevOps/Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) experience

    We offer a competitive compensation package where you’ll be rewarded based on your performance and recognized for the value you bring to our business. The grade-based pay range for this job is listed below. Individual salaries within that range are determined through a wide variety of factors including but not limited to education, experience, knowledge and skills.

    (Min - Max)

    $127,500.00 - $214,900.00

    Pay Basis: Annual

    Leadership Competencies

    Our leadership philosophy is simple: every employee, regardless of level and role, can demonstrate leadership. At Aerospace, our commitment is our people. To cultivate our talent and ensure that we have a strong pipeline of future leaders, we want individuals who:

    • Operate Strategically
    • Lead Change  
    • Engage with Impact  
    • Foster Innovation  
    • Deliver Results

    Ways We Reward Our Employees

    During your interview process, our team will provide details of our industry-leading benefits.

    Benefits vary and are applicable based on Job Type. A few highlights include:

    • Comprehensive health care and wellness plans
    • Paid holidays, sick time, and vacation
    • Standard and alternate work schedules, including telework options
    • 401(k) Plan — Employees receive a total company-paid benefit of 8%, 10%, or 12% of eligible compensation based on years of service and matching contributions; employees are immediately eligible and vested in the plan upon hire
    • Flexible spending accounts
    • Variable pay program for exceptional contributions
    • Relocation assistance
    • Professional growth and development programs to help advance your career
    • Education assistance programs
    • An inclusive work environment built on teamwork, flexibility, and respect

    We are all unique, from various backgrounds and all walks of life, yet one thing bonds all of us to each other—the belief that we can make a difference. This core belief empowers us to do our best work at The Aerospace Corporation.

    Equal Opportunity Commitment

    The Aerospace Corporation is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment and will not be discriminated against on the basis of race, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, and related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender, gender identity or expression, color, religion, genetic information, marital status, ancestry, national origin, protected veteran status, physical disability, medical condition, mental disability, or disability status and any other characteristic protected by state or federal law. The Opportunity

This position works out of our Maple Grove, MN or our Austin, TX location in the Electrophysiology Medical Device division. In Abbott’s Electrophysiology (EP) business, we’re advancing the treatment of heart disease through breakthrough medical technologies in atrial fibrillation, allowing people to restore their health and get on with their lives.

We are seeking an Enterprise Data Architect to lead the design, governance, and optimization of enterprise data platforms, integrations, and data assets that support critical business applications and strategic decision-making. This role is responsible for establishing enterprise data architecture standards, advancing data governance and lifecycle management practices, and ensuring data is secure, reliable, scalable, and accessible across the organization.

Partnering closely with business and technology stakeholders, the Enterprise Data Architect will drive data strategy, platform modernization, automation, and continuous improvement to deliver trusted data solutions that support operational excellence and business growth.

What You'll Work On

  • Lead the design, development, and optimization of enterprise data architecture, integration frameworks, databases, and data platforms to deliver scalable, reliable business solutions.
  • Design and implement data pipelines, integrations, migrations, transformations, and automation capabilities that improve efficiency, performance, and data accessibility.
  • Establish and maintain architectural standards, development methodologies, and best practices that promote scalability, consistency, maintainability, and operational excellence.
  • Lead enterprise data governance and Data Lifecycle Management activities, including data quality, stewardship, retention, auditing, validation, and change control.
  • Partner with business and technology stakeholders to define and implement data standards that improve data integrity, consistency, and trust across enterprise systems.
  • Design, support, and optimize the data platforms, integrations, and data assets that enable critical business applications and digital solutions.
  • Administer Support enterprise data platforms, Microsoft Fabric environments, Azure resources, databases, gateways, and related infrastructure.
  • Drive platform modernization, capacity planning, performance optimization, disaster recovery, and business continuity initiatives to ensure secure and reliable operations.
  • Ensure compliance with security, access management, and data protection requirements through effective governance and monitoring practices.
  • Maintain technical documentation and development standards for deployment, version control, change management, and operational support.
  • Mentor team members and stakeholders on data management, governance, and platform best practices.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Analytics, Engineering, or a related technical discipline, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Minimum 5 years of progressively responsible experience in data architecture, data engineering, analytics, database administration, or related technical disciplines.
  • Experience designing and supporting enterprise data architectures, integration frameworks, and scalable data platforms.
  • Experience developing enterprise-scale solutions utilizing Microsoft Fabric, Power BI, Azure Data Factory, Azure SQL Server or related cloud data technologies.
  • Experience developing and maintaining data pipelines, ETL processes, integrations, and automation solutions.
  • Strong understanding of data governance, data quality management, master data concepts and Data Lifecycle Management principles.
  • Experience supporting enterprise data platforms and supporting highly available, secure, and data solutions.
  • Knowledge of security, access management, change control, disaster recovery, and business continuity best practices.
  • Ability to work effectively in a highly matrixed and geographically diverse business environment.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, organizational, and project management skills.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to effectively communicate technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional initiatives, influence stakeholders, and drive organizational change.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities, adapt to changing business needs, and deliver high-quality results within established timelines.

Apply Now

Learn more about our health and wellness benefits, which provide the security to help you and your family live full lives : www.abbottbenefits.com

Follow your career aspirations to Abbott for diverse opportunities with a company that can help you build your future and live your best life. Abbott is an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to employee diversity.

Connect with us at www.abbott.com, on Facebook at www.facebook.com/Abbott, and on X @AbbottNews.

The base pay for this position is $86,700.00 – $173,300.00. In specific locations, the pay range may vary from the range posted.

Required:

descriptionHtml:
WHAT MAKES US A GREAT PLACE TO WORK

We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world’s best places to work. We are currently the top ranked consulting firm on Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work list and have earned the #1 overall spot a record seven times. Extraordinary teams are at the heart of our business strategy, but these don’t happen by chance. They require intentional focus on bringing together a broad set of backgrounds, cultures, experiences, perspectives, and skills in a supportive and inclusive work environment. We hire people with exceptional talent and create an environment in which every individual can thrive professionally and personally.


WHO YOU'LL WORK WITH

You'll join our Architecture experts within the Applied Technology & AI. This team combines Bain’s strategy, industry, and transformation capabilities with deep technical expertise to solve clients’ most important business problems. Software, AI, and data engineers, data scientists, designers, product managers, and technical leads work with clients and Bain consultants to shape, build, deploy, and scale production-grade products and systems that create lasting competitive advantage.


WHAT YOU'LL DO (Essential Functions):

Shape Architecture and Technology Strategy 

  • Lead the definition of enterprise data architecture strategies, target states, and roadmaps aligned with client business priorities and transformation outcomes. 
  • Architect scalable, resilient, and secure enterprise data platforms and solutions across cloud, hybrid, and multi-cloud environments. 
  • Define organizational strategies and operating models for a modern Data Office, including governance, ownership, platform, and delivery capabilities. 
  • Develop as-is and to-be architectures, reference models, migration options, and transition roadmaps for complex data transformations. 
  • Define enterprise integration and data-sharing standards across APIs, event streaming, data pipelines, and microservices-aligned architectures. 
  • Shape the data foundations required for analytics and AI, including data engineering, feature engineering, model data pipelines, and MLOps enablement. 
  • Assess, select, and integrate modern data platforms, vendor solutions, and hyperscaler services, including Databricks, Snowflake, Microsoft Fabric, AWS, Azure, and GCP. 
  • Translate complex business and technical requirements into clear architecture decisions, investment priorities, and executable plans.


Advise and Influence Senior Leaders 

  • Serve as a trusted advisor to CISOs, CIOs, CTOs, Chief Architects, and senior executives on cyber security strategy, architecture decisions, and technology trade-offs. 
  • Establish executive-level credibility and communicate effectively with senior business and technology stakeholders as part of client project leadership teams. 
  • Act as an independent design authority by reviewing and validating data architecture proposals, evaluating options, and providing delivery assurance. 
  • Influence, coach, and mentor client data and technology leaders and Bain teams to build sustainable architecture and Data Office capabilities.


Enable Transformation at Scale

  • Lead high-impact data architecture workstreams within large-scale, multi-year transformation programs. 
  • Set direction and lead internal and external teams across complex, multi-million-dollar client engagements. 
  • Guide Bain consulting and client teams in executing architecture roadmaps, managing dependencies and risks, and embedding effective governance. 
  • Ensure architectures evolve through agile and MVP delivery while maintaining security, resilience, interoperability, scalability, and coherence. 
  • Partner with Bain consulting teams to integrate data architecture into broader business, technology, cloud, and AI transformations. 
  • Lead and mentor teams of architects and consultants to deliver secure, scalable, and high-performing enterprise data platforms aligned with client outcomes. 
  • Collaborate with leaders across Vector guilds to bring the optimal combination of expertise to clients. 
  • Support recruiting, onboarding, and people development, and help create an environment that attracts and develops great architects. 


Advance Bain’s Reputation and Growth 

  • Define and create demand by co-creating differentiated points of view and go-to-market offerings in enterprise data architecture, data modernization, Master Data Management, Data Office design, and AI-enabled transformation. 
  • Support proposals, pursuits, and account expansion by bringing data architecture expertise into client discussions and solution shaping. 
  • Maintain market and vendor awareness, collaborate with ecosystem partners, and continuously evolve Bain's enterprise data architecture point of view. 
  • Contribute actively to client cases, intellectual property, publications, and architecture community engagement. 
  • Build and sustain trusted relationships with senior stakeholders, sponsors, and architecture communities.


WHAT YOU'LL BRING (Qualifications):

  • 10+ years of experience in data architecture and technology leadership, including large-scale transformation programs. 
  • Deep enterprise data architecture expertise across multiple industries, such as financial services, consumer, and technology. 
  • Demonstrated track record shaping enterprise data strategies, target architectures, platform roadmaps, and operating models. 
  • End-to-end lifecycle experience leading large, complex, multi-year data transformation programs from strategy and architecture through implementation and migration. 
  • Deep understanding of how data enables AI, with delivery experience across data engineering, feature engineering, model data pipelines, and MLOps enablement. 
  • Hands-on architecture and delivery experience with modern data stacks and cloud data services, including Snowflake, Microsoft Fabric, and AWS, Azure, or GCP. 
  • Strong knowledge of data governance, metadata, data quality, Master Data Management, data integration, security, privacy, and responsible data use. 
  • Strong client leadership and business development experience, including pre-sales, go-to-market efforts, proposal shaping, and account expansion. 
  • Proven thought leadership in contemporary topics such as Master Data Management, data modernization, Data Office design, data products, and AI adoption. 
  • Exceptional communication and influencing skills, with the ability to explain complex solutions, algorithms, and trade-offs to business and technology audiences. 
  • High emotional intelligence and proven ability to lead, mentor, and inspire diverse, cross-functional, and multi-office teams. 
  • Curiosity, proactivity, critical thinking, and the ability to work independently and manage competing priorities in fast-paced, ambiguous environments.


U.S. Compensation Information 

Compensation for this role includes base salary, annual discretionary performance bonus, 401(k) plan with an annual employer contribution based on years of service and Bain’s best in class benefits package (details listed below).


Some local governments in the United States require a good-faith, reasonable salary range be included in job postings for open roles. The estimated annualized compensation for this role is as follows:


In the states of Georgia, Illinois, Massachusetts, and Texas, the good-faith, reasonable annualized full-time salary range for this role is between $168,500 - $206,000. In New York City, the good-faith, reasonable annualized full-time salary range for this role is between $191,000 - $234,500. Placement within these ranges will vary based on several factors including, but not limited to experience, education, licensure/certifications, training and skill level 


For all other locations, the good-faith, reasonable annualized full-time salary range for this role is commensurate with competitive geographic market rates for this role and will vary based on several factors including, but not limited to experience, education, licensure/certifications, training and skill level.

  • Generous paid time off, including parental leave, sick leave and paid holidays

descriptionHtml:
The Supply Chain Lead Data Architect will own the supply chain data model and the data-product architecture that enables trusted analytics, decision intelligence and data science across the North America Operating Unit. This leader will treat data as a product: defining the business purpose, consumers, ownership, quality expectations, access patterns, lifecycle and measurable value of the data assets the organization depends on. The role combines supply-chain domain mastery with enterprise data modeling, platform product strategy and modern engineering fluency. Partnering with supply chain, product, analytics, data science, Global Data and AI, Enterprise Architecture, Security, Governance and platform teams, the successful candidate will translate business decisions into interoperable, secure, governed and reusable data capabilities that improve performance and deliver measurable business value.

This is a Director-level role.

About The Role

Own Supply Chain Data Products and Enterprise Data Models

  • Define and execute the supply chain data-product strategy and multi-year architecture roadmap that enables analytics, reporting, decision intelligence and data science.
  • Develop and own the canonical supply chain data model, including conceptual, logical and physical models, shared business definitions and semantic layers for domains such as demand, supply, inventory, manufacturing, logistics, customer service and performance.
  • Establish reusable patterns for data products, ingestion, integration, lakehouse and warehouse platforms, APIs, events and streaming, master and reference data, semantic models, analytics and data-science consumption.
  • Lead architecture reviews and technology decisions, balancing decision value, interoperability, scalability, security, quality, reliability, performance, cost and speed to market.

Enable Integration Interoperability and Modern Data Engineering

  • Connect supply chain data requirements with enterprise platforms, applications and standards, reducing duplicate data, fragmented definitions, point-to-point integrations and technical debt.
  • Define integration and interoperability standards across ERP, manufacturing, warehouse, transportation, planning, customer and external-partner systems using APIs, events, common identifiers and governed data contracts.
  • Set engineering standards for CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, automated testing, orchestration, observability, metadata, lineage, data quality, reliability and operational support.
  • Drive reusable frameworks, platform capabilities and product operating practices that accelerate delivery and make data easy to discover, understand, access and use responsibly. Improve workload performance, resilience and cost efficiency across cloud data, analytics and data-science platforms.

Translate Business Decisions into Data Requirements

  • Work with supply-chain leaders to identify the decisions that matter most, the measures that define success and the data required to improve planning, service, cost, inventory, capacity, resilience and sustainability outcomes.
  • Convert business priorities into clear data requirements, data-product backlogs, domain models, data contracts, acceptance criteria and delivery roadmaps that technical teams can execute.
  • Define patterns that enable data scientists and analysts to use governed, explainable and fit-for-purpose data, including feature-ready data, semantic models and secure self-service access.
  • Partner with data science and engineering teams to move analytical and predictive solutions from prototypes to secure, observable and reliable production capabilities.
  • Establish architecture guardrails for privacy, security, governance, model use, explainability, evaluation and appropriate human oversight where AI is applied.

Lead Cross Functional Delivery and Augmented Teams

  • Serve as a trusted partner to supply-chain, product, finance, operations, data science and technology leaders; communicate architecture choices, dependencies, tradeoffs, value, cost and risk in clear business language.
  • Lead cross-functional teams and augmented resources, setting clear outcomes, architectural guardrails, delivery expectations and quality standards while building capability in internal teams.
  • Facilitate alignment across organizational boundaries, resolve design decisions and sequence investments to deliver the highest-value data products first.
  • Improve the discoverability, accessibility, quality and usability of trusted supply-chain data so teams can move from questions to decisions more efficiently.

Drive Governance Quality Value and Enterprise Alignment

  • Establish data-product governance with clear ownership, stewardship, quality rules, service expectations, metadata, lineage, retention and least-privilege access from design through operations.
  • Partner with NAOU Digital and Data, Global Data and AI, Enterprise Architecture, Cybersecurity, Privacy, Governance and platform organizations to align supply-chain solutions with enterprise direction.
  • Establish measures and operating reviews for data quality, adoption, reuse, time to insight, delivery speed, reliability, cost, risk reduction and realized supply-chain value.
  • Build a high-performing culture focused on accountability, product thinking, value creation, inclusion, quality and continuous improvement; mentor technical talent and augmented team members.
  • Enable teams to make decisions within clear architectural guardrails and continuously improve the data-product portfolio based on stakeholder feedback and performance evidence.

What You Will Need

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Data Science or a related field, or equivalent professional experience; advanced degree is a plus.
  • 7+ years of progressive experience in data architecture, enterprise data modeling, data engineering or analytics platforms, including leadership of complex enterprise-scale transformations.
  • 7+ years of experience leading architects, engineers, technical leaders, augmented resources or multidisciplinary platform teams, including responsibility for talent development and delivery outcomes.
  • Demonstrated supply-chain domain expertise and experience translating supply-chain processes and decisions into data requirements, business definitions, data models and analytical products.
  • Demonstrated expertise designing enterprise conceptual, logical and physical data models; canonical data models; master and reference data; semantic models; and data products for analytics and data science.
  • Demonstrated experience designing cloud-native architectures spanning lakehouse and warehouse platforms, data products, streaming, APIs, events, semantic models and analytical consumption.
  • Experience with enterprise cloud data platforms such as Microsoft Azure, Microsoft Fabric, OneLake, Power BI and Azure Databricks, or comparable technologies.
  • Strong understanding of integration and interoperability patterns, including APIs, event-driven architecture, data contracts, common identifiers and operational-system integration.
  • Strong understanding of CI/CD, DevOps, DataOps, Infrastructure as Code, automated testing, orchestration, observability and cloud cost-management practices.
  • Deep understanding of data governance, security, privacy, metadata, lineage, data quality, stewardship, access control and data-product operating practices.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence senior business and technology leaders, lead decisions across organizational boundaries, manage augmented resources and communicate complex topics in clear business language.
  • Experience translating technology investments into measurable outcomes across data quality, reliability, adoption, reuse, speed, cost, risk and realized business value.
  • Proven track record of working independently, applying platform product strategy and fostering a growth mindset culture in a data-product environment.

Job Description

Agilent instruments produce the measurements behind pharmaceutical quality control, food and environmental testing, and research labs worldwide. That data sits in dozens of software products, and we are building a platform that lets our products, our customers' workflows, and AI agents find and use it wherever it lives.

We are hiring a data architect to own the discovery and access side of that platform: how scientific data is registered and found, and how it is composed and served. The platform architecture is established; the target state for discovery and access, and the path to it, are yours to define.

You work under the Lead Data Architect, who owns cross-service standards and governance. Within your areas, the architecture decisions are yours; cross-service decisions go to the Lead with evidence, options, and a recommendation.

This is an architecture role with hands-on evidence: you decide the architecture for your areas, stay with engineering through implementation, and read the code, run the queries, and build the proof of concept when an argument needs one.

Your areas:

  • Data access. Your part of the federated GraphQL gateway, which the platform team owns how connected systems are represented on it, directly or through data services; the read layer that composes results across systems; and the application data services that expose access-controlled views of scientific data to products, workflows, and AI consumers.
  • Catalog and search. The catalog record model, how connected systems register their data and how that metadata is represented, search over it, and the path to richer indexes like vector and graph.

Access is the first-year priority; catalog work runs alongside as the first connectors land. File management, metadata extraction, and semantic standards are owned by other architects on the team. The data is scientific data created by software products: results, methods, samples, files. ERP, CRM, and other enterprise business systems are out of scope.

What you will do:

  • Establish how the catalog and access paths behave today and define the target state: service boundaries, contracts, integration patterns, and the path between the two.
  • Own the schemas and contracts your areas depend on: catalog records, subgraph boundaries, data service views, and versioned event schemas. Design them and make explicit which system is authoritative for each piece of information under the program's data governance rules, and version them so existing consumers keep working.
  • Design the access paths AI agents use to read what they can, under what controls, and with what provenance.
  • Review proposed integrations against your contracts and the program's participation requirements. Change your contracts when the evidence warrants and propose changes to the requirements.
  • Design modernization paths for legacy sources that keep customers running through the transition, including moves from on-premises to hybrid or cloud.
  • Set query and index performance targets for catalog and access paths.
  • Design the pipelines that keep the catalog, the search index, and the access views current as data arrives, from extractor output through backfill and recovery.
  • Work directly with engineering: clarify designs, evaluate implementation plans, review delivered work against the decisions.
  • Write the decision records and diagrams for your areas, and explain the tradeoffs to engineers, product managers, and business stakeholders.

What we work with:

  • .NET (C#) services, Angular front ends, and a federated GraphQL gateway
  • PostgreSQL by default, with Oracle and SQL Server across the installed base
  • RabbitMQ for messaging and event-driven change discovery
  • Kubernetes and Helm alongside Windows installers for on-premises and hybrid customers, with S3-compatible object storage
  • Scientific data in proprietary instrument formats as well as vendor-neutral formats like Allotrope
  • AI assistants in daily use

Qualifications

Required qualifications:

  • Has 8+ years in software engineering, data engineering, or architecture with distributed systems: service boundaries, APIs, and event-driven integration.
  • Has defined architecture ahead of finalized standards and governance and can show which decisions held up and which had to change.
  • Has owned the architecture of a production system in at least one of these areas: data catalogs and metadata management (DataHub, OpenMetadata, or similar); search and indexing (Elasticsearch, OpenSearch, or similar); API or federated-query data access layers (Apollo Federation, or similar); or the data layer of a scientific, laboratory, or regulated application.
  • Writes SQL and reads execution plans in PostgreSQL or SQL Server.
  • Has built and run data pipelines, including recovery and backfill.
  • Reads production code in a typed language (C#, Java, TypeScript, or similar) and can build a proof of concept.
  • Uses AI tools in daily architecture and data work (profiling and cleaning data, reading and generating code, drafting decision records) and can show the process: what you delegate, what you verify, and how.
  • Works across product, engineering, and business teams without direct authority.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Has delivered data products consumed by applications: APIs, views, or datasets that other software depends on.
  • Working knowledge of catalog, search, and data access beyond the area you have owned.
  • Laboratory informatics or regulated life sciences, including data integrity and audit trail expectations.
  • Architecture decision records, C4 or similar diagrams, and interface contracts.
  • Cloud integration patterns (identity, storage, messaging, managed data services) alongside on-premises deployment.

Additional Details

This job has a full time weekly schedule. It includes the option to work remotely.

Our pay ranges are determined by role, level, and location. Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. During the hiring process, a recruiter can share more about the specific pay range for a preferred location. Pay and benefit information by country are available at: https://careers.agilent.com/locations

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, disability or any other protected categories under all applicable laws.

Deloitte helps navigate this complexity by bringing deep industry insights and integrated solutions to achieve business objectives. From strategy to technology to operations, and across workforce, risk, assurance, and tax, Deloitte helps drive value along the Finance Transformation journey.

Recruiting for this role ends on 09/30/2026

Work you'll do

As a Finance Data & AI Manager specializing in Microsoft Azure and Fabric, you'll lead teams that design end-to-end solutions from source integration and OneLake through trusted data products, AI, and Power BI. You will guide architecture from strategy through production.



-  Lead engagements or workstreams that define end-to-end Azure and Fabric architectures across integration, OneLake, lakehouse/warehouse, security, AI, and finance consumption
-  Guide batch, streaming, mirroring, and orchestration design with Fabric Data Factory, Data Engineering, Spark, Data Warehouse, and Real-Time Intelligence
-  Establish governance, lineage, Entra-based access, data quality, observability, service-level objectives, and remediation with Microsoft Purview
-  Define reusable finance data products, canonical models, OneLake sharing, APIs, and governed semantic models for planning, close, profitability, treasury, and reporting
-  Architect production ML and generative and agentic AI with Fabric Data Science and Azure AI services, MLOps and LLMOps, evaluation, monitoring, and responsible AI
-  Manage client relationships, estimates, design reviews, deployment, capacity and cost outcomes; mentor teams and support demonstrations, proposals, and RFP responses
-  Agentic Redesign of Finance data and processes such as planning, forecasting, close, profitability, treasury, or reporting

A successful candidate would possess these skills:



-  Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
-  Ability to translate finance outcomes into clear architecture decisions
-  Effective written, verbal, and executive communication skills
-  Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
-  Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
-  Ability to lead projects or workstreams
-  Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
-  Ability to meet deadlines
-  Ability to mentor and provide clear guidance to others

The team

Deloitte's Finance Transformation offering helps finance and global business services leaders navigate an increasingly challenging environment marked by disruptive tech like AI, market uncertainty, and regulatory change, and recognize the opportunity to better serve the enterprise, shareholders, customers, and regulators.

Within the Finance Transformation offering, our Business Finance team drives strategic value through planning, forecasting, and analytics. We design trusted finance data products, modern platforms, and AI-enabled solutions that deliver timely, actionable insights.

Qualifications

Required:



-  6+ years of experience architecting enterprise data, analytics, or AI solutions in a corporate or consulting environment
-  4+ years of experience designing Azure or Fabric solutions across data engineering, lakehouse/warehouse, security, performance, and multi-environment deployment
-  4+ years of experience with finance data and processes such as planning, forecasting, close, profitability, treasury, or reporting
-  Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Information Systems, Finance, Accounting, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field
-  Ability to travel 50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
-  Limited immigration sponsorship may be available.

Preferred:



-  Experience with OneLake, Lakehouse, Data Warehouse, Data Factory, Data Engineering, Real-Time Intelligence, Direct Lake, Power BI, and Purview
-  Experience with data quality, observability, lineage, testing, CI/CD, infrastructure as code, and capacity/cost optimization
-  Experience deploying ML, retrieval-augmented generation, or agentic AI with Azure AI or Fabric Data Science and responsible AI controls
-  Experience integrating SAP, Oracle, Workday, Anaplan, or OneStream and building governed Power BI semantic models, DAX measures, and reports
-  Microsoft certification in Azure architecture, Fabric, or Power BI; or a master's degree in a related field
-  2+ years of experience supporting pre-sales, proposals, RFP responses, and mentoring data and AI delivery teams

Today, it is one of the top 10 children’s hospital in the nation and ranked in all specialties evaluated by U.S. News & World Report. Children’s National is transforming pediatric medicine for all children. The Children’s National Research & Innovation Campus opened in 2021, a first-of-its-kind pediatric hub dedicated to developing new and better ways to care for kids. Children’s National has been designated four times in a row as a Magnet® hospital, demonstrating the highest standards of nursing and patient care delivery. This pediatric academic health system offers expert care through a convenient, community-based primary care network and specialty care locations in the D.C. metropolitan area, including Maryland and Virginia. Children’s National is home to the Children’s National Research Institute and Sheikh Zayed Institute for Pediatric Surgical Innovation. It is recognized for its expertise and innovation in pediatric care and as a strong voice for children through advocacy at the local, regional and national levels. As a non-profit, Children's National relies on generous donors to help ensure that every child receives the care they need.

Hybrid - Joint Base Andrews, MD

 

At IPT Associates (IPTA), we enjoy solving real-world problems with technology. We work closely with our customers, teammates, experts, and partners to come up with practical solutions that make a difference. Whether it's a government or business organization, we focus on understanding the need and building something that works.

Our Team

At IPTA, everything starts with our people. We're big believers that when you invest in your team, great things happen. That's why we encourage learning, growth, and trying new things-even if you don't have all the answers yet.

Our culture is rooted in fierce determination, fearless integrity, and passionate service-but we also like to keep things collaborative, supportive, and down-to-earth.

We're Looking For People Who

  • Are curious and excited about technology
  • Like solving problems and figuring things out
  • Can take initiative but also enjoy working with a team
  • Want to keep learning, growing, and challenging themselves

If you're someone who's eager to jump in, learn something new, and make an impact-you'll fit right in here.

Responsibilities

  • Serves as the technical authority for enterprise data architecture, data warehouse management, repository administration, and data platform modernization supporting ANG CDAO operations
  • Designs and maintains secure, scalable data architectures that support data pipeline development, data integration, reporting, analytics, and AI/ML initiatives across multiple Government systems
  • Establishes data models, source-to-target mappings, lineage standards, governance controls, and interoperability requirements to ensure data integrity, availability, and usability
  • Leads technical planning and implementation activities for Azure Databricks, Palantir Foundry, Advana/Warfighter Data Platform, and other approved data environments while optimizing performance and reliability
  • Supports Data Pipeline Development and Data Warehouse Management by providing architectural oversight, technical guidance, and lifecycle management of CDAO data assets

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Science, Engineering, or related field
  • 15+ years of experience in enterprise data architecture and data warehouse management
  • Design strategies for enterprise database systems and set standards for operations, programming, and security
  • Design and construct large relational databases. Integrate new systems with existing warehouse structure and refine system performance and functionality
  • Provides technical/management leadership on major tasks or technology assignments
  • Establishes goals and plans that meet project objectives. Has domain and expert technical knowledge
  • Directs and controls activities for a client, having overall responsibility for financial management, methods, and staffing to ensure that technical requirements are met
    • Interactions involve client negotiations and interfacing with senior management
    • Decision making and domain knowledge may have a critical impact on overall project implementation
  • May supervise others
  • IAM Level III certification
  • An Active Security clearance is required
IPTA is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All employment decisions are based on individual merit, including qualifications, experience, performance, and business needs, consistent with applicable federal laws and federal contracting requirements. IPTA provides equal opportunity and utilizes merit-based principles to make employment-related decisions.

descriptionHtml:
As a Principal Architect, EDT Data Platform Engineering you will translate enterprise data architecture into scalable engineering solutions on the Azure and Databricks Lakehouse platform. You will partner with delivery teams, business representatives, and data stewards to build governed data pipelines, analytics-ready models, and reusable automation that improves consistency across projects and teams.

What you will do:

Technical Responsibilities:

  • Build and maintain ingestion frameworks using Azure Data Factory, Databricks, and Spark.
  • Implement Bronze-to-Silver transformations with data quality checks, schema validation, and data contract rules.
  • Optimize batch and streaming pipelines for performance and cost.
  • Own CI/CD pipelines in Azure DevOps and automate project onboarding, including repositories, pipelines, policies, and templates.
  • Maintain Infrastructure as Code and automation using Terraform, PowerShell, and Python; troubleshoot pipeline failures and permission issues.
  • Design curated Gold-layer data models, including star and snowflake schemas, fact tables, dimensions, surrogate keys, and slowly changing dimensions.
  • Align reusable models, KPI definitions, and business logic with the enterprise semantic layer in Power BI, Microsoft Fabric, and downstream tools.
  • Manage model changes through impact analysis, backward compatibility, regression support, and documented column derivation logic.
  • Implement Unity Catalog standards, naming conventions, metadata policies, data quality frameworks, and role- and attribute-based access controls.
  • Translate high-level architecture into low-level designs, reusable templates, and engineering playbooks.

Leadership & People Management Responsibilities:

  • Guide delivery teams through onboarding, debugging, and design reviews.
  • Create reusable assets and hands-on guidance that build engineering capability and reduce repeat questions.

Knowledge and Capabilities:

  • Assess complex data systems, identify patterns, and recommend practical solutions.
  • Explain technical concepts clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Partner with business representatives and data stewards to define requirements, validate metrics and edge cases, and guide solution decisions.
  • Identify opportunities for process optimization, redesign, and new or updated policies.

What You Need:

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree from an accredited university in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Business, or an equivalent field of study.
  • Minimum 8 years of experience in data engineering, data warehousing, and data and analytics platforms, including recent hands-on delivery on Azure and Databricks Lakehouse platforms.
  • Experience with Azure Data Factory, Azure Data Lake Storage, Azure SQL, Databricks Delta Live Tables, Delta Lake, Spark, Workflows, and Unity Catalog.
  • Advanced experience with PySpark or Python and SQL, including batch and streaming pipeline design.
  • Experience with Azure DevOps pipelines, repositories, and policies; PowerShell automation; CI/CD; and Infrastructure as Code.
  • Experience with schema enforcement, data contracts, data quality frameworks, metadata-driven design, monitoring, debugging, and performance tuning.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master's degree in Management Information Systems, Business Administration, or a related discipline, or an Azure analytics certification.
  • Experience with Microsoft Fabric
  • Experience within the medical device or another regulated industry.

United States of America Pay Ranges:

As a Principal Architect, EDT Data Platform Engineering you will translate enterprise data architecture into scalable engineering solutions on the Azure and Databricks Lakehouse platform. You will partner with delivery teams, business representatives, and data stewards to build governed data pipelines, analytics-ready models, and reusable automation that improves consistency across projects and teams.

What you will do:

Technical Responsibilities:



- Build and maintain ingestion frameworks using Azure Data Factory, Databricks, and Spark.
- Implement Bronze-to-Silver transformations with data quality checks, schema validation, and data contract rules.
- Optimize batch and streaming pipelines for performance and cost.
- Own CI/CD pipelines in Azure DevOps and automate project onboarding, including repositories, pipelines, policies, and templates.
- Maintain Infrastructure as Code and automation using Terraform, PowerShell, and Python; troubleshoot pipeline failures and permission issues.
- Design curated Gold-layer data models, including star and snowflake schemas, fact tables, dimensions, surrogate keys, and slowly changing dimensions.
- Align reusable models, KPI definitions, and business logic with the enterprise semantic layer in Power BI, Microsoft Fabric, and downstream tools.
- Manage model changes through impact analysis, backward compatibility, regression support, and documented column derivation logic.
- Implement Unity Catalog standards, naming conventions, metadata policies, data quality frameworks, and role- and attribute-based access controls.
- Translate high-level architecture into low-level designs, reusable templates, and engineering playbooks.

- Guide delivery teams through onboarding, debugging, and design reviews.

    • B uilding data pipelines and integrating multiple data sources .

    • Performing conceptual, logical, and physical data modeling using data modeling tools and database design techniques in complex, large-scale data environments.
    • Transactional data modeling, dimensional modeling, and object - oriented modeling.

    • Developing data models that support time dependencies, historical tracking, simple and complex taxonomies, and multilingual data.
    • Creating data dictionaries, defining metadata management approaches, and establishing governance processes.
    • Developing and implementing IT architecture plans, Enterprise Information Architecture standards and guidelines, software development methodologies, and strategic plans.
    • Developing data sharing standards and architecting scalable service - oriented solutions.
    • Creating enterprise models incorporating master and reference data.
  • Solid understanding of transaction and information systems, data warehouses, data marts, ODS, MDM methodologies and life cycles, as well as ETL and MDM technologies.

  • Experience with machine learning frameworks such as TensorFlow or PyTorch .
  • Experience with data quality management and data validation techniques .
  • Ability to work with sensitive data sources and develop data anonymization algorithms .

Requirements Gathering And Business Partnership

Data Modeling and ETL

Analytics and Business Intelligence Tools

Healthcare Domain and Interoperability

descriptionHtml:
About Peregrine

Peregrine Advisors is a rapidly growing AI and data innovation hub helping government solve hard problems and deliver better outcomes. We work across the full lifecycle—from strategy and governance through architecture, engineering, analytics, AI, visualization, and training—for clients including the SEC, PCAOB, DDOT, and DCAA.

Our clients describe our support as "absolutely excellent" and our people as "instrumental to organization's success." Winner of the United Nations COP27 Datathon, our work has earned all Exceptional CPARS ratings, SEC Chair's Awards, the SEC Vision Award, and recognition from FDA leadership.

We are also built differently. Peregrine is the first and only social enterprise organized as a Benefit Corporation and SBA 8(a) company focused on AI and data for government. We believe business success should create client value, social value, and opportunity for our people.

As we enter our next stage of growth, we need dependable, motivated, and skilled people who have a combination of intellectual curiosity and intellectual courage. With new clients, larger programs, and expanding responsibilities, the people joining Peregrine now will have the opportunity to help shape the company we become.

People first. Ownership always.

We solve problems through people, process, and technology—in that order. Technology matters, but people make transformation happen. That principle defines our culture. Trust and motivation are the foundational pillars of delivery on which our skills stand. We hire people we can trust, who care deeply about what they do, take ownership, learn quickly, help one another, and refuse to walk past a problem because it belongs to someone else.

At Peregrine, you are not joining simply to fill a position. You are joining a team, taking ownership of a mission, and helping build a company. If that excites you, we should talk.

At Peregrine Advisors, you will design the data models and architecture for a large federal data-lake platform on Amazon Web Services (AWS). But we hire people, not seats. As the work evolves, you will move to where the hardest problems are.

This is a hybrid work arrangement based in the Washington, DC metropolitan area, and the commuting cadence varies by assignment. The initial engagement requires United States citizenship and the ability to obtain a Public Trust determination.

Your first project

Your first project will likely have you shaping how a federal data lake and its data stores fit together. Depending on the assignment, you may:

  • Design clean data models and schemas across the data lake and its stores: Amazon Simple Storage Service (S3) with Apache Iceberg tables, Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL, and Amazon DynamoDB
  • Set the models and schemas that new and migrated data sources land in, so the data comes together in one architecture
  • Restructure the existing data ecosystem to remove redundancy and protect the integrity and accessibility of the data
  • Keep all of it under governed access

You help deliver a data architecture that brings new and existing sources together cleanly, built for a regulated environment where accuracy and auditability are not optional.

This is where you start, not the shape of your career here.

Requirements

  • 4+ years of data architecture and data modeling experience
  • 4+ years of cloud data architecture on AWS, including AWS Glue, Amazon EMR, and AWS Lambda
  • Bachelor's degree
  • Schema design across a data lake and relational stores, including S3 with Apache Iceberg tables, Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL, and Amazon DynamoDB
  • Data governance and security, with Apache Ranger or comparable access controls
  • Data modeling tools, for example ER/Studio or IBM InfoSphere
  • Communication with technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Proficiency in writing, PowerPoint, and Excel

Preferred

  • Master's degree in a relevant field
  • Hadoop or Spark
  • Breadth across the data lifecycle: data engineering, data product, data science, or data management
  • Federal information technology experience
  • Familiarity with AI-assisted developer tools

Who You Are

You see the whole data system and care how each piece fits. You model precisely, you can explain a design to an engineer or an executive, and you leave every data estate in better shape than you found it. You experiment, fail, learn, and repeat quickly. You would rather own an outcome than be handed a task.

What You Bring

  • Deep skill in data modeling and schema design, across both a data lake and relational stores on AWS
  • The tools of the architect's trade, including cloud data services, governed access, and modeling tools, plus the judgment to restructure a live data ecosystem without breaking it
  • The communication skills to win support for a design from technical and non-technical stakeholders, in a regulated environment where accuracy and auditability are not optional

When we talk

Be prepared to discuss a difficult problem you worked through, the decisions you made, what happened, and what you learned.

Benefits

This is a full-time W-2 position with a salary of $112,000 to $170,000 per year.

Benefits include medical, dental, and vision insurance with the employee premium fully paid and half of dependent premiums; employer-paid life, accidental death, and short-term and long-term disability insurance; a 401(k) with an employer match of up to 4% of salary; unlimited paid time off; and sponsored professional certifications and continuing education.

What We Offer

You will work alongside developers, engineers, data scientists, architects, and strategists, on work ranging from strategy to implementation. We support your development across assignments and clients through extensive onboarding, sponsored professional certifications such as the Data Management Capability Assessment Model (DCAM) and AWS technical certifications, and rotation across functions to expand your skills and perspective. The mission is real, the problems are hard, and you own what you ship.

What We Commit To

As a Benefit Corporation, our commitment runs three ways: real, measurable value for our clients; government that works better for the public; and a team that makes everyone in it better.

We hire people who want to help build the firm, not just work at it. If that is you, apply.

Peregrine Advisors is an equal opportunity employer.

Peregrine exclusively works with OPEN Data Jobs to recruit our team. Register with OPEN Data Jobs to be considered for this and future openings.

It Starts With Our Employees

FourLeaf's ultimate goal is to provide the best-in-class member and employee experience, and it all begins with two things: hiring incredible people and giving them a great place to work.

What You’ll Do

The Solutions Architect – Data Engineering serves as the principal technical architect and hands-on engineer responsible for designing, building, and scaling FourLeaf's enterprise data platform. This role bridges strategic vision with technical execution, translating business requirements into robust, scalable data solutions that power analytics, AI, and operational decision-making across the organization.

This position is open to flexible work options including a remote set up.

Core Contributions

  • Enterprise Data Architecture
    • End‑to‑End Architecture Ownership: Design and maintain an enterprise data platform that provides a unified, governed view of credit union operations across all domains.
    • Medallion Architecture: Implement Bronze/Silver/Gold layer strategy with data contracts, transformation standards, and quality expectations.
    • Domain Data Modeling: Create and maintain enterprise data models for Member, Deposit, Transaction, Lending, Finance, Marketing, Digital, and Regulatory domains.
    • Governance & Standards: Define architectural patterns, modeling standards, naming conventions, and documentation practices.
    • Reference Architecture: Develop and maintain reference architectures and reusable design patterns for the broader EDAO team.
  • Data Ingestion & Integration
    • Pipeline Strategy & Implementation: Lead the design of ingestion pipelines for 75+ systems of record including digital platforms, payment processors, lending systems, and third‑party providers.
    • Matillion Framework Development:
      • Build reusable ETL/ELT patterns, templates, and parameterized components.
      • Standardize batch, near‑real‑time, and streaming ingestion methods.
      • Implement error handling, retry logic, and alerting frameworks.
    • Integration Patterns: Define approaches for database connections, APIs, file transfers, and CDC‑based ingestion.
    • Quality at Source: Embed validation, profiling, and quality checks within ingestion workflows.
  • Solution Architecture & Hands‑On Engineering
    • End-to-End Project Delivery: Lead mid‑to‑large data initiatives from requirements through deployment.
    • Technical Solution Design: Translate complex business needs into technical specifications, data models, and implementation plans.
    • Hands‑On Delivery: Build critical pipelines, transformations, and data products while setting engineering quality standards.
    • Technical Problem-Solving: Serve as the expert problem solver for performance challenges, integration issues, and architectural decisions.
    • Stakeholder Collaboration: Work directly with business analysts, product owners, and subject matter experts to understand requirements and deliver solutions that meet business needs.
  • DataOps & Observability
    • End‑to‑End Observability: Design frameworks for monitoring data quality, freshness, pipeline reliability, and lineage.
    • Monitoring and Alerting: Implement proactive alerts and incident‑response processes.
    • SLA & Reliability Management: Define, measure, and optimize SLAs for critical business processes.
    • Operational Excellence: Introduce automated testing, CI/CD pipelines, and environment management.
    • Incident Management: Develop runbooks and lead root‑cause analysis for operational issues.
  • Snowflake FinOps & Cost Optimization
    • Cost Governance: Implement Snowflake cost‑management strategies including monitoring, warehouse optimization, and chargeback/showback models.
    • Performance Optimization: Optimize queries, warehouse sizing, and resource utilization to balance performance and cost.
    • Usage Analytics: Analyze consumption trends and identify optimization opportunities.
    • Budget Management: Partner with finance and IT to forecast and manage Snowflake spend.
    • Standards Enforcement: Define and enforce development practices supporting cost‑efficient usage.
  • AI‑Accelerated Development
    • AI‑Assisted Engineering: Use AI tools to accelerate pipeline development, code generation, and documentation.
    • Snowflake Cortex Integration: Leverage Cortex capabilities for data processing and enrichment.
    • Automation Strategy: Identify repetitive engineering tasks suitable for AI‑driven automation.
    • Innovation Leadership: Stay current on AI advancements relevant to data engineering and evaluate adoption opportunities.
  • Semantic Layer & Analytics Enablement
    • Semantic Architecture: Build and maintain a semantic layer with consistent business definitions, metrics, and data products.
    • Member 360: Develop comprehensive member‑centric data products that enable insights into behavior, engagement, and opportunities.
    • Standardized Metrics: Deliver enterprise KPIs for Lending, Deposits, Digital, Branch Performance, and more.
    • Regulatory Analytics: Support NCUA, BSA/AML, GLBA, and other compliance requirements through curated data products.
    • BI Integration: Optimize models for consumption in Power BI and Sigma Computing.
  • Advanced Analytics & ML Support
    • Predictive Analytics Infrastructure: Build the data infrastructure and feature stores required for predictive modeling (risk, churn, behavior, growth).
    • Prescriptive Analytics: Enable next‑best‑action and prescriptive decision‑support pipelines.
    • MLOps Collaboration: Work with data scientists to operationalize models and ensure reliable data flows and monitoring.
    • Analytics Sandbox: Maintain secure, well‑structured environments for experimentation and advanced analytics.
Assets You Will Bring

  • Bachelors Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field. Masters degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field. is a plus.
  • 15+ years of progressive experience in data engineering, data architecture, database development, and enterprise analytics with experience in solution architecture and technical leadership roles with demonstrated ownership of enterprise-scale data platforms.
  • Hands-on experience with cloud data platforms (Snowflake required; additional cloud DW experience valued). Experience with modern ETL/ELT tools, with Matillion expertise strongly preferred.
  • Certifications: This position requires at least one of the certifications listed below. Additional certifications are considered a plus
    • SnowPro Advanced: Architect and SnowPro Advanced: Data Engineer
    • Matillion Associate or Professional Certification

descriptionHtml:
Your Role

Wind River, An Aptiv Company, is seeking a Data Platform Architect to define and guide the architecture of our modern data platform supporting enterprise analytics, business metrics, dashboards, and visualization. This is a unique opportunity to architect the end-to-end data journey from ingestion through visualization using technologies including Fivetran, Snowflake, dbt, Tableau, and modern data engineering practices.

You will partner with executives and cross-functional stakeholders to translate business requirements into scalable data solutions, establish data engineering and analytics best practices, and provide technical leadership and mentorship to data developers in a fast-paced, service-oriented environment.

Roles And Responsibilities

  • Architect end-to-end data structures and workflows from ingestion through visualization using Fivetran, Snowflake, dbt, and Tableau.
  • Define and implement data engineering best practices that improve platform maintainability, reliability, scalability, and efficiency.
  • Provide expertise in Snowflake data warehouse architecture, modeling, and development across diverse and nonuniform data sets.
  • Design and maintain data security and access controls while establishing effective source code management practices using GitHub.
  • Develop SQL, HTML, and JavaScript solutions to optimize the data platform and support analytics and visualization requirements.
  • Partner with executives and cross-functional teams to gather business requirements and translate them into effective data architecture and analytics solutions.
  • Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior data developers while promoting data engineering, analytics, CI/CD, and development best practices.

Your Background

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field; emphasis in Data Engineering is a plus.
  • 10–12 years of Data Engineering development and visualization experience, including 6–8 years of Data Warehouse experience; Snowflake DWH experience is preferred.
  • 6–8 years of SQL experience, preferably Snowflake SQL, with strong data modeling and modern data warehouse expertise.
  • 2–4 years of dbt experience, 3–5 years of GitHub experience, and 2–3 years of experience with CI/CD tools for the modern data stack; semantic layer experience is a plus.
  • 3–5 years of experience with Tableau Cloud or a comparable modern data visualization platform, plus 2+ years of Python development.
  • Experience with enterprise systems including Salesforce, Workday, Oracle, Oracle BI, Jira, and financial planning applications such as Anaplan or Adaptive, with HTML and JavaScript experience related to Tableau preferred.
  • Fluent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate with executives and cross-functional stakeholders.

Why join Wind River / Aptiv?

  • You grow at Aptiv. Aptiv's winning culture is global by design. We bring together diverse perspectives, cultures, and business contexts to solve our customers' toughest challenges. In this environment, every individual can grow, lead, and make an impact, regardless of background, because inclusion fuels how we innovate and win.
  • You make an impact at Aptiv. One of the strengths of humanity is our drive to progress, to improve, to achieve more tomorrow than we did yesterday. People need solutions they can trust when it matters most. At Aptiv, you are building those solutions every day.
  • You have support at Aptiv. We ensure you have the resources and support you need to take care of your family, your physical health, and your mental health with a competitive benefits package.

Your Benefits At Aptiv

  • Comprehensive health, dental, vision, and life insurance.
  • Flexible time off supporting work-life balance.
  • Eligibility to enroll in a 401(k) plan.
  • 12 paid holidays.
  • Professional development and career growth opportunities.
  • Opportunity to work with cutting-edge technologies and teams focused on innovation.

Compensation

The compensation range for this role is $176,000 to $210,000 USD plus an annual incentive plan bonus. Compensation is determined through interviews and a review of the applicant’s education, experience, knowledge, skills, location, abilities, and internal equity.

Security Clearance Requirements

Successful candidates must engage in a security clearance process in regard to their citizenship in order to perform fundamental job duties, as per applicable law. In particular, candidates with certain citizenship may not be able to perform such fundamental job duties. Currently, this includes citizens of the following countries: Belarus; Burma; China; Cuba; Iran; North Korea; Syria; Venezuela; Afghanistan; Cambodia; Central African Republic; Cyprus; Democratic Republic of Congo; Ethiopia; Eritrea; Haiti; Iraq; Lebanon; Libya; Russia; Somalia; South Sudan; Sudan; Zimbabwe.

The security clearance process may take a significant amount of time to complete, and any offer of employment will be contingent on the candidate's legal ability to perform the fundamental job duties. Wind River is committed to meeting its obligations to candidates under applicable human rights law and privacy law in this regard.

Meet the Next Generation Aptiv

At Aptiv, we deliver innovative solutions that people trust when it matters most.

Progress is never static. It is about reaching further, exploring new possibilities, and enabling mobility. Aptiv empowers customers to create solutions people rely on, advancing safety and autonomy in Automotive and Commercial Vehicles, enabling mission-critical performance in Aerospace & Defense, and powering intelligent systems across Energy, Enterprise, and Telecommunications. We also drive precision and efficiency in Industrials & Robotics and support life-critical innovation in Medical technologies.

Guided by our winning culture and values to Think & Act Like Owners, as One Team, and Play to Win, we turn commitment into results and achieve more together.

Join Us to Deliver Innovative Solutions That People Trust!

descriptionHtml:
Xcel Energy (NASDAQ: XEL) is a leading energy provider and Fortune 500 company, dedicated to serving millions of electricity and natural gas customers across eight states: Minnesota, Colorado, Wisconsin, Michigan, North Dakota, South Dakota, New Mexico and Texas. We make energy work better for our customers, helping them thrive every day. That means always raising the bar - delivering better service and providing more reliable, resilient, and sustainable energy.

Xcel Energy is a place where you’ll have opportunities to grow, expand your skills, and help lead the clean energy transition. We offer meaningful rewards, recognition, and support to help you build your career and make an impact - both on the job and beyond. Most importantly, it means you’ll be joining a company that knows employees are the driving force behind its success and is committed to helping you be your best.

Xcel Energy supports a hybrid work model to enable collaboration and flexibility. Many roles are expected to work onsite three days per week (Tuesday–Thursday); however, work location expectations vary based on role, team, and business needs.

Position Summary

The Senior Data Architect is a senior technical leader responsible for advancing enterprise data architecture and driving a data product operating model that connects project delivery to a clear architectural north star. As a member of a cross-functional data product team, this role helps design, manage, deploy, maintain, and continuously improve data products as software products using agile product-team practices. The architect defines and governs reference architectures, reusable design patterns, and standards that progressively modernize the data estate and enable trusted, discoverable, and reusable data consumption through Xcel Data Fabric (XDF).

The architect participates directly in project-level architecture design, translating business needs into end-to-end solutions and evaluating trade-offs across data modeling, integration, security, governance, scalability, and operational sustainability. Working with business partners, subject matter experts, data owners and stewards, developers, product owners, data engineers, enterprise architecture, and platform teams, this role guides domain-owned data products throughout their lifecycle, including definition, onboarding to XDF, deployment, ongoing maintenance, and evolution. This includes clear ownership, data contracts, semantics, metadata, access controls, and service expectations.

This position requires the depth to resolve complex design challenges and the enterprise perspective to shape technology direction, define practical transition roadmaps, and influence adoption without direct authority. The architect connects near-term investment decisions to the target architecture, promotes reuse over isolated solutions, and communicates the health, risks, and modernization needs of the data domain.

Essential Responsibilities

  • Architectural Operations: Review and approve projects and work efforts to ensure that they are compliant with architectural standards. Track and manage exceptions to standards. Continuously improve operational processes. Assess, report, and make recommendations to eliminate operational risk related to technology or architecture.
  • Technical Expertise: Provide consultation and direction to delivery and operational teams on optimal architecture for respective solutions. Maintain state-of-the-art expertise of enterprise architecture technologies, frameworks, and industry innovations.
  • Leadership: Lead work cross-organizationally through coaching and feedback, and through significant interactions and influence with leaders. Govern work efforts to ensure alignment with reference architecture, IT strategy and policy. Collaborate cross-organizationally to influence alignment on and adoption of enterprise architecture standards.
  • Planning and Strategy: Participate in creation and renewal of an overarching IT strategy. Develop and enforce reference architecture standards that are aligned with IT strategies and principles. Contribute to architecture road maps and provide input to technology roadmaps. Ensure the domain IT Strategy align with Enterprise Architecture framework and standards.

Minimum Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in technology, science, business or related field, or 4 years of experience equivalent to the position.
  • 10 years of related functional experience.
  • Architecture acumen across multiple domains including network, infrastructure, software, hosting models, mobile platforms, and security.
  • Exposure to diverse systems, technologies and processing environments in a large corporate setting.
  • Project solution architecture experience.
  • General knowledge of core aspects of enterprise architecture (Software, Hardware, Network, Integration, Data, hosting models, platform types, etc.).
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving and troubleshooting skills.
  • Extensive knowledge of future technology trends within area of expertise.
  • Demonstrated leadership on technical aspects of large scale projects.
  • Excellent communication skills, effective with varying organizational levels and skill sets.
  • Excellent Relationship Management and collaboration skills, with a track record of working as one team cross-organizationally to drive innovation and business results.

Preferred Requirements

  • Demonstrated senior-level experience shaping enterprise data architecture and data product strategy, with a track record of translating a target-state vision into reference architectures, transition roadmaps, and adopted project solutions.
  • Deep expertise in conceptual, logical, and physical data modeling; domain boundaries; enterprise business semantics; and designing reusable data assets that remain stable as source systems evolve.
  • Experience defining domain-owned, contract-driven data products, including schema, business definitions, ownership and stewardship, quality expectations, freshness, availability, access context, versioning, and lifecycle management.
  • Experience establishing repeatable data product onboarding and publication patterns for an enterprise data platform such as XDF, including discovery, metadata, lineage, security, consumer readiness, and operational support expectations. Demonstrated experience applying software-product engineering practices to data products, including version control, automated data and contract testing, continuous integration and delivery, release and rollback strategies, production monitoring, and ongoing maintenance.
  • Strong hands-on architecture experience across ingestion, transformation, storage, integration, and consumption, with the ability to evaluate batch, event-driven, and near-real-time approaches and explain trade-offs in performance, resilience, cost, and complexity.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead project-level architecture design, document consequential design decisions, assess alternatives, and guide engineering teams from solution definition through implementation while maintaining alignment with enterprise standards.
  • Experience defining reusable reference solutions for governed data sharing, analytics, and AI-ready consumption, reducing duplicated pipelines and consumer-specific logic through standardized interfaces and shared semantics.
  • Experience embedding data governance, classification, access controls, quality measurement, lineage, and observability into architecture designs in partnership with business owners, data stewards, security, and platform teams.
  • Proven ability to influence business and technology leaders without direct authority, facilitate cross-domain design decisions, mentor architects and engineers, and communicate architectural trade-offs and modernization priorities to executive and technical audiences.
