Gilbane is seeking a Data Architect to provide strategic and technical leadership in the design, evaluation, and governance of enterprise technology capabilities. This role translates business objectives into scalable, secure, reliable, and sustainable architectures while ensuring alignment with enterprise strategy, standards, and roadmaps. This role can be located near any Gilbane office or remote.

Who are we?

As a Top-10 ENR Contractor, Gilbane is a family-owned business with 45 offices that has been shaping communities since 1870. Consistently recognized as one of the most reputable construction management firms in the country, Gilbane is committed to delivering projects safely and on-time. You will have the opportunity to build schools, labs, hospitals, corporate offices, sports arenas and more!

We are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

Who are you?

You are someone who acts inclusively, showing empathy and treating others with respect and dignity in order to uphold Gilbane’s core value of Caring and “People First” workplace culture. You seek to listen in order to understand and can convey information clearly. You’re a strong problem solver who can identify, prioritize, and implement alternatives for solutions, and you demonstrate adaptability by collaborating with others and supporting team members to achieve excellence. A self-starter who shows passion, commitment, and ownership all while delivering on business outcomes and driving results. You’re someone who identifies opportunities for new and improved ways of doing things that result in value-add solutions.

Your core values match Gilbane’s: Integrity, Caring, Teamwork, Toughmindedness, Dedication to Excellence, Discipline, Loyalty, and Entrepreneurship.

What’s in it for you?

Gilbane offers employees multi-dimensional training opportunities through a number of resources. While managing your responsibilities to projects, you will be able to enroll in trainings through our award-winning Gilbane University to build leadership and technical skills. In addition, you would work with an experienced team which provides you with the opportunity to learn new industry skills every day. You will protect and promote the interests of both Gilbane and the client in all matters as well as demonstrating the personal characteristics of a developing leader.

  • Defines and maintains architecture principles, standards, reference architectures, reusable patterns, and technical guidance for assigned domains
  • Leads architecture and high-level design activities for strategic business and technology initiatives
  • Translates business capabilities, requirements, and constraints into practical architectures
  • Ensures architectures address key attributes such as scalability, security, reliability, interoperability, performance, maintainability, and supportability
  • Supports enterprise strategies and roadmaps by developing current-state, target-state, and transition architectures
  • Identifies relevant dependencies, risks, gaps, and opportunities across technology domains
  • Participates in architecture reviews, governance processes, portfolio planning, and the development of technology roadmaps
  • Provides architecture guidance throughout the delivery lifecycle to maintain alignment with approved designs and enterprise standards
  • Partners with business and technology stakeholders to understand strategic objectives, operational needs, and technology requirements; aligns architecture decisions with business priorities, enterprise capabilities, and long-term technology strategies
  • Communicates critical decision points such as options, tradeoffs, risks, and recommendations to technical and non-technical audiences; facilitates collaboration across business teams, product teams, delivery teams, security, operations, and vendors
  • Services as a trusted advisor for technology strategy solution design, and architectural decision-making
  • Promotes consistency and reuse across Business Units, applications, and technology initiatives
  • Coaches and mentors less experienced team members
  • Supports a positive and inclusive work environment

Experience/Education

 Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field; advanced degree preferred but not required
  • ?5+ years of experience in Solution Architecture, Application Architecture, Data Architecture, Enterprise Architecture, or related technical leadership roles
  • Certification or familiarity with architecture frameworks such as The Open Group Architecture Framework (TOGAF) or Zachman preferred
  • Relevant architecture, cloud, application, data, or technology certifications such as Azure Solutions Architect Expert, Certified Data Management Professional (CDMP), or comparable certification preferred
  • Or equivalent combination of education and experience

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

  • Experience designing enterprise-scale solutions across applications, data platforms, integrations, analytics, and cloud services
  • Experience evaluating packaged applications, cloud services, platform capabilities, and custom-development approaches to determine appropriate technology solutions
  • Strong knowledge of enterprise and data architecture, including data modeling, governance, information management, APIs, integration patterns, ETL/ELT, data lineage, access controls, and security principles
  • Understanding of application architecture principles, including service boundaries, scalability, resiliency, observability, interoperability, and lifecycle management
  • Ability to define architecture patterns and standards for APIs, events, messaging, data exchange, workflow orchestration, and system integration
  • Ability to translate business requirements and long-term objectives into scalable, secure, and sustainable technology solutions
  • Ability to architect solutions that balance governance, security, compliance, and data controls with innovation and agility
  • Strong problem-solving and collaboration skills, with the ability to identify root causes and build alignment across business, technology, and cross-functional teams
  • Ability to evaluate emerging technologies and capabilities for their potential to improve business outcomes, delivery effectiveness, and technology sustainability

Salary to be determined based on factors such as geographic location, skills, education, and/or experience of the applicant, as well as the internal equity and alignment with the team.

The pay ranges from $110,000-$155,000.00 plus benefits and retirement program.

Gilbane offers an excellent total compensation package which includes competitive health and welfare benefits and a generous profit-sharing/401k plan. We invest in our employees’ education and have built Gilbane University into a top training organization in the construction industry. Qualified applicants who are offered a position must pass a pre-employment substance abuse test.

Position Summary:

The Principal Cloud Data Architect serves as the architectural authority for Channels Data Platforms and Analytics. This leader defines the target state architecture, drives modernization from legacy technologies to cloud native platforms, and ensures security, resiliency, performance, and compliance across the data and analytics ecosystem. The role provides strategic and technical oversight for the Payment Tracker and guides the transformation of large scale engineering teams and platforms, including mainframe based reporting systems.

The Principal Cloud Data Architect will lead the architecture, modernization, and transformation of the Channels Data Platform, which today includes on prem data warehouses, Informatica ETL, Hadoop ecosystems, mission critical mainframe processing, and legacy reporting workloads. The role will evolve this platform toward a cloud native, scalable, resilient architecture leveraging Azure, Databricks, Snowflake, Kafka, APIs/microservices, and modern engineering patterns.

  • Define and communicate the solution intent and architectural vision across Business, Data, Application, and Technology domains.
  • Build and maintain a multi year modernization roadmap for Channels Data Platforms, including mainframe, Hadoop, ETL, and analytics components.
  • Establish target operating models, architectural patterns, and guardrails to support evolving capabilities and regulatory expectations.
  • Drive enterprise alignment by collaborating with Enterprise Architecture, Platform Architecture, Information Governance, Risk, and Product.
  • Lead transformation from Informatica, on prem databases, Hadoop, and mainframe based reporting into cloud native architectures (Azure, Databricks/Delta, Snowflake, Event Hubs/Kafka).
  • Define migration paths for mainframe jobs, batch interfaces, and legacy ledger/reporting logic into scalable modern architectures.
  • Implement CI/CD for data, Infrastructure as Code (Terraform/Bicep), observability (logs/metrics/traces), and cost/performance governance.
  • Ensure platform resiliency, scalability, and operational readiness (HA/DR, autoscaling, performance tuning, traffic management).
  • Provide end to end architectural oversight for Payment Tracker, including UI, APIs/microservices, data models, analytics layers, and dashboards.
  • Guide design for real time and near real time insights, data marts, and advanced analytics embedded in Payment Tracker experiences.
  • Ensure adherence to NFRs (performance, security, maintainability, reliability) and integrated monitoring/alerting for application and data services.
  • Lead design and code reviews; resolve architectural blockers; ensure compliance with the Bank’s Risk Framework, data privacy, entitlements, masking, and audit expectations.
  • Partner with delivery teams to translate strategy into actionable technical backlogs and architecture epics.
  • Drive the creation of reusable accelerators, libraries, templates, migration playbooks, and modernization frameworks.
  • Mentor engineers and elevate engineering excellence across Channels Technology.
  • Own R\&D for the data and analytics portfolio: evaluate emerging tools, run POCs/Pilots, benchmark performance, publish decision records, and set technology adoption standards.

Required Qualifications

  • 12+ years in data/software engineering with 8+ years designing enterprise data platforms or large distributed architectures.
  • Demonstrated leadership in cloud modernization (Azure preferred), including Databricks (Spark/Delta), Snowflake, Kafka/Event Hubs.
  • Strong background in modernizing legacy systems, including Informatica ETL, Hadoop/Big Data systems, and mainframe workloads (batch pipelines, reporting interfaces).
  • Deep expertise in NFR driven design: resiliency, security, performance, scalability, observability, and operational excellence.
  • Strong proficiency in SQL and Python (Scala or Java a plus).
  • Proven ability to influence senior leaders, drive enterprise alignment, and deliver outcomes in highly regulated environments.
  • Strong communication skills—capable of translating complex engineering concepts for executive, business, and technical audiences.
  • Strong background in modernizing legacy systems, including Informatica ETL, Hadoop/Big Data systems, and mainframe workloads (batch pipelines, reporting interfaces).
  • Experience with microservices, containers (Kubernetes/OpenShift), API gateways, and integration patterns.

Representative tools/technologies :

Azure (ADLS Gen2, Event Hubs, Key Vault), Databricks, Snowflake, Informatica, Kafka, Mainframe/Z Series job orchestration, Oracle/Postgres, Python, SQL, Java/Scala (optional), Git, Azure DevOps/Jenkins, Docker/Kubernetes/OpenShift, Collibra, AppDynamics/Splunk/Grafana.Starburst

Desired Qualifications

  • Experience in Payments, Channels, CashPro, or analytics driven applications.
  • Knowledge of semantic layers (dbt, LookML), data quality frameworks (Great Expectations/Deequ), and data governance (Purview, Collibra).
  • FinOps experience with cost optimization for cloud data workloads.
  • Advanced understanding of streaming, event driven architectures, and ML/AI integration.

This job is responsible for defining and leading the engineering approach for solutions at the program or portfolio level, to deliver significant business outcomes. Key responsibilities include continuously improving the design, quality, and reuse of the solution and delivering technology enablers that improve development efficiencies for the solution. Job Title & Specialty Area: Principal Cloud Data Architect (Microsoft Fabric and Azure)

Department: Advanced Analytics

Location: Dallas, TX

Shift: 8:00 am to 5:00 pm

Job Type: Remote

Why Children's Health?

At Children's Health, our mission is to Make Life Better for Children, and we recognize that their health plays a crucial role in achieving this goal.

Through our cutting-edge treatments and affiliation with UT Southwestern, we strive to deliver an extraordinary patient and family experience, ensuring that every moment, big or small, contributes to their overall well-being.

Our dedication to promoting children's health extends beyond our organization and encompasses the broader community. Together, we can make a significant difference in the lives of children and contribute to a brighter and healthier future for all.

Summary

The Principal Cloud Solution Data Architect designs, develops, and implements scalable, secure, and high performance data solutions, integrating source systems, data stores, interfaces, and cloud infrastructure. This role involves analyzing business requirements, creating system-level data architectures, and leveraging cloud-native technologies to optimize performance, scalability, and maintainability. The architect ensures seamless integration of enterprise-wide data while designing solutions that align with cloud best practices, including containerization, microservices, and serverless architectures. As a technical leader, the architect collaborates with cross-functional teams enterprise-wide, troubleshoots reporting, products, and data issues, and guides development teams in full-stack and cloud-native development best practices. They research emerging technologies, create reusable frameworks, document technical designs, and ensure data systems are designed for efficient deployment and management in cloud environments. This role is critical and has ultimate oversight in delivering innovative, cloud-optimized data and artificial intelligence (AI) products aligned with business goals.

Responsibilities

Technical Leadership:

  • Define and deliver high-level cloud medallion data architecture that empowers enterprise-wide analytics and AI solutions to address business objectives and balance scalability, performance, and security
  • Mentor and advise data professionals (engineers and analysts) within Enterprise Data Analytics, Information Services, and operational analytics teams, championing best practices in healthcare cloud data architecture, data and AI product development, standard operating procedures (SOPs), DevOps, and SDLC throughout the organization and enabling growth across teams
  • Translate architectural designs into actionable tasks for development teams
  • Evaluate, select, and implement emerging technologies (e.g., data mesh, GenAI data stack, lakehouse evolution) that meet the unique demands of Children’s Health, with foresight for future scalability and interoperability

Collaboration and Communication:

  • Work with stakeholders, including product owners, business analysts, and project managers, to ensure technical solutions meet business and user needs.
  • Coordinate with cross-functional teams to ensure successful integration of data and components

System Design and Development:

  • Lead the design and integration data from source applications (e.g. electronic health records, enterprise resource planning, and other health information systems), leveraging API, ELT (extract, load, and transform), and cloud-based infrastructure
  • Make architecture decisions that align with long-term organizational goals and industry best practices, using systems performance and process modeling to establish a robust foundation
  • Leverage expertise in software engineering practices, back-end technologies, databases, data development/engineering, and artificial intelligence/machine learning engineering to build robust solutions
  • Ensure solutions align with industry best practices for user experience, security, integrity, patient privacy, regulatory compliance, and quality

Project Management:

  • Develop and communicate project estimates and work plans, ensuring tasks and deliverables adhere to schedules and budgets
  • Manage cross-functional teams and align project execution with organizational objectives
  • Align project goals with agile methodologies such as Scrum and Kanban
  • Communicate progress to stakeholders and adjust plans to meet evolving requirements

Documentation and Technical References:

  • Produce and maintain detailed documentation of design components, including technical designs, program specifications, and interim components
  • Produce and maintain comprehensive documentation of data architecture frameworks, policies, and procedures for transparency and accountability
  • Prepare operational manuals, technical references, security policies, and user training materials to support system deployment and maintenance

System Monitoring and Maintenance:

  • Oversee data, analytics, and AI operating environments across production, UAT, QA, and development systems or bronze, silver, and gold layers of cloud platform.
  • Perform regular system upgrades, patches, and performance-tuning enhancements to ensure optimal functionality and reliability
  • Monitor the performance of solutions within the cloud data platform and strategize optimization measures to consistently improve system or query performance, decrease processing time, reduce costs, and enhance overall productivity

Collaboration and Communication:

  • Collaborate with business and clinical stakeholders, directors, managers, analytics and data science teams, and informatics specialists to communicate data and AI architectural concepts and technical strategies
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with stakeholders by providing technical guidance and addressing concerns effectively
  • Lead the enterprise data architecture and innovation roadmap, aligned with Children’s Health’s business and technology strategy
  • Guide engineering, product, security, and compliance leaders to ensure data platform supports real-time analytics, ML/AI, and regulatory needs

Work Experience

How You’ll Be Successful:

  • At least 10 years hands-on experience in data extraction, data architecture, data administration, data modeling, data management, BI, with heavy focus on data warehousing and ELT technologies

EDUCATION

  • Four-year Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience required
  • Graduate or professional work or advanced degree; or equivalent experience preferred

LICENSES AND CERTIFICATIONS

  • Data architecture certification (e.g. SnowPro, Advanced Architect, Microsoft Azure Data Architect, AWS, Certified Solutions Architect, Google Professional Data Engineer, or healthcare IT certifications) required within 180 Days of hire
  • Denodo preferred

A Place Where You Belong

We put our people first. We welcome, value, and respect the beliefs, identities and experiences of our patients and colleagues. We are committed to delivering culturally effective care, creating meaningful partnerships in the communities we serve, and equipping and developing our team members to make Children’s Health a place where everyone can contribute.

Holistic Benefits – How We’ll Care For You

  • Employee portion of medical plan premiums are covered after 3 years.
  • 4%-10% employee savings plan match based on tenure
  • Paid Parental Leave (up to 12 weeks)
  • Caregiver Leave
  • Adoption and surrogacy reimbursement

Job Description

Raymond James is seeking an experienced, hands-on Data Modeler & Architecture Lead to support the Capital Markets & Advisory (CMA) Technology organization. This position will serve as a senior technical leader within CMA Technology Product Management, connecting business requirements, data architecture, database engineering, and application development across the organization's on-premises and cloud data environments.

The successful candidate will combine deep technical expertise in Microsoft SQL Server, Oracle, AWS, and enterprise data modeling with a strong understanding of business processes and application architecture. This individual will work directly with Product Owners, business stakeholders, and Development teams to investigate complex data challenges, design scalable solutions, improve existing systems, and establish consistent, reusable data architectures.

This is a highly technical, hands-on position requiring the ability to independently analyze databases, develop and optimize SQL, troubleshoot production issues, design data models, and guide technical implementations. The role will also play a key part in advancing CMA's hybrid-cloud modernization strategy and building governed, reliable data foundations for enterprise reporting, analytics, and AI-enabled business capabilities.

Key Responsibilities

Data Architecture & Modeling

  • Design, develop, and maintain conceptual, logical, and physical data models supporting operational applications, databases, data warehouses, reporting, and analytical platforms.
  • Translate business processes, Product Owner requirements, and operational workflows into data architectures, schemas, entity relationships, business rules, and technical specifications.
  • Establish authoritative and reusable data models, identifying opportunities to standardize, consolidate, and improve existing data structures.
  • Design normalized and dimensional models, source-to-target mappings, reference data structures, and data integration patterns.
  • Define and promote database design standards, data quality controls, metadata management, and data lineage practices.

Database Engineering & Technical Problem-Solving

  • Provide hands-on technical expertise across Microsoft SQL Server, Oracle, and AWS database environments.
  • Develop, review, and optimize complex SQL queries, stored procedures, database objects, and supporting scripts.
  • Investigate and resolve complex database performance issues, data discrepancies, integration failures, and production incidents.
  • Analyze execution plans, database dependencies, query performance, and application data flows to identify root causes and implement improvements.
  • Partner with Development and engineering teams to design, implement, test, and validate database changes and technical solutions.
  • Evaluate database performance, scalability, reliability, and maintainability, recommending improvements that support business and operational requirements.

Cloud Architecture & Data Modernization

  • Support the design and evolution of hybrid-cloud data architectures integrating existing SQL Server and Oracle environments with AWS.
  • Evaluate database modernization opportunities, cloud migration approaches, workload placement, and integration architectures.
  • Partner with cloud engineering and enterprise architecture teams to design scalable, secure, and cost-effective AWS database and analytics solutions.
  • Develop practical transition architectures that preserve existing application functionality while enabling cloud modernization.
  • Help establish reusable data services and cloud-based data foundations supporting future business capabilities.

Data Integration, Analytics & Governance

  • Design and support data integration solutions, including ETL/ELT processes, APIs, data ingestion, transformation, and database-to-database integrations.
  • Investigate and resolve data quality issues, reporting discrepancies, and reconciliation gaps across applications and platforms.
  • Enable governed, reusable datasets for business intelligence, self-service reporting, advanced analytics, and AI use cases.
  • Collaborate with Security, Enterprise DBA, and Data Governance teams to ensure solutions align with enterprise requirements for access controls, data entitlements, ethical walls, auditability, and information security.
  • Improve documentation of data definitions, source systems, transformations, dependencies, and technical architecture.

Business Partnership & Technical Leadership

  • Work directly with CMA business stakeholders and Product Owners to understand business workflows, data requirements, operational challenges, and opportunities for improvement.
  • Translate business needs into actionable technical requirements, architecture recommendations, and prioritized engineering work.
  • Serve as a primary technical point of coordination for assigned CMA database and data architecture initiatives, partnering closely with Development, Enterprise DBA, Cloud Infrastructure, and enterprise technology teams.
  • Provide technical guidance and design reviews to promote consistency, architectural integrity, and alignment with business objectives.
  • Balance immediate production support needs and application enhancements with longer-term data architecture and modernization priorities.
  • Communicate technical findings, solution options, dependencies, risks, and tradeoffs clearly to both business and technology stakeholders.

Required Qualifications

  • More than eight (8) years of hands-on experience in database architecture, data modeling, SQL development, and enterprise data management.
  • Advanced proficiency with Microsoft SQL Server and Oracle, including relational database design, stored procedures, complex queries, performance tuning, and troubleshooting.
  • Demonstrated experience developing conceptual, logical, and physical data models for operational and analytical systems.
  • Strong understanding of database architecture, normalization, dimensional modeling, data integrity, and performance optimization.
  • Experience designing and supporting data integrations, ETL/ELT processes, source-to-target mappings, and complex application data flows.
  • Practical knowledge of AWS database and data architecture technologies and hybrid on-premises/cloud environments.
  • Experience investigating production database issues, identifying root causes, and working with engineering teams to implement and validate solutions.
  • Understanding of data governance, metadata, lineage, data quality, security, and access control requirements.
  • Demonstrated ability to translate complex business requirements into practical technical solutions.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, documentation, and communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently, provide technical leadership, and collaborate effectively across Product Management, Development, Infrastructure, and business teams.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with AWS services such as RDS, Aurora, S3, Redshift, Glue, Athena, Lake Formation, and IAM.
  • Experience with enterprise database modernization, cloud migration, and hybrid-cloud data architecture.
  • Familiarity with reporting and analytics platforms such as Qlik, Power BI, Tableau, and Python-based analytical solutions.
  • Experience developing curated datasets, semantic models, and governed self-service analytics capabilities.
  • Knowledge of master/reference data management, historical data modeling, data lineage, and cross-system reconciliation.
  • Experience supporting data architectures for advanced analytics and AI-enabled applications.
  • Experience working in financial services, capital markets, investment banking, or another highly regulated environment.
  • Experience operating in a cross-functional technology organization with shared responsibilities across Product Management, application engineering, and enterprise infrastructure teams.

Licenses/Certifications

  • None required.

Education

Bachelor’s - Completed: Business Administration, Bachelor’s - Completed: Computer and Information Science, Bachelor’s - Completed: Computer Engineering, High School (HS) - Completed (Required)

Work Experience

General Experience - 3 to 6 years

Certifications

Less than 25%

Hybrid

Colgate-Palmolive Company is a global consumer products company operating in over 200 countries specializing in Oral Care, Personal Care, Home Care, Skin Care, and Pet Nutrition. Our products are trusted in more households than any other brand in the world, making us a household name!

Join Colgate-Palmolive, a caring, innovative growth company reimagining a healthier future for people, their pets, and our planet. Guided by our core values—Caring, Inclusive, and Courageous—we foster a culture that inspires our people to achieve common goals. Together, let's build a brighter, healthier future for all.

Role Summary

We are looking for an Enterprise Data Architect to join our Data Engineering, Architecture and Delivery Organization within Global Information Technology (GIT). In this role, you will bridge the gap between complex business requirements and technical implementation, designing scalable, AI-ready data solutions that empower stakeholders and AI agents to make data-driven decisions. Working within a federated data ecosystem, while Domain Data Architects focus on specific verticals (such as Customer Development, Supply Chain, Finance, and R&D), you will focus on the horizontal, cross-domain layer—maintaining the enterprise data architecture framework and ensuring shared models, standards, and ontologies work seamlessly across teams. You will partner with our Data Platform team (who manage Snowflake and infrastructure), domain data architects, and data engineers to deliver high-value, performant data products using our modern data stack.

Responsibilities :

  • Enterprise Data Strategy & Modeling: Collaborate with Global IT domain and division data architects to design and maintain conceptual, logical, and physical data models across core global domains (including Supply Chain, Finance, etc.,) and divisions (North America, LATAM, EMEA, etc.), ensuring alignment between business capability maps and technical implementation.
  • Cross-Functional Data & Architecture Delivery: Work as part of a team to deliver cross-functional data products while maintaining alignment with the enterprise data architecture framework. Collaborate with Global IT domain and division teams to translate business goals into robust, AI-ready architectures, develop Entity Relationship Diagrams, Data Flow Diagrams, and machine-readable semantic models, and build data engineering pipelines that solve critical business problems rather than just moving data.
  • Domain Hierarchy & Business Logic Modeling: Maintain and evolve the established data domain hierarchy to avoid data duplication, advance "Data as a Product" principles, and own the design and lifecycle of logical and physical data models—ensuring business rules are accurately codified, versioned, and optimized for both human analytics and LLM/AI consumption (such as semantic layers and enterprise ontologies).
  • Architecture Review Leadership: Drive and manage the data architecture review process for all initiatives. Establish architecture review workflows, oversee structured project onboarding, and ensure that all new data initiatives strictly adhere to technical standards and enterprise guidelines.
  • Community of Practice Facilitation: Actively run and lead the Data Architects Community of Practice. Act as the central technical point of contact for all data architects across the enterprise, foster cross-domain synergy, share knowledge, curate training resources, and upskill data and analytics engineers on domain-driven design and shared technical standards.
  • Governance, Security & Data Quality: Collaborate with Data Governance and Data Platforms teams to operationalize enterprise-wide data standards, metadata management, data quality standards and data cataloging.
  • Solution Optimization & Cost Management: Proactively optimize pipeline performance, monitor Snowflake resource consumption, track data usage KPIs, and ensure all data pipelines are architected for long-term scalability and cost-efficiency.

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field.
  • 5–8 years of experience in data architecture and data engineering.
  • Proficiency in dimensional data modeling (Star Schema, Snowflake Schema) as well as semantic modeling and enterprise ontologies for AI integration, with the ability to map complex business processes to data structures. Experience with diagramming tools like Lucidchart.
  • Proven practical experience with Snowflake (architecture, performance tuning, security) and dbt (project structure, macros, testing, documentation).
  • Solid understanding of Airflow DAG design patterns and dependencies, along with familiarity with Infrastructure-as-Code principles (Terraform) and containerization concepts.
  • Working knowledge of AI-assisted modeling features, automated testing frameworks, and agentic development patterns (such as Model Context Protocol or specialized agent skills).

Preferred Qualifications

  • Ability to see the "big picture," connect day-to-day designs to the enterprise domain hierarchy, and design systems that persist beyond the current sprint.
  • Excellent ability to translate technical concepts into business language for stakeholders and vice-versa, while effectively guiding and upskilling architects and engineering peers on shared standards.
  • Consumer Packaged Goods (CPG) experience involving external datasets like Nielsen, Point-of-Sale (POS) and internal data like ERP/SAP systems.
  • Understanding of how BI tools (Domo, Sigma) ingest and query data, with the ability to design models that ensure fast, interactive dashboard performance.
  • Working knowledge of Iceberg

Compensation And Benefits

Salary Range $130,000.00 - $150,000.00 USD

Pay is determined based on experience, qualifications, and location. Salaried employees may also be eligible for discretionary bonuses, profit-sharing, and long-term incentives for Executive-level roles.

Benefits: Salaried employees enjoy a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, basic life insurance, paid parental leave, disability coverage, and participation in the 401(k) retirement plan with company matching contributions subject to eligibility requirements. Additional benefits include a minimum of 15 vacation/PTO days (hourly employees receive a minimum of 120 hours) and 13 paid holidays (vacation days are prorated based on the employee's hire date within the calendar year). Paid sick leave is adjusted based on role and location in accordance with local laws. Detailed information regarding paid sick leave entitlements will be provided to employees upon hiring and may be subject to adjustments based on changes in legislation or company policies.

Our Commitment to Inclusion

Our journey begins with our people—developing strong talent with diverse backgrounds and perspectives to best serve our consumers around the world and fostering an inclusive environment where everyone feels a true sense of belonging. We are dedicated to ensuring that each individual can be their authentic self, is treated with respect, and is empowered by leadership to contribute meaningfully to our business.

The group you’ll be a part of

The Global Information Systems Group is dedicated to the success of Lam through providing best-in-class and innovative information system solutions and services. Together, we support users globally with data, information, and systems to achieve their business objectives.

The impact you’ll make

This role will lead platform architecture, integration and solution design in Palantir for enterprise data, analytics, and AI use cases. The solution architect will work with business, GIS, AI, data, governance, and delivery teams to translate business needs into scalable, secure, and reusable platform solutions. The role will focus on building trusted data assets, integration patterns, semantic models, and platform standards that support AI-driven business outcomes and long-term operational readiness.

What You’ll Do

  • Design and architect scalable data pipelines in Palantir Foundry, enabling seamless ingestion, transformation, and delivery of data across enterprise systems.
  • Develop and maintain robust Palantir Foundry Ontologies to model business entities, relationships, and operational workflows for enhanced data usability and decision-making.
  • Build end-to-end data workflows leveraging Palantir Code Repositories, Pipeline Builder, and operational applications while integrating with Microsoft Fabric, Databricks, Power BI, SQL, Python/PySpark, and cloud data services.
  • Leverage Palantir native capabilities such as Foundry Ontology SDK, data lineage, governance, and access controls to deliver secure, reusable, and production-grade data assets.
  • Define standards and best practices for modular design, data security, access management, performance optimization, testing, and scalable deployment within the Palantir ecosystem.
  • Mentor engineering teams, promote consistent engineering practices, and evaluate emerging technologies that enhance analytics, AI enablement, automation, and platform operations.
  • Partner with business stakeholders, product owners, architects, and engineering teams to define solution roadmaps and deliver scalable, governed, and operationalized data solutions.

Who We’re Looking For

  • 12+ years of experience in data architecture, platform engineering, cloud data platforms, analytics, digital transformation, or enterprise data modernization initiatives.
  • Deep expertise in Palantir Foundry, Ontology, Pipeline Builder, Code Repositories, Operational Applications, Ontology SDK, data lineage, governance, and platform administration.
  • Strong experience with modern data platforms such as Palantir, Microsoft Fabric, Databricks, Snowflake, Azure Synapse, or equivalent cloud-native analytics ecosystems.
  • Strong understanding of Palantir ontology modeling, lakehouse architecture, data warehousing, semantic modeling, enterprise integration patterns, and operational analytics.
  • Hands-on experience with Palantir Foundry security and governance frameworks, including user access management, data lineage, SQL, data modeling, ETL/ELT, Python/PySpark, and enterprise analytics solutions.
  • Experience with SAP, MES, Kinaxis, supply chain, planning, manufacturing, service systems, APIs, or operational databases is preferred.
  • Strong understanding of data governance, Lifecycle, metadata, lineage, access control, and data quality frameworks.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to lead business-facing discussions and translate business problems into scalable technical solutions.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, MIS, Data Science, Analytics, or a relevant Engineering field; Master's or PhD preferred.

Our commitment

We believe it is important for every person to feel valued, included, and empowered to achieve their full potential. By bringing unique individuals and viewpoints together, we achieve extraordinary results.

Chevron is accepting online applications for the position SAP MDG Senior Architect through 11/30/2026 at 11:59 p.m. (CST).

The SAP MDG Architect is responsible for designing, governing, and delivering enterprise master data solutions using SAP Master Data Governance (MDG).

This role defines the end-to-end data architecture, governance framework, and integration strategy to ensure consistent, high-quality master data across SAP S/4HANA and connected systems.

The architect partners with business, functional, and technical teams to establish a single source of truth (gold standard” data) and enable scalable digital core data standards across enterprise segments.

Responsibilities for this position may include but are not limited to:

MDG Architecture & Strategy

  • Define enterprise MDG architecture across SAP S/4HANA and non-SAP systems
  • Design master data governance frameworks (standards, policies, workflows)
  • Establish data domains (Business Partner, Material, Finance, EAM, etc.)
  • Define multi-instance and cross-system MDG strategy
  • Architect data replication and synchronization strategies

Solution Design & Governance

  • Lead design of MDG data models, extensions, Data quality Validation rules and governance controls
  • Ensure alignment with enterprise data governance operating model
  • Define approval workflows and data stewardship processes
  • Establish master data standards and templates across domains
  • Define integration patterns
  • Ensure data consistency and system-of-record alignment
  • Define MDG playbooks, design standards, and best practices

Program Delivery & stakeholder relationship

  • Guide SAP S/4HANA transformation programs via Data migration, conversion, and cutover activities
  • Act as primary MDG architecture authority across Business stakeholders, Data stewards / owners and Functional data leads and architects
  • Collaborate with Integration teams, Data platforms (Data Lake, Analytics) and Security & Basis teams.

Required Qualifications

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience)

Core Technical Skills

  • Deep expertise in SAP MDG (Master Data Governance) product
  • Strong knowledge of MDG data models, Workflow and Data replication (DRF)
  • Experience supporting data conversion or migration initiatives
  • Familiarity with SAP Data Services (BODS) or similar ETL tools is a strong plus
  • Understanding of key mapping, staging tables, and reconciliation concepts
  • Experience setting up customizing synchronization between MDG Hub and Transactional S/4HANA.

Functional & Process Knowledge

  • Good understanding of end‑to‑end business processes impacted by master data
  • Ability to translate business requirements into MDG technical solutions
  • Experience with SAP S/4HANA master data objects (BP, Material, Finance, EAM)

Soft Skills

  • Strong stakeholder management and clear communication
  • Strategic thinking + hands-on solution design
  • Ability to operate in cross-functional, global programs

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in multi‑instance S/4HANA landscapes
  • Exposure to Enterprise Asset Management (EAM) MDG extensions
  • Prior experience in large SAP transformation programs
  • Knowledge of data governance frameworks and operating models

Relocation Options:

Relocation may be considered.

International Considerations

Expatriate assignments will not be considered.

Chevron regrets that it is unable to sponsor employment Visas or consider individuals on time-limited Visa status for this position.

US Salary: - $135,800 - $143,000

About Us

Bonterra exists to propel every doer of good to their peak impact. We measure that impact against our vision to increase the giving rate as a percentage of GDP from 2% to 3% by 2033. We know that this goal is lofty, but we are confident that the right technology and expertise will strengthen trust in the sector, allowing the social good industry to accelerate growth and reach peak impact. Bonterra's differentiated, end-to-end solutions collectively support a unique network of over 20,000 customers, including over 16,000 nonprofit organizations and over 50 percent of Fortune 100 companies. Learn more at bonterratech.com.

About The Role

The Sr. Data Architect is a principal-level authority on Bonterra's internal data warehouse platform, responsible for setting the strategic direction of Bonterra's data architecture across Enterprise Applications and beyond. This role operates at the intersection of data engineering depth and organizational influence — defining the frameworks, standards, and roadmap that govern how data is structured, governed, and consumed enterprise-wide. The Sr. Data Architect shapes platform strategy, elevates the capabilities of the data team, and ensures Bonterra's data infrastructure can support the organization's mission at scale.

Key Responsibilities

  • Set the strategic architecture vision for Bonterra's Enterprise data platform — including warehouse design, transformation standards, semantic layer, and data product frameworks.
  • Own enterprise-level data governance — including data contracts, ownership models, quality SLAs, and lineage across all data domains.
  • Define the gold-standard architecture patterns and dbt modeling conventions that the team implements across all pipelines and domains.
  • Partner with IT leadership and business stakeholders to align data platform strategy with organizational priorities and AOP planning.
  • Evaluate and lead adoption of new data technologies, platforms, and methodologies — balancing innovation with stability and team capacity.
  • Mentor Data Architects and Data Engineers; elevate the team's architectural thinking and drive consistency in execution.
  • Represent the data platform perspective in cross-functional planning, vendor evaluation, and enterprise technology decisions.

Requirements

  • 8+ years of data engineering and architecture experience, with a significant portion in enterprise data platform ownership.
  • Deep expertise in modern data stack architecture — Snowflake/BigQuery/Redshift, dbt, orchestration (Airflow, Prefect, or similar), and BI tooling.
  • Proven experience designing and governing enterprise-scale data warehouses with complex, cross-domain data models.
  • Track record of setting and enforcing data governance frameworks that scale across teams and use cases.
  • Strong executive communication skills; able to influence platform direction with senior leadership and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Experience in nonprofit, SaaS, or mission-driven environments a plus.

At Bonterra, we’re building AI-powered tools to solve real human challenges—and we want teammates who share that enthusiasm. We value people who will champion AI and bring diverse perspectives from different industries, backgrounds, and cultures. Together, we create AI that breaks down barriers, empowers communities, and delivers better outcomes

At this time, we are unable to consider candidates who require current or future sponsorship for employment authorization.

____________________________________________________________________________________

Our Culture

At Bonterra, we’re innovating with a higher purpose: to increase giving to 3% of US GDP by 2033, creating $573 billion more in global impact every year. At Bonterra, we foster an inclusive, equitable culture where every team member belongs and contributes to meaningful impact. Read more about our values and culture here.

Compensation & Benefits

We offer a comprehensive benefits package that supports your health, well-being and growth - explore full details here.

Compensation and benefits for this U.S. role apply to regular full-time and part-time employees scheduled to work 30 or more hours a week. Pay reflects location, skills, experience, and education, and is one part of Bonterra’s total rewards package, which may include bonuses, incentives, and equity. Benefits include comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance with employer-subsidized premiums, unlimited Flexible Time Off (FTO), paid holidays, and dedicated time off to volunteer. All regular and part-time employees are eligible for the Bonterra 401(k) plan with a 3% company match.

____________________________________________________________________________________

Equal Opportunity & Accommodations

At Bonterra, we are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We provide equal employment opportunities without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, or gender identity), national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

If you require a reasonable accommodation during the application process, please submit a request.

Data Ideology

At DI, we provide Data & Analytics expertise to drive measurable business outcomes, often solving complex business problems for our clients. Our data analytics advisory services enable our customers to transform data into insights by driving a culture of empowerment and ownership of results. Our team consists of highly motivated individuals passionate about learning, understanding, collaborating, and intellectually curious. For more information about Data Ideology, visit www.dataideology.com.


Snowflake Data Architect

We are always looking to connect with top talent! We are seeking a skilled and collaborative Snowflake Data Architect to help drive ongoing data modernization efforts. This role is responsible for designing and enabling modern cloud data platforms, integrating enterprise systems, and building semantic data models that support critical business functions across the organization. If you're passionate about cloud architecture, scalable data solutions, and helping organizations transform their data ecosystems, we'd love to connect with you.


Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the architecture and technical direction of enterprise Snowflake data platforms, designing scalable solutions for analytics, reporting, business intelligence, and data science.
  • Design and implement Snowflake data models and ELT/ETL pipelines, including dimensional, semantic, and enterprise data models supporting financial, operational, ERP, and other business data.
  • Lead data warehouse modernization and migrations to Snowflake, including source-to-target mapping, transformation, reconciliation, testing, performance optimization, and production cutover.
  • Establish and optimize Snowflake security, governance, performance, and cost management, including RBAC, masking policies, row access policies, workload management, query optimization, and data quality.
  • Partner with business and technical stakeholders to integrate Snowflake with enterprise systems and cloud platforms, evaluate Snowflake capabilities such as Snowpark and Cortex, and provide technical leadership and mentorship across data initiatives.


Qualifications

  • 8+ years of experience in data architecture, data engineering, or data modeling, with 5+ years of hands-on Snowflake experience designing and implementing enterprise data platforms.
  • Deep expertise in Snowflake architecture, data modeling, ELT/ETL, performance optimization, security, governance, and cost management, with strong SQL skills.
  • Demonstrated experience designing scalable Snowflake solutions, including enterprise data warehouses, semantic models, high-volume data environments, and batch or near-real-time data pipelines.
  • Proven experience leading large-scale data migrations and modernization initiatives to Snowflake, from discovery and architecture through development, testing, reconciliation, and production cutover.
  • Strong ability to lead technical direction and collaborate with business and technical stakeholders, translating complex data architecture concepts into scalable Snowflake solutions while balancing strategic vision with hands-on execution.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Deep experience with data governance, metadata management, MDM, and data quality frameworks.
  • Familiarity with data catalog tools (e.g., Purview, Collibra, Alation).
  • Track record supporting enterprise data modernization, migration, or cloud transformation initiatives.


Work Environment:

  • Remote work from home.
  • Hours of work and days are generally Monday through Friday. Specific business hours will depend on client needs.


Physical Demands:

  • Must be able to remain in a stationary position 50% of the time.
  • The person in this position must occasionally move about inside the office to access file cabinets, library stacks, office machinery, etc.
  • Constantly operates a computer and other office productivity machinery, such as a calculator, copy machine, and printer.
  • The person in this position frequently communicates with clients and coworkers. Must be able to exchange accurate information in these situations.


Data Ideology is an EEO Employer

Beyond traditional data layouts, this position requires applying clean code practices, distributed software design patterns, caching mechanisms. Working closely with business and technical teams, you will oversee the design of robust semantic layers, conceptual, logical, and physical schemas, and optimized layouts for relational (SQL) and non-relational (NoSQL) configurations within modern data warehousing and data lakehouse systems.


As a technical leader, you will handle the entire data lifecycle, setting up automated data quality processes, master data management, data observability tools, and managing metadata to make sure all data is accurate, consistent, and easy to use for analytics and AI/LLM applications. Using secure CI/CD practices and containerization, the architect will translate requirements into practical solutions, provide implementation guidance, and drive data governance best practices. Strong skills in data modeling, SQL, cloud platforms (Azure or GCP), and APIs are required, with experience in large-scale data projects and exposure to the C3 AI platform will be highly preferred.


Key Responsibilities:

Enterprise Data Architecture

  • Define and maintain enterprise-wide data architecture standards, principles, and best practices.
  • Design scalable, resilient, and secure data architectures supporting analytics, AI/ML, LLM, and operational workloads.
  • Develop conceptual, logical, and physical data models that align with business objectives and enterprise architecture standards.
  • Architect modern data warehouse, data lakehouse, and data mesh solutions.
  • Drive data platform modernization initiatives and cloud migration strategies.


Data Modeling & Semantic Layer Design

  • Design and optimize: Conceptual Data Models Logical Data Models Physical Data Models
  • Create enterprise semantic layers to support self-service analytics and business intelligence.
  • Establish standards for dimensional modeling, data vault, star schema, snowflake schema, and normalized data models.
  • Design scalable relational and non-relational data structures for diverse business use cases.
  • Ensure data models support reporting, advanced analytics, AI, and machine learning requirements.


Modern Data Platform Architecture

  • Architect and govern data solutions on: Microsoft Fabric, Databricks, Snowflake, Azure Data Platform, and Google Cloud Platform (GCP)
  • Design data ingestion, transformation, storage, and consumption layers.
  • Establish best practices for batch, streaming, and real-time data processing architectures.
  • Design architectures supporting hybrid and multi-cloud environments.


Performance Optimization & Resource Efficiency

  • Drive optimization of compute, storage, and networking resources across cloud platforms.
  • Implement scalable data processing patterns for high-volume and high-throughput environments.
  • Design caching mechanisms and distributed processing strategies to improve platform performance.
  • Establish performance benchmarks, monitoring frameworks, and optimization standards.
  • Identify opportunities to reduce cloud infrastructure costs while maintaining performance and reliability.
  • Ensure efficient utilization of cloud resources through workload optimization and architecture reviews.


Required Experience:

  • 8–12 years of overall experience in data architecture, enterprise data management, or platform architecture.
  • MS or PhD in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, Operations Research, or a related quantitative field.
  • Proven experience designing and implementing large-scale data platforms and enterprise data solutions.
  • Experience leading architecture initiatives across multiple business functions and technology teams.
  • Strong background in cloud-based analytics and modern data platforms.


Preferred Experience:

  • Hands-on experience with the C3 AI platform.
  • Experience working in an embedded client environment, partner delivery model, enterprise SaaS implementation, or AI platform delivery role.
  • Experience delivering AI solutions for large enterprises or Fortune 500 clients.
  • Domain experience in manufacturing, energy, utilities, supply chain, aerospace, or other operationally complex industries.
  • Experience with demand forecasting, asset reliability planning, predictive maintenance, inventory optimization, or supply chain optimization.
  • Experience mentoring junior team members or leading small technical teams.

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions, including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Fractal, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is: $130,000 - $185,000. In addition, you may be eligible for a discretionary bonus for the current performance period.

As a full-time employee of the company or as an hourly employee working more than 30 hours per week, you will be eligible to participate in the health, dental, vision, life insurance, and disability plans in accordance with the plan documents, which may be amended from time to time. You will be eligible for benefits on the first day of employment with the Company. In addition, you are eligible to participate in the Company 401(k) Plan after 30 days of employment, in accordance with the applicable plan terms. The Company provides for 11 paid holidays and 12 weeks of Parental Leave. We also follow a “free time” PTO policy, allowing you the flexibility to take the time needed for either sick time or vacation.

Description

Position Summary:

The Principal Cloud Data Solutions Architect is a senior individual contributor and technical leader who remains close to implementation. The role is accountable for turning enterprise data strategy into working platforms, reusable engineering capabilities, production-grade pipelines, and architecture decisions that improve delivery across teams.

This role combines hands-on data engineering leadership with ownership of enterprise cloud data solutions architecture. It designs, builds, and evolves scalable, secure, resilient, and cost-effective data platforms; establishes engineering standards and reusable patterns; and guides teams from architecture through production delivery. Operating with significant autonomy, the role partners with business, data, security, infrastructure, and application teams to modernize the enterprise data ecosystem, deliver trusted data products, and ensure solutions meet strategic, regulatory, operational, and reliability requirements.

Role Specific Essential Functions

  • Define, evolve, and govern modern cloud data solutions architecture principles, standards, reference architectures, and reusable patterns aligned with business and data strategy.
  • Design and evaluate end-to-end cloud data solution architectures spanning ingestion, streaming, storage, lakehouse and warehouse platforms, transformation, orchestration, analytics, AI/ML, and data consumption.
  • Design, build, and evolve end-to-end cloud data solutions spanning source acquisition, data contracts, batch and streaming ingestion, storage, lakehouse and warehouse platforms, transformation, orchestration, analytical modeling, APIs, and data consumption.
  • Own the technical direction and delivery quality of complex data initiatives, ensuring platforms, pipelines, and data products are scalable, resilient, observable, interoperable, secure, compliant, and operable in production.
  • Assess cloud data technology options and trade-offs, including performance, scalability, interoperability, security, vendor fit, total cost of ownership, and long-term value.
  • Establish and improve engineering practices for testing, deployment, monitoring, incident response, data quality, lineage, service-level objectives, fault tolerance, and cost optimization across production data pipelines and platforms.
  • Own critical data domains and their supporting pipelines end to end, from source-system engagement and data acquisition through modeling, delivery, operational support, and continuous improvement.
  • Partner with business, analytics, data governance, security, application, and platform teams to translate domain needs into governed data products, APIs, shared datasets, and trusted self-service capabilities.
  • Identify and lead opportunities to modernize and simplify the data ecosystem through cloud-native services, reusable ingestion and transformation frameworks, configuration-driven data pipelines, data mesh and data product practices, platform consolidation, automation, and legacy-data migration.
  • Serve as a cloud data solutions architecture thought leader and mentor, guiding architecture reviews, promoting data engineering best practices, and influencing teams without direct authority.
  • Shape cloud data platform and capability roadmaps by anticipating emerging technologies and practices, including real-time data, open table formats, semantic technologies, data observability, FinOps, and AI-ready architecture.

Role Specific Expectations And Qualifications

  • Anticipates internal and external business issues and recommends product, process, or service improvements, including opportunities to modernize cloud data platforms, engineering frameworks, governed data products, semantic layers, and data consumption capabilities.
  • Leads high-risk, complex initiatives across the cloud data ecosystem from technical strategy through implementation and operational adoption.
  • Analyzes complex business and data problems, makes sound architectural and engineering trade-offs, and delivers recommendations that improve scalability, reliability, delivery speed, data trust, and cost.Exercises independent judgment in methods, techniques and evaluation criteria to work on significant and unique issues involving cloud data solutions architecture, platform capabilities, data integration, modeling, governance, security, scalability, and cost.
  • Expert level knowledge in functional area and broad understanding of multiple disciplines. Applies innovative technical or industry knowledge to modern data solutions architecture and analytics practices. Communicates frequently with leadership.
  • Acts independently to determine methods and procedures and may supervise the activities of others. Works autonomously under general guidance and serves as a hands-on technical leader for cloud data solutions architecture and engineering.
  • Guides cross-functional teams on architecture standards, reference patterns, data contracts, engineering frameworks, semantic-layer approaches, modernization decisions, and production-readiness expectations. Manages multiple processes or programs and establishes operational plans.

Education & Experience

  • Required Education: Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics, information systems, or a related field; equivalent relevant experience may be considered.
  • Required Experience: 10+ years of data, software, or technology experience, including 5+ years architecting and implementing enterprise data and analytics solutions on AWS or an equivalent public cloud platform.
  • 7+ years designing, building, and operating modern data platforms and distributed data systems using technologies such as SQL, NoSQL, data lakes, lakehouses, cloud data warehouses, Spark, Kafka, and cloud-native batch and streaming services.
  • 5+ years of hands-on software and data engineering experience using SQL and at least one modern programming language, such as Python, Java, or Scala, with demonstrated use of version control, automated testing, continuous integration and delivery, infrastructure as code, and code-review practices.
  • 5+ years leading complex, large-scale, cross-functional data or cloud initiatives and working directly with internal or external customers and senior stakeholders.

Qualifications & Skills

  • Extensive experience architecting, building, and operating enterprise-scale data and analytics solutions on AWS or an equivalent public cloud platform, including hands-on implementation across data ingestion, transformation, orchestration, storage, modeling, platform engineering, migration, governance, and related technology domains.
  • Demonstrated experience building and operating highly available, distributed data ingestion and processing systems at scale, including performance tuning, failure recovery, schema evolution, data quality controls, lineage, observability, and cost management.
  • Strong ability to conceptualize modern data solutions architecture, data product, information-model, and semantic-layer patterns and translate them into actionable designs and implementation roadmaps.
  • Deep understanding of cloud-native data platforms and end-to-end data solutions architectures, including data lakes, lakehouses, warehouses, batch and streaming pipelines, data modeling, APIs, metadata, data quality, observability, security, governance, and performance optimization.
  • Proven skill in evaluating cloud data technologies and solution options from technical, operational, security, interoperability, vendor, and financial perspectives, including performance and FinOps considerations.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead technical workstreams and cross-functional project teams, influence technology and data decisions, drive alignment, and communicate complex cloud data solutions architecture concepts to business, engineering, security, governance, and executive audiences.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, troubleshooting, and decision-making capabilities, with the ability to provide technical guidance throughout delivery and balance scalability, resilience, governance, security, performance, delivery speed, cost, and long-term architectural outcomes.
  • Experience working independently on highly complex cloud data problems with broad organizational impact, leading cross-functional teams through platform modernization, and developing data and analytics migration strategies from current-state assessment through implementation.
  • Certification/License: Relevant cloud architecture, cloud data engineering, or data management.

Location: Hillsboro, OR | Marlborough/Chelmsford, MA

Target Compensation: $164 - $197K + Annual Bonus

Schedule: Mon- Friday : 8am- 5pm (Hybrid)

We are launching a multi‑year transformation from SAP ECC to SAP S/4HANA, and Raytheon’s Data, Analytics and AI organization is looking for a Senior S/4 Transition Data Architect to help shape the enterprise data foundation that will enable this journey. In this role, you will define and evolve the data architecture that supports seamless reporting and insight generation across both ECC and S/4HANA as they run in parallel during our migration. You will design canonical data models, integration patterns, and a bridge‑reporting strategy that brings together data from migrated and non‑migrated business areas—ensuring leaders and frontline teams have timely, trustworthy insights.

This senior individual contributor role partners closely with product managers, enterprise architects, business stakeholders, and delivery teams to set direction, establish standards, and guide solution teams across the full lifecycle—from strategic planning and design through deployment and ongoing operations.

You will apply formal architecture and strategy methods, such as TOGAF, to articulate business strategy, challenges, needs, and structure ahead of solution design. You will also own the continuous development of reference architectures, data models, personas, use cases, landscape views, and knowledge repositories that accelerate future architecture work and support a consistent, enterprise‑wide approach.

What You Will Do

  • Own the enterprise data architecture for the ECC → S/4HANA transition, defining principles, reference architectures, and guardrails for data domains (Finance, Supply Chain, Order‑to‑Cash, Procure‑to‑Pay, etc.).
  • Design the bridge reporting strategy that harmonizes ECC and S/4HANA datasets to produce consistent KPI definitions and cross‑system analytics (e.g., consolidated financials, inventory, order fulfillment), including semantic layers and data virtualization/replication as appropriate.
  • Model canonical and system‑specific data (conceptual, logical, physical) and establish golden sources, conformed dimensions, data standards, and naming/versioning conventions.
  • Define integration patterns (e.g., SLT/ODP/CDC, APIs, files, events) between SAP and the analytical stack, balancing latency, cost, reliability, and data quality.
  • Enable analytics & planning in SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC)—curate models, measures, and calculations; design security and data‑access patterns; guide dashboard/story design standards.
  • Oversee ETL/ELT pipelines using SAP BusinessObjects Data Services (BODS) and modern orchestration patterns; define error handling, lineage, and observability.
  • Create and maintain architecture artifacts (capability maps, value streams, domain models, roadmaps, standards) aligned to TOGAF ADM phases A–D and communicate them to technical and business stakeholders.
  • Coach delivery teams and provide architectural reviews to ensure solutions conform to strategy while meeting near‑term milestones during the phased migration.

Qualifications You Must Have

  • Typically requires a University Degree or equivalent experience and minimum 10 years prior relevant experience, or An Advanced Degree in a related field and minimum 7 years' experience
  • Deep expertise in the SAP ECC and SAP S/4HANA data models, including CDS views, embedded analytics concepts, and differences from ECC.
  • Leverage tools such as SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC), Snowflake, SAP Business Data Cloud, and BusinessObjects Data Services (BODS) to support data modeling, integration, governance and and reporting needs.
  • Proven track record designing bridge/transition architectures that support multi‑system reporting during large transformations.
  • Strong grounding in data modeling, data warehousing, and data integration techniques.
  • The ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. government issued security clearance is required. U.S. citizenship is required, as only U.S. citizens are eligible for a security clearance.

Qualifications We Prefer

  • TOGAF‑certified; practiced in using the TOGAF framework to build and communicate architecture to business and technical stakeholders.
  • 8–12+ years in data architecture/engineering with end‑to‑end ownership of enterprise data platforms.
  • Experience with SAP in an Aerospace and defense environment.
  • Experience with formal architecture modeling (UML, BPMN, SysML, ArchiMate).
  • Executive presence and strong communication skills; comfortable leading change across large initiatives and organizations.
  • Ability to dive deep into how the business creates value and translate that into data architectures and roadmaps.
  • Experience across the full IT lifecycle (planning, design, deployment, operations) and with cross‑functional delivery teams.
  • Demonstrated ability to use abstraction and simplification to communicate complex systems to different audiences.
  • Strong influencing and relationship skills to develop and maintain key partnerships.

Position Summary

The Data Architect defines and governs the enterprise data architecture for a modern Azure-based platform integrating Avatar NX, Salesforce, and financial systems. This role establishes a scalable, consistent, and governed data ecosystem aligned with business and regulatory requirements. A critical responsibility is reverse engineering the Avatar NX EHR data model, due to limited vendor documentation, to enable accurate integration, reporting, and long-term data governance.

Schedule

  • 8am-5pm CST

Salary Range

$140,000- $160,000 commensurate with experience

Location: Remote- Must be US based, and able to work with no restrictions in the US in a remote home office.

Visa / work permit sponsorship is not available for this position

How Data Architects Empower Recovery

Enterprise Data Architecture

  • Design end-to-end Azure data architecture (ingestion, staging, curated, reporting layers)
  • Define enterprise data domains (Clinical, RCM, CRM, Finance)
  • Establish canonical data models (e.g., Patient, Encounter, Claim, Revenue)
  • Reverse engineer and document the Avatar NX data model, including:
    • Table structures, relationships, and data flows
    • Enterprise ERDs and logical models
    • Mapping vendor-specific schemas to normalized structures
    • Interpreting and modeling data from a non-traditional database architecture (InterSystems Caché/IRIS), where the SQL layer represents an abstraction over a non-relational core, resulting in limited schema transparency, minimal documentation, and increased complexity in reverse engineering
Integration Strategy

  • Define integration patterns across:
    • Avatar NX (EHR and billing logic)
    • Salesforce (CRM and engagement)
    • Financial systems (GL and revenue recognition)
  • Standardize data contracts and exchange patterns (batch, API, event-driven)
Data Governance & Standards

  • Establish standards for naming, definitions, and data quality
  • Implement governance for billing rules and derived logic
  • Lead development of a data catalog, business glossary, and lineage framework
  • Ensure reverse-engineered models are documented and version-controlled
  • Ensure data models, pipelines, and architectural artifacts are managed using enterprise source control practices (e.g., Git) to support auditability and traceability

Rule & Revenue Transparency

  • Define architecture for rule outcome (inferred) tracking within Azure
  • Enable reconciliation between NX and downstream financial systems
  • Ensure billing logic is auditable, traceable, and explainable

Collaboration

  • Partner with Finance, RCM, Operations, IT, and Analytics leadership
  • Provide architectural guidance to Data Modelers, Developers, and DBAs

Education Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Systems, Data Engineering, or a related technical field

Professional Qualifications

  • 7+ years in data architecture, data modeling, or enterprise data engineering
  • Hands-on experience designing data platforms in Azure (ADF, Synapse, Data Lake, SQL)
  • Demonstrated experience integrating EHR, CRM, and financial systems
  • Proven experience working with EHR vendor databases (e.g., Netsmart Avatar NX, Epic, Cerner, or similar)
  • Hands-on experience reverse engineering undocumented or poorly documented schemas, including:
    • Identifying table relationships and key linkages
    • Reconstructing data models from source systems
    • Building ERDs from live databases rather than vendor documentation
  • Experience translating complex clinical and billing data structures into usable enterprise models
  • Ability to work with stakeholders to validate inferred logic (e.g., encounter flows, billing rules, documentation timing)
  • Strong expertise in relational and dimensional data modeling
  • Experience establishing canonical data models across domains (clinical, financial, operational)
  • Experience implementing data governance frameworks, lineage, and data quality controls
  • Advanced SQL Server expertise (querying, schema analysis, performance tuning)
  • Experience with large, complex, highly normalized transactional systems
  • Proficiency with source control and version management tools (e.g., Git), including branching strategies, pull requests, and versioning of data models, pipelines, and schema definitions
Preferred Experience

  • Experience in the Healthcare industry, data domains (clinical workflows, RCM, compliance)
  • Experience supporting finance and revenue cycle reporting (AR, billing, reconciliation)
  • Familiarity with Power BI, SSRS, or other reporting platforms
  • Experience working in environments with limited vendor transparency or documentation

Workplace Environment

  • Requires long periods of sitting (95% sitting, 5% standing)
  • Extensive computer use

Competencies

  • Technical Architecture
  • Data Governance & Quality
  • Business & Strategy Alignment
  • Leadership & Influence

Position Summary

The Data Architect defines and governs the enterprise data architecture for a modern Azure-based platform integrating Avatar NX, Salesforce, and financial systems. This role establishes a scalable, consistent, and governed data ecosystem aligned with business and regulatory requirements. A critical responsibility is reverse engineering the Avatar NX EHR data model, due to limited vendor documentation, to enable accurate integration, reporting, and long-term data governance.

Schedule



- 8am-5pm CST

Salary Range

$140,000- $160,000 commensurate with experience

Location: Remote- Must be US based, and able to work with no restrictions in the US in a remote home office.

Visa / work permit sponsorship is not available for this position

How Data Architects Empower Recovery

Enterprise Data Architecture



- Design end-to-end Azure data architecture (ingestion, staging, curated, reporting layers)
- Define enterprise data domains (Clinical, RCM, CRM, Finance)
- Establish canonical data models (e.g., Patient, Encounter, Claim, Revenue)
- Reverse engineer and document the Avatar NX data model, including:

- Table structures, relationships, and data flows
- Enterprise ERDs and logical models
- Mapping vendor-specific schemas to normalized structures
- Interpreting and modeling data from a non-traditional database architecture (InterSystems Caché/IRIS), where the SQL layer represents an abstraction over a non-relational core, resulting in limited schema transparency, minimal documentation, and increased complexity in reverse engineering

- Avatar NX (EHR and billing logic)
- Salesforce (CRM and engagement)
- Financial systems (GL and revenue recognition)
- Standardize data contracts and exchange patterns (batch, API, event-driven)
