- Establish standards for naming, definitions, and data quality
- Implement governance for billing rules and derived logic
- Lead development of a data catalog, business glossary, and lineage framework
- Ensure reverse-engineered models are documented and version-controlled
- Ensure data models, pipelines, and architectural artifacts are managed using enterprise source control practices (e.g., Git) to support auditability and traceability

Rule & Revenue Transparency



- Define architecture for rule outcome (inferred) tracking within Azure
- Enable reconciliation between NX and downstream financial systems
- Ensure billing logic is auditable, traceable, and explainable

Collaboration



- Partner with Finance, RCM, Operations, IT, and Analytics leadership
- Provide architectural guidance to Data Modelers, Developers, and DBAs

Education Qualifications



- Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Systems, Data Engineering, or a related technical field

Professional Qualifications



- 7+ years in data architecture, data modeling, or enterprise data engineering
- Hands-on experience designing data platforms in Azure (ADF, Synapse, Data Lake, SQL)
- Demonstrated experience integrating EHR, CRM, and financial systems
- Proven experience working with EHR vendor databases (e.g., Netsmart Avatar NX, Epic, Cerner, or similar)
- Hands-on experience reverse engineering undocumented or poorly documented schemas, including:

- Identifying table relationships and key linkages
- Reconstructing data models from source systems
- Building ERDs from live databases rather than vendor documentation
- Experience translating complex clinical and billing data structures into usable enterprise models
- Ability to work with stakeholders to validate inferred logic (e.g., encounter flows, billing rules, documentation timing)
- Strong expertise in relational and dimensional data modeling
- Experience establishing canonical data models across domains (clinical, financial, operational)

- Advanced SQL Server expertise (querying, schema analysis, performance tuning)
- Experience with large, complex, highly normalized transactional systems
- Proficiency with source control and version management tools (e.g., Git), including branching strategies, pull requests, and versioning of data models, pipelines, and schema definitions

- Experience supporting finance and revenue cycle reporting (AR, billing, reconciliation)

- Experience working in environments with limited vendor transparency or documentation

Position Summary

The Data Architect will play a key role in designing and enabling the future-state enterprise data platform for the Medical Stop Loss business. The role will define the architecture, data models, integration patterns, and technical standards for a modern enterprise data warehouse and analytics ecosystem built on Microsoft Fabric and Azure.

This role requires strong enterprise data warehousing expertise combined with modern cloud data architecture experience. The Data Architect will work closely with business SMEs, Data & Analytics, Application Engineering, Enterprise Architecture, and other technology teams to ensure data across key business domains is integrated, standardized, governed, and readily available for reporting, analytics, AI, and operational decision-making.

Key Responsibilities

  • Must have have experience defining and maintaining the target-state architecture for the enterprise data warehouse and broader data platform using Microsoft Fabric and Azure.
  • Establish architectural patterns and standards for data ingestion, transformation, storage, modeling, integration, and consumption.
  • Apply established enterprise data warehousing principles and best practices to create a scalable, maintainable, and extensible data environment.
  • Lead the design of conceptual, logical, dimensional, and physical data models supporting key Medical Stop Loss business domains.
  • Define approaches for integrating data from Policy Administration, Claims, Underwriting, external partners, and other operational systems.
  • Establish patterns for handling source-system differences, data standardization, incremental processing, historical data, change data capture, and evolving source structures.
  • Partner with business SMEs and Data & Analytics teams to establish common business definitions, canonical entities, relationships, and data rules.
  • Design warehouse structures and semantic models that effectively support enterprise reporting, analytics, self-service BI, and AI/ML use cases.
  • Must have a minimum of 4 years of Data Architecture
  • Provide architectural guidance to Data Engineers and conduct data model, pipeline, and solution design reviews to ensure alignment with target-state standards.
  • Partner with application and solution architects to ensure modern applications and services produce data that can be effectively integrated into the enterprise data ecosystem.
  • Define and promote standards for data quality, reconciliation, metadata, lineage, governance, security, privacy, and appropriate access to sensitive information.
  • Establish reusable data architecture patterns and standards that reduce duplication and improve consistency across business domains and engineering teams.
  • Support modernization and migration of existing data warehouses, databases, reporting solutions, and data pipelines into the future-state architecture.
  • Evaluate Microsoft Fabric and Azure capabilities and recommend appropriate technologies and patterns based on business needs, scalability, performance, security, maintainability, and cost.

Education, Experience & Knowledge

  • 5+ years of experience understanding and hands-on implementation experience with enterprise data warehousing principles, architecture, design patterns, and best practices.
  • 5 + years of demonstrated experience designing and implementing enterprise data warehouses from ingestion through consumption, including data integration, transformation, modeling, historical data management, and analytical delivery.
  • Strong understanding of dimensional modeling, including facts, dimensions, star schemas, conformed dimensions, slowly changing dimensions, surrogate keys, and historical data management.
  • Experience designing modern data warehouse, lakehouse, and medallion architectures, with the ability to determine when and where different patterns should be applied.
  • Strong knowledge of Microsoft Fabric, including OneLake, Lakehouse, Warehouse, Data Factory, and Power BI capabilities.
  • Strong experience with Azure data technologies and cloud-based data architectures.
  • Strong understanding of ETL/ELT patterns, incremental data processing, change data capture, data reconciliation, and integration of heterogeneous source systems.
  • Strong SQL skills and understanding of data engineering practices, performance optimization, scalability, and workload management.
  • Experience designing data architectures supporting enterprise reporting, semantic models, self-service BI, advanced analytics, AI/ML, and GenAI use cases.
  • Strong understanding of data quality, metadata management, lineage, governance, security, privacy, and master/reference data concepts.
  • Experience establishing reusable data architecture patterns, development standards, naming conventions, and data modeling practices across engineering teams.
  • Ability to translate complex business concepts and processes into sustainable enterprise data models and architecture.
  • Experience providing architectural guidance and conducting data models, pipelines, and solution design reviews with Data Engineering and BI teams.
  • Experience modernizing legacy data warehouses and migrating analytical workloads to modern cloud-based data platforms.
  • Strong collaboration skills across business SMEs, Data Engineering, BI, Application Engineering, Enterprise Architecture, and technology leadership.
  • Experience in insurance, healthcare, financial services, or another data-intensive and regulated industry preferred.
  • Medical Stop Loss or Accident & Health insurance experience is a plus.

Tokio Marine offers a competitive salary and benefits package, including:

  • Generous paid time off (PTO), 12 paid company holidays,
  • 401(k) Retirement Plan with 6% company match.
  • Health and dental insurance, and vision plan available.
  • Company-provided long-term disability and life insurance.
  • Opportunities for advancement in a successful and growing organization.
  • Flexible work schedules and a great work/life balance.
  • Paid Parental Leave.
  • Volunteer Time Off.
  • Enjoy casual dress and work in a modern, comfortable office with free parking.
  • Hybrid work schedule

ABOUT THE POSITION

As a Principal Analytics Architect, you will serve as a senior technical leader for data architecture and analytics solutions, reporting to the Associate Director of Data and Backend Engineering. You will help set the technical direction for how ButcherBox connects operational flows across the business, the systems that support them, and the data models that draw from them. You'll bring a data-oriented perspective to how we integrate backend systems and balance impacts on how we design, build, and evolve our warehousing and modeling layers. The work of this role will simplify our overall architecture while better connecting systems that need to draw from data across our ecommerce suite, including Shopify, NetSuite, CDP, and CRM platforms.

This role blends hands-on technical leadership with organization-wide influence. You will translate business strategies into scalable, well-governed architectural designs, establish standards for trusted and maintainable data solutions, and drive adoption of core models and integrations across reporting and operational endpoints. Your work will reduce metric ambiguity, improve data quality and timeliness, and accelerate delivery of insights and downstream capabilities that depend on reliable foundations.

The ideal candidate will find value in coming to our Watertown office twice a week for old fashioned white-boarding sessions, taking the occasional meeting on a walk around the river trails, and of course trying out our cold brew keg!

  • Lead design reviews and provide architectural guidance across the data and backend engineering team as well as the ERP engineers.
  • Translate business strategies into solution designs that are secure, scalable, and aligned with enterprise data standards
  • Work with business and technical stakeholders to help design and guide solutions and roadmaps that identify and manage dependencies as well as create outcomes that incrementally build needed functionality.

  • Ensure architecture balances cost, performance, and business objectives while maintaining data quality and long-term scalability

ABOUT THE POSITION
As a Principal Analytics Architect, you will serve as a senior technical leader for data architecture and analytics solutions, reporting to the Associate Director of Data and Backend Engineering. You will help set the technical direction for how ButcherBox connects operational flows across the business, the systems that support them, and the data models that draw from them. You'll bring a data-oriented perspective to how we integrate backend systems and balance impacts on how we design, build, and evolve our warehousing and modeling layers. The work of this role will simplify our overall architecture while better connecting systems that need to draw from data across our ecommerce suite, including Shopify, NetSuite, CDP, and CRM platforms.
This role blends hands-on technical leadership with organization-wide influence. You will translate business strategies into scalable, well-governed architectural designs, establish standards for trusted and maintainable data solutions, and drive adoption of core models and integrations across reporting and operational endpoints. Your work will reduce metric ambiguity, improve data quality and timeliness, and accelerate delivery of insights and downstream capabilities that depend on reliable foundations.
The ideal candidate will find value in coming to our Watertown office twice a week for old fashioned white-boarding sessions, taking the occasional meeting on a walk around the river trails, and of course trying out our cold brew keg!
RESPONSIBILITIES

- Act as an owner for the end-to-end data architecture for analytics solutions, including data models, platform design, integration patterns, and BI/reporting frameworks
- Guide the unification of platform and integration architecture with the data dependencies across back-end systems.
- Lead design reviews and provide architectural guidance across the data and backend engineering team as well as the ERP engineers.
- Translate business strategies into solution designs that are secure, scalable, and aligned with enterprise data standards
- Work with business and technical stakeholders to help design and guide solutions and roadmaps that identify and manage dependencies as well as create outcomes that incrementally build needed functionality.
- Establish and enforce best practices across data modeling, documentation, testing, security, and compliance
- Ensure architecture balances cost, performance, and business objectives while maintaining data quality and long-term scalability
- Drive technical decision-making for analytics platforms and tools based on business impact potential
REQUIREMENTS

- 8+ years of experience in data analytics or related field
- Experience with ERP or ecommerce strongly preferred
- Experience collaborating with Business Operations teams and other non-technical stakeholders
- Bias for action over perfection
- Solutions oriented mindset with a desire to find the most efficient approach to meeting business needs

The Strategic Technology Group (STG) unit at Infosys is designed for power programmers and senior technologists who want to go beyond traditional development roles and take on complex, large-scale technology challenges.The STG unit brings together Specialist Programmers, Senior Technologists, and Technical Leaders who possess deep expertise across software design and development, cloud-native architectures, enterprise platforms, data engineering, and emerging technologies, including generative AI and agentic AI.Members of the STG unit play a strategic role in shaping technology direction, solving complex business challenges, and delivering resilient, high-quality outcomes. They are expected to demonstrate strong technical depth, sound architectural judgment, and hands-on leadership, while mentoring teams and influencing best practices across programs.The STG unit emphasizes software development excellence, innovation, and continuous upskilling. In the assigned Job Role of Architecture Principal, your Area Of Responsibility will be as below:

  • Partner with business stakeholders and oversee requirement elicitation process, to align requirements with immediate and prospective market demands.
  • Drive scalable and secure architectural designs ensuring compliance with architectural standards, integration of appropriate security measures and smooth integration with existing systems.
  • Lead and anchor solution evaluation efforts, assessing the client’s existing landscape to recommend integrated, stable, and future-proof solutions. Develop a strategic roadmap for future transformation and communicate the same to client stakeholders.
  • Create roadmap for integration of architectural solutions basis system risk landscape and define short, medium and long-term milestones, ensuring alignment with organization's overall technology and business goals.
  • Define strategies for large-scale transitions and modernization initiatives.
  • Act as an advisor to technical teams and client stakeholders. Build client relationships, assess client feedback obtained by the team and provide insights on plans to be actioned upon basis the feedback.
  • Drive performance optimization initiatives for the enterprise architectural landscape and provide insights on technological risk areas and related mitigation strategies.
  • Oversee the creation and dissemination of critical organizational technical knowledge.
  • Contribute to proposals and go-to market materials by collaborating with sales teams and provide insights on specialized methodologies and architectural solutions during client engagement.
  • Represent the organization in industry forums and contribute to professional publications.

Your Contribution To The Team

  • A strategic vision for aligning technical solutions with evolving business goals and industry trends
  • Expertise in designing scalable and secure architectures while ensuring compliance with standards.
  • A proactive approach to risk management and solution-oriented problem-solving.
  • Proficiency in creating, managing and disseminating technical insights and frameworks.
  • Strong communication and advisory skills to build trust and engagement.
  • The ability to define future-state roadmaps and modernization strategies.
  • Passion to represent the organization in industry forums and contribute to professional publications.

Required Skill And Experience

Experience in Data and Digital Architecture, with a focus on enterprise data platforms and data-driven solutions.

Knowledge of the full SDLC, including the data engineering lifecycle (ingestion, transformation, storage, serving, and consumption).

Experience with Lean / Agile development methodologies, including DataOps and MLOps practices.

Experience in Data-First and AI-First architecture across modern data platforms (data lake, lakehouse, data warehouse, data mesh, data fabric), real-time and batch pipelines, analytics and BI, cloud data services, API/microservices for data access, and Agentic AI implementation.

Should have played the role of Chief Architect or Data/Digital Architecture Lead in the past, and personally led a team of architects on large programs, providing guidance, coaching, and mentoring to ensure the technical quality of the program is met.

Should have strong command of data governance, data quality, metadata management, master data management, lineage, and security and privacy by design (including regulatory compliance such as GDPR).

Should have technology breadth across data engineering and streaming (e.g., Spark, Kafka), cloud data platforms (e.g., Snowflake, Hadoop, Databricks, BigQuery, Azure Synapse), data modeling (relational, dimensional, NoSQL, graph, vector), ML/GenAI data foundations (feature stores, RAG pipelines, vector databases), and enterprise integration (REST APIs, event-driven architecture, ETL/ELT), with depth in several of these areas to drive end-to-end data solutions.

Should have a very good understanding of EA frameworks (e.g., TOGAF, Zachman, DAMA-DMBOK for data management) and should have applied one or more of them in practice.

Should have working awareness of the consumption layer (analytics, dashboards, and AI-enabled applications) and of how data products reach end users.

Preferred Skill And Experience

  • Should have high level business and process understanding of one or more industries
  • Should have personally led & delivered one or more digital transformation program (size > $10m) successfully with tangible business outcomes
  • Should have very good communication and articulation skills and is able to communicate with right level of abstraction and detail when interacting with CXO, Middle mgmt. and developers
  • Should be able to do rough order of magnitude estimation and costing to determine the high-level TCO for large programs
  • Should have deep technology expertise in one or more areas (Digital/Mobility, Customer/User experience, API and Micro services, Search, Content Management, DAM, Commerce, CRM, Order management, Analytics, Cloud and SAAS/PAAS platforms) and should be able to have deep dive discussions with SMEs in this space
  • Should have zero distance to code and be able review the detailed design, code, configuration, data model and provide specific inputs to the architects and developers
  • Should have good understanding and exposure to the products and platforms relevant to digital transformation
  • Should have good understanding of the leading open-source technologies, frameworks and tools in the market
  • Should have good understanding of leading No SQL databases
  • Should be able to work as part of a cross-cultural team including flexibility to support multiple time zones when necessary
  • Experience and desire to work in a Global delivery environment.

Additional Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree or foreign equivalent required from an accredited institution. Will also consider three years of progressive experience in the specialty in lieu of every year of education.
  • This position may require relocation and/or travel to work/project location.
  • Candidates authorized to work for any employer in the United States without employer-based visa sponsorship are welcome to apply. Infosys is unable to provide immigration sponsorship for this role now or in the future.

Benefits

Along with competitive pay, as a full-time Infosys employee you are also eligible for the following benefits:

  • Medical/Dental/Vision/Life Insurance
  • Long-term/Short-term Disability
  • Health and Dependent Care Reimbursement Accounts
  • Insurance (Accident, Critical Illness , Hospital Indemnity, Legal)
  • 401(k) plan and contributions dependent on salary level
  • Paid holidays plus Paid Time Off

Infosys is a global leader in next-generation digital services and consulting. We enable clients in more than 50 countries to navigate their digital transformation. With over four decades of experience in managing the systems and workings of global enterprises, we expertly steer our clients through their digital journey. We do it by enabling the enterprise with an AI-powered core that helps prioritize the execution of change. We also empower the business with agile digital at scale to deliver unprecedented levels of performance and customer delight. AUSTIN, TX (HYBRID - 4 DAYS ONSITE)

$220,000 - $250,000 + BONUS + EQUITY

The Opportunity We're partnering with a leading consumer technology organization to hire a Principal Data Engineer who will serve as a strategic technical leader across enterprise data architecture, platform modernization, governance, and data product initiatives.

This is not a traditional data engineering role focused solely on pipelines and development. This individual will partner closely with senior leadership to shape the future of the organization's data ecosystem, influence long-term technology investments, evaluate platform strategy, and guide enterprise architecture decisions that directly impact business outcomes.

The ideal candidate combines deep technical expertise with strong communication skills and the ability to influence stakeholders, mentor engineers, and drive large-scale data initiatives from strategy through execution.

The Data Environment The team is focused on building and evolving modern cloud-native data platforms supporting analytics, customer intelligence, operational decision-making, and future AI initiatives.

  • Modern cloud-based data architecture and platform modernization
  • Data lakes, data warehouses, lakehouse architectures, and semantic layers
  • Real-time and event-driven data processing environments
  • Enterprise data governance, quality, security, and compliance
  • Data products, domain-oriented architecture, and scalable analytics platforms
  • Strategic investments supporting long-term business objectives and AI readiness

What You'll Be Working On

  • Define and drive enterprise data architecture strategy across modern cloud data platforms
  • Partner with senior business and technology stakeholders to develop long-term data roadmaps and investment strategies
  • Evaluate technologies, vendors, and platform capabilities while providing architecture recommendations and business cases
  • Lead architectural decisions around data warehouses, data lakes, lakehouse environments, semantic layers, and data products
  • Establish and promote best practices for data governance, security, compliance, quality, and cost optimization
  • Architect scalable real-time and batch data ecosystems supporting analytics and operational workloads
  • Provide technical leadership, mentorship, and guidance across engineering teams
  • Review architecture, troubleshoot complex technical challenges, and influence technical direction across multiple teams
  • Drive modernization initiatives that improve scalability, performance, reliability, and business value

What We're Looking For

  • 12+ years of experience in data engineering, data architecture, or enterprise data platforms
  • Strong experience designing enterprise-scale data architectures and modern cloud data platforms
  • Expertise with data warehousing, data lakes, lakehouse architectures, and data modeling best practices
  • Experience building or supporting real-time, event-driven, or streaming data platforms
  • Strong understanding of data governance, quality, metadata, lineage, security, and compliance frameworks
  • Experience developing data strategies, roadmaps, architecture standards, and platform modernization initiatives
  • Ability to communicate architectural concepts and recommendations to both technical and executive audiences
  • Proven success influencing stakeholders, evaluating technology solutions, and guiding strategic technical decisions
  • Strong SQL, data modeling, schema design, and distributed data systems experience
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or related field; advanced degree preferred

Why This Role

  • Opportunity to shape enterprise-wide data architecture strategy for a highly visible consumer technology organization
  • Direct partnership with senior leadership on technology investments, platform decisions, and long-term roadmap planning
  • Influence a critical business function that directly drives company initiatives and outcomes
  • Work on modern cloud data platforms, real-time architectures, governance programs, and AI-ready data ecosystems
  • Serve as a trusted technical authority and mentor across engineering and architecture teams
  • High-impact role with significant ownership, visibility, and strategic influence
  • Competitive compensation package including bonus and comprehensive benefits

This is a rare opportunity for a senior data architecture leader who enjoys balancing strategy, business influence, platform vision, and technical depth while helping define the future of a large-scale modern data ecosystem.

descriptionHtml:
Job Requirements

At Disney Experiences Technology, we design and deliver more than 400 digital and physical products that bring Disney stories to life in unexpected ways. From theme parks and resorts to cruise ships and beyond, our global team of technologists, designers, and innovators creates seamless, immersive experiences that delight millions of Guests and Cast Members around the world.

The Disney Signature Experiences and Data team delivers innovative technology solutions across Disney Cruise Line, Disney Vacation Club, and our global tour businesses. We support Guest and Crew experiences at sea, enable commercial growth through digital platforms, and lead the segment’s data strategy. With a strong focus on reliability, scalability, and strategic expansion, we build the systems that support immersive experiences and unlock new opportunities for growth.

Data Platform – This role is on the Data Platform team, which builds and manages the data architecture, governance, and engineering capabilities that power insights and decision-making across Disney Experiences. We are looking for a Principal Software Data Capability Architect on the Reference Architecture team to lead the design vision of data products and solutions. You will lead all aspects of assigned data initiatives working with multiple engineering and product teams.

What You Will Do

  • Architect, build, and scale full stack data applications: UI, API, & AI
  • Define, influence, and prototype the design of highly scalable software systems and applications
  • Create, maintain, and evangelize data architecture standards, patterns, and best practices to ensure alignment with established principles and technologies
  • Architect end-to-end data interfaces from ingestion through consumption layers that support business requirements and process automation
  • Provide guidance to ensure solutions are well-architected to meet standards and requirements (e.g., SLA, resiliency, security, and privacy requirements)
  • Lead in strategy for large, technical initiatives involving multiple teams, leaders, and stakeholders
  • Create and maintain clear communication, documents, and diagrams that define, guide, and influence engineering and product teams
  • Lead projects that may be used in end-user applications, focusing on software, APIs, and tools supporting infrastructure and technology platforms
  • Continuously monitor and evaluate emerging technologies to drive informed decision-making and recommendations
  • Foster and maintain productive engagement with executive leadership and partners to ensure solutions are right-sized and strategically aligned to the overall data strategy and architecture principles

Required Qualifications & Skills

  • 10+ years of experience with the delivery of data solutions

As a Principal Architect, Data Product Delivery, you will lead the design of scalable, secure, and maintainable data and analytics solutions across multiple programs and business domains. You will partner with Engineering, Product Management, Data Governance, Security, platform teams, and business stakeholders to translate strategy into practical architecture, delivery roadmaps, and reusable implementation patterns.

What You Will Do

Technical Responsibilities:

  • Define architecture direction, standards, reference patterns, and reusable components for data ingestion, storage, transformation, analytics, and consumption.
  • Own architecture diagrams, technical designs, integration blueprints, data models, standards, and architecture decision records for the Data and Analytics vertical.
  • Develop proofs of concept, reference implementations, and reusable patterns that accelerate delivery and reduce technical debt.
  • Evaluate emerging technologies, platforms, frameworks, and advanced analytics capabilities, and recommend fit-for-purpose adoption.
  • Conduct architecture, design, and code reviews to assess scalability, performance, security, reliability, supportability, and engineering quality.
  • Embed data privacy, access control, governance, and compliance requirements into solution designs with Data Governance and Security teams.
  • Resolve complex performance, quality, scalability, integration, reliability, and operational challenges with engineering teams.
  • Mentor engineers and architects through solution design, implementation planning, technical evaluations, and delivery reviews.
  • Translate strategic requirements into technical designs, delivery roadmaps, and phased implementation plans with Product Management, platform teams, and business stakeholders.

Knowledge and Capabilities:

  • Apply enterprise data architecture practices across data warehousing, Lakehouse, real-time streaming, data engineering, integration, analytics, and operational support.
  • Balance scalability, performance, cost, maintainability, delivery constraints, and engineering trade-offs when designing solutions.
  • Analyze ambiguous, cross-functional technical challenges and explain architecture decisions and trade-offs to technical and executive audiences.
  • Influence technical decisions through expertise, collaboration, and hands-on leadership while staying current with relevant data and analytics technologies.

What You Need

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related discipline.
  • Minimum 8 years of experience in data engineering, solution architecture, or technical design roles, including architecture ownership.
  • Experience architecting large-scale enterprise data platforms and integration solutions.
  • Hands-on experience with cloud data platforms, data modeling, modern data architecture patterns, Databricks or an equivalent Lakehouse platform, and guiding implementation teams through complex technical challenges.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related discipline.
  • Experience with Azure Data Services, Databricks Lakehouse, Delta Lake, Delta Live Tables, Unity Catalog, SQL, Python, ETL/ELT, change data capture, dimensional modeling, medallion architecture, and distributed data processing.
  • Experience with ERP and integration ecosystems such as Oracle, JDE, Salesforce, SAP S/4HANA, Kafka, REST, or GraphQL, including commercial, manufacturing, supply chain, or finance data domains.
  • Cloud architecture certification such as AWS Solutions Architect, Azure Solutions Architect Expert, or GCP Professional Cloud Architect; TOGAF or an equivalent enterprise architecture certification.

descriptionHtml:
Planned Parenthood is the nation’s leading provider and advocate of high-quality, affordable sexual and reproductive health care for all people, as well as the nation’s largest provider of sex education. Planned Parenthood organizations serve all people with care and compassion, with respect, and without judgment, striving to create equitable access to health care. Through health centers, programs in schools and communities, and online resources, Planned Parenthood is a trusted source of reliable education and information that allows people to make informed health decisions. We do all this because we care passionately about helping people lead healthier lives.

Planned Parenthood Federation of America (PPFA) is a 501(c)(3) charitable organization that supports the independently incorporated Planned Parenthood affiliates, which operate non-profit health centers across the U.S. PPFA also works to educate the public on and advocate for issues of sexual and reproductive health. Formed as the advocacy arm of Planned Parenthood Federation of America, Planned Parenthood Action Fund is a separate non-profit membership organization tax-exempt under section 501(c)(4). The Action Fund engages in educational, advocacy, and limited electoral activity, including grassroots organizing, legislative advocacy, and voter education in furtherance of the Planned Parenthood mission.

Planned Parenthood Federation of America (PPFA) and Planned Parenthood Action Fund (PPAF) seek a conscientious and collaborative Manager, Data Architect. This job reports to the Director, Data Architecture in the Data Architecture & Governance department within the Development Data, Operations & Technology (DOT) division. The Data Architecture & Governance department is responsible for designing and governing a scalable, enterprise data ecosystem that enables end-user fundraising goals and organizational strategy.

Purpose:

The Data Architect designs and implements the enterprise data architecture for the Development organizational unit. They identify key data requirements for design and execution in the data lakehouse which lead to successful fundraising. They construct data models that highlight anticipated outcomes and demonstrate campaign performance and prescriptive insights. They organize provision of services in support of key organizational data strategy.

Delivery:

  • Create a scalable data framework to support organizational needs to advance fundraising achievements.
  • Review and advise on the organization of data integration and engineering to further refinements to expand and deepen understanding of a data-driven culture.
  • Review and advise on processes for delivery of the data lakehouse for identifying possible improvements to enhance outcomes.
  • Define methodology/approach with particular attention to the analysis of issues.
  • Maintain technology platforms such as the data lakehouse, team wiki, shared drive, and project management tools.
  • Develop logical and physical data models to support the enterprise data lakehouse and manage projects within and across teams to ensure timely delivery.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Engagement:

  • Advise on optimal organization/delivery of service data architecture, identifying issues which affect capacity to meet stakeholder needs.
  • Advise on optimal approach to data architecture and engineering best practices.
  • Independently engage stakeholders across all levels of PPFA National office to engage around key initiatives and provide training on design and delivery of services.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders and partners to provide technical support and training on design and delivery of data services.
  • Communicate project/service process and status for the data lakehouse to ensure data continuity and clarity in expectations.
  • Train new team members on departmental processes and projects.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities (KSAs):

  • Bachelor’s degree with 3-5 years of related work experience in data architecture and engineering for an enterprise data warehouse required, preferably in a nonprofit organization.
  • Ability to recognize and respond to problems with potential solutions in a highly professional, confidential, and sensitive manner.
  • Strong organizational, analytical, and problem-solving skills
  • Proven ability to work collaboratively in a team environment as well as independently when required.
  • Understanding of data warehouse methodologies, data engineering principles, concepts, and methodologies.
  • Experience with SQL required.
  • Experience with dbt, Amazon Redshift, and CRMs such as Salesforce preferred.
  • Flexibility and ability to adapt to quickly changing priorities and ambiguous situations.
  • Commitment to PPFA’s mission and diversity, equity, and inclusion, particularly surrounding race equity.
  • A deep commitment to Planned Parenthood’s mission of promoting Sexual and Reproductive Health
  • Excellent analytical skills with sharp attention to detail and the ability to meet critical deadlines.
  • Strong oral and written communication skills
  • Flexibility and ability to adapt to quickly changing priorities and ambiguous situations
  • Commitment to PPFA’s mission and diversity, equity, and inclusion, particularly surrounding race equity
  • A deep commitment to Planned Parenthood’s mission of promoting Sexual and Reproductive Health

$105,000 - $110,000 a year

Travel: 0-5% domestic travel

How to Apply

A cover letter and resume are important submissions for the hiring team to get a sense of your experience. In the cover letter, in two pages or less, please let us know how this role aligns with your career aspirations and skill set. Submit both a cover letter and resume as one file (because of system limitations).

Who We Are

About The Center For Academic Innovation

Through curricular innovation, tools for student success, and educational research and analytics, the University of Michigan Center for Academic Innovation is building the future of education. Our vision is a future in which education connects and empowers learners everywhere to reach their full potential throughout their lives. To realize our vision, we make it our mission to collaborate across campus and around the world to create equitable, lifelong educational opportunities for learners everywhere.

About The Data And Business Intelligence Team

The Data and Business Intelligence Team within the Center for Academic Innovation (CAI) at the University of Michigan drives CAI's data strategy, ensuring that data is used responsibly, ethically, and securely. Our team of data engineers, scientists, and analysts powers internal operations and the Michigan Online platform by leveraging data as our universal language for analytics, insights and decision-making. We strive to democratize access to data while upholding strong standards for governance, security, and privacy. Through collaboration and communities of practice, we share innovations, learn from peers, and help foster a culture of data-informed decision-making across CAI and the broader campus.

For more information, please visit our website: Academic Innovation.

Responsibilities*

Data Strategy & Architecture Ownership

  • Evolve CAI's data architecture strategy to support reporting, analytics, AI/ML, and operational needs
  • Architect and oversee implementation of end-to-end data warehousing solutions integrating diverse institutional and platform data sources
  • Establish and enforce standards for dimensional modeling (e.g., Kimball methodology, Star and Snowflake schemas), pipeline design, documentation, and engineering best practices
  • Ensure cloud data platforms (e.g., Snowflake, Databricks) are optimized for scalability, reliability, cost efficiency, and long-term sustainability
  • Design and maintain complex ELT frameworks and scalable pipeline patterns


People Leadership & Team Development

  • Directly manage and mentor Data Engineers and Senior Data Engineers, including performance management, coaching, hiring, and career development
  • Foster a culture of shared ownership, technical excellence, and continuous learning
  • Provide technical guidance and architectural oversight across projects, ensuring high-quality delivery and consistency
  • Plan for team growth and capability development to support CAI's long-term data vision


Governance, Risk & Compliance

  • Establish and operationalize scalable data governance practices, including standards for data quality, metadata, lineage, and access controls
  • Ensure compliance with institutional and regulatory data privacy requirements (e.g., FERPA, GDPR) within a higher education environment
  • Promote strong data stewardship and responsible use of institutional and learner data


Cross-Functional Leadership & Strategic Alignment

  • Partner with Engineering, Online Learning, XR, and campus stakeholders to translate complex business and academic needs into cohesive data strategies and solutions
  • Lead discovery sessions with stakeholders and communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical audiences
  • Align team priorities with CAI's strategic objectives and contribute to roadmap planning within the data domain
  • Oversee service delivery and stakeholder engagement to ensure responsive, high-impact data support

JOB SUMMARY:

The Director, Principal Data Architect shapes the data foundation for Universal Destinations & Experiences’ (UDX) growth, innovation, and AI transformation. Leading the data architecture pillar, this role translates the Enterprise Data & AI vision into an executable strategy and target-state architecture that modernizes platforms and enables advanced analytics, intelligent automation, and AI-powered solutions.

The role leads the design of end-to-end data solutions, including data models, integration patterns, and data platform architecture. Partnering with business and technology leaders, the role connects architecture decisions to measurable improvements in guest experience, revenue, and operations. This hands-on leader develops the data architecture team, owns data governance design and architecture standards, and leads the Data Architecture Review Board—providing clear direction and decisive recommendations that enable teams to build trusted, secure, and reusable data capabilities at enterprise scale.

MAJOR RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Data Strategy, Vision & Target-State Design: Treat data as a strategic business asset, ensuring architecture decisions are grounded in measurable business value, including guest experience, revenue, cost, and risk. Translate the enterprise data and AI strategy into the data architecture strategy, guiding principles, and multi-year target-state design aligned to UDX business priorities across guest, commercial, and operational domains. As part of target-state design, evaluate and recommend data platform capabilities, tools, and patterns (e.g., cloud data warehouse and lakehouse, streaming, integration, cataloging, observability), including build/buy/reuse decisions and rationalization of redundant capabilities. Work directly with business and technology stakeholders to translate needs into clear architectural direction, documented as architecture decisions.
  • Data Architecture Standards & Alignment: Author, publish, and continuously evolve UDX data architecture and data governance standards, including data modeling, integration and interoperability, metadata and lineage, master and reference data, and security and access patterns. Chair the Data Architecture Review Board (DARB), UDX’s decision-making body for data architecture, and own its charter, entry criteria, review cadence, decision rights, and escalation paths. Review solution designs from internal teams, delivery partners, and vendors, issue clear recommendations (approve, approve with conditions, or reject) in adherence with UDX standards, and govern exceptions and architectural debt through to closure.
  • Data Governance Design Ownership: Serve as the enterprise owner of data governance design, defining the governance framework, operating model, data ownership and stewardship structures, data domain definitions, data quality standards and controls, classification, lineage, and retention policies. Embed privacy-by-design, regulatory, and data residency requirements into architecture in partnership with Information Security, Privacy, and Legal. Define governance-by-design patterns so controls are built into platforms and pipelines, and partner with platform and engineering teams to ensure governance designs are implemented and adopted.
  • Data Readiness for AI: Define the architecture that makes enterprise data AI-ready, including canonical data models, semantic layers, ontologies and knowledge graphs, data contracts, and feature and vector data patterns supporting ML, generative AI, and agentic use cases. Establish standards for AI data quality, lineage, observability, and responsible use. Assess data readiness for proposed AI initiatives and define remediation paths before build commitments are made.
  • Practice Leadership & Development: Lead, coach, and develop data architects, including team members and partner resources, setting clear expectations and quality bars. Build a consistent, repeatable data architecture practice with standard artifacts, maturity metrics, and a community of practice. Communicate architecture strategy and decisions to executive, technical, and non-technical audiences.
  • Understands and actively participates in Environmental, Health & Safety responsibilities by following established UO policy, procedures, training and team member involvement activities.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

QUALIFICATIONS:

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skills, and/or abilities (KSAs) required.

  • Proven experience in data architecture, data engineering, enterprise data platforms, including significant experience leading architecture for complex enterprise environments.
  • Enterprise data architecture: expert command of conceptual, logical, and physical data modeling (relational, dimensional), data product and domain design, lakehouse and cloud data warehouse patterns, batch and real-time/streaming integration, APIs, and event-driven architecture.
  • Data governance design: deep expertise designing enterprise data governance frameworks and operating models, including ownership and stewardship, data domains, data quality controls, classification, metadata, lineage, and master data management, aligned to DAMA-DMBOK or equivalent.
  • Privacy & regulatory: working knowledge of privacy, security, and regulatory requirements such as GDPR/UK GDPR, CCPA/CPRA, Japan APPI, and PCI DSS, including cross-border data residency and sharing.
  • Cloud data platforms: deep knowledge of Snowflake and AWS/Azure data and AI services, ELT and transformation tooling (e.g., dbt), orchestration, cataloging, and data observability; ability to evaluate platforms objectively on capability, cost, performance, and scalability.
  • AI & advanced analytics: working knowledge of ML platforms and MLOps, feature stores, vector databases, retrieval-augmented generation, semantic layers, ontologies/knowledge graphs, and AI data governance patterns.
  • Decision-making & governance leadership: proven ability to lead architecture review forums and make timely, defensible decisions, balancing standards with pragmatic delivery and managing exceptions transparently.
  • Data as a strategic business asset: demonstrated ability to connect data architecture to business outcomes, articulate and measure the value of data assets, and prioritize architecture investments based on business impact.
  • Communication & influence: executive presence and exceptional written and verbal communication; distills complex technical options into clear recommendations; influences without authority and resolves conflict across competing priorities.
  • Tools: proficiency with SQL, data modeling tools, data catalogs, and architecture diagramming/repository tools.
  • Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
  • Consistent attendance is a job requirement

EDUCATION:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field required.
  • Master’s degree in a related field preferred.

EXPERIENCE:

  • Required: 12+ years of proven experience in data, technology, or engineering roles, including 10+ years in data architecture, data engineering, or data platform leadership.
  • Required: 5+ years in an enterprise, principal, or lead data architect role setting architecture strategy and standards across multiple domains and platforms.
  • Required: experience designing and implementing an enterprise data governance framework and operating model in a large, complex organization.
  • Required: demonstrated experience chairing an architecture review board or equivalent governance forum and issuing binding architectural decisions.
  • Required: experience designing and delivering cloud-scale data platforms (Snowflake, AWS, and/or Azure), including platform evaluation and selection.
  • Required: 3+ years leading, coaching, or managing architects or senior technical staff, including directing external partners and vendors.
  • Preferred: experience architecting data foundations for AI/ML and generative AI solutions running in production.
  • Preferred: experience in global, multi-region organizations with data residency and cross-border data sharing requirements.
  • Helpful but Not required: experience in hospitality, theme parks, travel, entertainment, or retail;
  • or equivalent combination of education and experience.

CERTIFICATIONS, LICENSES, REGISTRATIONS:

Relevant certifications preferred, such as TOGAF, DAMA Certified Data Management Professional (CDMP), SnowPro Advanced: Architect, AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Professional, or Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert.

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION:

  • Carries out supervisory responsibilities in accordance with the organization’s policies and applicable laws.
  • Travel up to approximately 10% may be required, including domestic and international travel to UDX destinations and partners (e.g., Japan, United Kingdom).
  • Flexibility to collaborate across global time zones, including early-morning or evening meetings with international teams, is required.

Your talent, skills and experience will be rewarded with a competitive compensation package.

descriptionHtml:
Be visionary

Teledyne Technologies Incorporated provides enabling technologies for industrial growth markets that require advanced technology and high reliability. These markets include aerospace and defense, factory automation, air and water quality environmental monitoring, electronics design and development, oceanographic research, deepwater oil and gas exploration and production, medical imaging and pharmaceutical research.

We are looking for individuals who thrive on making an impact and want the excitement of being on a team that wins.

Job Description

Job Summary:

The Data Architect defines the enterprise data model, business data definitions, and reporting standards for Teledyne's global analytics platform. You will work with business stakeholders, Data Engineering, and Analytics to develop a standardized enterprise data model across multiple ERP systems and business units, so reporting, analytics, AI, and planning all use the same definitions.

The right person understands how business processes turn into data and has designed data structures across multiple systems in a large, multi-business manufacturing company.

Job Duties & Responsibilities

  • Design and maintain enterprise data models for reporting, analytics, AI, and planning.
  • Define and maintain standard business data definitions, KPI calculations, business rules, and data standards across multiple ERPs and business units.
  • Lead the design work to combine data from SAP, Infor XA, IFS, Dynamics AX, OneStream, CRM, and acquired business systems and ERPs into one consistent structure.
  • Partner with business stakeholders to understand reporting requirements and translate them into scalable data structures and business rules.
  • Develop source-to-target mapping specifications and transformation requirements for Data Engineering teams.
  • Define and document business rules required to standardize data across enterprise systems.
  • Review data structures, mappings, and transformed datasets prior to business validation and release.
  • Support data governance, data quality, master data management, and data stewardship initiatives.
  • Collaborate with Analytics teams to ensure semantic models and reports align with approved business definitions and standards.

Job Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Information systems, Business, Computer Science, Engineering, Finance, or a related field preferred.
  • 8+ years
  • Experience with ERP platforms such as SAP, Infor XA, Dynamics AX, IFS or Oracle.
  • Experience in multinational manufacturing, aerospace, defense, electronics, or high-tech companies, including work with acquired businesses or ERP consolidation.
  • Strong understanding of enterprise reporting, KPI development, and analytical data structures.
  • Experience developing enterprise data models, business rules, and source-to-target mappings, and standardizing data across multiple systems.
  • Strong communication and documentation skills, with experience working directly with business stakeholders and translating business requirements into technical solutions.
  • Experience designing and implementing solutions using Microsoft Fabric, Power BI, or other modern cloud-based data and analytics platforms preferred.
  • DAMA CDMP certification is a plus.
  • U.S. Citizenship required.

Salary Range

$129,900.00-$173,200.000

The anticipated salary range listed for this role is only an estimate. Actual compensation for successful candidates is carefully determined based on several factors including, but not limited to, location, local regulations (such as minimum wage), education/training, work experience, key skills, and type of position.

Job Description

As a Data Solutions Architect, you will lead the design of secure, reliable, and cost-conscious data and analytics solutions for clients. You will translate business goals and existing system constraints into target architectures, guide engineering teams through implementation while remaining hands-on in the development, and explain technical decisions and tradeoffs to client stakeholders. Your work will span data integration, storage, modeling, governance, and analytics across modern data platforms in Azure.

Key Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with clients and internal stakeholders to design and implement scalable data engineering solutions using the Microsoft Analytics ecosystem.
  • Lead discovery, select architecture patterns, document tradeoffs, guide implementations, and is accountable for the overall technical design.
  • Deliver current-state assessments, target architectures, integration patterns, data models, migration plans, estimates, and technical decision records.
  • Develop and maintain data pipelines, ensuring efficient extraction, transformation, and loading (ETL) processes for structured and unstructured data.
  • Apply best practices in dimensional modeling to create robust and scalable data models for analytics and reporting.
  • Leverage tools such as Python, dbt, and SQL to develop advanced data transformation and integration processes.
  • Optimize data storage and retrieval mechanisms to support high-performance analytics workloads.
  • Define approaches for access, sensitive data, data quality, lineage, deployment, monitoring, recovery, and capacity or cost.
  • Define hybrid analytics requirements, including connectivity and security, in partnership with cloud and security specialists.
  • Monitor and troubleshoot data pipelines and workflows to ensure accuracy, reliability, and performance.
  • Collaborate with analytics and BI teams to ensure seamless integration of data assets into Power BI and other reporting platforms.
  • Stay informed about emerging trends and technologies in data engineering and cloud analytics to enhance solution delivery.

Required Qualifications

  • At least 10 years of experience in data engineering, with deep expertise in the Microsoft Data and Analytics stack.
  • Multiple years of experience leading discovery, evaluating design tradeoffs, presenting recommendations, and guiding a delivery team.
  • Strong proficiency in SQL, Python, and data modeling techniques.
  • Working knowledge of data extraction patterns and best practices.
  • Experience with ETL tools and frameworks, such as dbt.
  • Solid understanding of dimensional modeling and its application in analytics.
  • Strong problem-solving skills with a focus on delivering scalable and efficient solutions.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with experience in client-facing roles.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Azure Cloud infrastructure, including hybrid analytics workload configurations and networking.
  • Certifications in Azure Engineering and Administration (e.g., Fabric Data Engineer Associate, Azure Administrator Associate, Azure Solutions Architect Expert).
  • Experience with Azure DevOps or GitHub for code repositories and deployment.
  • Experience with data vault modeling and data mesh architecture concepts preferred.
  • Familiarity with advanced analytics tools and concepts, including machine learning workflows.
  • Experience using approved AI-assisted development tools responsibly preferred.
  • Knowledge of additional data visualization tools such as Tableau, Qlik, or AWS Quicksight.
  • Experience with Agile methodologies for project management.

The pay range for this position is $100,000 to $182,400. This range represents a good-faith and reasonable estimate of the compensation the firm expects to pay for this position at the time of posting. Actual compensation will depend on a variety of relevant factors, including an applicant’s skills, experience, qualifications, professional certifications, work arrangements, geographic location, and other business and organizational needs. It is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range, and compensation decisions depend on the facts and circumstances of each case. Baker Tilly offers a compensation and benefits package to eligible employees.

descriptionHtml:
The Aerospace Corporation is the trusted partner to the nation’s space programs, solving the hardest problems and providing unmatched technical expertise. As the operator of a federally funded research and development center (FFRDC), we are broadly engaged across all aspects of space— delivering innovative solutions that span satellite, launch, ground, and cyber systems for defense, civil and commercial customers. When you join our team, you’ll be part of a special collection of problem solvers, thought leaders, and innovators. Join us and take your place in space.

All roles require onsite presence a minimum of four days per week. Some roles may require five days onsite based on role responsibilities, business needs and manager discretion. Schedule flexibility may be available depending on the role and manager approval, including a 9/80 work schedule and compensatory time off (time off earned for hours worked beyond 40 per week) for eligible employees.

Aerospace is the trusted partner to the nation's space enterprise, solving the hardest problems with innovative solutions. We are at the forefront of advanced technology development, systems engineering, and research, providing trusted, objective technical expertise across the entire space enterprise. Within Aerospace’s Office of the CIO, the newly constructed Data and AI Services team provides advanced modeling, machine learning, and predictive analytics capabilities that inform enterprise services operations and facilitates strategic decision-making across the corporation.

As our enterprise data and knowledge management needs continue to grow in scale and complexity, we are looking for a Senior Data Architect. This role will design, implement, and govern enterprise-scale data solutions that support operations—including the integration of identity management, ERP, digital libraries, and AI-powered knowledge management systems. This position sits at the intersection of data engineering, AI/ML, and enterprise architecture, giving the selected candidate the opportunity to shape how the corporation manages and leverages data.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Design enterprise data architecture frameworks that integrate identity management, ERP, digital libraries, and AI/ML applications
  • Develop data models, schemas, and ontologies to enable semantic interoperability and knowledge graphs
  • Architect data pipelines and semantic layers supporting Graph RAG and AI-driven knowledge management systems
  • Lead integration architecture for enterprise systems, including the design of ETL/ELT pipelines, real-time synchronization, master data management (MDM), and data quality monitoring solutions
  • Define and enforce governance policies for CUI, proprietary, and classified information, including classification frameworks (CUI, ITAR, export control) and role-based access control architectures
  • Architect scalable solutions capable of supporting 90,000+ documents with ongoing growth, while optimizing cost-effectiveness across cloud, on-prem, and hybrid environments

We are seeking an experienced and highly technical Database Architect to lead the design, development, optimization, and long-term strategy of enterprise data platforms and integrations. This position will office at our Corporate Headquarters in New Orleans, Louisiana.

The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise in SQL, Python, modern cloud data platforms, and enterprise ERP ecosystems such as Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations or similar ERP solutions. This individual must be comfortable partnering with both functional business users and technical teams to translate operational requirements into scalable, maintainable, and high-performing data solutions.

This role will play a critical part in advancing enterprise reporting, analytics, automation, and data warehouse modernization initiatives.

  • Monitor database performance, troubleshoot issues, and proactively identify optimization opportunities.
  • Collaborate with development teams, infrastructure teams, analysts, and external vendors on cross-functional projects.
  • Provide technical mentorship and guidance to developers, analysts, and support personnel.
  • Participate in architecture reviews, planning, and long-term data strategy initiatives led by leadership.
  • Support label/report development and document generation solutions as needed (experience with label development platforms is a plus).

Qualifications

Qualifications & Skills:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Engineering, or related field preferred; equivalent hands-on experience will be considered.
  • 10+ years of experience in database architecture, database administration, enterprise data engineering, or related technical roles.
  • Advanced expertise in SQL development, query optimization, indexing strategies, and relational database design.
  • Strong Python development experience focused on data engineering, automation, integrations, and analytics workflows.
  • Hands-on experience with cloud data platforms such as Microsoft Fabric, Databricks, or comparable enterprise data engineering technologies.
  • Experience supporting enterprise ERP systems, preferably Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations or similar ERP platforms (SAP, Oracle, etc.).
  • Experience supporting deployments, environment management, and administrative functions within Microsoft Dynamics Lifecycle Services and/or Microsoft Power Platform Admin Center.
  • Strong understanding of data warehousing concepts, dimensional modeling, and enterprise integration patterns.
  • Experience working collaboratively with both technical teams and functional business users.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent communication, documentation, and stakeholder management skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Manufacturing industry experience strongly preferred.
  • Experience within food and beverage manufacturing or distribution environments is a plus.
  • Experience with Azure data services and cloud architecture.
  • Familiarity with Power BI or enterprise analytics/reporting platforms.
  • Experience with API integrations, EDI, or middleware solutions.
  • Knowledge of DevOps, CI/CD pipelines, and source control practices.
  • Experience with label development or enterprise labeling platforms is a plus.
  • Exposure to machine learning, predictive analytics, or advanced data science workflows is a plus.

We offer a comprehensive and thoughtfully designed benefits package that supports the well-being, financial security, and work-life balance of our employees.

  • 10 Paid Company Holidays
  • Generous Paid Vacation & Sick Time
  • Comprehensive, Affordable Medical, Dental & Vision Coverage for you and your family
  • Health Savings Account (HSA) with company contributions
  • Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA) & Dependent Care FSA (DCFSA)
  • 401(k) Retirement Plan with company match and discretionary profit sharing
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP) and financial wellness resources
  • Company‑Paid Disability
  • Company‑Paid Life Insurance equal to 1.5× annual compensation
  • And more benefits designed to support your health, wealth, and well‑being

Together, these benefits reflect our commitment to caring for our employees both inside and outside the workplace.

Job Description

ECS is seeking an Enterprise Architect - Data & Employee Systems (Databricks) to work remotely.

This role designs and owns the enterprise data architecture for employee data, using Databricks as the core platform. The person in this role translates company policy, data standards, and business logic into a secure, scalable, and compliant architecture that other teams build on.

Key Responsibilities

  • Architecture Design Design end-to-end data architecture for employee data (HR, payroll, benefits, performance, etc.) on Databricks, including data lakehouse structure, pipelines, and governance layers.
  • Policy & Standards Translation Convert company policy (e.g., data privacy, retention, access control) and industry standards (e.g., GDPR, SOC 2, HIPAA where relevant) into concrete technical architecture and data models.
  • Business Logic Implementation Partner with HR, Legal, and business stakeholders to encode business rules (eligibility, compensation logic, org hierarchy, etc.) directly into the data architecture.
  • Governance & Security Define data access controls, lineage tracking, and audit mechanisms using Databricks Unity Catalog or equivalent governance tools.
  • Platform Leadership Set best practices for Databricks usage across the organization — including Delta Lake, workflows, cluster management, and cost optimization.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration Work with data engineers, security teams, HR systems owners, and compliance officers to ensure the architecture meets both technical and regulatory needs.
  • Documentation & Roadmap Maintain architecture diagrams, data dictionaries, and a roadmap for evolving the employee data platform.

Salary Range: $150,000 - $170,000

General Description Of Benefits

Required Skills

  • Strong hands-on experience with Databricks (Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, Workflows, cluster/compute management)
  • Proven experience designing enterprise-level data architecture, ideally for HR/employee data or other sensitive datasets
  • Solid understanding of data governance, privacy regulations, and compliance standards
  • Ability to translate business and legal policy into technical specifications
  • Experience with data modeling (dimensional modeling, master data management)
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, or GCP) since Databricks runs on top of these

Responsibilities

The core responsibilities for this role are based on a broad knowledge of IT and include, but are not limited to the following:

  • Own what and how data is transformed, transmitted, modeled, categorized, and mastered for Plant to Stock’s systems
  • Overall data design authority for the 1LMX ERP PTS systems
  • Act as an approver on functional and technical specifications to support the function for models/reports, with tangible knowledge on what SAP ERP has out of the box vs. performing customizations in S/4

  • Work closely with both functional and technical leads to ensure that analytics requirements are well understood, organized, and documented
  • Document analytics architectures, strategies and metrics for a variety of audiences, including the executive level

Basic Qualifications

  • Experience working within production, distribution or delivery related scenarios
  • Solid multi-year experience in complex analytics solutions, from hands-on development to analytics design to strategy creation
  • Experience with multiple data sources and reporting
  • Solid domain experience in key SAP analytics technologies
  • Ability to abstract, summarize and explain data and analytics concepts to non-technical audiences
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills

Desired Skills

  • Demonstrated experience managing complex system deployments.
  • Scaled agile methodologies
  • Atlassian Jira & Confluence
  • Exposure to the following SAP functional areas: (PP/PEO, MM, MRP & PP/DS, EWM, GTS, ATM, Delivery, GTS)

WHY JOIN US?Evinova is a health-tech business focused on accelerating better health outcomes by advancing digital transformation across the life sciences sector. By combining science-based expertise, evidence-led rigor, and deep human insight, we design digital solutions that enable healthcare to work better for everyone. Operating at the intersection of healthcare, technology, data, and analytics, we are helping unlock the full potential of digital health, transforming how clinical research is conducted, how care is delivered, and how patients experience healthcare. Our solutions are built to scale, driving efficiency, improving decision-making, and ultimately delivering better outcomes for patients worldwide.

At Evinova, we are driven by a shared purpose to transform health through data and digital innovation. Our teams collaborate across disciplines to solve complex challenges, continuously learning and evolving in a fast-paced, high-impact environment.

We also recognize the importance of flexibility and balance. Our ways of working support both individual needs and team collaboration. To foster connection and collaboration, employees are expected to work from the office three days per week, creating opportunities for in-person teamwork, innovation, and meaningful connection.

Role Summary:As a Product Data Architect at Evinova, you will shape the data architecture behind our AI-powered products, including Study Designer and AI Document Authoring. You’ll design scalable, secure, and high-quality data solutions that enable smarter, more connected clinical trials.

Working closely with Product and Engineering teams, you’ll define data models, integration patterns, and standards that support both current delivery and future innovation—especially across AI, LLM, and RAG-driven capabilities in a regulated environment.

This is a high-impact role where you’ll help build the data foundations that power the next generation of digital health solutions.

What You’ll Do

Shape Data Architecture for AI-Powered Products

  • Design and evolve data models that power our AI-native products
  • Build and guide architectures supporting LLMs, generative AI, and RAG pipelines
  • Define scalable data flows, integration patterns, and interfaces across products
  • Establish reusable data patterns to support long-term product growth

Ensure Quality, Compliance, and Scalability

  • Drive consistency and interoperability across our product ecosystem
  • Align data architecture with regulatory and enterprise standards (including GxP)
  • Support data governance practices like access, retention, and auditability
  • Identify risks and continuously improve data architecture and performance

Use Data to Drive Better Decisions

  • Define metrics and dashboards to monitor data quality and system health
  • Turn insights into actionable improvements for product and engineering teams
  • Promote a strong data quality mindset across teams

Collaborate and Deliver Across Teams

  • Partner with Product and Engineering to bring scalable data solutions to life
  • Work closely with global teams and external partners to guide implementation
  • Stay hands-on when needed—supporting design, troubleshooting, and delivery

Lead and Elevate Data Excellence

  • Mentor engineers and help set best practices for data architecture
  • Contribute to a shared vision across teams and geographies
  • Help define how data supports AI-driven product innovation at scale

What Success Looks Like

  • Data models and interfaces are clear, scalable, and widely adopted across teams
  • Product teams move faster with fewer data-related blockers or rework
  • Data architecture evolves seamlessly as products, AI capabilities, and usage grow
  • LLM and RAG pipelines are reliable, transparent, and meet both technical and regulatory standards
  • You are seen as a trusted partner by Product and Engineering leadership

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Mathematics, Information Science, or a related field
  • 8+ years of experience in data architecture, data engineering, or platform architecture roles
  • Proven experience owning data architecture for complex products or product suites
  • Strong experience in data modeling and data design
  • Proficiency in Python
  • Experience working with SQL and NoSQL databases
  • Hands-on experience building and managing ETL processes and data pipelines
  • Demonstrated ability to make architectural decisions with product-level impact
  • Strong collaboration skills with Product and Engineering teams
  • A data-driven mindset, with experience defining metrics and using insights to guide decisions

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience architecting data layers for AI/ML-powered products — especially LLM pipelines, RAG architectures, vector databases, or embedding strategies.
  • Familiarity with GxP software validation, computerised system validation (CSV), or regulated-industry quality practices.
  • Background in life sciences, health-tech, or clinical-trial technology.
  • Experience working with geographically distributed teams and external vendor squads.
  • Experience operating within a Data Owner / Data Steward governance model.
  • Experience defining reference architectures reused across multiple products.
  • Prior experience mentoring senior engineers or architects.

SO, WHAT’S NEXT?

To be considered for this exciting opportunity, please complete the full application on our website at your earliest convenience – it is the only way that our Recruiter and Hiring Manager can know that you feel well qualified for this opportunity. If you know someone who would be a great fit, please share this posting with them.

Where can I find out more?

  • Explore what we’re building: www.evinova.com
  • Stay connected and see our impact in action: https://www.linkedin.com/company/evinova/

Apply today to bring smarter, faster clinical trials to life!

Such accommodation is available on request in respect of all aspects of the recruitment, assessment and selection process and may be requested by emailing AZCHumanResources@astrazeneca.com.

In addition, our positions offer a short-term incentive bonus opportunity; eligibility to participate in our equity-based long-term incentive program. Benefits offered included a qualified retirement program [401(k) plan]; paid vacation and holidays; paid leaves; and, health benefits including medical, prescription drug, dental, and vision coverage in accordance with the terms and conditions of the applicable plans.

  • Design federated ontologies and knowledge‑graph structures that enrich data products and support AI agents, AI reasoning, and analytics applications.

  • Define logical representations for SAP, Apriso, and other source systems and guide ingestion patterns that preserve semantic integrity.
  • Produce architecture artifacts (diagrams, data dictionaries, ontology catalogs) and enforce data‑quality, security, and lineage standards.
  • Design data entities in a way so that they can be productized to ensure they meet the requirements of their documented use cases.
  • Collaborate with the Lead Data Engineer to validate designs.
  • Continuously improve modeling processes, promote ontology reuse, and stay current on semantic‑modeling and Databricks advancements.
  • Advise on the technology stack used in team operations.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s (or higher) in Computer Science, Systems Engineering, Information Management, or a related field.
  • 10 + years of large-scale data architecture/engineering experience, with at least 5 years focused on productizing data assets for enterprise consumption.
  • Significant experience designing/operationalizing ontologies.
  • Demonstrated ability to probe for and understand core customer needs as opposed to surface-level needs.
  • Strong programming skills in Python and SQL; proficient with Spark (PySpark/Scala) and deep experience with AI-assisted development.

  • Generous paid time off policy
  • Remote work flexibility across Canada and the US
  • Opportunities for professional development and mentorship
