How You Will Make History Here…

As a Data Solutions Architect, you will play a key role in shaping and advancing our enterprise data platform strategy. You will design scalable, secure, and governed data solutions that enable analytics, reporting, and business decision-making across the organization. By establishing architectural standards, mentoring engineering teams, and driving best practices, you will help build a modern data ecosystem that supports current and future business needs.

The Company is only considering candidates who do not, now or in the future, require employer sponsorship to legally work in the United States.

What You Will Do…

  • Design and implement enterprise data solutions leveraging Databricks, Azure, and modern cloud data technologies.
  • Lead data engineering solution design utilizing Delta Lake and Medallion Architecture principles.
  • Guide and mentor teams responsible for data modeling, ETL/ELT development, and data platform implementation.
  • Define and implement scalable data integration patterns and data movement strategies.
  • Establish, maintain, and evolve architecture standards, coding standards, and engineering best practices.
  • Implement and enforce data security frameworks using Unity Catalog, role-based access controls (RBAC), data masking, row-level security, column-level security, and least-privilege access models.
  • Ensure data quality, monitoring, auditing, lineage, and governance capabilities are implemented and maintained across data solutions.
  • Optimize Apache Spark workloads, Delta tables, and SQL queries for performance, scalability, and cost efficiency.
  • Review technical designs and provide guidance to data engineers and development teams.
  • Create and maintain architecture documentation, technical standards, and reusable design patterns.
  • Partner with stakeholders to ensure data solutions align with business objectives and enterprise architecture strategies.

Who You Will Work With…

  • Data Engineering teams responsible for building and maintaining data pipelines and data products.
  • Analytics, Reporting, and Business Intelligence teams leveraging enterprise data assets.
  • Enterprise Architecture and Technology leaders to align solutions with organizational standards.
  • Data Governance and Security teams to ensure compliance, data protection, and governance requirements are met.
  • Business stakeholders and product teams to understand data needs and deliver scalable solutions.
  • Cross-functional technology teams supporting cloud infrastructure, DevOps, and application integrations.

What You Bring To The Table… (must Have)

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field.
  • 8+ years of experience in Data Engineering, Data Architecture, or related disciplines.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Databricks, Apache Spark, Delta Lake, and Unity Catalog.
  • Experience working with Azure Data Lake, Azure Data Factory, and SQL-based data solutions.
  • Deep understanding of Medallion Architecture, data warehousing concepts, and dimensional data modeling.
  • Experience designing and implementing secure, governed enterprise data platforms.
  • Knowledge of CI/CD practices, Git, automated testing frameworks, and Infrastructure as Code (IaC).
  • Proven ability to troubleshoot, optimize, and scale large-volume data pipelines and data processing workloads.
  • Strong communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to establish technical standards and mentor engineering teams.

IT WOULD BE GREAT IF YOU HAVE… (NICE TO HAVE)

  • Azure and/or Databricks certifications.
  • Experience with enterprise reporting and analytics platforms such as MicroStrategy and Power BI.
  • Experience defining and implementing enterprise data architecture standards and governance frameworks.
  • Experience supporting large-scale cloud modernization and data transformation initiatives.
  • Familiarity with enterprise-wide data quality, metadata management, and data lineage solutions.

Compensation And Benefits

The target base salary range for this full-time, salaried position is between

$127,900-$175,900

Individual base pay depends on work location and additional factors such as experience, job-related skills, and relevant education or training. Total pay may include other forms of compensation. In addition, we offer competitive health, dental, 401k and wellness benefits beginning on the first day of employment. descriptionHtml:
Wells Fargo is seeking a Principal Data Architect— a hands-on technologist who will shape modern data architecture across cloud and on-prem environments in a large-scale banking ecosystem. This role designs scalable patterns for application, analytics, workflow, and AI-enabled workloads while guiding the evolution of legacy systems into secure, resilient, and future-ready platforms. The ideal candidate balances strategy, design, and hands-on execution—proving concepts through code, solving complex data challenges, and influencing senior technologists. You will work across diverse systems, define architectural patterns, and enable teams to modernize data environments with practical, AI-aware solutions.

This role requires deep expertise in distributed data systems, application and workflow integration, and analytic platforms, along with the ability to translate current-state constraints into forward-looking architectures. descriptionHtml:
Job Number: R0251946

Data Architect, Lead

The Opportunity:

For an organization to transform in today’s digital world, it needs to properly collect, store, and organize its data. Effective data management can enable more efficient operations, yielding more growth. As a data architect, you know how to apply your creative-thinking and analytical mindset to help organizations manage their data assets. We’re looking for a data architecture lead like you to solve complex challenges and deliver leading-edge solutions for national security.

As a data architect on our national security team, you’ll use your extensive technical expertise to lead the design of data architecture solutions for big data analytics. You’ll resolve routine data architecture-related issues in collaboration with business analysts and technology teams by working with project staff to make decisions and recommendations on future data architecture development.

In this role, you’ll share your technical expertise, introduce best practices, and use tools like Closure, Scala, Python, and R to design databases and applications. You’ll lead your team as it designs, defines, develops, and tests cloud solution components, and you’ll serve as a liaison between clients and developers to ensure that requirements are met and solutions are delivered.

With your motivation to establish processes and facilitate technological innovation, you’ll make a lasting impact on national security.

Join us. The world can’t wait.

You Have:  

  • 10+ years of experience in data analytics, data architecture, or data engineering
  • 5+ years of experience working directly with business stakeholders, IT organizations, and technical teams to develop and implement data solutions
  • 5+ years of experience leading data-focused initiatives involving analytics, machine learning, artificial intelligence, or enterprise data management
  • Experience recommending and implementing data solutions to address business and mission requirements
  • Knowledge of an analytical or statistical language such as Closure, Scala, Python, or R
  • Ability to work independently and execute technical efforts with minimal oversight
  • Secret clearance
  • Bachelor’s degree


Nice If You Have:  

  • Experience with ColdFusion
  • Master's degree in Mathematics or Statistics  


Clearance:  

Applicants selected will be subject to a security investigation and may need to meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information; Secret clearance is required.

Compensation

At Booz Allen, we celebrate your contributions, provide you with opportunities and choices, and support your total well-being. Our offerings include health, life, disability, financial, and retirement benefits, as well as paid leave, professional development, tuition assistance, work-life programs, and dependent care. Our recognition awards program acknowledges employees for exceptional performance and superior demonstration of our values. Full-time and part-time employees working at least 20 hours a week on a regular basis are eligible to participate in Booz Allen’s benefit programs. Individuals that do not meet the threshold are only eligible for select offerings, not inclusive of health benefits. We encourage you to learn more about our total benefits by visiting the Resource page on our Careers site and reviewing Our Employee Benefits page.

Salary at Booz Allen is determined by various factors, including but not limited to location, the individual’s particular combination of education, knowledge, skills, competencies, and experience, as well as contract-specific affordability and organizational requirements. The projected compensation range for this position is $99,000.00 to $225,000.00 (annualized USD). The estimate displayed represents the typical salary range for this position and is just one component of Booz Allen’s total compensation package for employees. This posting will close within 90 days from the Posting Date.

Identity Statement

As part of the hiring process, we will ask you to complete an identity verification process that leverages advanced biometrics and artificial intelligence to ensure authenticity and protect against identity fraud. You are expected to be on camera during interviews and assessments. We reserve the right to take your picture to verify your identity and prevent fraud.

Candidate AI Usage Policy

AI is a part of our daily work at Booz Allen, and we are committed to the responsible and ethical use of AI tools. However, we want to ensure a fair candidate process based on your own skills and knowledge. As part of this commitment, the use of artificial intelligence (AI) or other tools to assist with responses during interviews (whether in-person or virtual) is prohibited unless permission is explicitly provided.

Work Model

Our people-first culture prioritizes the benefits of collaboration. To support engagement and effective communication, employees working virtually are generally expected to have their cameras on during meetings.

  • Remote: If this position is listed as remote, there may still be occasions when you are required to work in person at a Booz Allen or customer facility.
  • Hybrid: If this position is listed as hybrid, you will be expected to work from a Booz Allen or customer facility, in alignment with your leadership's expectations and the needs of the role.
  • Onsite: If this position is listed as onsite, work will primarily be performed full-time at a customer facility, where employees will collaborate directly with colleagues and customers as required by the role.


Commitment to Non-Discrimination

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to disability, status as a protected veteran or any other status protected by applicable federal, state, local, or international law.

descriptionText:
Wells Fargo is seeking a Principal Data Architect— a hands-on technologist who will shape modern data architecture across cloud and on-prem environments in a large-scale banking ecosystem. This role designs scalable patterns for application, analytics, workflow, and AI-enabled workloads while guiding the evolution of legacy systems into secure, resilient, and future-ready platforms. The ideal candidate balances strategy, design, and hands-on execution—proving concepts through code, solving complex data challenges, and influencing senior technologists. You will work across diverse systems, define architectural patterns, and enable teams to modernize data environments with practical, AI-aware solutions.

This role requires deep expertise in distributed data systems, application and workflow integration, and analytic platforms, along with the ability to translate current-state constraints into forward-looking architectures. Experience using both traditional development and AI-assisted engineering tools is key. Beyond technical leadership, you will mentor teams, align architecture to business outcomes, and communicate effectively with both technical and business stakeholders. Success in this role requires driving solutions that balance innovation with measurable value, including considerations of scalability, cost (TCO), and ROI.

In This Role, You Will

Act as an advisor to senior leadership to develop the architectural framework & delivery for highly complex business and technical needs across multiple groups

Lead the strategy and resolution of highly complex and unique challenges requiring in-depth evaluation across multiple areas or the enterprise, delivering products and solutions that are long-term, large-scale, and require vision, creativity, innovation, advanced analytical and inductive thinking

Provide vision, direction, and expertise to senior leadership on implementing the transformation strategy describing the current state, target state, and transition architecture

Develop and influence strategic plans, investment planning, and execution on cutover strategies to target

Strategically engage with all levels of professionals and managers across the enterprise and serve as an architectural domain expert advisor to leadership 

Drive target investments towards target technologies and rationalize spend, total cost of ownership, and return on investment

Ensure applications adhere to established Wells Fargo standards, policies, methodologies, and industry best practices as it transforms toward target state architecture

Drive the definition, establishment, selection of strategic tools, and application of architecture frameworks

Maintain knowledge of industry best practices and new technologies and recommends innovations that enhance operations or provide a competitive advantage to the organization and can influence internal and vendor roadmaps in a significant capacity

Required Qualifications



- 7+ years of experience in data architecture, data engineering, database platforms, or enterprise technology roles, with significant experience in large-scale financial services or banking environments. 
- 7+ years of designing enterprise-scale data architectures across hybrid cloud, public cloud, private cloud, and on-premises platforms. 
- 7+ years of experience with relational, NoSQL, columnar, distributed, and shared-nothing database technologies. 

Desired Qualifications



- Proven ability to design scalable architectures using partitioning, sharding, replication, workload isolation, horizontal scaling, and distributed processing patterns
- Experience architecting batch, streaming, event-driven, real-time, near-real-time, and API-based data integration patterns
- Strong understanding of how application workloads, analytical workloads, reporting workloads, workflow engines, and AI/ML workloads interact with enterprise data platforms
- Hands-on capability with technologies such as SQL, Python, Java, Spark, Kafka, Airflow, APIs, and modern data pipeline frameworks
- Expertise in data modeling, including conceptual, logical, physical, dimensional, canonical, domain-driven, and event-based models
- Strong knowledge of data security architecture, including encryption, tokenization, masking, access controls, entitlement models, secrets management, and audit logging
- Ability to define and evaluate non-functional technical requirements, including latency, throughput, scalability, availability, resiliency, recovery, observability, security, and maintainability
- Familiarity with designing data architectures that support AI, machine learning, feature engineering, model training, retrieval-augmented generation, vector search, and analytical workloads
- Experience developing reference architectures, reusable design patterns, platform standards, technical guardrails, and implementation blueprints

Category/Area of Expertise: Data-Science & Analytics

Job Requisition: 537753

Address: USA-NC-Salisbury-2110 Executive Drive


Ahold Delhaize USA, a division of global food retailer Ahold Delhaize, is part of the U.S. family of brands, which includes five leading omnichannel grocery brands - Food Lion, Giant Food, The GIANT Company, Hannaford and Stop & Shop. Our associates support the brands with a wide range of services, including Finance, Legal, Sustainability, Commercial, Digital and E-commerce, Technology and more.


Primary Purpose:

Enterprise level technical leader who defines the vision, architecture, and operating model for data platforms and data products, enabling secure, scalable, and reliable data solutions that accelerate analytics, reporting, and machine learning across the business.


This hands-on leader acts as a conduit between enterprise data engineering teams and the Transformation organization, remaining highly technical while building frameworks, guiding team direction, architecture, and best practices.


Our flexible/hybrid work schedule includes 3 in-person days at one of our core locations and 2 remote days. Our core office location for this role is Salisbury, NC. Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis.


Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Set the north star data architecture (batch/streaming, lakehouse, MDM, governance) and establish actionable standards, guardrails, and reference implementations.
  • Establish product-oriented platform capabilities (self-service ingestion, transformation, orchestration, catalog/lineage, quality) and the internal tooling that enables scalable developer and analyst workflows.
  • Define and drive automation standards, including CI/CD pipelines and deployment workflows for data platforms and services.
  • Embed security, privacy, and compliance by design, leveraging automation to enforce policies and produce audit-ready evidence.
  • Orchestrate reliability and observability across pipelines and platforms (SLOs, cost/performance telemetry, automated remediation), including platform-wide monitoring, logging, and tracing practices (e.g., DataDog).
  • Guide cloud service integration and container/orchestration strategy where applicable, ensuring cost-effective scale and predictable performance.
  • Maintain and govern infrastructure as code practices (e.g., Terraform, Ansible, CloudFormation) to standardize environments, reduce drift, and improve repeatability.
  • Prioritize roadmaps and investments using measurable value, risk reduction, and customer (data consumer) outcomes; evaluate and adopt new technologies to improve platform capabilities.
  • Collaborate with development teams to provide reusable infrastructure components, golden paths, and platform patterns that accelerate delivery.
  • Mentor principal and senior engineers, grow a community of practice, and raise engineering quality.
  • May be called upon to support critical escalations and must be available during urgent IT incidents as needed.
  • Design and build reusable data engineering frameworks and standards used across multiple squads to improve consistency, scalability, and delivery quality.
  • Develop, manage, and optimize scalable pipelines that move data from SAP and legacy platforms into the enterprise data lake and deliver trusted data for reporting, analytics, AI, application and business consumption.
  • Harmonize and transform data from disparate legacy systems into SAP while maintaining appropriate data quality, lineage, governance, and reconciliation controls.
  • Provide hands-on technical leadership for Microsoft Data Ecosystem, Databricks and SAP Business Data Cloud solutions, including architecture decisions, implementation guidance, proof-of-concepts, and performance optimization.
  • Drive the Reporting & Analytics engineering strategy and design API-driven and event-streaming solutions that enable secure, reliable, and timely access to enterprise data products.


Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent years of work experience.
  • 12+ years in data/platform engineering with enterprise scope and measurable impact.
  • Mastery of data architecture (streaming and batch), lake/lakehouse/warehouse patterns, governance, and security.
  • Proven leadership of automation, CI/CD for data, and observability at scale.
  • Executive level communication, influence, and stakeholder alignment.
  • Deep expertise with Databricks and modern lakehouse architecture, including Spark-based processing, Delta Lake, orchestration, governance, performance optimization, and production operations.
  • Demonstrated experience designing, building, testing, and operating scalable batch and real-time data pipelines using SQL and a modern programming language such as Python or Scala.
  • Strong knowledge of REST APIs, event-driven architectures, and streaming technologies such as Kafka or comparable platforms.
  • Strong background in reporting and analytics, including data modeling and delivery of trusted, analytics-ready datasets for enterprise consumption.
  • Proven ability to communicate complex technical concepts to technical and non-technical audiences, manage stakeholders, influence across teams, and serve as a bridge among engineering, business, and transformation teams.
  • Practical interest and experience in AI, Generative AI, and emerging technologies, supported by a demonstrated passion for continuous learning.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience productizing internal data platforms and measuring adoption/value.
  • Exposure to cost governance (FinOps) and multi cloud strategies.
  • Hands-on experience with SAP Business Data Cloud, Databricks, SAP Datasphere, or integration of SAP data products with an enterprise Databricks environment.
  • Experience supporting a large-scale SAP S/4HANA transformation and harmonizing data between legacy platforms, SAP, and enterprise analytical environments.
  • Databricks Data Engineer Professional certification or a comparable advanced cloud, data engineering, SAP, or architecture certification.
  • Experience with Delta Sharing, Unity Catalog, Lakeflow, Auto Loader, production-grade streaming workloads, and AI-ready or Generative AI data products.
  • Experience partnering with system integrators and shaping reporting and analytics strategy across multiple business domains or squads.


Salary Range NC: $160,000 - $240,000

Actual compensation offered to a candidate may vary based on their unique qualifications and experience, internal equity, and market conditions. Final compensation decisions will be made in accordance with company policies and applicable laws.

Standard Job Description

Join Lockheed Martin’s Data & AI Enablement organization and accelerate the company’s AI transformation. As a lead data architect, you will drive the creation of logical data models that underpin our next‑generation data products and enterprise ontology. You will partner with Data Product Owners by architecting data models, data pipelines and ontologies, and ensure consistent semantic definitions across the Enterprise Data Ecosystem (EDE). The role operates in a Databricks‑centric environment, integrating source systems such as SAP and Apriso upstream, and powering AI agents and analytics applications downstream. By governing and expanding the semantic layer of the corporate data foundation, you will play a key role in the company’s AI transformation.

Key Responsibilities

  • Partner with Data Product Owners to capture business requirements and create robust logical data models.
  • Design federated ontologies and knowledge‑graph structures that enrich data products and support AI agents, AI reasoning, and analytics applications.
  • Ensure models deliver clean, well‑documented feature sets for machine‑learning pipelines; work with data scientists to embed model‑ready attributes (feature stores, lineage metadata).
  • Define logical representations for SAP, Apriso, and other source systems and guide ingestion patterns that preserve semantic integrity.
  • Produce architecture artifacts (diagrams, data dictionaries, ontology catalogs) and enforce data‑quality, security, and lineage standards.
  • Design data entities in a way so that they can be productized to ensure they meet the requirements of their documented use cases.
  • Collaborate with the Lead Data Engineer to validate designs.
  • Continuously improve modeling processes, promote ontology reuse, and stay current on semantic‑modeling and Databricks advancements.
  • Advise on the technology stack used in team operations.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s (or higher) in Computer Science, Systems Engineering, Information Management, or a related field.
  • 10 + years of large-scale data architecture/engineering experience, with at least 5 years focused on productizing data assets for enterprise consumption.
  • Significant experience designing/operationalizing ontologies.
  • Demonstrated ability to probe for and understand core customer needs as opposed to surface-level needs.
  • Strong programming skills in Python and SQL; proficient with Spark (PySpark/Scala) and deep experience with AI-assisted development.
  • Experience with data‑integration/orchestration tools (e.g., NiFi, Airflow) for pipeline development.
  • Must be a US Citizen.

Desired Skills

  • Experience with Databricks (Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, Jobs/Workflows).
  • Experience with federated data models and ontologies.
  • Excellent interpersonal and collaboration skills for cross‑functional teamwork and internal‑customer support.
  • Master’s degree or advanced technical training (optional).
  • Databricks certifications (Data Engineer Associate/Professional) or comparable big‑data credentials.
  • Experience developing applications leveraging genAI.

Standard Job Description

Join Lockheed Martin’s Data & AI Enablement organization and accelerate the company’s AI transformation. As a lead data architect, you will drive the creation of logical data models that underpin our next‑generation data products and enterprise ontology. You will partner with Data Product Owners by architecting data models, data pipelines and ontologies, and ensure consistent semantic definitions across the Enterprise Data Ecosystem (EDE). The role operates in a Databricks‑centric environment, integrating source systems such as SAP and Apriso upstream, and powering AI agents and analytics applications downstream. By governing and expanding the semantic layer of the corporate data foundation, you will play a key role in the company’s AI transformation.

Key Responsibilities

  • Partner with Data Product Owners to capture business requirements and create robust logical data models.
  • Design federated ontologies and knowledge‑graph structures that enrich data products and support AI agents, AI reasoning, and analytics applications.
  • Ensure models deliver clean, well‑documented feature sets for machine‑learning pipelines; work with data scientists to embed model‑ready attributes (feature stores, lineage metadata).
  • Define logical representations for SAP, Apriso, and other source systems and guide ingestion patterns that preserve semantic integrity.
  • Produce architecture artifacts (diagrams, data dictionaries, ontology catalogs) and enforce data‑quality, security, and lineage standards.
  • Design data entities in a way so that they can be productized to ensure they meet the requirements of their documented use cases.
  • Collaborate with the Lead Data Engineer to validate designs.
  • Continuously improve modeling processes, promote ontology reuse, and stay current on semantic‑modeling and Databricks advancements.
  • Advise on the technology stack used in team operations.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s (or higher) in Computer Science, Systems Engineering, Information Management, or a related field.
  • 10 + years of large-scale data architecture/engineering experience, with at least 5 years focused on productizing data assets for enterprise consumption.
  • Significant experience designing/operationalizing ontologies.
  • Demonstrated ability to probe for and understand core customer needs as opposed to surface-level needs.
  • Strong programming skills in Python and SQL; proficient with Spark (PySpark/Scala) and deep experience with AI-assisted development.
  • Experience with data‑integration/orchestration tools (e.g., NiFi, Airflow) for pipeline development.

Standard Job Description

Lockheed Martin Aeronautics Quality & Mission Success (Q&MS) is seeking a Senior Staff Data Engineer to lead the architecting and implementation of the Q&MS data system and its supporting data-management plan. Reporting into Quality Performance Management and aligned to the Q&MS Digital Transformation Director, the role establishes the reference architecture, common data models, and governance patterns that consolidate fragmented Q&MS data into governed, value-creating data products fit for reporting, decision support, and approved AI uses. The architect works across a federated operating model spanning multiple participating organizations, replacing fragmented pipelines and definitions with a coherent, measurable data system, and interfaces with the Aeronautics data office, 1LMX, IT, and other intra- and extra-functional teams.

Key Responsibilities

  • Establish and maintain the target-state reference architecture across the data-system lifecycle, along with the current-to-target transition architecture.
  • Author and maintain common and canonical data models; reconcile them with applicable enterprise and business-unit models to enable semantic interoperability and shared reuse.
  • Own the multi-year data-architecture roadmap that feeds the annual data portfolio plan; sequence capability increments, dependencies, and shared-capability alternatives before dev/test/build sequences.
  • Author functional data-architecture command media aligned to applicable enterprise data-management, governance, stewardship, and data-quality direction; prepare architecture-decision content for senior functional leadership and higher-tier governance bodies.
  • Define architectural patterns and certification criteria for governed data products, pipelines, and interfaces so participating intra-Q&MS organizations can adopt shared capabilities without divergent localized implementations.
  • Translate organizational data-management maturity gaps into architectural investments carried in the Q&MS data-system roadmap.
  • Advise on governance approach for AI enablement — traceability, lineage, and fitness-for-use for approved AI agentic use cases.
  • Serve as the architecture interface to the enterprise data office, corporate IT, and corporate data and AI enablement organizations; elevate matters beyond functional authority through the applicable interface.
  • Mentor Staff and Senior data engineers, modelers, and technical stewards across participating organizations.

Delivers full-stack data solutions across the entire data processing pipeline. This relies on systems engineering principles to design and implement solutions that span the data lifecycle to: collect, ingest, process, store, persist, access, and deliver data at scale and at speed. It includes knowledge of local, distributed, and cloud-based technologies; data virtualization and smart caching; and all security and authentication mechanisms required to protect the data.Build data pipelines that clean, transform, and aggregate unorganized data into databases or data sources that are ready for analysis; Design and implement data solutions by defining functional capabilities, security, back-up, and recovery specifications; Work through all stages of a data solution lifecycle, e.g., analyze / profile data, create conceptual, logical and physical data model designs, architect and design ETL, reporting and analytics; Maintain data systems performance by identifying and resolving production and application development problems; calculating optimum values for parameters; evaluating, integrating, and installing new releases; Define standards, best practices, and certification processes for data objects

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in a related technical discipline plus 14+ years in data architecture or enterprise data management
  • Demonstrated ownership of enterprise or functional data-architecture strategy, reference architectures, and common data models
  • Advanced conceptual, logical, and physical data modeling for complex, cross-organizational domains
  • Demonstrated authorship of governance and architecture artifacts — standards, models, architectural decision records — and experience presenting to senior governance bodies
  • Ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. DoD Secret clearance (U.S. citizenship required)

Desired Skills

  • Databricks (Unity Catalog, Delta, Lakehouse patterns)
  • Metadata, lineage, glossary, and data-product certification design
  • Common data modeling and semantic interoperability across federated organizations
  • Familiarity with controlled command-media authoring in a regulated enterprise
  • Quality data-model domain experience (nonconformance, corrective action, assessment, inspection)
  • Relevant certifications (e.g., CDMP, TOGAF, Databricks Data Engineer, Security+)

Standard Job Description

Lockheed Martin Aeronautics Quality & Mission Success (Q&MS) is seeking a Senior Staff Data Engineer to lead the architecting and implementation of the Q&MS data system and its supporting data-management plan. Reporting into Quality Performance Management and aligned to the Q&MS Digital Transformation Director, the role establishes the reference architecture, common data models, and governance patterns that consolidate fragmented Q&MS data into governed, value-creating data products fit for reporting, decision support, and approved AI uses. The architect works across a federated operating model spanning multiple participating organizations, replacing fragmented pipelines and definitions with a coherent, measurable data system, and interfaces with the Aeronautics data office, 1LMX, IT, and other intra- and extra-functional teams.

Key Responsibilities

  • Establish and maintain the target-state reference architecture across the data-system lifecycle, along with the current-to-target transition architecture.
  • Author and maintain common and canonical data models; reconcile them with applicable enterprise and business-unit models to enable semantic interoperability and shared reuse.
  • Own the multi-year data-architecture roadmap that feeds the annual data portfolio plan; sequence capability increments, dependencies, and shared-capability alternatives before dev/test/build sequences.
  • Author functional data-architecture command media aligned to applicable enterprise data-management, governance, stewardship, and data-quality direction; prepare architecture-decision content for senior functional leadership and higher-tier governance bodies.
  • Define architectural patterns and certification criteria for governed data products, pipelines, and interfaces so participating intra-Q&MS organizations can adopt shared capabilities without divergent localized implementations.
  • Translate organizational data-management maturity gaps into architectural investments carried in the Q&MS data-system roadmap.
  • Advise on governance approach for AI enablement — traceability, lineage, and fitness-for-use for approved AI agentic use cases.
  • Serve as the architecture interface to the enterprise data office, corporate IT, and corporate data and AI enablement organizations; elevate matters beyond functional authority through the applicable interface.
  • Mentor Staff and Senior data engineers, modelers, and technical stewards across participating organizations.

Delivers full-stack data solutions across the entire data processing pipeline. This relies on systems engineering principles to design and implement solutions that span the data lifecycle to: collect, ingest, process, store, persist, access, and deliver data at scale and at speed. It includes knowledge of local, distributed, and cloud-based technologies; data virtualization and smart caching; and all security and authentication mechanisms required to protect the data.Build data pipelines that clean, transform, and aggregate unorganized data into databases or data sources that are ready for analysis; Design and implement data solutions by defining functional capabilities, security, back-up, and recovery specifications; Work through all stages of a data solution lifecycle, e.g., analyze / profile data, create conceptual, logical and physical data model designs, architect and design ETL, reporting and analytics; Maintain data systems performance by identifying and resolving production and application development problems; calculating optimum values for parameters; evaluating, integrating, and installing new releases; Define standards, best practices, and certification processes for data objects

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in a related technical discipline plus 14+ years in data architecture or enterprise data management
  • Demonstrated ownership of enterprise or functional data-architecture strategy, reference architectures, and common data models
  • Advanced conceptual, logical, and physical data modeling for complex, cross-organizational domains
  • Demonstrated authorship of governance and architecture artifacts — standards, models, architectural decision records — and experience presenting to senior governance bodies
  • Ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. DoD Secret clearance (U.S. citizenship required)

Desired Skills

  • Databricks (Unity Catalog, Delta, Lakehouse patterns)
  • Metadata, lineage, glossary, and data-product certification design
  • Common data modeling and semantic interoperability across federated organizations
  • Familiarity with controlled command-media authoring in a regulated enterprise
  • Quality data-model domain experience (nonconformance, corrective action, assessment, inspection)
  • Relevant certifications (e.g., CDMP, TOGAF, Databricks Data Engineer, Security+)

Full-Time Salary Range: $129000.00 - $239600.00

  • Annual short-term and/or long-term incentive compensation programs may be offered depending on the position. Payments under these annual programs are not guaranteed and can vary from year to year and are tied to a range of performance metrics.

descriptionHtml:
Who We Are

TKO Group Holdings, Inc. (NYSE: TKO) is a premium sports and entertainment company. TKO owns iconic properties including UFC, the world’s premier mixed martial arts organization; WWE, the global leader in sports entertainment; and PBR, the world’s premier bull riding organization. Together, these properties reach 1 billion households across 210 countries and territories and organize more than 500 live events year-round, attracting more than three million fans. TKO also services and partners with major sports rights holders through IMG, an industry-leading global sports marketing agency; and On Location, a global leader in premium experiential hospitality.

Why this role exists

TKO is consolidating the data estates of five businesses onto one enterprise data platform.

The Principal Data Architect & Modeler is going to lead data architecture role at TKO. You define the standards, the data model, the framework and the roadmap for the platform. Product, Engineering and Data Science build to your recommendations; Data Governance and Master Data Management set the policies your designs make enforceable.

This role is hands on as well as an influencer. You will design & write models, semantic definitions, standards and architecture decision records.

The north star

The platform exists to deliver three enterprise views, on one AI-ready foundation, built iteratively.

  • Fan 360 — one resolved identity for the consumer across UFC, WWE and PBR: tickets, viewership, merchandise, membership, engagement and consent, with the lineage that makes cross-brand use defensible.
  • Event 360 — every live event, broadcast and activation on one spine: venue, gate, attendance, rights, sponsorship, hospitality and media performance, at the grain each business needs.
  • Customer 360 — the B2B side of TKO: rights holders, sponsors, partners, hospitality buyers and agency clients across IMG and On Location, resolved to golden records and linked to the events and fans they touch.
  • Employee 360 - Trusted employee domain aligned to enterprise HR systems and P+C priorities; sequenced behind higher-value domains

AI-readiness is central theme, not a feature appended at the end. Agents and reporting needs to be based on a common definition of metric and attributes, context and data relationships embedded within the semantic layer access to information based on user roles..

None of this is built in one pass. The job is to set the end state, then sequence the increments — one entity, one conformed dimension, one certified metric set at a time — so each release puts a usable slice of a 360 into production and the model improves under use.

What You Will Own

The enterprise data framework and roadmap. Define the target-state architecture and the published roadmap from today's estate to the north star. Set the reference patterns for how data is ingested (batch, CDC, streaming, API), how it is curated through the medallion from landing to marts, how it is served to BI, agents and applications, and how data science and ML consume it (feature-ready datasets, training and retrieval pipelines, in-platform serving). Define the environments and promotion path from development to production, and the standards each layer must meet to pass. Engineering builds the pipelines, Product owns the data products, Data Science builds the models; your framework is what they all build against.

The canonical enterprise model. Define the dimensional and conformed-dimension standards that govern how raw data becomes curated data: grain, conformance, slowly changing dimension handling, surrogate and business keys, and the shared dimensions that must mean the same thing in every brand. Design for modularity, so that the fifth domain costs less than the first and new properties, partnerships and source systems are absorbed rather than re-engineered.

Master data design. Design the master data architecture across fan, event, rights holder, sponsor and partner, employee and vendor, in partnership with Master Data Management and Governance, which owns the policy, stewardship and governance framework your designs implement. Choose and justify the implementation style per domain. Design entity resolution as a cascade — deterministic, probabilistic, machine-learned, human-stewarded — with attribute-level survivorship, versioned match rules, and merges that are defensible and reversible. Treat consent state, opt-out signals and retention obligations as master data carried with identity across brands.

The semantic layer and its hierarchy. Own the enterprise-certified definitions for the concepts the whole company shares — fan, event, attendance, revenue, engagement, rights — and the domain models that inherit from and extend them. Set the metric tiers, the certification bar at each tier, and the promotion path from exploratory to certified. Decide where each definition physically lives across Snowflake semantic views, dbt, the BI semantic layer and the Open Semantic Interchange specification, and keep those representations in sync. TKO already runs conversational analytics agents in production for business users; the accuracy of every one of them is bounded by this model.

The Opportunity

As a Applied AI Health Data Architect you will shape data architecture solutions that support health services provider clients, bringing together data engineering, analytics, and AI to improve how information is structured, integrated, and used across cloud environments. As a Senior Manager you will lead large projects, bring strategic direction to complex data modernization efforts, and use sound judgment to guide teams and stakeholders through changing priorities and technical complexity. In this role at PwC, you will work within our Advisory practice and within our Data, Analytics & AI services to design data platforms, support cloud-native architecture decisions, and contribute to delivery across AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud Platform environments for health sector clients.

Responsibilities

  • Leading applied AI and health data architecture initiatives for provider data environments, translating business goals into scalable data solutions
  • Designing cloud-native data platforms, pipelines, and integration patterns across AWS, Azure, Databricks, and Snowflake
  • Developing data models, warehouse structures, and transformation logic that support analytics, AI workloads, and operational reporting
  • Guiding data modernization efforts that migrate legacy systems into modern architectures with improved performance, security, and usability
  • Overseeing data quality, validation, governance, and anonymization practices across sensitive health data domains
  • Applying data engineering methods to tune pipelines, optimize queries, and improve database and warehouse performance
  • Advising client stakeholders on data strategy, architecture decisions, and AI-ready platform design within complex provider environments
  • Leading teams through delivery planning, issue resolution, and technical coordination across multiple workstreams
  • Coaching practitioners on data engineering platforms, digital tooling, and AI-enabled solution delivery
  • Presenting solution options, tradeoffs, and implementation paths that support modernization priorities and future data capabilities

What You Must Have

  • At least a Bachelor's degree
  • At least 7 years of experience

What Sets You Apart

  • Preference for at least one of the following fields of study: Analytics/Data Science, Business Administration/Management, Computer Science/Information Systems, Economics, Engineering, Finance, Mathematics/Statistics, Operations/Supply Chain
  • Demonstrating data architecture leadership for healthcare provider modernization initiatives
  • Utilizing AWS, Azure, Databricks, or Snowflake for cloud data platforms
  • Applying AI fluency to data engineering and architecture decisions
  • Translating client needs into scalable data modernization roadmaps
  • Leading complex, multi-team delivery with composure and sound judgment

Job Description:

What You’ll Do

Enterprise Information Architect & BIDW Leader will establish and deliver upon the enterprise information architecture vision for enterprise-level solutions. This role is responsible for the delivery of business Intelligence & data warehouse solutions to the firm, including the information architecture and management processes of the BI data warehouse and leading the BI function and team.

Responsibilities

LEADERSHIP

  • Ownership of and accountability for successful results of the Data Warehouse & Business Intelligence teams within Data Transformation.
  • Thought leadership in matters of enterprise data architecture, staying abreast of new technologies, patterns and methods which c an be applicable to Crowe data
  • Development of team strategy, creation and socialization of roadmaps, establishing and ensuring adherence to timelines, and resource assignment for the BIDW team
  • Seek opportunities to bring value to the Crowe business and/or its customers through innovative enterprise data and BI strategies to support strategic business goals
  • Develop quantifiable goals for the team which are aligned with Data Transformation’s strategic goals as well as Crowe’s strategic business initiatives
  • Mentor and coach developers, data engineers, managers, and other roles within team, intentionally managing career growth via mentorship and proactive planning
  • Actively participate in and collaborate with technical guilds to further expose and align the firm on best practices
  • Understand when to delegate; this role manages resources and owns the entire team’s success
  • Responsibility to track and maintain clear visibility into the value and delivery timing of BIDW team initiatives for Head of Data and business stakeholders

DEMAND MANAGEMENT & BUSINESS ENGAGEMENT

  • Collaboration with Head of Data and/or other firm leaders to understand strategic business needs and requirements, and planning team and technology capacity accordingly
  • Communication and engagement to ensure the business sees maximum value from its data warehouse and business intelligence investments
  • Develop and maintain an understanding of business needs, technical architecture and systems landscape, and the technology strategy of the business
  • Collaborate with both BIDW team and Data Transformation leaders to establish goals, plan capacity, support other Data Transformation initiatives, and leave margin for learning and unexpected shifts

PROGRAM DESIGN, DEVELOPMENT & DEPLOYMENT

  • Ultimate ownership for team delivery quality and schedule
  • Work closely with technology and business personnel to deliver value in a timely manner
  • Accountability for team using best practices for development and quality assurance aligned with firmwide standards, seeking opportunities to automate and improve
  • CONTINUOUS IMPROVEMENT
  • Champion a culture and mindset of excellence, collaboration, continuous improvement, design thinking and positivity
  • Establish metrics to monitor and tangibly demonstrate the value provided to the business via effectiveness, quality metrics, sensitive data monitoring as well as alert to any negative trends in these areas
  • Work with stakeholders to prioritize continuous improvement
  • Assess and recommend opportunities to retire/consolidate redundant legacy system assets
  • ADOPTION & VALUE REALIZATION
  • Work with team and business users to ensure successful adoption, usage, and benefit realization from solutions
  • Define and track KPIs and success metrics for adoption and value creation

Specific responsibility expectations by the components listed below –

Information Architecture Vision: Establish the Enterprise Information Architecture vision within the context of business strategy and in alignment with overall Technology & Strategy direction.

  • Translate strategic requirements into a usable enterprise information architecture, which may include an enterprise data model, common business vocabulary, ontology, and taxonomies, to guide enterprise solution development and achieve consistency of information assets.
  • Create an information architecture consistent with the business, application, and technical architectures.
  • Facilitate the mapping and traceability of information assets as they flow from source datastores to targets, thus ensuring optimal transparency, quality, consistency, and controlled redundancy.

Information Architecture Delivery: Work with and mentor delivery teams to provide data solutions that are in keeping with the enterprise information architecture. This may include:

  • Assessing suitability of vendor solutions to meet enterprise information requirements.
  • Construct, refine and maintain information models, as needed, to meet business requirements and drive data designs for operational and analytical solutions.
  • Facilitate the definition of integrative and canonical views of data or information across multiple content types to support convergence of information asset migration planning or impact analysis.
  • Ensure new development is consistent and well-integrated with the established enterprise information architecture, using metadata management and/or a repository to promote reuse and standards adoption.
  • Review corporate data sources for new business information and better data sources. Assist in post-implementation improvement efforts to enhance performance and provide increased functionality.
  • Participate in key project design reviews as part of the methodology process to ensure application designs adhere to enterprise information architecture guidelines.
  • Provide oversight for the BI Data Warehouse. Design an enterprise-wide integrated Data Warehouse for
  • Business Intelligence by modeling new and enhancing existing BIDW datamarts. Establish logical and physical models, maintain metadata, and guide integration engineers for the physical datamart schema and logical integration (ETL) processes. Assist, as required, with testing and issue resolution. Establish and enhance governance processes for the BI Data Warehouse (naming conventions, conformed dimensions and facts, meta-models, security configuration) to ensure a consistent implementation across all datamarts.
  • On large implementation projects, deliver project artifacts including: Data Integration Inventory, 360 Data Integration Diagram, Core structures diagram, Data Integration Requirements document and Test Plans, Report Inventory, Reporting Gap Analysis and Strategy, and Historical Data Strategy

Business Intelligence Team Leadership: Provide leadership, oversight, and quality assurance for BI Team and team deliverables. This may include:

  • Manage and coach BI team members in delivery of high-quality business intelligence solutions. Assist to estimate effort / duration for new requests and change orders. Track work queue, assign and adjust priorities and due dates based on client requirements and DT Leadership direction. Provide BI team with visibility to DT projects and project pipeline. Provide a forum for BI team collaboration on BI and Data Warehouse design and technical challenges.
  • Establish, document, and maintain best practices for Business Intelligence and Data Warehousing.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Analytics, Data/Information Science, Information Systems, Mathematics (or other related fields)
  • 6+ years of experience with SQL
  • 4+ years of experience in Business Intelligence, data analysis, and reporting
  • 4+ years of experience with Microsoft Power BI, including DAX, Power Query, and M language.
  • 2+ years of experience with Python (or other programming languages)
  • 4+ years of experience managing projects from inception to execution.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Microsoft Fabric Analytics Engineer certifications preferred.
  • Strong understanding of Data Warehousing and Business Intelligence concepts, Data Quality, and the related technology landscape, processes, and design principles
  • Proven track record in operating large data warehouse and business intelligence programs
  • Experience in managing enterprise data assets in a large, complex organization
  • Should be familiar with cloud and data management trends and methodologies
  • Ability to analyze complex situations and to derive workable actions
  • Ability to constructively challenge requirements and current state to increase overall value to the firm
  • Strong relationship building skills
  • Flexibility to adjust to multiple demands, shifting priorities, ambiguity, and rapid change
  • Good written and verbal communication
  • Strong analytical and time management skills
  • Strong facilitation skills with the ability to drive issues to closure
  • Self-motivated and able to handle tasks with minimal supervision or questions
  • Ability to compare technologies and make recommendations to senior members of the team
  • Understanding of privacy laws and regulations

#Remote

The application deadline for this role is 02/28/2027.

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Crowe, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $151,100.00 - $318,600.00 per year.

We will nurture your talent in an inclusive culture that values diversity. You will have the chance to meet on a consistent basis with your Career Coach that will guide you in your career goals and aspirations. Learn more about where talent can prosper!

As independent members of Crowe Global, Crowe LLP and Crowe Advisory LLC serve clients worldwide. (*As of July 2026)

Crowe LLP and Crowe Advisory LLC (and their respective subsidiary entities) provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetics, national origin, disability or protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

Crowe LLP and Crowe Advisory LLC (and their respective subsidiary entities) does not accept unsolicited candidates, referrals or resumes from any staffing agency, recruiting service, sourcing entity or any other third-party paid service at any time. Any referrals, resumes or candidates submitted to Crowe, or any employee or owner of Crowe without a pre-existing agreement signed by both parties covering the submission will be considered the property of Crowe, and free of charge.

Crowe will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance, San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, and the California Fair Chance Act.

Please visit our webpage to see notices of the various state and local Ban-the-Box laws and Fair Chance Ordinances, where applicable.

We are committed to a merit-based hiring process, evaluating all candidates consistently using objective, job-related criteria such as relevant experience, demonstrated skills, measurable impact, and alignment with the role’s responsibilities, and making employment decisions in a fair and inclusive manner free from discrimination.

  • Mentor and coach developers, data engineers, managers, and other roles within team, intentionally managing career growth via mentorship and proactive planning
  • Actively participate in and collaborate with technical guilds to further expose and align the firm on best practices
  • Understand when to delegate; this role manages resources and owns the entire team’s success
  • Responsibility to track and maintain clear visibility into the value and delivery timing of BIDW team initiatives for Head of Data and business stakeholders

DEMAND MANAGEMENT & BUSINESS ENGAGEMENT

  • Collaboration with Head of Data and/or other firm leaders to understand strategic business needs and requirements, and planning team and technology capacity accordingly
  • Communication and engagement to ensure the business sees maximum value from its data warehouse and business intelligence investments
  • Develop and maintain an understanding of business needs, technical architecture and systems landscape, and the technology strategy of the business
  • Collaborate with both BIDW team and Data Transformation leaders to establish goals, plan capacity, support other Data Transformation initiatives, and leave margin for learning and unexpected shifts

PROGRAM DESIGN, DEVELOPMENT & DEPLOYMENT

  • Ultimate ownership for team delivery quality and schedule
  • Work closely with technology and business personnel to deliver value in a timely manner
  • Accountability for team using best practices for development and quality assurance aligned with firmwide standards, seeking opportunities to automate and improve
  • CONTINUOUS IMPROVEMENT
  • Champion a culture and mindset of excellence, collaboration, continuous improvement, design thinking and positivity
  • Establish metrics to monitor and tangibly demonstrate the value provided to the business via effectiveness, quality metrics, sensitive data monitoring as well as alert to any negative trends in these areas
  • Work with stakeholders to prioritize continuous improvement
  • Assess and recommend opportunities to retire/consolidate redundant legacy system assets
  • ADOPTION & VALUE REALIZATION
  • Work with team and business users to ensure successful adoption, usage, and benefit realization from solutions
  • Define and track KPIs and success metrics for adoption and value creation

  • Translate strategic requirements into a usable enterprise information architecture, which may include an enterprise data model, common business vocabulary, ontology, and taxonomies, to guide enterprise solution development and achieve consistency of information assets.
  • Create an information architecture consistent with the business, application, and technical architectures.
  • Facilitate the mapping and traceability of information assets as they flow from source datastores to targets, thus ensuring optimal transparency, quality, consistency, and controlled redundancy.

Information Architecture Delivery: Work with and mentor delivery teams to provide data solutions that are in keeping with the enterprise information architecture. This may include:

  • Assessing suitability of vendor solutions to meet enterprise information requirements.
  • Construct, refine and maintain information models, as needed, to meet business requirements and drive data designs for operational and analytical solutions.
  • Facilitate the definition of integrative and canonical views of data or information across multiple content types to support convergence of information asset migration planning or impact analysis.
  • Ensure new development is consistent and well-integrated with the established enterprise information architecture, using metadata management and/or a repository to promote reuse and standards adoption.
  • Review corporate data sources for new business information and better data sources. Assist in post-implementation improvement efforts to enhance performance and provide increased functionality.
  • Participate in key project design reviews as part of the methodology process to ensure application designs adhere to enterprise information architecture guidelines.
  • Provide oversight for the BI Data Warehouse. Design an enterprise-wide integrated Data Warehouse for
  • Business Intelligence by modeling new and enhancing existing BIDW datamarts. Establish logical and physical models, maintain metadata, and guide integration engineers for the physical datamart schema and logical integration (ETL) processes. Assist, as required, with testing and issue resolution. Establish and enhance governance processes for the BI Data Warehouse (naming conventions, conformed dimensions and facts, meta-models, security configuration) to ensure a consistent implementation across all datamarts.
  • On large implementation projects, deliver project artifacts including: Data Integration Inventory, 360 Data Integration Diagram, Core structures diagram, Data Integration Requirements document and Test Plans, Report Inventory, Reporting Gap Analysis and Strategy, and Historical Data Strategy

Business Intelligence Team Leadership: Provide leadership, oversight, and quality assurance for BI Team and team deliverables. This may include:

  • Manage and coach BI team members in delivery of high-quality business intelligence solutions. Assist to estimate effort / duration for new requests and change orders. Track work queue, assign and adjust priorities and due dates based on client requirements and DT Leadership direction. Provide BI team with visibility to DT projects and project pipeline. Provide a forum for BI team collaboration on BI and Data Warehouse design and technical challenges.
  • Establish, document, and maintain best practices for Business Intelligence and Data Warehousing.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Analytics, Data/Information Science, Information Systems, Mathematics (or other related fields)
  • 6+ years of experience with SQL
  • 4+ years of experience in Business Intelligence, data analysis, and reporting
  • 4+ years of experience with Microsoft Power BI, including DAX, Power Query, and M language.
  • 2+ years of experience with Python (or other programming languages)
  • 4+ years of experience managing projects from inception to execution.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Microsoft Fabric Analytics Engineer certifications preferred.
  • Strong understanding of Data Warehousing and Business Intelligence concepts, Data Quality, and the related technology landscape, processes, and design principles
  • Proven track record in operating large data warehouse and business intelligence programs
  • Experience in managing enterprise data assets in a large, complex organization
  • Should be familiar with cloud and data management trends and methodologies
  • Ability to analyze complex situations and to derive workable actions
  • Ability to constructively challenge requirements and current state to increase overall value to the firm
  • Strong relationship building skills
  • Flexibility to adjust to multiple demands, shifting priorities, ambiguity, and rapid change
  • Good written and verbal communication
  • Strong analytical and time management skills
  • Strong facilitation skills with the ability to drive issues to closure
  • Self-motivated and able to handle tasks with minimal supervision or questions
  • Ability to compare technologies and make recommendations to senior members of the team
  • Understanding of privacy laws and regulations

Job Description

The Senior Data Architect will design and implement scalable data solutions using the latest and advanced technology and toolsets. This role offers the right candidate the rare opportunity to leverage their extensive background to design and architect scalable, secure, and modern cloud-native data solutions. The role will also be responsible for working closely with business partners and IT leadership to understand the organization's business requirements and work with the broader IT team to enable/build new capabilities in our data platform that will support the current needs and scale to accommodate future growth.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the design and architecture of end-to-end data solutions, translating business strategy and requirements into scalable, secure, high-performing architectures.
  • Define target-state data architectures and blueprints, including data flows, integration patterns, storage strategies, data processing, and consumption layers.
  • Establish and govern standard architecture patterns for data ingestion, transformation (ETL/ELT), integration, interoperability, and data sharing across platforms and domains.
  • Architect scalable and resilient data pipelines and workflows, optimizing for performance, cost, reliability, and operational efficiency.
  • Design cloud-native data architectures that leverage modern data platforms for elasticity, resilience, modularity, and scalability.
  • Enable AI/ML capabilities through data architectures that support experimentation, feature engineering, model development, deployment, and production consumption.
  • Incorporate data governance, security, privacy, and compliance by design, including access controls, data classification, masking, lineage, and regulatory requirements.
  • Design for interoperability and seamless data exchange across applications, data domains, platforms, and external systems.
  • Lead the evaluation and selection of data technologies and platforms in partnership with IT, Enterprise Architecture, and business stakeholders, ensuring alignment with enterprise capabilities and strategy.
  • Collaborate with Enterprise Architecture, Infrastructure, Application Development, Data Engineering, and business teams to define technology roadmaps, capabilities, and solution strategies.
  • Provide architectural oversight and governance for data solutions and cloud-native data platforms, ensuring adherence to enterprise standards and addressing risks, gaps, dependencies, and architectural trade-offs.
  • Drive innovation through feasibility assessments, POCs, and pilots, evaluating emerging technologies and validating new architectural approaches.
  • Provide architectural oversight for vendor and third-party data solutions, ensuring alignment with enterprise architecture, security, integration, and data standards.
  • Participate in architecture governance forums, contributing to design reviews, architecture decisions, approvals, and continuous improvement of enterprise data architecture.
  • Mentor and guide data architects and engineers, promoting architecture best practices, design excellence, and continued capability development.

Qualifications

  • 4+ years of experience in modern cloud data architecture or related fields, with a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related discipline.
  • Deep understanding of modern data and analytics platforms and technologies, including Snowflake, Matillion, Microsoft Fabric, Power BI, Tableau, and other industry-leading solutions.
  • Proven experience designing and delivering enterprise data solutions, including data warehousing, data lakes, lakehouse architectures, data management, integration, and analytics platforms.
  • Extensive experience architecting end-to-end, scalable data platforms using modern cloud technologies, preferably Microsoft Azure, with experience in cloud-native, hybrid, or multi-cloud architectures.
  • Strong ability to translate business requirements into scalable data architectures and solutions, with excellent communication skills to articulate complex technical concepts to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Strong understanding of data architecture patterns and technology capabilities across ingestion, storage, processing, analytics, APIs, and microservices, with the ability to evaluate and select appropriate technologies.
  • Experience collaborating with vendors and third-party partners to deliver solutions aligned with enterprise architecture, security, and data standards.
  • Strong foundation in data governance, data quality, security, privacy, and regulatory compliance within enterprise data environments.
  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to influence decisions, facilitate collaboration, and drive alignment across cross-functional teams.
  • Experience architecting data platforms that enable advanced analytics, AI/ML, MCP, and Generative AI use cases, while maintaining appropriate governance, security, scalability, and performance.

Base Pay Information

The national base pay range at the end is a good-faith estimate of what Delta Dental may pay for new hires. Actual pay may vary based on Delta Dental’s assessment of the candidate’s knowledge, skills, abilities (KSAs), related experience, education, certifications and ability to meet required minimum job qualifications. Other factors impacting pay include prevailing wages in the work location and internal equity.

Pay Grade 22. $92,500 - $200,400

Behind the smile! We are dedicated to safeguarding the health and financial stability of our employees and their loved ones. This commitment extends beyond the workplace to foster personal growth and holistic wellbeing. Our life-changing rewards package includes:

  • Competitive base and incentive pay
  • 401(k) with robust matching and non-matching contributions
  • Rich medical & pharmacy benefits
  • 100% employer-paid dental and vision benefits
  • Holistic wellbeing program with deep financial incentives
  • Generous paid time off plus 12 paid holidays and your birthday off
  • Culture of growth and learning: career development; tuition reimbursement; recognition program
  • Family support: adoption assistance, fertility treatment, child, elder & pet care assistance
  • Social responsibility and volunteer opportunities
  • Employee discount program

Fair Chance Ordinances and Criminal Background Considerations

This position requires that the applicant undergo a background check. Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with any applicable federal, state or local laws, including, but not limited to, the California Fair Chance Act, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance, the City of Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, and/or New York Corrections Law Article 23-A.

This role offers the right candidate the rare opportunity to leverage their extensive background to design and architect scalable, secure, and modern cloud-native data solutions. The role will also be responsible for working closely with business partners and IT leadership to understand the organization's business requirements and work with the broader IT team to enable/build new capabilities in our data platform that will support the current needs and scale to accommodate future growth.

Responsibilities



- Lead the design and architecture of end-to-end data solutions, translating business strategy and requirements into scalable, secure, high-performing architectures.
- Define target-state data architectures and blueprints, including data flows, integration patterns, storage strategies, data processing, and consumption layers.
- Establish and govern standard architecture patterns for data ingestion, transformation (ETL/ELT), integration, interoperability, and data sharing across platforms and domains.
- Architect scalable and resilient data pipelines and workflows, optimizing for performance, cost, reliability, and operational efficiency.
- Design cloud-native data architectures that leverage modern data platforms for elasticity, resilience, modularity, and scalability.
- Enable AI/ML capabilities through data architectures that support experimentation, feature engineering, model development, deployment, and production consumption.
- Incorporate data governance, security, privacy, and compliance by design, including access controls, data classification, masking, lineage, and regulatory requirements.
- Design for interoperability and seamless data exchange across applications, data domains, platforms, and external systems.
- Lead the evaluation and selection of data technologies and platforms in partnership with IT, Enterprise Architecture, and business stakeholders, ensuring alignment with enterprise capabilities and strategy.
- Collaborate with Enterprise Architecture, Infrastructure, Application Development, Data Engineering, and business teams to define technology roadmaps, capabilities, and solution strategies.
- Provide architectural oversight and governance for data solutions and cloud-native data platforms, ensuring adherence to enterprise standards and addressing risks, gaps, dependencies, and architectural trade-offs.
- Drive innovation through feasibility assessments, POCs, and pilots, evaluating emerging technologies and validating new architectural approaches.
- Provide architectural oversight for vendor and third-party data solutions, ensuring alignment with enterprise architecture, security, integration, and data standards.
- Participate in architecture governance forums, contributing to design reviews, architecture decisions, approvals, and continuous improvement of enterprise data architecture.
- Mentor and guide data architects and engineers, promoting architecture best practices, design excellence, and continued capability development.

Qualifications



- 4+ years of experience in modern cloud data architecture or related fields, with a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related discipline.
- Deep understanding of modern data and analytics platforms and technologies, including Snowflake, Matillion, Microsoft Fabric, Power BI, Tableau, and other industry-leading solutions.
- Proven experience designing and delivering enterprise data solutions, including data warehousing, data lakes, lakehouse architectures, data management, integration, and analytics platforms.
- Extensive experience architecting end-to-end, scalable data platforms using modern cloud technologies, preferably Microsoft Azure, with experience in cloud-native, hybrid, or multi-cloud architectures.
- Strong ability to translate business requirements into scalable data architectures and solutions, with excellent communication skills to articulate complex technical concepts to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
- Strong understanding of data architecture patterns and technology capabilities across ingestion, storage, processing, analytics, APIs, and microservices, with the ability to evaluate and select appropriate technologies.
- Experience collaborating with vendors and third-party partners to deliver solutions aligned with enterprise architecture, security, and data standards.
- Strong foundation in data governance, data quality, security, privacy, and regulatory compliance within enterprise data environments.
- Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to influence decisions, facilitate collaboration, and drive alignment across cross-functional teams.
- Experience architecting data platforms that enable advanced analytics, AI/ML, MCP, and Generative AI use cases, while maintaining appropriate governance, security, scalability, and performance.

Enterprise Data Architect

The Opportunity:

Define and own the enterprise data architecture vision, roadmap, and standards, aligned to long-term business goals. Lead Enterprise Data Model strategy and Operational Data Store design. Establish data governance processes, modeling standards, and data quality procedures. Serve as the in-house data authority and enforce integration standards, documentation, and best practices. Lead the phased migration from legacy Sybase to a modern AWS microservices architecture, such as PostgreSQL Aurora, DMS, or Lambda, including live system synchronization strategies. Evaluate and adopt emerging technologies that advance the data architecture practice. Communicate architecture decisions clearly to both technical and business audiences. May supervise other architects and technical staff.

You Have:

  • 6+ years of experience in data architecture, data modeling, and database design
  • Experience in Sybase or PostgreSQL
  • Experience with AWS, including Aurora, RDS, DMS, or Lambda
  • Experience with data modeling tools, including ERStudio, ERWIN, or PowerDesigner
  • Experience executing phased migrations with live system synchronization and designing and implementing data synchronization strategies across heterogeneous systems, including interim sync patterns during active migrations
  • Experience using AI-assisted development tools to support coding, code review, and problem-solving
  • Knowledge of microservices architecture
  • Ability to stay current on emerging technologies and applies them to new and existing systems
  • Ability to obtain and maintain a Public Trust or Suitability/Fitness determination based on client requirements
