About Northern Trust


As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.


Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.


With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.



We are seeking an experienced Data Architect to lead the data architecture strategy for our Securities Services organization. This role will be responsible for designing and governing the enterprise data landscape across key business domains including Custody, Settlements, Entitlements, Reconciliations, Regulatory Reporting, and Asset Servicing.

The successful candidate will partner with business, product, engineering, and architecture teams to establish scalable data models, data products, governance frameworks, and integration patterns that enable modernization, real-time processing, analytics, and cloud adoption. The role will play a critical part in transforming legacy platforms into a modern, event-driven and data-centric ecosystem


Key Responsibilities

  • Define and maintain the target-state data architecture for the Securities Services portfolio.
  • Develop enterprise, domain, and canonical data models that support strategic business capabilities.
  • Establish data architecture standards, design principles, and governance frameworks.
  • Drive Data Mesh, data product, metadata, lineage, and data quality strategies across business domains include working with COO/AS CDO.
  • Design scalable integration patterns leveraging event-driven architecture, APIs, and cloud-native technologies.
  • Partner with business and technology stakeholders to align data strategy with business priorities and modernization initiatives.
  • Ensure data platforms support operational, analytical, regulatory, and client reporting needs.
  • Lead data architecture reviews and provide guidance on strategic programs, platform investments, and solution designs.
  • Promote reuse, simplification, and standardization of data assets across the enterprise.
  • Support regulatory, risk, audit, security, and compliance requirements through robust data controls and governance practices.


Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information System, Engineering, or a related discipline.
  • 10+ years of experience in Data Architecture, Information Architecture, Data Management, or related roles.
  • Strong knowledge of Securities Services, Custody, Settlements, Accounting, Reconciliations, Asset Servicing, or Capital Markets operations.
  • Expertise in data modeling, data governance, metadata management, reference/master data, and data quality frameworks.
  • Experience designing cloud-based data platforms, data lakes/lakehouses, and event-driven architectures.
  • Strong understanding of modern integration patterns including APIs, messaging, and streaming technologies.
  • Proven ability to influence senior business and technology leaders and drive enterprise-wide architectural decisions.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Data Mesh and domain-driven data architectures.
  • Experience with Azure cloud technologies, Databricks, Kafka, Solace, and modern data platforms.
  • Familiarity with financial services regulatory and data management requirements.
  • Experience supporting large-scale transformation and modernization programs.


Success Measures

  • Adoption of standardized data models and architecture patterns across Securities Services.
  • Improved data quality, lineage, governance, and transparency.
  • Increased reuse of data products and reduced duplication of data assets.
  • Simplified integration landscape and reduced operational complexity.
  • Successful enablement of real-time and analytics-driven business capabilities.
  • Delivery of a scalable and strategic data foundation supporting business growth and modernization objectives.


This role offers the opportunity to shape the future data ecosystem for a large-scale Securities Services organization and drive the transformation toward a modern, data-driven operating model.


Salary range is a good faith estimate of base pay. Northern Trust provides a comprehensive benefits package including retirement benefits (401k and pension), health and welfare benefits (medical, dental, vision, spending accounts and disability), paid time off, parental and caregiver leave, life & accident insurance, and other voluntary and well-being benefits. Northern Trust also provides a discretionary bonus program that may include an equity component.


Work Authorization


Applicants must be authorized to work in the U.S. without the need for employment-based visa sponsorship now or in the future. Northern Trust will not sponsor applicants for U.S. work visa status for this opportunity (no sponsorship is available for H-1B, L-1, TN, O-1, E-3, H-1B1, F-1, J-1, OPT, CPT or any other employment-based visa).


Working with Us


As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.


Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities.

Job Description

Join the team that assesses current state and target state plans for consolidation to the strategic data lake, adoption of core data technologies for application development, and defining data standards across a portfolio of applications serving the Compliance, Oversight, and Governance businesses.

As a Lead Data Architect, within Corporate Technology, you will provide expertise to develop and enhance the data architecture of multiple applications in their journey to modernize to cloud-based technologies.

Job Responsibilities

  • Drive the Data Architecture principles and framework to enforce and strengthen the overall data environment for the portfolio of applications
  • Own and evolve database standards, including database choice and sensible defaults in collaboration with application architects for the portfolio applications
  • Drive adoption of the strategic lake by designing target state data architectures to reduce the presence of bespoke data applications holding large amounts of duplicate data
  • Define data processing patterns and standards for data exchange between applications including streaming, API, and batch based interactions
  • Serves as the function's go-to subject matter expert for data architecture needs across 100+ applications
  • Mentors and coaches junior architects and technologists regarding data practices, modeling, design, and storage
  • Champions the firm's culture of diversity, opportunity, inclusion, and respect

Required Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills

  • 10+ years of related experience in data architecture roles; Experience with various data modeling techniques and tools related to data across both OLTP and OLAP patterns
  • Deep knowledge of data architecture, best practices, and industry trends for modern data needs and proven ability to work in a multi-national, geographically distributed team
  • Deep knowledge in one or more cloud based databases, such as Postgres or Cockroach DB, or data lake platforms such as Databricks or Snowflake
  • Proven ability to set standards, and write Architecture Decision Records to set the north star vision, and evangelize across many application teams
  • Broad expertise in data technologies; i.e. data processing, data quality concepts, Business Intelligence and analytical tools, unstructured data, machine learning
  • Experience with data governance frameworks, data catalogs, data vocabularies, and data classification needs
  • Cloud fundamentals, AWS (preferred) or other public cloud platforms

Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills

  • Advanced analytical thinking and problem-solving skills
  • Experience with alternative data platforms such as graph databases or graph based data.
  • Familiar with Large Language Models (LLMs) and prompt engineering

We are CNN. The world’s most essential and engaging source of digital news. We are in the midst of rapid transformation and are looking for the next generation of innovators, makers, and dreamers to help lead our growth and shape the future of news.

Your New Role…
The Staff Data Architect plays a critical, hands‑on role in evolving and strengthening CNN’s modern data ecosystem. This is a platform‑focused role for a senior technologist who thrives at scale—designing and implementing robust, performant, and governed data architecture that powers analytics, reporting, and decision‑making across the organization.


You’ll combine deep technical expertise with practical leadership, helping define architecture and modeling standards, mentoring engineers and analysts, and partnering closely with platform and analytics teams to deliver reliable, scalable data systems. This role is ideal for someone passionate about improving time‑to‑insight, driving metric consistency, and building trusted semantic data models across a high‑impact analytics platform.

Your Role Accountabilities…

  • Design and implement scalable data architecture patterns on Snowflake to support high‑volume event and analytics workloads, with a strong focus on performance, security, and cost efficiency through query optimization, warehouse sizing, storage management, and governance best practices.

  • Lead the technical design and implementation of complex data systems and platform enhancements, establishing and maintaining architecture and data modeling standards that promote consistency, scalability, and reliability across Snowflake and dbt workflows.

  • Define and implement secure, scalable data access patterns, leveraging role‑based access control and managed access schemas to ensure data is governed, auditable, and accessible to the right audiences.

  • Design and operate data quality and observability frameworks, using dbt tests and monitoring tools to track pipeline health, latency, and freshness, and to continuously improve platform reliability and operational visibility.

  • Partner closely with platform engineering and analytics teams to improve system reliability, scalability, and operational efficiency, contributing to platform architecture planning and technical roadmaps.

  • Translate complex analytics and business requirements into clean, well‑governed semantic data models that enable trusted self‑service analytics and consistent metrics across BI tools.

  • Define and implement data lifecycle and retention strategies that balance performance, cost efficiency, compliance, and data availability across the analytics platform.

  • Act as a technical mentor and thought leader, helping grow the skills of engineers and analysts and raising the overall bar for data architecture and engineering practices.



Qualifications & Experience…

  • 5–8 years of experience in data engineering, data architecture, or a related field, with demonstrated ownership of production data systems or platform components.

  • Deep expertise in cloud data warehousing, with hands‑on experience in Snowflake, including performance tuning, security design, cost optimization, and large‑scale data modeling.

  • Strong experience designing and maintaining dbt‑based transformation workflows, including testing, performance optimization, and deployment best practices.

  • Experience working with event or clickstream data, ideally using Snowplow or comparable technologies, and a strong understanding of instrumentation and processing challenges at scale.

  • Proven ability to design and implement semantic layers and analytics‑ready data models that serve as a trusted source of truth for BI tools such as Looker, Tableau, or Domo.

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder engagement skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to non‑technical audiences, influence architectural decisions, and build alignment across teams.


Nice to Haves…

  • Experience with Customer Data Platforms (CDPs).

  • Experience with data orchestration tools such as Airflow or Dagster.

  • Familiarity with data privacy and compliance requirements (e.g., GDPR, CCPA).

  • Experience working in the media, publishing, or digital content industry.

Skydance is a next-generation global media and entertainment company, comprised of three business segments: Studios, Direct-to-Consumer, and TV Media. Skydance's portfolio unites legendary brands, including Paramount, Warner Bros., HBO and HBO Max, Paramount+, Pluto TV, CBS, CNN, CBS Sports, TNT Sports, Nickelodeon, Cartoon Network, MTV, Food Network, BET, HGTV, and Comedy Central.

We embrace the opportunity to build a workforce that reflects a wide array of perspectives, backgrounds and experiences. Job Description:

What You’ll Do

Enterprise Information Architect & BIDW Leader will establish and deliver upon the enterprise information architecture vision for enterprise-level solutions. This role is responsible for the delivery of business Intelligence & data warehouse solutions to the firm, including the information architecture and management processes of the BI data warehouse and leading the BI function and team.

Responsibilities

LEADERSHIP

  • Ownership of and accountability for successful results of the Data Warehouse & Business Intelligence teams within Data Transformation.
  • Thought leadership in matters of enterprise data architecture, staying abreast of new technologies, patterns and methods which c an be applicable to Crowe data
  • Development of team strategy, creation and socialization of roadmaps, establishing and ensuring adherence to timelines, and resource assignment for the BIDW team
  • Seek opportunities to bring value to the Crowe business and/or its customers through innovative enterprise data and BI strategies to support strategic business goals
  • Develop quantifiable goals for the team which are aligned with Data Transformation’s strategic goals as well as Crowe’s strategic business initiatives
  • Mentor and coach developers, data engineers, managers, and other roles within team, intentionally managing career growth via mentorship and proactive planning
  • Actively participate in and collaborate with technical guilds to further expose and align the firm on best practices
  • Understand when to delegate; this role manages resources and owns the entire team’s success
  • Responsibility to track and maintain clear visibility into the value and delivery timing of BIDW team initiatives for Head of Data and business stakeholders

DEMAND MANAGEMENT & BUSINESS ENGAGEMENT

  • Collaboration with Head of Data and/or other firm leaders to understand strategic business needs and requirements, and planning team and technology capacity accordingly
  • Communication and engagement to ensure the business sees maximum value from its data warehouse and business intelligence investments
  • Develop and maintain an understanding of business needs, technical architecture and systems landscape, and the technology strategy of the business
  • Collaborate with both BIDW team and Data Transformation leaders to establish goals, plan capacity, support other Data Transformation initiatives, and leave margin for learning and unexpected shifts

PROGRAM DESIGN, DEVELOPMENT & DEPLOYMENT

  • Ultimate ownership for team delivery quality and schedule
  • Work closely with technology and business personnel to deliver value in a timely manner
  • Accountability for team using best practices for development and quality assurance aligned with firmwide standards, seeking opportunities to automate and improve
  • CONTINUOUS IMPROVEMENT
  • Champion a culture and mindset of excellence, collaboration, continuous improvement, design thinking and positivity
  • Establish metrics to monitor and tangibly demonstrate the value provided to the business via effectiveness, quality metrics, sensitive data monitoring as well as alert to any negative trends in these areas
  • Work with stakeholders to prioritize continuous improvement
  • Assess and recommend opportunities to retire/consolidate redundant legacy system assets
  • ADOPTION & VALUE REALIZATION
  • Work with team and business users to ensure successful adoption, usage, and benefit realization from solutions
  • Define and track KPIs and success metrics for adoption and value creation

Specific responsibility expectations by the components listed below –

Information Architecture Vision: Establish the Enterprise Information Architecture vision within the context of business strategy and in alignment with overall Technology & Strategy direction.

  • Translate strategic requirements into a usable enterprise information architecture, which may include an enterprise data model, common business vocabulary, ontology, and taxonomies, to guide enterprise solution development and achieve consistency of information assets.
  • Create an information architecture consistent with the business, application, and technical architectures.
  • Facilitate the mapping and traceability of information assets as they flow from source datastores to targets, thus ensuring optimal transparency, quality, consistency, and controlled redundancy.

Information Architecture Delivery: Work with and mentor delivery teams to provide data solutions that are in keeping with the enterprise information architecture. This may include:

  • Assessing suitability of vendor solutions to meet enterprise information requirements.
  • Construct, refine and maintain information models, as needed, to meet business requirements and drive data designs for operational and analytical solutions.
  • Facilitate the definition of integrative and canonical views of data or information across multiple content types to support convergence of information asset migration planning or impact analysis.
  • Ensure new development is consistent and well-integrated with the established enterprise information architecture, using metadata management and/or a repository to promote reuse and standards adoption.
  • Review corporate data sources for new business information and better data sources. Assist in post-implementation improvement efforts to enhance performance and provide increased functionality.
  • Participate in key project design reviews as part of the methodology process to ensure application designs adhere to enterprise information architecture guidelines.
  • Provide oversight for the BI Data Warehouse. Design an enterprise-wide integrated Data Warehouse for
  • Business Intelligence by modeling new and enhancing existing BIDW datamarts. Establish logical and physical models, maintain metadata, and guide integration engineers for the physical datamart schema and logical integration (ETL) processes. Assist, as required, with testing and issue resolution. Establish and enhance governance processes for the BI Data Warehouse (naming conventions, conformed dimensions and facts, meta-models, security configuration) to ensure a consistent implementation across all datamarts.
  • On large implementation projects, deliver project artifacts including: Data Integration Inventory, 360 Data Integration Diagram, Core structures diagram, Data Integration Requirements document and Test Plans, Report Inventory, Reporting Gap Analysis and Strategy, and Historical Data Strategy

Business Intelligence Team Leadership: Provide leadership, oversight, and quality assurance for BI Team and team deliverables. This may include:

  • Manage and coach BI team members in delivery of high-quality business intelligence solutions. Assist to estimate effort / duration for new requests and change orders. Track work queue, assign and adjust priorities and due dates based on client requirements and DT Leadership direction. Provide BI team with visibility to DT projects and project pipeline. Provide a forum for BI team collaboration on BI and Data Warehouse design and technical challenges.
  • Establish, document, and maintain best practices for Business Intelligence and Data Warehousing.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Analytics, Data/Information Science, Information Systems, Mathematics (or other related fields)
  • 6+ years of experience with SQL
  • 4+ years of experience in Business Intelligence, data analysis, and reporting
  • 4+ years of experience with Microsoft Power BI, including DAX, Power Query, and M language.
  • 2+ years of experience with Python (or other programming languages)
  • 4+ years of experience managing projects from inception to execution.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Microsoft Fabric Analytics Engineer certifications preferred.
  • Strong understanding of Data Warehousing and Business Intelligence concepts, Data Quality, and the related technology landscape, processes, and design principles
  • Proven track record in operating large data warehouse and business intelligence programs
  • Experience in managing enterprise data assets in a large, complex organization
  • Should be familiar with cloud and data management trends and methodologies
  • Ability to analyze complex situations and to derive workable actions
  • Ability to constructively challenge requirements and current state to increase overall value to the firm
  • Strong relationship building skills
  • Flexibility to adjust to multiple demands, shifting priorities, ambiguity, and rapid change
  • Good written and verbal communication
  • Strong analytical and time management skills
  • Strong facilitation skills with the ability to drive issues to closure
  • Self-motivated and able to handle tasks with minimal supervision or questions
  • Ability to compare technologies and make recommendations to senior members of the team
  • Understanding of privacy laws and regulations

- Understand when to delegate; this role manages resources and owns the entire team’s success
- Responsibility to track and maintain clear visibility into the value and delivery timing of BIDW team initiatives for Head of Data and business stakeholders

DEMAND MANAGEMENT & BUSINESS ENGAGEMENT



- Collaboration with Head of Data and/or other firm leaders to understand strategic business needs and requirements, and planning team and technology capacity accordingly
- Communication and engagement to ensure the business sees maximum value from its data warehouse and business intelligence investments
- Develop and maintain an understanding of business needs, technical architecture and systems landscape, and the technology strategy of the business
- Collaborate with both BIDW team and Data Transformation leaders to establish goals, plan capacity, support other Data Transformation initiatives, and leave margin for learning and unexpected shifts

- Ultimate ownership for team delivery quality and schedule
- Work closely with technology and business personnel to deliver value in a timely manner
- Accountability for team using best practices for development and quality assurance aligned with firmwide standards, seeking opportunities to automate and improve

- Assessing suitability of vendor solutions to meet enterprise information requirements.

- 6+ years of experience with SQL
- 4+ years of experience in Business Intelligence, data analysis, and reporting
- 4+ years of experience with Microsoft Power BI, including DAX, Power Query, and M language. 
- 2+ years of experience with Python (or other programming languages)
- 4+ years of experience managing projects from inception to execution.

- Microsoft Fabric Analytics Engineer certifications preferred. 
- Strong understanding of Data Warehousing and Business Intelligence concepts, Data Quality, and the related technology landscape, processes, and design principles
- Proven track record in operating large data warehouse and business intelligence programs
- Experience in managing enterprise data assets in a large, complex organization
- Should be familiar with cloud and data management trends and methodologies
- Ability to analyze complex situations and to derive workable actions
- Ability to constructively challenge requirements and current state to increase overall value to the firm
- Strong relationship building skills
- Flexibility to adjust to multiple demands, shifting priorities, ambiguity, and rapid change
- Good written and verbal communication
- Strong analytical and time management skills
- Strong facilitation skills with the ability to drive issues to closure
- Self-motivated and able to handle tasks with minimal supervision or questions
- Ability to compare technologies and make recommendations to senior members of the team
- Understanding of privacy laws and regulations

Job Description

You'll own data architecture solutions to deliver high-quality, governed, AI-ready data for business-critical applications and use cases. You'll leverage AI to automate data architecture design workflows and deliver “Data Architecture as a Product”. If you enjoy turning complexity into clarity—and making data easier to discover, understand, and use—this role offers high visibility and strong growth opportunities.

Job Summary

As a Lead Data Architect in our wealth management data architecture team, you define the conceptual, logical, and physical data models for domains and data products. You create and maintain data models, taxonomies, business glossaries, metadata, and a semantic layer so teams can build analytics and artificial intelligence solutions with confidence. You partner with stakeholders to align on canonical business concepts, stable identifiers, and clear definitions that make data easier to find, interpret, and govern. You help shape the target-state architecture by setting standards that enable interoperability and sustainable evolution over time.

Job Responsibilities

  • Engage engineering teams and business stakeholders to propose data-architecture approaches that meet current and future needs
  • Define the target-state data architecture for owned data products and drive delivery against the strategy
  • Participate in data-architecture governance forums and ensure alignment to standards and controls
  • Design and troubleshoot architecture solutions, applying creative thinking beyond routine or conventional approaches to solve complex technical problems
  • Own conceptual, logical, and physical data models for wealth management domains, including keys, relationships, and lifecycle states
  • Define canonical business concepts and relationships, including conformed dimensions and standardized measures (for example, assets under management and net flows)
  • Produce and maintain metadata artifacts (business glossary, taxonomy, semantic/context layer mappings, naming standards, modeling conventions) and embed them into data mesh delivery processes
  • Design for AI readiness: Ensure models support analytics/AI use: stable identifiers, entity resolution approach, history (SCD/event modeling), feature-friendly structures, and clear semantics for retrieval and grounding
  • Establish patterns for schema evolution, versioning, deprecation, and backward compatibility across platforms (warehouse, lakehouse, application programming interfaces, business intelligence)

Required Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills

  • (Option A — regions where years are permitted) 5+ years of experience or equivalent expertise in data design for data products, data lakes, or data warehouses
  • (Option B — EMEA-style) Demonstrable experience in data design for data products, data lakes, or data warehouses
  • Advanced knowledge of data-product development lifecycles, design practices, and analytics within a domain-driven, data mesh paradigm
  • Demonstrable data modeling experience with ability to move from conceptual to logical to physical implementation
  • Practical cloud-native experience in designing and delivering data solutions
  • Experience defining and maintaining metadata (for example, glossary terms, definitions, and mappings) with governance discipline
  • Ability to partner effectively with business stakeholders and technical teams to translate requirements into durable data designs
  • Familiarity with using automation or artificial intelligence tools to improve documentation quality, metadata coverage, or design workflows

Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills

  • Experience working in a highly matrixed, complex organization
  • Wealth management domain expertise, especially client onboarding and lifecycle processes (for example, customer relationship management, know your customer, onboarding, client servicing)
  • Strong data profiling and analytics fluency, including SQL skills
  • Experience with graph data modeling or graph database design
  • Risk and privacy awareness (for example, entitlements, data minimization, data classification) and ability to partner effectively with controls teams

JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. We also offer a range of benefits and programs to meet employee needs, based on eligibility. These benefits include comprehensive health care coverage, on-site health and wellness centers, a retirement savings plan, backup childcare, tuition reimbursement, mental health support, financial coaching and more. Additional details about total compensation and benefits will be provided during the hiring process.

We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Job Description

Roles & Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

Data Architecture & Design

  • Define and own the enterprise data architecture aligned with business strategy and cloud-first principles.
  • Design and implement AWS-based data lake architectures, leveraging Medallion Architecture (Bronze, Silver, Gold layers).
  • Establish standards for data modeling (conceptual, logical, and physical) for analytical and reporting workloads.
  • Drive architectural decisions for batch and near–real-time data processing.

AWS & Cloud Technologies

  • Architect solutions using AWS services such as:
  • S3, Glue, Athena, Redshift, Lake Formation
  • EMR, Lambda, Step Functions
  • Kinesis / MSK (streaming, where applicable)
  • Ensure architectures are secure, scalable, cost-optimized, and highly available.
  • Collaborate with cloud platform teams to align on networking, IAM, encryption, and governance.

Data Engineering & Integration

  • Guide data ingestion patterns from multiple sources (operational systems, SaaS platforms, APIs, streaming sources).
  • Define standards for ETL/ELT pipelines, orchestration, and data quality frameworks.
  • Partner with Data Engineering teams to ensure architectural integrity during implementation.

Business Intelligence & Analytics

  • Enable BI and analytics platforms (e.g., Power BI, Tableau, QuickSight) through optimized data models and semantic layers.
  • Design Gold-layer datasets optimized for reporting, dashboards, and advanced analytics.
  • Ensure consistency and reliability of enterprise KPIs and metrics.

Governance, Quality & Security

  • Establish data governance principles including metadata management, lineage, cataloging, and stewardship.
  • Define data quality rules, monitoring, and remediation processes.
  • Ensure compliance with enterprise security, privacy, and regulatory requirements.

Leadership & Collaboration

  • Act as a trusted advisor to business and technology leadership.
  • Review and approve solution designs, ensuring alignment with target architecture.
  • Mentor data engineers, analysts, and junior architects.
  • Contribute to roadmap planning and modernization initiatives.

Salary Range-$100,000-$150,000 a year

Job Description:

What You’ll Do

Enterprise Information Architect & BIDW Leader will establish and deliver upon the enterprise information architecture vision for enterprise-level solutions. This role is responsible for the delivery of business Intelligence & data warehouse solutions to the firm, including the information architecture and management processes of the BI data warehouse and leading the BI function and team.

Responsibilities

LEADERSHIP

  • Ownership of and accountability for successful results of the Data Warehouse & Business Intelligence teams within Data Transformation.
  • Thought leadership in matters of enterprise data architecture, staying abreast of new technologies, patterns and methods which c an be applicable to Crowe data
  • Development of team strategy, creation and socialization of roadmaps, establishing and ensuring adherence to timelines, and resource assignment for the BIDW team
  • Seek opportunities to bring value to the Crowe business and/or its customers through innovative enterprise data and BI strategies to support strategic business goals
  • Develop quantifiable goals for the team which are aligned with Data Transformation’s strategic goals as well as Crowe’s strategic business initiatives
  • Mentor and coach developers, data engineers, managers, and other roles within team, intentionally managing career growth via mentorship and proactive planning
  • Actively participate in and collaborate with technical guilds to further expose and align the firm on best practices
  • Understand when to delegate; this role manages resources and owns the entire team’s success
  • Responsibility to track and maintain clear visibility into the value and delivery timing of BIDW team initiatives for Head of Data and business stakeholders

DEMAND MANAGEMENT & BUSINESS ENGAGEMENT

  • Collaboration with Head of Data and/or other firm leaders to understand strategic business needs and requirements, and planning team and technology capacity accordingly
  • Communication and engagement to ensure the business sees maximum value from its data warehouse and business intelligence investments
  • Develop and maintain an understanding of business needs, technical architecture and systems landscape, and the technology strategy of the business
  • Collaborate with both BIDW team and Data Transformation leaders to establish goals, plan capacity, support other Data Transformation initiatives, and leave margin for learning and unexpected shifts

PROGRAM DESIGN, DEVELOPMENT & DEPLOYMENT

  • Ultimate ownership for team delivery quality and schedule
  • Work closely with technology and business personnel to deliver value in a timely manner
  • Accountability for team using best practices for development and quality assurance aligned with firmwide standards, seeking opportunities to automate and improve
  • CONTINUOUS IMPROVEMENT
  • Champion a culture and mindset of excellence, collaboration, continuous improvement, design thinking and positivity
  • Establish metrics to monitor and tangibly demonstrate the value provided to the business via effectiveness, quality metrics, sensitive data monitoring as well as alert to any negative trends in these areas
  • Work with stakeholders to prioritize continuous improvement
  • Assess and recommend opportunities to retire/consolidate redundant legacy system assets
  • ADOPTION & VALUE REALIZATION
  • Work with team and business users to ensure successful adoption, usage, and benefit realization from solutions
  • Define and track KPIs and success metrics for adoption and value creation

Specific responsibility expectations by the components listed below –

Information Architecture Vision: Establish the Enterprise Information Architecture vision within the context of business strategy and in alignment with overall Technology & Strategy direction.

  • Translate strategic requirements into a usable enterprise information architecture, which may include an enterprise data model, common business vocabulary, ontology, and taxonomies, to guide enterprise solution development and achieve consistency of information assets.
  • Create an information architecture consistent with the business, application, and technical architectures.
  • Facilitate the mapping and traceability of information assets as they flow from source datastores to targets, thus ensuring optimal transparency, quality, consistency, and controlled redundancy.

Information Architecture Delivery: Work with and mentor delivery teams to provide data solutions that are in keeping with the enterprise information architecture. This may include:

  • Assessing suitability of vendor solutions to meet enterprise information requirements.
  • Construct, refine and maintain information models, as needed, to meet business requirements and drive data designs for operational and analytical solutions.
  • Facilitate the definition of integrative and canonical views of data or information across multiple content types to support convergence of information asset migration planning or impact analysis.
  • Ensure new development is consistent and well-integrated with the established enterprise information architecture, using metadata management and/or a repository to promote reuse and standards adoption.
  • Review corporate data sources for new business information and better data sources. Assist in post-implementation improvement efforts to enhance performance and provide increased functionality.
  • Participate in key project design reviews as part of the methodology process to ensure application designs adhere to enterprise information architecture guidelines.
  • Provide oversight for the BI Data Warehouse. Design an enterprise-wide integrated Data Warehouse for
  • Business Intelligence by modeling new and enhancing existing BIDW datamarts. Establish logical and physical models, maintain metadata, and guide integration engineers for the physical datamart schema and logical integration (ETL) processes. Assist, as required, with testing and issue resolution. Establish and enhance governance processes for the BI Data Warehouse (naming conventions, conformed dimensions and facts, meta-models, security configuration) to ensure a consistent implementation across all datamarts.
  • On large implementation projects, deliver project artifacts including: Data Integration Inventory, 360 Data Integration Diagram, Core structures diagram, Data Integration Requirements document and Test Plans, Report Inventory, Reporting Gap Analysis and Strategy, and Historical Data Strategy

Business Intelligence Team Leadership: Provide leadership, oversight, and quality assurance for BI Team and team deliverables. This may include:

  • Manage and coach BI team members in delivery of high-quality business intelligence solutions. Assist to estimate effort / duration for new requests and change orders. Track work queue, assign and adjust priorities and due dates based on client requirements and DT Leadership direction. Provide BI team with visibility to DT projects and project pipeline. Provide a forum for BI team collaboration on BI and Data Warehouse design and technical challenges.
  • Establish, document, and maintain best practices for Business Intelligence and Data Warehousing.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Analytics, Data/Information Science, Information Systems, Mathematics (or other related fields)
  • 6+ years of experience with SQL
  • 4+ years of experience in Business Intelligence, data analysis, and reporting
  • 4+ years of experience with Microsoft Power BI, including DAX, Power Query, and M language.
  • 2+ years of experience with Python (or other programming languages)
  • 4+ years of experience managing projects from inception to execution.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Microsoft Fabric Analytics Engineer certifications preferred.
  • Strong understanding of Data Warehousing and Business Intelligence concepts, Data Quality, and the related technology landscape, processes, and design principles
  • Proven track record in operating large data warehouse and business intelligence programs
  • Experience in managing enterprise data assets in a large, complex organization
  • Should be familiar with cloud and data management trends and methodologies
  • Ability to analyze complex situations and to derive workable actions
  • Ability to constructively challenge requirements and current state to increase overall value to the firm
  • Strong relationship building skills
  • Flexibility to adjust to multiple demands, shifting priorities, ambiguity, and rapid change
  • Good written and verbal communication
  • Strong analytical and time management skills
  • Strong facilitation skills with the ability to drive issues to closure
  • Self-motivated and able to handle tasks with minimal supervision or questions
  • Ability to compare technologies and make recommendations to senior members of the team
  • Understanding of privacy laws and regulations

As a Applied AI Health Data Architect you will shape data architecture solutions that support health services provider clients, bringing together data engineering, analytics, and AI to improve how information is structured, integrated, and used across cloud environments. As a Senior Manager you will lead large projects, bring strategic direction to complex data modernization efforts, and use sound judgment to guide teams and stakeholders through changing priorities and technical complexity. In this role at PwC, you will work within our Advisory practice and within our Data, Analytics & AI services to design data platforms, support cloud-native architecture decisions, and contribute to delivery across AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud Platform environments for health sector clients.

Responsibilities

  • Leading applied AI and health data architecture initiatives for provider data environments, translating business goals into scalable data solutions
  • Designing cloud-native data platforms, pipelines, and integration patterns across AWS, Azure, Databricks, and Snowflake
  • Developing data models, warehouse structures, and transformation logic that support analytics, AI workloads, and operational reporting
  • Guiding data modernization efforts that migrate legacy systems into modern architectures with improved performance, security, and usability
  • Overseeing data quality, validation, governance, and anonymization practices across sensitive health data domains
  • Applying data engineering methods to tune pipelines, optimize queries, and improve database and warehouse performance
  • Advising client stakeholders on data strategy, architecture decisions, and AI-ready platform design within complex provider environments
  • Leading teams through delivery planning, issue resolution, and technical coordination across multiple workstreams
  • Coaching practitioners on data engineering platforms, digital tooling, and AI-enabled solution delivery
  • Presenting solution options, tradeoffs, and implementation paths that support modernization priorities and future data capabilities

What You Must Have

  • At least a Bachelor's degree
  • At least 7 years of experience

Join us at Crowe and embark on a career where you can help shape the future of our industry.

Job Description:

What You’ll Do

Enterprise Information Architect & BIDW Leader will establish and deliver upon the enterprise information architecture vision for enterprise-level solutions. This role is responsible for the delivery of business Intelligence & data warehouse solutions to the firm, including the information architecture and management processes of the BI data warehouse and leading the BI function and team.

Responsibilities

LEADERSHIP

  • Ownership of and accountability for successful results of the Data Warehouse & Business Intelligence teams within Data Transformation.
  • Thought leadership in matters of enterprise data architecture, staying abreast of new technologies, patterns and methods which c an be applicable to Crowe data
  • Development of team strategy, creation and socialization of roadmaps, establishing and ensuring adherence to timelines, and resource assignment for the BIDW team
  • Seek opportunities to bring value to the Crowe business and/or its customers through innovative enterprise data and BI strategies to support strategic business goals
  • Develop quantifiable goals for the team which are aligned with Data Transformation’s strategic goals as well as Crowe’s strategic business initiatives
  • Mentor and coach developers, data engineers, managers, and other roles within team, intentionally managing career growth via mentorship and proactive planning
  • Actively participate in and collaborate with technical guilds to further expose and align the firm on best practices
  • Understand when to delegate; this role manages resources and owns the entire team’s success
  • Responsibility to track and maintain clear visibility into the value and delivery timing of BIDW team initiatives for Head of Data and business stakeholders

DEMAND MANAGEMENT & BUSINESS ENGAGEMENT

  • Collaboration with Head of Data and/or other firm leaders to understand strategic business needs and requirements, and planning team and technology capacity accordingly
  • Communication and engagement to ensure the business sees maximum value from its data warehouse and business intelligence investments
  • Develop and maintain an understanding of business needs, technical architecture and systems landscape, and the technology strategy of the business
  • Collaborate with both BIDW team and Data Transformation leaders to establish goals, plan capacity, support other Data Transformation initiatives, and leave margin for learning and unexpected shifts

PROGRAM DESIGN, DEVELOPMENT & DEPLOYMENT

  • Ultimate ownership for team delivery quality and schedule
  • Work closely with technology and business personnel to deliver value in a timely manner
  • Accountability for team using best practices for development and quality assurance aligned with firmwide standards, seeking opportunities to automate and improve
  • CONTINUOUS IMPROVEMENT
  • Champion a culture and mindset of excellence, collaboration, continuous improvement, design thinking and positivity
  • Establish metrics to monitor and tangibly demonstrate the value provided to the business via effectiveness, quality metrics, sensitive data monitoring as well as alert to any negative trends in these areas
  • Work with stakeholders to prioritize continuous improvement
  • Assess and recommend opportunities to retire/consolidate redundant legacy system assets
  • ADOPTION & VALUE REALIZATION
  • Work with team and business users to ensure successful adoption, usage, and benefit realization from solutions
  • Define and track KPIs and success metrics for adoption and value creation

Specific responsibility expectations by the components listed below –

Information Architecture Vision: Establish the Enterprise Information Architecture vision within the context of business strategy and in alignment with overall Technology & Strategy direction.

  • Translate strategic requirements into a usable enterprise information architecture, which may include an enterprise data model, common business vocabulary, ontology, and taxonomies, to guide enterprise solution development and achieve consistency of information assets.
  • Create an information architecture consistent with the business, application, and technical architectures.
  • Facilitate the mapping and traceability of information assets as they flow from source datastores to targets, thus ensuring optimal transparency, quality, consistency, and controlled redundancy.

Information Architecture Delivery: Work with and mentor delivery teams to provide data solutions that are in keeping with the enterprise information architecture. This may include:

  • Assessing suitability of vendor solutions to meet enterprise information requirements.
  • Construct, refine and maintain information models, as needed, to meet business requirements and drive data designs for operational and analytical solutions.
  • Facilitate the definition of integrative and canonical views of data or information across multiple content types to support convergence of information asset migration planning or impact analysis.
  • Ensure new development is consistent and well-integrated with the established enterprise information architecture, using metadata management and/or a repository to promote reuse and standards adoption.
  • Review corporate data sources for new business information and better data sources. Assist in post-implementation improvement efforts to enhance performance and provide increased functionality.
  • Participate in key project design reviews as part of the methodology process to ensure application designs adhere to enterprise information architecture guidelines.
  • Provide oversight for the BI Data Warehouse. Design an enterprise-wide integrated Data Warehouse for
  • Business Intelligence by modeling new and enhancing existing BIDW datamarts. Establish logical and physical models, maintain metadata, and guide integration engineers for the physical datamart schema and logical integration (ETL) processes. Assist, as required, with testing and issue resolution. Establish and enhance governance processes for the BI Data Warehouse (naming conventions, conformed dimensions and facts, meta-models, security configuration) to ensure a consistent implementation across all datamarts.
  • On large implementation projects, deliver project artifacts including: Data Integration Inventory, 360 Data Integration Diagram, Core structures diagram, Data Integration Requirements document and Test Plans, Report Inventory, Reporting Gap Analysis and Strategy, and Historical Data Strategy

Business Intelligence Team Leadership: Provide leadership, oversight, and quality assurance for BI Team and team deliverables. This may include:

  • Manage and coach BI team members in delivery of high-quality business intelligence solutions. Assist to estimate effort / duration for new requests and change orders. Track work queue, assign and adjust priorities and due dates based on client requirements and DT Leadership direction. Provide BI team with visibility to DT projects and project pipeline. Provide a forum for BI team collaboration on BI and Data Warehouse design and technical challenges.
  • Establish, document, and maintain best practices for Business Intelligence and Data Warehousing.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Analytics, Data/Information Science, Information Systems, Mathematics (or other related fields)
  • 6+ years of experience with SQL
  • 4+ years of experience in Business Intelligence, data analysis, and reporting
  • 4+ years of experience with Microsoft Power BI, including DAX, Power Query, and M language.
  • 2+ years of experience with Python (or other programming languages)
  • 4+ years of experience managing projects from inception to execution.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Microsoft Fabric Analytics Engineer certifications preferred.
  • Strong understanding of Data Warehousing and Business Intelligence concepts, Data Quality, and the related technology landscape, processes, and design principles
  • Proven track record in operating large data warehouse and business intelligence programs
  • Experience in managing enterprise data assets in a large, complex organization
  • Should be familiar with cloud and data management trends and methodologies
  • Ability to analyze complex situations and to derive workable actions
  • Ability to constructively challenge requirements and current state to increase overall value to the firm
  • Strong relationship building skills
  • Flexibility to adjust to multiple demands, shifting priorities, ambiguity, and rapid change
  • Good written and verbal communication
  • Strong analytical and time management skills
  • Strong facilitation skills with the ability to drive issues to closure
  • Self-motivated and able to handle tasks with minimal supervision or questions
  • Ability to compare technologies and make recommendations to senior members of the team
  • Understanding of privacy laws and regulations

We embrace you for who you are, care for your well-being, and nurture your career. Everyone has equitable access to opportunities for career growth and leadership. Join us at Crowe and embark on a career where you can help shape the future of our industry.

Job Description:

What You’ll Do

Enterprise Information Architect & BIDW Leader will establish and deliver upon the enterprise information architecture vision for enterprise-level solutions. This role is responsible for the delivery of business Intelligence & data warehouse solutions to the firm, including the information architecture and management processes of the BI data warehouse and leading the BI function and team.

Responsibilities

LEADERSHIP

  • Ownership of and accountability for successful results of the Data Warehouse & Business Intelligence teams within Data Transformation.
  • Thought leadership in matters of enterprise data architecture, staying abreast of new technologies, patterns and methods which c an be applicable to Crowe data
  • Development of team strategy, creation and socialization of roadmaps, establishing and ensuring adherence to timelines, and resource assignment for the BIDW team
  • Seek opportunities to bring value to the Crowe business and/or its customers through innovative enterprise data and BI strategies to support strategic business goals
  • Develop quantifiable goals for the team which are aligned with Data Transformation’s strategic goals as well as Crowe’s strategic business initiatives
  • Mentor and coach developers, data engineers, managers, and other roles within team, intentionally managing career growth via mentorship and proactive planning
  • Actively participate in and collaborate with technical guilds to further expose and align the firm on best practices
  • Understand when to delegate; this role manages resources and owns the entire team’s success
  • Responsibility to track and maintain clear visibility into the value and delivery timing of BIDW team initiatives for Head of Data and business stakeholders

DEMAND MANAGEMENT & BUSINESS ENGAGEMENT

  • Collaboration with Head of Data and/or other firm leaders to understand strategic business needs and requirements, and planning team and technology capacity accordingly
  • Communication and engagement to ensure the business sees maximum value from its data warehouse and business intelligence investments
  • Develop and maintain an understanding of business needs, technical architecture and systems landscape, and the technology strategy of the business
  • Collaborate with both BIDW team and Data Transformation leaders to establish goals, plan capacity, support other Data Transformation initiatives, and leave margin for learning and unexpected shifts

PROGRAM DESIGN, DEVELOPMENT & DEPLOYMENT

  • Ultimate ownership for team delivery quality and schedule
  • Work closely with technology and business personnel to deliver value in a timely manner
  • Accountability for team using best practices for development and quality assurance aligned with firmwide standards, seeking opportunities to automate and improve
  • CONTINUOUS IMPROVEMENT
  • Champion a culture and mindset of excellence, collaboration, continuous improvement, design thinking and positivity
  • Establish metrics to monitor and tangibly demonstrate the value provided to the business via effectiveness, quality metrics, sensitive data monitoring as well as alert to any negative trends in these areas
  • Work with stakeholders to prioritize continuous improvement
  • Assess and recommend opportunities to retire/consolidate redundant legacy system assets
  • ADOPTION & VALUE REALIZATION
  • Work with team and business users to ensure successful adoption, usage, and benefit realization from solutions
  • Define and track KPIs and success metrics for adoption and value creation

Specific responsibility expectations by the components listed below –

Information Architecture Vision: Establish the Enterprise Information Architecture vision within the context of business strategy and in alignment with overall Technology & Strategy direction.

  • Translate strategic requirements into a usable enterprise information architecture, which may include an enterprise data model, common business vocabulary, ontology, and taxonomies, to guide enterprise solution development and achieve consistency of information assets.
  • Create an information architecture consistent with the business, application, and technical architectures.
  • Facilitate the mapping and traceability of information assets as they flow from source datastores to targets, thus ensuring optimal transparency, quality, consistency, and controlled redundancy.

Information Architecture Delivery: Work with and mentor delivery teams to provide data solutions that are in keeping with the enterprise information architecture. This may include:

  • Assessing suitability of vendor solutions to meet enterprise information requirements.
  • Construct, refine and maintain information models, as needed, to meet business requirements and drive data designs for operational and analytical solutions.
  • Facilitate the definition of integrative and canonical views of data or information across multiple content types to support convergence of information asset migration planning or impact analysis.
  • Ensure new development is consistent and well-integrated with the established enterprise information architecture, using metadata management and/or a repository to promote reuse and standards adoption.
  • Review corporate data sources for new business information and better data sources. Assist in post-implementation improvement efforts to enhance performance and provide increased functionality.
  • Participate in key project design reviews as part of the methodology process to ensure application designs adhere to enterprise information architecture guidelines.
  • Provide oversight for the BI Data Warehouse. Design an enterprise-wide integrated Data Warehouse for
  • Business Intelligence by modeling new and enhancing existing BIDW datamarts. Establish logical and physical models, maintain metadata, and guide integration engineers for the physical datamart schema and logical integration (ETL) processes. Assist, as required, with testing and issue resolution. Establish and enhance governance processes for the BI Data Warehouse (naming conventions, conformed dimensions and facts, meta-models, security configuration) to ensure a consistent implementation across all datamarts.
  • On large implementation projects, deliver project artifacts including: Data Integration Inventory, 360 Data Integration Diagram, Core structures diagram, Data Integration Requirements document and Test Plans, Report Inventory, Reporting Gap Analysis and Strategy, and Historical Data Strategy

Business Intelligence Team Leadership: Provide leadership, oversight, and quality assurance for BI Team and team deliverables. This may include:

  • Manage and coach BI team members in delivery of high-quality business intelligence solutions. Assist to estimate effort / duration for new requests and change orders. Track work queue, assign and adjust priorities and due dates based on client requirements and DT Leadership direction. Provide BI team with visibility to DT projects and project pipeline. Provide a forum for BI team collaboration on BI and Data Warehouse design and technical challenges.
  • Establish, document, and maintain best practices for Business Intelligence and Data Warehousing.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Analytics, Data/Information Science, Information Systems, Mathematics (or other related fields)
  • 6+ years of experience with SQL
  • 4+ years of experience in Business Intelligence, data analysis, and reporting
  • 4+ years of experience with Microsoft Power BI, including DAX, Power Query, and M language.
  • 2+ years of experience with Python (or other programming languages)
  • 4+ years of experience managing projects from inception to execution.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Microsoft Fabric Analytics Engineer certifications preferred.
  • Strong understanding of Data Warehousing and Business Intelligence concepts, Data Quality, and the related technology landscape, processes, and design principles
  • Proven track record in operating large data warehouse and business intelligence programs
  • Experience in managing enterprise data assets in a large, complex organization
  • Should be familiar with cloud and data management trends and methodologies
  • Ability to analyze complex situations and to derive workable actions
  • Ability to constructively challenge requirements and current state to increase overall value to the firm
  • Strong relationship building skills
  • Flexibility to adjust to multiple demands, shifting priorities, ambiguity, and rapid change
  • Good written and verbal communication
  • Strong analytical and time management skills
  • Strong facilitation skills with the ability to drive issues to closure
  • Self-motivated and able to handle tasks with minimal supervision or questions
  • Ability to compare technologies and make recommendations to senior members of the team
  • Understanding of privacy laws and regulations

The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled.   • Mentor and coach developers, data engineers, managers, and other roles within team, intentionally managing career growth via mentorship and proactive planning
  • Actively participate in and collaborate with technical guilds to further expose and align the firm on best practices
  • Understand when to delegate; this role manages resources and owns the entire team’s success
  • Responsibility to track and maintain clear visibility into the value and delivery timing of BIDW team initiatives for Head of Data and business stakeholders

DEMAND MANAGEMENT & BUSINESS ENGAGEMENT

  • Collaboration with Head of Data and/or other firm leaders to understand strategic business needs and requirements, and planning team and technology capacity accordingly
  • Communication and engagement to ensure the business sees maximum value from its data warehouse and business intelligence investments
  • Develop and maintain an understanding of business needs, technical architecture and systems landscape, and the technology strategy of the business
  • Collaborate with both BIDW team and Data Transformation leaders to establish goals, plan capacity, support other Data Transformation initiatives, and leave margin for learning and unexpected shifts

PROGRAM DESIGN, DEVELOPMENT & DEPLOYMENT

  • Ultimate ownership for team delivery quality and schedule
  • Work closely with technology and business personnel to deliver value in a timely manner
  • Accountability for team using best practices for development and quality assurance aligned with firmwide standards, seeking opportunities to automate and improve
  • CONTINUOUS IMPROVEMENT
  • Champion a culture and mindset of excellence, collaboration, continuous improvement, design thinking and positivity
  • Establish metrics to monitor and tangibly demonstrate the value provided to the business via effectiveness, quality metrics, sensitive data monitoring as well as alert to any negative trends in these areas
  • Work with stakeholders to prioritize continuous improvement
  • Assess and recommend opportunities to retire/consolidate redundant legacy system assets
  • ADOPTION & VALUE REALIZATION
  • Work with team and business users to ensure successful adoption, usage, and benefit realization from solutions
  • Define and track KPIs and success metrics for adoption and value creation

Specific responsibility expectations by the components listed below –

Information Architecture Vision: Establish the Enterprise Information Architecture vision within the context of business strategy and in alignment with overall Technology & Strategy direction.

  • Translate strategic requirements into a usable enterprise information architecture, which may include an enterprise data model, common business vocabulary, ontology, and taxonomies, to guide enterprise solution development and achieve consistency of information assets.
  • Create an information architecture consistent with the business, application, and technical architectures.
  • Facilitate the mapping and traceability of information assets as they flow from source datastores to targets, thus ensuring optimal transparency, quality, consistency, and controlled redundancy.

Information Architecture Delivery: Work with and mentor delivery teams to provide data solutions that are in keeping with the enterprise information architecture. This may include:

  • Assessing suitability of vendor solutions to meet enterprise information requirements.
  • Construct, refine and maintain information models, as needed, to meet business requirements and drive data designs for operational and analytical solutions.
  • Facilitate the definition of integrative and canonical views of data or information across multiple content types to support convergence of information asset migration planning or impact analysis.
  • Ensure new development is consistent and well-integrated with the established enterprise information architecture, using metadata management and/or a repository to promote reuse and standards adoption.
  • Review corporate data sources for new business information and better data sources. Assist in post-implementation improvement efforts to enhance performance and provide increased functionality.
  • Participate in key project design reviews as part of the methodology process to ensure application designs adhere to enterprise information architecture guidelines.
  • Provide oversight for the BI Data Warehouse. Design an enterprise-wide integrated Data Warehouse for
  • Business Intelligence by modeling new and enhancing existing BIDW datamarts. Establish logical and physical models, maintain metadata, and guide integration engineers for the physical datamart schema and logical integration (ETL) processes. Assist, as required, with testing and issue resolution. Establish and enhance governance processes for the BI Data Warehouse (naming conventions, conformed dimensions and facts, meta-models, security configuration) to ensure a consistent implementation across all datamarts.
  • On large implementation projects, deliver project artifacts including: Data Integration Inventory, 360 Data Integration Diagram, Core structures diagram, Data Integration Requirements document and Test Plans, Report Inventory, Reporting Gap Analysis and Strategy, and Historical Data Strategy

Business Intelligence Team Leadership: Provide leadership, oversight, and quality assurance for BI Team and team deliverables. This may include:

  • Manage and coach BI team members in delivery of high-quality business intelligence solutions. Assist to estimate effort / duration for new requests and change orders. Track work queue, assign and adjust priorities and due dates based on client requirements and DT Leadership direction. Provide BI team with visibility to DT projects and project pipeline. Provide a forum for BI team collaboration on BI and Data Warehouse design and technical challenges.
  • Establish, document, and maintain best practices for Business Intelligence and Data Warehousing.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Analytics, Data/Information Science, Information Systems, Mathematics (or other related fields)
  • 6+ years of experience with SQL
  • 4+ years of experience in Business Intelligence, data analysis, and reporting
  • 4+ years of experience with Microsoft Power BI, including DAX, Power Query, and M language.
  • 2+ years of experience with Python (or other programming languages)
  • 4+ years of experience managing projects from inception to execution.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Microsoft Fabric Analytics Engineer certifications preferred.
  • Strong understanding of Data Warehousing and Business Intelligence concepts, Data Quality, and the related technology landscape, processes, and design principles
  • Proven track record in operating large data warehouse and business intelligence programs
  • Experience in managing enterprise data assets in a large, complex organization
  • Should be familiar with cloud and data management trends and methodologies
  • Ability to analyze complex situations and to derive workable actions
  • Ability to constructively challenge requirements and current state to increase overall value to the firm
  • Strong relationship building skills
  • Flexibility to adjust to multiple demands, shifting priorities, ambiguity, and rapid change
  • Good written and verbal communication
  • Strong analytical and time management skills
  • Strong facilitation skills with the ability to drive issues to closure
  • Self-motivated and able to handle tasks with minimal supervision or questions
  • Ability to compare technologies and make recommendations to senior members of the team
  • Understanding of privacy laws and regulations

descriptionHtml:
Overview

Are you looking for a highly rewarding opportunity that provides extensive career growth opportunity? Gilbane is seeking a Data Architect to provide strategic and technical leadership in the design, evaluation, and governance of enterprise technology capabilities. This role translates business objectives into scalable, secure, reliable, and sustainable architectures while ensuring alignment with enterprise strategy, standards, and roadmaps. This role can be located near any Gilbane office or remote.

Who are we?

As a Top-10 ENR Contractor, Gilbane is a family-owned business with 45 offices that has been shaping communities since 1870. Consistently recognized as one of the most reputable construction management firms in the country, Gilbane is committed to delivering projects safely and on-time. You will have the opportunity to build schools, labs, hospitals, corporate offices, sports arenas and more!

We are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway.
