Principal Data Architect & Modeler


The Company

TKO Group Holdings, Inc. (NYSE: TKO) is a premium sports and entertainment company. TKO owns UFC, the world's premier mixed martial arts organization; WWE, the global leader in sports entertainment; and PBR, the world's premier bull riding organization. Together these properties reach 210 countries and territories, stage more than 500 live events a year, and attract more than three million fans in person. TKO also serves major sports rights holders through IMG, a global sports marketing agency, and On Location, a leader in premium experiential hospitality.


Why this role exists

TKO is consolidating the data estates of five businesses onto one enterprise data platform.

The Principal Data Architect & Modeler is going to lead data architecture role at TKO. You define the standards, the data model, the framework and the roadmap for the platform. Product, Engineering and Data Science build to your recommendations; Data Governance and Master Data Management set the policies your designs make enforceable.


This role is hands on as well as an influencer. You will design & write models, semantic definitions, standards and architecture decision records.


The north star

The platform exists to deliver three enterprise views, on one AI-ready foundation, built iteratively.

  • Fan 360 — one resolved identity for the consumer across UFC, WWE and PBR: tickets, viewership, merchandise, membership, engagement and consent, with the lineage that makes cross-brand use defensible.
  • Event 360 — every live event, broadcast and activation on one spine: venue, gate, attendance, rights, sponsorship, hospitality and media performance, at the grain each business needs.
  • Customer 360 — the B2B side of TKO: rights holders, sponsors, partners, hospitality buyers and agency clients across IMG and On Location, resolved to golden records and linked to the events and fans they touch.
  • Employee 360 - Trusted employee domain aligned to enterprise HR systems and P+C priorities; sequenced behind higher-value domains


AI-readiness is central theme, not a feature appended at the end. Agents and reporting needs to be based on a common definition of metric and attributes, context and data relationships embedded within the semantic layer access to information based on user roles..

None of this is built in one pass. The job is to set the end state, then sequence the increments — one entity, one conformed dimension, one certified metric set at a time — so each release puts a usable slice of a 360 into production and the model improves under use.


What you will own


The enterprise data framework and roadmap. Define the target-state architecture and the published roadmap from today's estate to the north star. Set the reference patterns for how data is ingested (batch, CDC, streaming, API), how it is curated through the medallion from landing to marts, how it is served to BI, agents and applications, and how data science and ML consume it (feature-ready datasets, training and retrieval pipelines, in-platform serving). Define the environments and promotion path from development to production, and the standards each layer must meet to pass. Engineering builds the pipelines, Product owns the data products, Data Science builds the models; your framework is what they all build against.


The canonical enterprise model. Define the dimensional and conformed-dimension standards that govern how raw data becomes curated data: grain, conformance, slowly changing dimension handling, surrogate and business keys, and the shared dimensions that must mean the same thing in every brand. Design for modularity, so that the fifth domain costs less than the first and new properties, partnerships and source systems are absorbed rather than re-engineered.


Master data design. Design the master data architecture across fan, event, rights holder, sponsor and partner, employee and vendor, in partnership with Master Data Management and Governance, which owns the policy, stewardship and governance framework your designs implement. Choose and justify the implementation style per domain. Design entity resolution as a cascade — deterministic, probabilistic, machine-learned, human-stewarded — with attribute-level survivorship, versioned match rules, and merges that are defensible and reversible. Treat consent state, opt-out signals and retention obligations as master data carried with identity across brands.


The semantic layer and its hierarchy. Own the enterprise-certified definitions for the concepts the whole company shares — fan, event, attendance, revenue, engagement, rights — and the domain models that inherit from and extend them. Set the metric tiers, the certification bar at each tier, and the promotion path from exploratory to certified. Decide where each definition physically lives across Snowflake semantic views, dbt, the BI semantic layer and the Open Semantic Interchange specification, and keep those representations in sync. TKO already runs conversational analytics agents in production for business users; the accuracy of every one of them is bounded by this model.


Governance made enforceable in the platform. You do not own governance. You design the architecture that makes it real: how the catalog is populated and kept current, how lineage is captured from source through transformation to semantic layer to agent, where data quality rules execute and how results surface, what observability every data product carries by default, and how classification and access boundaries travel with the data into every tool and agent. Convert standards into automated checks — model contracts, linting, pre-merge data diffs, quality thresholds — so governance happens by rule rather than by inspection.


Architecture decisions and the paved road. Establish the architecture decision record practice, stored with the code. Run an advisory forum rather than an approval board. Publish and maintain the reference implementations, templates and modeling patterns that make the standard the path of least resistance. Define the target model for each domain before its migration wave, and the parity criteria that decide whether a cutover is complete.


How you will work

The role reports to the VP, Data Engineering & Science within TKO's Enterprise Data organization and works across four partnerships, each with a deliberate boundary.


Data Governance & MDM

Policy, stewardship, standards, data ownership, the governance framework

The models those policies govern, and the platform design that makes them enforceable

Data Product Management

What gets built, for whom, in what order; the data product backlog and outcomes

How it is modeled, what reuse it must honor, and the architecture it must land on

Data Engineering & Platform

Pipelines, infrastructure, orchestration, delivery, and the agent runtime

The framework, standards and target model they build against; design review of what ships

Data Science & ML

Models, features, experiments, evaluation

The feature-ready and retrieval-ready substrate, and the environments ML runs in

Application Teams

System of records for data created in organization

Alignment on data movement patterns and pub/sub models, data lineage and quality frameworks


You influence without line authority. Engineers, analytics engineers and the global delivery partners supporting the brand and IMG estates adopt your standards because the reference implementations work and the decisions are written down. You raise architectural issues early and in writing, including unpopular ones, and own the trade-off conversation with engineering and business leadership. You explain to non-engineers what a decision costs, what it buys and what it forecloses. You mentor engineers in dimensional modeling, semantic design and master data practice as a discipline distinct from pipeline engineering.


What success looks like

By 6 months. The target-state framework is published and adopted as the standard for the platform unification program: ingest, curation, serving and ML patterns; environments and promotion path; modeling standards; the architecture decision record practice. The first conformed dimensions (fan, event, date, venue, brand) are in production and used by more than one domain. The semantic metric tiers and certification process are defined and the first enterprise-certified metrics are live in the agent estate.

By 12 months. One 360 has a usable production slice: a resolved entity graph with defensible merges, consent lineage, and at least one cross-brand question answerable through governed definitions rather than hand-built SQL. Lineage, catalog coverage and quality checks are automated for every certified data product. Each domain migrating onto the unified platform has a target model defined before its wave begins, and parity criteria that go beyond a green pipeline.

By 18 months. All three 360s have production increments, and the fifth domain onboarded demonstrably cost less than the first. The global delivery partners build to the standard without escalation. Executive-facing numbers from conversational agents trace to certified definitions, and the failure mode for an unanswerable question is a refusal rather than a plausible wrong answer.


What you bring

Must have

  • 12+ years in data architecture and engineering, with a substantial portion as a named architect accountable for enterprise-wide design across multiple business units or operating companies, adopted without line authority over the teams adopting it.
  • Deep dimensional modeling expertise at enterprise scale: conformed dimensions, grain discipline, slowly changing dimensions, and the judgment to know when a star schema is the wrong answer.
  • Hands-on master data architecture across multiple domains: implementation-style selection, entity resolution, survivorship and golden-record design, including what breaks at scale and what it costs to unmerge.
  • Production ownership of a semantic layer used by more than one team: metric definition ownership, certification, and the organizational work of collapsing competing definitions of the same number into one.
  • Deep, current Snowflake architecture experience: medallion design, role and access taxonomy, tag-driven masking and row-access policies, and the cost consequences of modeling decisions.
  • Strong dbt: project and mesh structure, macros, contracts, versions, testing, and the judgment to consolidate overlapping projects.
  • Experience architecting through a platform migration or consolidation of real scope, including the parity validation that determined whether it succeeded.
  • Practical command of governance from a semantics perspective — glossaries, metric definitions, lineage, data contracts, classification and access models — and how they become enforceable in a platform.
  • Exceptional written communication. This role is judged on design documents, standards and decision records that hold up after the author has moved on.


Strongly preferred

  • Direct experience making enterprise data consumable by AI systems: semantic models exposed as agent tools, retrieval-ready and context-rich datasets, and a clear view of where generated SQL is appropriate and where it is not.
  • Identity graph, Customer 360 or Fan 360 design experience, and working knowledge of consumer privacy regimes (CCPA, GDPR) and consent management as a modeling input.
  • Designing the data substrate for ML: feature stores, training and retrieval pipelines, in-platform serving.
  • Experience in media, sports, entertainment, live events, ticketing or consumer and fan data environments.
  • Familiarity with open semantic interchange, open catalog and metadata standards, and the vendor landscape around them.
  • Experience working alongside offshore and partner delivery teams and raising their output to an architecture's standard.

Introduction

A career in IBM Consulting is built on long-term client relationships and close collaboration worldwide. You'll work with leading companies across industries, helping them shape their hybrid cloud and AI journeys. With support from our strategic partners, robust IBM technology, and Red Hat, you'll have the tools to drive meaningful change and accelerate client impact. At IBM Consulting, curiosity fuels success. You'll be encouraged to challenge the norm, explore new ideas, and create innovative solutions that deliver real results. Our culture of growth and empathy focuses on your long-term career development while valuing your unique skills and experiences.

Your Role And Responsibilities

As a Business Transformation Consultant specializing in Data Platforms, you will plan, design, manage, and implement core components of Watson Service Offerings and Digital Insights Platforms, as well as other similar non-IBM solutions. This role involves creating solutions that deliver significant and lasting business improvements for clients.

Your Primary Responsibilities Will Include

  • Design Solution Architecture: Provide expert architecture, design, and implementation support for solutions in virtualized and cloud-based environments, including both hosted and on-premise solutions.
  • Implement Data Platforms: Plan, manage, and implement core components of Watson Service Offerings and Digital Insights Platforms to deliver significant business improvements for clients.
  • Support Sales and Delivery: Define solutions and present a point of view for these offerings' services to clients, collaborating with Sales and Delivery teams.
  • Develop Cloud-Based Solutions: Create solutions in virtualized and cloud-based environments, leveraging expertise in architecture, data lake, design, and implementation.
  • Drive Business Transformation: Deliver lasting business improvements for clients through the implementation of Data Platforms and Watson Service Offerings.
  • This job can be performed from anywhere in the US.

Preferred Education

Master's Degree

Required Technical And Professional Expertise

  • Deep Expertise in Data Platforms: Proven experience in planning, designing, managing, and implementing core components of data platforms, Snowflake, Databricks and Digital Insights Platforms, to deliver significant business improvements for clients.
  • Experience with Cloud-Based Solutions: Skilled in creating solutions in virtualized and cloud-based environments, including both hosted and on-premise solutions, leveraging expertise in architecture, data lake, design, and implementation.
  • Proficiency in Solution Architecture: Experienced in providing expert architecture, design, and implementation support for solutions in complex environments, ensuring seamless integration and effective solution delivery.
  • Experience in Implementation and Integration: Proven ability to plan, manage, and implement core components of data platforms, ensuring successful integration with existing systems and infrastructure.
  • Strong Understanding of Business Transformation: Experienced in delivering lasting business improvements for clients through the implementation of data platforms and Watson Service Offerings, driving business transformation and growth.

Preferred Technical And Professional Experience

  • Data Lake Expertise: Deep understanding of data lake architecture and design, with experience in implementing data lakes in virtualized and cloud-based environments, including both hosted and on-premise solutions.
  • Virtualization Knowledge: Familiarity with virtualization technologies and their application in data platform solutions, ensuring seamless integration and effective solution delivery.
  • Cloud Solution Development: Experience with developing cloud-based solutions, leveraging expertise in architecture, design, and implementation to deliver significant business improvements for clients.
  • Snow Pro Certification
  • Databricks Certification
  • Claude Certifications
  • OpenAI Certification
  • Industry expertise in High Tech, Energy, Utilities, Manufacturing, Product.

descriptionHtml:
The Opportunity

As a Applied AI Health Data Architect you will shape data architecture solutions that support health services provider clients, bringing together data engineering, analytics, and AI to improve how information is structured, integrated, and used across cloud environments. As a Senior Manager you will lead large projects, bring strategic direction to complex data modernization efforts, and use sound judgment to guide teams and stakeholders through changing priorities and technical complexity. In this role at PwC, you will work within our Advisory practice and within our Data, Analytics & AI services to design data platforms, support cloud-native architecture decisions, and contribute to delivery across AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud Platform environments for health sector clients.

Responsibilities

  • Leading applied AI and health data architecture initiatives for provider data environments, translating business goals into scalable data solutions
  • Designing cloud-native data platforms, pipelines, and integration patterns across AWS, Azure, Databricks, and Snowflake
  • Developing data models, warehouse structures, and transformation logic that support analytics, AI workloads, and operational reporting
  • Guiding data modernization efforts that migrate legacy systems into modern architectures with improved performance, security, and usability
  • Overseeing data quality, validation, governance, and anonymization practices across sensitive health data domains
  • Applying data engineering methods to tune pipelines, optimize queries, and improve database and warehouse performance
  • Advising client stakeholders on data strategy, architecture decisions, and AI-ready platform design within complex provider environments
  • Leading teams through delivery planning, issue resolution, and technical coordination across multiple workstreams
  • Coaching practitioners on data engineering platforms, digital tooling, and AI-enabled solution delivery
  • Presenting solution options, tradeoffs, and implementation paths that support modernization priorities and future data capabilities

What You Must Have

  • At least a Bachelor's degree
  • At least 7 years of experience

What Sets You Apart

  • Preference for at least one of the following fields of study: Analytics/Data Science, Business Administration/Management, Computer Science/Information Systems, Economics, Engineering, Finance, Mathematics/Statistics, Operations/Supply Chain
  • Demonstrating data architecture leadership for healthcare provider modernization initiatives
  • Utilizing AWS, Azure, Databricks, or Snowflake for cloud data platforms
  • Applying AI fluency to data engineering and architecture decisions
  • Translating client needs into scalable data modernization roadmaps
  • Leading complex, multi-team delivery with composure and sound judgment

The salary range for this position is: $124,000 - $280,000. Actual compensation within the range will be dependent upon the individual's skills, experience, qualifications and location, and applicable employment laws. All hired individuals are eligible for an annual discretionary bonus. PwC offers a wide range of benefits, including medical, dental, vision, 401k, holiday pay, vacation, personal and family sick leave, and more. To view our benefits at a glance, please visit the following link: https://pwc.to/benefits-at-a-glance

As PwC is an equal opportunity employer, all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment at PwC without regard to race; color; religion; national origin; sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, and gender identity); age; disability; genetic information (including family medical history); veteran, marital, or citizenship status; or, any other status protected by law. 

PwC does not intend to hire experienced or entry level job seekers who will need, now or in the future, PwC sponsorship through the H-1B lottery, except as set forth within the following policy: https://pwc.to/H-1B-Lottery-Policy.

Learn more about how we work: https://pwc.to/how-we-work

For only those qualified applicants that are impacted by the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, the Los Angeles' Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, San Diego County Fair Chance Ordinance, and the California Fair Chance Act, where applicable, arrest or conviction records will be considered for Employment in accordance with these laws. At PwC, we recognize that conviction records may have a direct, adverse, and negative relationship to responsibilities such as accessing sensitive company or customer information, handling proprietary assets, or collaborating closely with team members. We evaluate these factors thoughtfully to establish a secure and trusted workplace for all.

Applications will be accepted until the position is filled or the posting is removed, unless otherwise set forth on the following webpage. Please visit this link for information about anticipated application deadlines: https://pwc.to/us-application-deadlines

It has set an aspiration to become the world's largest AI-led technology services company and is enabling its clients to transform themselves across the full AI stack, from infrastructure to intelligence.

Rooted in the heritage of the Tata Group, TCS is focused on creating long term value for its clients, its investors, its employees, and the community at large. With a highly skilled workforce spread across 56 countries and 194 service delivery centers across the world, the company has been recognized as a top employer in six continents. With the ability to rapidly apply and scale new technologies, the company has built long-term partnerships with its clients. descriptionHtml:
Job Description

Must Have Technical/Functional Skills

  • Modern data architecture across ingestion, lakehouse/warehouse, semantic/analytics layer, AI/ML integration, and GenAI workloads.
  • Cloud-native data platforms such as Azure Synapse / Fabric, Databricks, Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift or equivalent.
  • Lakehouse and medallion patterns, Delta Lake, data warehousing, data marts, and enterprise analytical modeling.
  • ETL/ELT and orchestration tools such as Azure Data Factory, Airflow, dbt, AWS Glue, Informatica or equivalent.
  • Data modeling across conceptual, logical, and physical models, metadata, lineage, master/reference data, and data quality principles.
  • Data governance, privacy, security, compliance, cataloging, and stewardship tools such as Microsoft Purview or Collibra concepts.
  • Streaming and integration patterns using Kafka, Event Hubs, APIs, and batch/near-real-time data pipelines.
  • Working knowledge of AI/ML, GenAI, RAG, vector databases, and how data platform design enables AI workloads.

Roles & Responsibilities

  • Lead technical discovery workshops with business, data, analytics, and IT stakeholders to understand target outcomes and constraints.
  • Translate business objectives into target-state data architectures, value-driven solution blueprints, and phased transition roadmaps.
  • Design end-to-end modern data platforms including ingestion, lakehouse/warehouse, analytics, AI/ML, and GenAI enablement layers.
  • Define reference architectures, integration patterns, data models, data quality controls, governance mechanisms, and security architecture.
  • Assess legacy data environments and recommend modernization approaches that balance scalability, cost, performance, and delivery practicality.
  • Support proposals, RFIs/RFPs, PoCs, architecture diagrams, cost modeling, sizing, and solution defense sessions.
  • Partner with cloud, AI, cybersecurity, application, and delivery teams to ensure architectures are secure, scalable, compliant, and delivery-ready.
  • Mentor data engineers and junior architects on architecture patterns, engineering standards, and reusable assets.

Generic Managerial Skills, If any

  • Strong client-facing communication and executive presentation skills.
  • Ability to facilitate workshops and align business, IT, enterprise architecture, security, and delivery stakeholders.
  • Technical leadership, mentoring, estimation support, solution governance, risk management, and proposal support.
  • Ability to balance innovation, implementation feasibility, cost, and commercial viability.

Salary Range: $160,000 -$220,000 year

TCS Employee Benefits Summary

Discretionary Annual Incentive.

Comprehensive Medical Coverage: Medical & Health, Dental & Vision, Disability Planning & Insurance, Pet Insurance Plans.

Family Support: Maternal & Parental Leaves.

Insurance Options: Auto & Home Insurance, Identity Theft Protection.

Convenience & Professional Growth: Commuter Benefits & Certification & amp; Training Reimbursement.

Time Off: Vacation, Time Off, Sick Leave & Holidays.

Legal & Financial Assistance: Legal Assistance, 401K Plan, Performance Bonus, College Fund, Student Loan Refinancing.

Qualifications: BACHELOR OF COMPUTER SCIENCE

PRINCIPAL DATA ENGINEER / DATA ARCHITECT

AUSTIN, TX (HYBRID - 4 DAYS ONSITE)

$220,000 - $250,000 + BONUS + EQUITY

The Opportunity We're partnering with a leading consumer technology organization to hire a Principal Data Engineer who will serve as a strategic technical leader across enterprise data architecture, platform modernization, governance, and data product initiatives.

This is not a traditional data engineering role focused solely on pipelines and development. This individual will partner closely with senior leadership to shape the future of the organization's data ecosystem, influence long-term technology investments, evaluate platform strategy, and guide enterprise architecture decisions that directly impact business outcomes.

The ideal candidate combines deep technical expertise with strong communication skills and the ability to influence stakeholders, mentor engineers, and drive large-scale data initiatives from strategy through execution.

The Data Environment The team is focused on building and evolving modern cloud-native data platforms supporting analytics, customer intelligence, operational decision-making, and future AI initiatives.

  • Documentation: Create and maintain technical documentation, including architecture diagrams, data models, and operational procedures.
  • Incident Management: Lead troubleshooting efforts for critical data issues, ensuring timely resolution and root cause analysis.
  • Innovation: Drive innovation by identifying opportunities to leverage AI, machine learning, and advanced analytics in data engineering solutions.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field.
  • Minimum of 10 years of experience in data engineering or architecture, with at least 3 years in a leadership role.
  • Proven track record of architecting and delivering large-scale data solutions in cloud environments (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP).
  • Expertise in data modeling, ETL processes, and data pipeline development.
  • Extensive experience with modern data platforms: Databricks and/or Snowflake preferred
    • Experience with data modeling and engineering in Databricks, including Delta Lake and advanced Spark-based transformations.

  • Proficiency in programming languages such as Python, SQL, Java, or Scala.
  • Experience with big data technologies (e.g., Hadoop, Spark, Kafka).
  • Hands-on experience with cloud-native data services (e.g., AWS Redshift, Azure Synapse, Google BigQuery).
  • Strong understanding of database technologies (e.g., relational, NoSQL, graph databases).

  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills to collaborate with diverse stakeholders.

  • Preferred certifications such as Databricks Professional or Azure Data Engineer Associate
  • Advanced analytical skills to solve complex technical and business problems.
  • Ability to translate technical concepts into business value for non-technical stakeholders.

Job Description:

What You’ll Do

Enterprise Information Architect & BIDW Leader will establish and deliver upon the enterprise information architecture vision for enterprise-level solutions. This role is responsible for the delivery of business Intelligence & data warehouse solutions to the firm, including the information architecture and management processes of the BI data warehouse and leading the BI function and team.

Responsibilities

LEADERSHIP

  • Ownership of and accountability for successful results of the Data Warehouse & Business Intelligence teams within Data Transformation.
  • Thought leadership in matters of enterprise data architecture, staying abreast of new technologies, patterns and methods which c an be applicable to Crowe data
  • Development of team strategy, creation and socialization of roadmaps, establishing and ensuring adherence to timelines, and resource assignment for the BIDW team
  • Seek opportunities to bring value to the Crowe business and/or its customers through innovative enterprise data and BI strategies to support strategic business goals
  • Develop quantifiable goals for the team which are aligned with Data Transformation’s strategic goals as well as Crowe’s strategic business initiatives
  • Mentor and coach developers, data engineers, managers, and other roles within team, intentionally managing career growth via mentorship and proactive planning
  • Actively participate in and collaborate with technical guilds to further expose and align the firm on best practices
  • Understand when to delegate; this role manages resources and owns the entire team’s success
  • Responsibility to track and maintain clear visibility into the value and delivery timing of BIDW team initiatives for Head of Data and business stakeholders

DEMAND MANAGEMENT & BUSINESS ENGAGEMENT

  • Collaboration with Head of Data and/or other firm leaders to understand strategic business needs and requirements, and planning team and technology capacity accordingly
  • Communication and engagement to ensure the business sees maximum value from its data warehouse and business intelligence investments
  • Develop and maintain an understanding of business needs, technical architecture and systems landscape, and the technology strategy of the business
  • Collaborate with both BIDW team and Data Transformation leaders to establish goals, plan capacity, support other Data Transformation initiatives, and leave margin for learning and unexpected shifts

PROGRAM DESIGN, DEVELOPMENT & DEPLOYMENT

  • Ultimate ownership for team delivery quality and schedule
  • Work closely with technology and business personnel to deliver value in a timely manner
  • Accountability for team using best practices for development and quality assurance aligned with firmwide standards, seeking opportunities to automate and improve
  • CONTINUOUS IMPROVEMENT
  • Champion a culture and mindset of excellence, collaboration, continuous improvement, design thinking and positivity
  • Establish metrics to monitor and tangibly demonstrate the value provided to the business via effectiveness, quality metrics, sensitive data monitoring as well as alert to any negative trends in these areas
  • Work with stakeholders to prioritize continuous improvement
  • Assess and recommend opportunities to retire/consolidate redundant legacy system assets
  • ADOPTION & VALUE REALIZATION
  • Work with team and business users to ensure successful adoption, usage, and benefit realization from solutions
  • Define and track KPIs and success metrics for adoption and value creation

Specific responsibility expectations by the components listed below –

Information Architecture Vision: Establish the Enterprise Information Architecture vision within the context of business strategy and in alignment with overall Technology & Strategy direction.

  • Translate strategic requirements into a usable enterprise information architecture, which may include an enterprise data model, common business vocabulary, ontology, and taxonomies, to guide enterprise solution development and achieve consistency of information assets.
  • Create an information architecture consistent with the business, application, and technical architectures.
  • Facilitate the mapping and traceability of information assets as they flow from source datastores to targets, thus ensuring optimal transparency, quality, consistency, and controlled redundancy.

Information Architecture Delivery: Work with and mentor delivery teams to provide data solutions that are in keeping with the enterprise information architecture. This may include:

  • Assessing suitability of vendor solutions to meet enterprise information requirements.
  • Construct, refine and maintain information models, as needed, to meet business requirements and drive data designs for operational and analytical solutions.
  • Facilitate the definition of integrative and canonical views of data or information across multiple content types to support convergence of information asset migration planning or impact analysis.
  • Ensure new development is consistent and well-integrated with the established enterprise information architecture, using metadata management and/or a repository to promote reuse and standards adoption.
  • Review corporate data sources for new business information and better data sources. Assist in post-implementation improvement efforts to enhance performance and provide increased functionality.
  • Participate in key project design reviews as part of the methodology process to ensure application designs adhere to enterprise information architecture guidelines.
  • Provide oversight for the BI Data Warehouse. Design an enterprise-wide integrated Data Warehouse for
  • Business Intelligence by modeling new and enhancing existing BIDW datamarts. Establish logical and physical models, maintain metadata, and guide integration engineers for the physical datamart schema and logical integration (ETL) processes. Assist, as required, with testing and issue resolution. Establish and enhance governance processes for the BI Data Warehouse (naming conventions, conformed dimensions and facts, meta-models, security configuration) to ensure a consistent implementation across all datamarts.
  • On large implementation projects, deliver project artifacts including: Data Integration Inventory, 360 Data Integration Diagram, Core structures diagram, Data Integration Requirements document and Test Plans, Report Inventory, Reporting Gap Analysis and Strategy, and Historical Data Strategy

Business Intelligence Team Leadership: Provide leadership, oversight, and quality assurance for BI Team and team deliverables. This may include:

  • Manage and coach BI team members in delivery of high-quality business intelligence solutions. Assist to estimate effort / duration for new requests and change orders. Track work queue, assign and adjust priorities and due dates based on client requirements and DT Leadership direction. Provide BI team with visibility to DT projects and project pipeline. Provide a forum for BI team collaboration on BI and Data Warehouse design and technical challenges.
  • Establish, document, and maintain best practices for Business Intelligence and Data Warehousing.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Analytics, Data/Information Science, Information Systems, Mathematics (or other related fields)
  • 6+ years of experience with SQL
  • 4+ years of experience in Business Intelligence, data analysis, and reporting
  • 4+ years of experience with Microsoft Power BI, including DAX, Power Query, and M language.
  • 2+ years of experience with Python (or other programming languages)
  • 4+ years of experience managing projects from inception to execution.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Microsoft Fabric Analytics Engineer certifications preferred.
  • Strong understanding of Data Warehousing and Business Intelligence concepts, Data Quality, and the related technology landscape, processes, and design principles
  • Proven track record in operating large data warehouse and business intelligence programs
  • Experience in managing enterprise data assets in a large, complex organization
  • Should be familiar with cloud and data management trends and methodologies
  • Ability to analyze complex situations and to derive workable actions
  • Ability to constructively challenge requirements and current state to increase overall value to the firm
  • Strong relationship building skills
  • Flexibility to adjust to multiple demands, shifting priorities, ambiguity, and rapid change
  • Good written and verbal communication
  • Strong analytical and time management skills
  • Strong facilitation skills with the ability to drive issues to closure
  • Self-motivated and able to handle tasks with minimal supervision or questions
  • Ability to compare technologies and make recommendations to senior members of the team
  • Understanding of privacy laws and regulations

This role is responsible for the delivery of business Intelligence & data warehouse solutions to the firm, including the information architecture and management processes of the BI data warehouse and leading the BI function and team.

Responsibilities

LEADERSHIP



- Ownership of and accountability for successful results of the Data Warehouse & Business Intelligence teams within Data Transformation. 
- Thought leadership in matters of enterprise data architecture, staying abreast of new technologies, patterns and methods which c an be applicable to Crowe data
- Development of team strategy, creation and socialization of roadmaps, establishing and ensuring adherence to timelines, and resource assignment for the BIDW team
- Seek opportunities to bring value to the Crowe business and/or its customers through innovative enterprise data and BI strategies to support strategic business goals
- Develop quantifiable goals for the team which are aligned with Data Transformation’s strategic goals as well as Crowe’s strategic business initiatives
- Mentor and coach developers, data engineers, managers, and other roles within team, intentionally managing career growth via mentorship and proactive planning
- Actively participate in and collaborate with technical guilds to further expose and align the firm on best practices
- Understand when to delegate; this role manages resources and owns the entire team’s success
- Responsibility to track and maintain clear visibility into the value and delivery timing of BIDW team initiatives for Head of Data and business stakeholders

DEMAND MANAGEMENT & BUSINESS ENGAGEMENT



- Collaboration with Head of Data and/or other firm leaders to understand strategic business needs and requirements, and planning team and technology capacity accordingly
- Communication and engagement to ensure the business sees maximum value from its data warehouse and business intelligence investments
- Develop and maintain an understanding of business needs, technical architecture and systems landscape, and the technology strategy of the business
- Collaborate with both BIDW team and Data Transformation leaders to establish goals, plan capacity, support other Data Transformation initiatives, and leave margin for learning and unexpected shifts

PROGRAM DESIGN, DEVELOPMENT & DEPLOYMENT



- Ultimate ownership for team delivery quality and schedule
- Work closely with technology and business personnel to deliver value in a timely manner
- Accountability for team using best practices for development and quality assurance aligned with firmwide standards, seeking opportunities to automate and improve
- CONTINUOUS IMPROVEMENT
- Champion a culture and mindset of excellence, collaboration, continuous improvement, design thinking and positivity
- Establish metrics to monitor and tangibly demonstrate the value provided to the business via effectiveness, quality metrics, sensitive data monitoring as well as alert to any negative trends in these areas
- Work with stakeholders to prioritize continuous improvement
- Assess and recommend opportunities to retire/consolidate redundant legacy system assets
- ADOPTION & VALUE REALIZATION
- Work with team and business users to ensure successful adoption, usage, and benefit realization from solutions
- Define and track KPIs and success metrics for adoption and value creation

Specific responsibility expectations by the components listed below –

Information Architecture Vision: Establish the Enterprise Information Architecture vision within the context of business strategy and in alignment with overall Technology & Strategy direction.



- Translate strategic requirements into a usable enterprise information architecture, which may include an enterprise data model, common business vocabulary, ontology, and taxonomies, to guide enterprise solution development and achieve consistency of information assets. 
- Create an information architecture consistent with the business, application, and technical architectures. 
- Facilitate the mapping and traceability of information assets as they flow from source datastores to targets, thus ensuring optimal transparency, quality, consistency, and controlled redundancy. 

Information Architecture Delivery: Work with and mentor delivery teams to provide data solutions that are in keeping with the enterprise information architecture. This may include:



- Assessing suitability of vendor solutions to meet enterprise information requirements. 
- Construct, refine and maintain information models, as needed, to meet business requirements and drive data designs for operational and analytical solutions. 
- Facilitate the definition of integrative and canonical views of data or information across multiple content types to support convergence of information asset migration planning or impact analysis. 
- Ensure new development is consistent and well-integrated with the established enterprise information architecture, using metadata management and/or a repository to promote reuse and standards adoption. 
- Review corporate data sources for new business information and better data sources. Assist in post-implementation improvement efforts to enhance performance and provide increased functionality. 
- Participate in key project design reviews as part of the methodology process to ensure application designs adhere to enterprise information architecture guidelines. 
- Provide oversight for the BI Data Warehouse. Design an enterprise-wide integrated Data Warehouse for
- Business Intelligence by modeling new and enhancing existing BIDW datamarts. Establish logical and physical models, maintain metadata, and guide integration engineers for the physical datamart schema and logical integration (ETL) processes. Assist, as required, with testing and issue resolution. Establish and enhance governance processes for the BI Data Warehouse (naming conventions, conformed dimensions and facts, meta-models, security configuration) to ensure a consistent implementation across all datamarts. 
- On large implementation projects, deliver project artifacts including: Data Integration Inventory, 360 Data Integration Diagram, Core structures diagram, Data Integration Requirements document and Test Plans, Report Inventory, Reporting Gap Analysis and Strategy, and Historical Data Strategy

Business Intelligence Team Leadership: Provide leadership, oversight, and quality assurance for BI Team and team deliverables. This may include:



- Manage and coach BI team members in delivery of high-quality business intelligence solutions. Assist to estimate effort / duration for new requests and change orders. Track work queue, assign and adjust priorities and due dates based on client requirements and DT Leadership direction. Provide BI team with visibility to DT projects and project pipeline. Provide a forum for BI team collaboration on BI and Data Warehouse design and technical challenges. 
- Establish, document, and maintain best practices for Business Intelligence and Data Warehousing. 

Qualifications



- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Analytics, Data/Information Science, Information Systems, Mathematics (or other related fields)
- 6+ years of experience with SQL
- 4+ years of experience in Business Intelligence, data analysis, and reporting
- 4+ years of experience with Microsoft Power BI, including DAX, Power Query, and M language. 
- 2+ years of experience with Python (or other programming languages)
- 4+ years of experience managing projects from inception to execution.

- Microsoft Fabric Analytics Engineer certifications preferred. 
- Strong understanding of Data Warehousing and Business Intelligence concepts, Data Quality, and the related technology landscape, processes, and design principles
- Proven track record in operating large data warehouse and business intelligence programs
- Experience in managing enterprise data assets in a large, complex organization
- Should be familiar with cloud and data management trends and methodologies
- Ability to analyze complex situations and to derive workable actions
- Ability to constructively challenge requirements and current state to increase overall value to the firm
- Strong relationship building skills
- Flexibility to adjust to multiple demands, shifting priorities, ambiguity, and rapid change
- Good written and verbal communication
- Strong analytical and time management skills
- Strong facilitation skills with the ability to drive issues to closure
- Self-motivated and able to handle tasks with minimal supervision or questions
- Ability to compare technologies and make recommendations to senior members of the team
- Understanding of privacy laws and regulations

The Opportunity

As a Applied AI Health Data Architect you will shape data architecture solutions that support health services provider clients, bringing together data engineering, analytics, and AI to improve how information is structured, integrated, and used across cloud environments. As a Senior Manager you will lead large projects, bring strategic direction to complex data modernization efforts, and use sound judgment to guide teams and stakeholders through changing priorities and technical complexity. In this role at PwC, you will work within our Advisory practice and within our Data, Analytics & AI services to design data platforms, support cloud-native architecture decisions, and contribute to delivery across AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud Platform environments for health sector clients.

Responsibilities

  • Leading applied AI and health data architecture initiatives for provider data environments, translating business goals into scalable data solutions
  • Designing cloud-native data platforms, pipelines, and integration patterns across AWS, Azure, Databricks, and Snowflake
  • Developing data models, warehouse structures, and transformation logic that support analytics, AI workloads, and operational reporting
  • Guiding data modernization efforts that migrate legacy systems into modern architectures with improved performance, security, and usability
  • Overseeing data quality, validation, governance, and anonymization practices across sensitive health data domains
  • Applying data engineering methods to tune pipelines, optimize queries, and improve database and warehouse performance
  • Advising client stakeholders on data strategy, architecture decisions, and AI-ready platform design within complex provider environments
  • Leading teams through delivery planning, issue resolution, and technical coordination across multiple workstreams
  • Coaching practitioners on data engineering platforms, digital tooling, and AI-enabled solution delivery
  • Presenting solution options, tradeoffs, and implementation paths that support modernization priorities and future data capabilities

What You Must Have

  • At least a Bachelor's degree
  • At least 7 years of experience

What Sets You Apart

  • Preference for at least one of the following fields of study: Analytics/Data Science, Business Administration/Management, Computer Science/Information Systems, Economics, Engineering, Finance, Mathematics/Statistics, Operations/Supply Chain
  • Demonstrating data architecture leadership for healthcare provider modernization initiatives
  • Utilizing AWS, Azure, Databricks, or Snowflake for cloud data platforms
  • Applying AI fluency to data engineering and architecture decisions
  • Translating client needs into scalable data modernization roadmaps
  • Leading complex, multi-team delivery with composure and sound judgment

descriptionHtml:
Introduction

A career in IBM Consulting is built on long-term client relationships and close collaboration worldwide. You'll work with leading companies across industries, helping them shape their hybrid cloud and AI journeys. With support from our strategic partners, robust IBM technology, and Red Hat, you'll have the tools to drive meaningful change and accelerate client impact. At IBM Consulting, curiosity fuels success. You'll be encouraged to challenge the norm, explore new ideas, and create innovative solutions that deliver real results. Our culture of growth and empathy focuses on your long-term career development while valuing your unique skills and experiences.

Your Role And Responsibilities

As an Application Architect specializing in Microsoft Analytics & Cloud, you will design, implement, and support complex Data & AI architectures, possessing a deep understanding of complex data platforms. You will leverage your expertise to create and maintain data pipelines, data storage solutions, and data integration using various Azure services.

Your Primary Responsibilities Will Include

  • Design and Implement Data Architectures: Design and implement complex data architectures, connecting data sources, data visualization, structured and unstructured data, and advanced analytics using AI/ML.
  • Develop and Maintain Data Pipelines: Create and maintain data pipelines, data storage solutions, and data integration using Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2, Azure Datafactory, Azure Databricks, and other Azure services.
  • Optimize Power BI Dashboards: Optimize Microsoft Power BI dashboards with a focus on usability, performance, flexibility, testability, and standardization.
  • Implement Data Governance: Implement data governance using Azure Purview, ensuring data quality, security, and compliance.
  • Deliver Solution Deployments: Deliver automated deployments using Azure DevOps, ensuring efficient and reliable solution delivery.

Required Technical And Professional Expertise

  • Data Platform Expertise: Possess a deep understanding of complex data platforms, including architectural sense for connecting data sources, data visualization, structured and unstructured data, and advanced analytics using AI/ML.
  • Azure Services Experience: Exposure to creating and maintaining data pipelines, data storage solutions, and data integration using Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2, Azure Datafactory, Azure Databricks, Azure SQL Server, Synapse, Microsoft Fabric, Purview, and Cosmos DB.
  • Business Intelligence Proficiency: In-depth experience with Power BI and Microsoft Business Intelligence Suite (Microsoft SSAS, SSIS, SSRS), including design, architecture, and development roles.
  • Data Governance Knowledge: Experience with implementing data governance using Azure Purview, ensuring data quality, security, and compliance.
  • Software Engineering Fundamentals: Exposure to software engineering techniques, software engineering architecture, software engineering life cycle, and data management, with experience in Agile fundamentals and methodology.

Preferred Technical And Professional Experience

  • Microsoft Azure Logic Apps: Experience with Microsoft Azure Logic Apps, Azure Functions, Azure Service Bus, Azure IoT, and Azure App Fabric is beneficial for this role.
  • Azure Machine Learning: Knowledge and experience in using Azure Machine Learning cloud-based predictive analytics services is advantageous.
  • No-SQL Database Expertise: Deep technical experience in No-SQL databases, specifically Cosmos DB, is desirable.
  • Preferred Skills: Project & Program Management, Cloud Operations, Security & Transformation Management.

Job Description:

What You’ll Do

Enterprise Information Architect & BIDW Leader will establish and deliver upon the enterprise information architecture vision for enterprise-level solutions. This role is responsible for the delivery of business Intelligence & data warehouse solutions to the firm, including the information architecture and management processes of the BI data warehouse and leading the BI function and team.

Responsibilities

LEADERSHIP

  • Ownership of and accountability for successful results of the Data Warehouse & Business Intelligence teams within Data Transformation.
  • Thought leadership in matters of enterprise data architecture, staying abreast of new technologies, patterns and methods which c an be applicable to Crowe data
  • Development of team strategy, creation and socialization of roadmaps, establishing and ensuring adherence to timelines, and resource assignment for the BIDW team
  • Seek opportunities to bring value to the Crowe business and/or its customers through innovative enterprise data and BI strategies to support strategic business goals
  • Develop quantifiable goals for the team which are aligned with Data Transformation’s strategic goals as well as Crowe’s strategic business initiatives
  • Mentor and coach developers, data engineers, managers, and other roles within team, intentionally managing career growth via mentorship and proactive planning
  • Actively participate in and collaborate with technical guilds to further expose and align the firm on best practices
  • Understand when to delegate; this role manages resources and owns the entire team’s success
  • Responsibility to track and maintain clear visibility into the value and delivery timing of BIDW team initiatives for Head of Data and business stakeholders

DEMAND MANAGEMENT & BUSINESS ENGAGEMENT

  • Collaboration with Head of Data and/or other firm leaders to understand strategic business needs and requirements, and planning team and technology capacity accordingly
  • Communication and engagement to ensure the business sees maximum value from its data warehouse and business intelligence investments
  • Develop and maintain an understanding of business needs, technical architecture and systems landscape, and the technology strategy of the business
  • Collaborate with both BIDW team and Data Transformation leaders to establish goals, plan capacity, support other Data Transformation initiatives, and leave margin for learning and unexpected shifts

PROGRAM DESIGN, DEVELOPMENT & DEPLOYMENT

  • Ultimate ownership for team delivery quality and schedule
  • Work closely with technology and business personnel to deliver value in a timely manner
  • Accountability for team using best practices for development and quality assurance aligned with firmwide standards, seeking opportunities to automate and improve
  • CONTINUOUS IMPROVEMENT
  • Champion a culture and mindset of excellence, collaboration, continuous improvement, design thinking and positivity
  • Establish metrics to monitor and tangibly demonstrate the value provided to the business via effectiveness, quality metrics, sensitive data monitoring as well as alert to any negative trends in these areas
  • Work with stakeholders to prioritize continuous improvement
  • Assess and recommend opportunities to retire/consolidate redundant legacy system assets
  • ADOPTION & VALUE REALIZATION
  • Work with team and business users to ensure successful adoption, usage, and benefit realization from solutions
  • Define and track KPIs and success metrics for adoption and value creation

Specific responsibility expectations by the components listed below –

Information Architecture Vision: Establish the Enterprise Information Architecture vision within the context of business strategy and in alignment with overall Technology & Strategy direction.

  • Translate strategic requirements into a usable enterprise information architecture, which may include an enterprise data model, common business vocabulary, ontology, and taxonomies, to guide enterprise solution development and achieve consistency of information assets.
  • Create an information architecture consistent with the business, application, and technical architectures.
  • Facilitate the mapping and traceability of information assets as they flow from source datastores to targets, thus ensuring optimal transparency, quality, consistency, and controlled redundancy.

Information Architecture Delivery: Work with and mentor delivery teams to provide data solutions that are in keeping with the enterprise information architecture. This may include:

  • Assessing suitability of vendor solutions to meet enterprise information requirements.
  • Construct, refine and maintain information models, as needed, to meet business requirements and drive data designs for operational and analytical solutions.
  • Facilitate the definition of integrative and canonical views of data or information across multiple content types to support convergence of information asset migration planning or impact analysis.
  • Ensure new development is consistent and well-integrated with the established enterprise information architecture, using metadata management and/or a repository to promote reuse and standards adoption.
  • Review corporate data sources for new business information and better data sources. Assist in post-implementation improvement efforts to enhance performance and provide increased functionality.
  • Participate in key project design reviews as part of the methodology process to ensure application designs adhere to enterprise information architecture guidelines.
  • Provide oversight for the BI Data Warehouse. Design an enterprise-wide integrated Data Warehouse for
  • Business Intelligence by modeling new and enhancing existing BIDW datamarts. Establish logical and physical models, maintain metadata, and guide integration engineers for the physical datamart schema and logical integration (ETL) processes. Assist, as required, with testing and issue resolution. Establish and enhance governance processes for the BI Data Warehouse (naming conventions, conformed dimensions and facts, meta-models, security configuration) to ensure a consistent implementation across all datamarts.
  • On large implementation projects, deliver project artifacts including: Data Integration Inventory, 360 Data Integration Diagram, Core structures diagram, Data Integration Requirements document and Test Plans, Report Inventory, Reporting Gap Analysis and Strategy, and Historical Data Strategy

Business Intelligence Team Leadership: Provide leadership, oversight, and quality assurance for BI Team and team deliverables. This may include:

  • Manage and coach BI team members in delivery of high-quality business intelligence solutions. Assist to estimate effort / duration for new requests and change orders. Track work queue, assign and adjust priorities and due dates based on client requirements and DT Leadership direction. Provide BI team with visibility to DT projects and project pipeline. Provide a forum for BI team collaboration on BI and Data Warehouse design and technical challenges.
  • Establish, document, and maintain best practices for Business Intelligence and Data Warehousing.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Analytics, Data/Information Science, Information Systems, Mathematics (or other related fields)
  • 6+ years of experience with SQL
  • 4+ years of experience in Business Intelligence, data analysis, and reporting
  • 4+ years of experience with Microsoft Power BI, including DAX, Power Query, and M language.
  • 2+ years of experience with Python (or other programming languages)
  • 4+ years of experience managing projects from inception to execution.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Microsoft Fabric Analytics Engineer certifications preferred.
  • Strong understanding of Data Warehousing and Business Intelligence concepts, Data Quality, and the related technology landscape, processes, and design principles
  • Proven track record in operating large data warehouse and business intelligence programs
  • Experience in managing enterprise data assets in a large, complex organization
  • Should be familiar with cloud and data management trends and methodologies
  • Ability to analyze complex situations and to derive workable actions
  • Ability to constructively challenge requirements and current state to increase overall value to the firm
  • Strong relationship building skills
  • Flexibility to adjust to multiple demands, shifting priorities, ambiguity, and rapid change
  • Good written and verbal communication
  • Strong analytical and time management skills
  • Strong facilitation skills with the ability to drive issues to closure
  • Self-motivated and able to handle tasks with minimal supervision or questions
  • Ability to compare technologies and make recommendations to senior members of the team
  • Understanding of privacy laws and regulations

Introduction

A career in IBM Consulting is built on long-term client relationships and close collaboration worldwide. You'll work with leading companies across industries, helping them shape their hybrid cloud and AI journeys. With support from our strategic partners, robust IBM technology, and Red Hat, you'll have the tools to drive meaningful change and accelerate client impact. At IBM Consulting, curiosity fuels success. You'll be encouraged to challenge the norm, explore new ideas, and create innovative solutions that deliver real results. Our culture of growth and empathy focuses on your long-term career development while valuing your unique skills and experiences.

Your Role And Responsibilities

As a Business Transformation Consultant specializing in Data Platforms, you will plan, design, manage, and implement core components of Watson Service Offerings and Digital Insights Platforms, as well as other similar non-IBM solutions. This role involves creating solutions that deliver significant and lasting business improvements for clients.

Your Primary Responsibilities Will Include

What You’ll Do

  • Design scalable and efficient Logical and Physical data models for enterprise data products storage solutions and lines of businesses
  • Design operational and analytical data models
  • Develop data management frameworks and standards to ensure data integrity, quality, and security.
  • Works closely with Data Product Managers, Value Stream architects, Data engineers to understand the business problems, desired outcomes using data strategy and translating these requirements into data solutions.
  • Create and maintain inventory and designs of current state data capabilities
  • Ensure alignment of data models with end-to-end data architecture including performance tuning to adhere to SLAs.
  • Demonstrated experience as a change agent, successfully leading and implementing organizational change initiatives that drive transformation and improve business outcomes.
  • Identify and frame opportunities for consolidation / simplification of legacy technologies, data stores, and applications.
  • Build subject matter expertise to be able to answer business questions as well as support new initiatives from a data knowledge perspective
  • Enforce data governance policies and procedures as part of the data model
  • Stay up to date with the latest industry trends and technologies in data management.
  • Identify opportunities for improvement and innovation within the existing data infrastructure.
  • Ensure data solutions comply with relevant data privacy and security regulations.
  • Implement data security measures to protect sensitive information.

 

What You’ll Bring

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience as a Data Modeler for large-scale enterprise solutions, with a strong focus on agile practices.
  • Deep understanding of modern data architecture, including experience with data lakes, data warehouses, data marts, relational and dimensional modeling, data quality, and master data management.
  • Strong background in Operational Data Stores, Dimensional Modeling, and supporting application data architecture. Experience with Oracle, Postgres, MySQL, and understanding of best practice architectural concepts for relational data models.
  • Experience in designing, deploying, and evaluating tools, frameworks, and patterns for scalable data platforms.
  • Extensive experience with industry-leading data platform technologies such as Data Lake, Databricks, Snowflake
  • Experience with database technologies for both structured and unstructured data, ensuring optimal storage and retrieval.
  • Extensive hands-on experience in creating STMs
  • Proficient in cloud architecture and best practices, particularly with AWS Cloud tools such as Amazon RDS, Redshift, AWS DMS, AWS Glue, Amazon S3, AWS Lambda, and more.
  • Proficient in managing large datasets, cloud computing, open-source tools, and optimization techniques.
  • Expertise in overall solution architecture for data platforms built on the cloud.
  • Strong experience in data integration, data processing, data streaming, and message queuing techniques
  • Familiarity with relevant code repository and project tools like GitHub, JIRA, Confluence.
  • Experience with Continuous Integration and Continuous Deployment (CI/CD) processes.
  • Detail-oriented with strong analytical, problem-solving, and organizational skills.
  • Excellent communication skills, capable of effectively conveying complex concepts both technical and business teams.

 

Desired Skills

  • Solid understanding of the insurance, wealth management or financial services industry
  • Extensive hands-on development experience with Cloud (AWS, Azure) and Storage services are desirable.
  • Knowledge of machine learning pipelines and frameworks is a plus.
  • Experience supporting AI solutions with data product strategy and enabling solutions.
  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science or an Engineering discipline
  • Certification in data management (structure and unstructured), and/or cloud architecture or engineering a plus
  • Certification in delivery methodologies such as Scaled Agile a plus.

 

Pay Transparency

Salary Range: $124,000-$177,000

Overtime eligible: Exempt

Discretionary bonus eligible: Yes

Sales bonus eligible: No

Actual base salary will be determined based on several factors but not limited to individual’s experience, skills, qualifications, and job location. descriptionHtml:
In an increasingly challenging environment marked by disruptive tech like AI, market uncertainty, and regulatory change, finance and global business services leaders recognize the opportunity to better serve the enterprise, shareholders, customers, and regulators.

Deloitte helps navigate this complexity by bringing deep industry insights and integrated solutions to achieve business objectives. From strategy to technology to operations, and across workforce, risk, assurance, and tax, Deloitte helps drive value along the Finance Transformation journey.

Recruiting for this role ends on 09/30/2026

Work you'll do

As a Finance Data & AI Manager specializing in Microsoft Azure and Fabric, you'll lead teams that design end-to-end solutions from source integration and OneLake through trusted data products, AI, and Power BI. You will guide architecture from strategy through production.

  • Lead engagements or workstreams that define end-to-end Azure and Fabric architectures across integration, OneLake, lakehouse/warehouse, security, AI, and finance consumption
  • Guide batch, streaming, mirroring, and orchestration design with Fabric Data Factory, Data Engineering, Spark, Data Warehouse, and Real-Time Intelligence
  • Establish governance, lineage, Entra-based access, data quality, observability, service-level objectives, and remediation with Microsoft Purview
  • Define reusable finance data products, canonical models, OneLake sharing, APIs, and governed semantic models for planning, close, profitability, treasury, and reporting
  • Architect production ML and generative and agentic AI with Fabric Data Science and Azure AI services, MLOps and LLMOps, evaluation, monitoring, and responsible AI
  • Manage client relationships, estimates, design reviews, deployment, capacity and cost outcomes; mentor teams and support demonstrations, proposals, and RFP responses
  • Agentic Redesign of Finance data and processes such as planning, forecasting, close, profitability, treasury, or reporting

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Ability to translate finance outcomes into clear architecture decisions
  • Effective written, verbal, and executive communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to mentor and provide clear guidance to others

The team

Deloitte's Finance Transformation offering helps finance and global business services leaders navigate an increasingly challenging environment marked by disruptive tech like AI, market uncertainty, and regulatory change, and recognize the opportunity to better serve the enterprise, shareholders, customers, and regulators.

Within the Finance Transformation offering, our Business Finance team drives strategic value through planning, forecasting, and analytics. We design trusted finance data products, modern platforms, and AI-enabled solutions that deliver timely, actionable insights.

Qualifications

Required:

  • 6+ years of experience architecting enterprise data, analytics, or AI solutions in a corporate or consulting environment
  • 4+ years of experience designing Azure or Fabric solutions across data engineering, lakehouse/warehouse, security, performance, and multi-environment deployment
  • 4+ years of experience with finance data and processes such as planning, forecasting, close, profitability, treasury, or reporting
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Information Systems, Finance, Accounting, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field
  • Ability to travel 50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
  • Limited immigration sponsorship may be available.

Preferred:

  • Experience with OneLake, Lakehouse, Data Warehouse, Data Factory, Data Engineering, Real-Time Intelligence, Direct Lake, Power BI, and Purview
  • Experience with data quality, observability, lineage, testing, CI/CD, infrastructure as code, and capacity/cost optimization
  • Experience deploying ML, retrieval-augmented generation, or agentic AI with Azure AI or Fabric Data Science and responsible AI controls
  • Experience integrating SAP, Oracle, Workday, Anaplan, or OneStream and building governed Power BI semantic models, DAX measures, and reports
  • Microsoft certification in Azure architecture, Fabric, or Power BI; or a master's degree in a related field
  • 2+ years of experience supporting pre-sales, proposals, RFP responses, and mentoring data and AI delivery teams

The Opportunity

As a Applied AI Health Data Architect you will shape data architecture solutions that support health services provider clients, bringing together data engineering, analytics, and AI to improve how information is structured, integrated, and used across cloud environments. As a Senior Manager you will lead large projects, bring strategic direction to complex data modernization efforts, and use sound judgment to guide teams and stakeholders through changing priorities and technical complexity. In this role at PwC, you will work within our Advisory practice and within our Data, Analytics & AI services to design data platforms, support cloud-native architecture decisions, and contribute to delivery across AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud Platform environments for health sector clients.

  • Leading applied AI and health data architecture initiatives for provider data environments, translating business goals into scalable data solutions
  • Designing cloud-native data platforms, pipelines, and integration patterns across AWS, Azure, Databricks, and Snowflake
  • Developing data models, warehouse structures, and transformation logic that support analytics, AI workloads, and operational reporting
  • Guiding data modernization efforts that migrate legacy systems into modern architectures with improved performance, security, and usability
  • Overseeing data quality, validation, governance, and anonymization practices across sensitive health data domains
  • Applying data engineering methods to tune pipelines, optimize queries, and improve database and warehouse performance
  • Advising client stakeholders on data strategy, architecture decisions, and AI-ready platform design within complex provider environments
  • Leading teams through delivery planning, issue resolution, and technical coordination across multiple workstreams
