Gilbane is seeking a Data Architect to provide strategic and technical leadership in the design, evaluation, and governance of enterprise technology capabilities. This role translates business objectives into scalable, secure, reliable, and sustainable architectures while ensuring alignment with enterprise strategy, standards, and roadmaps. This role can be located near any Gilbane office or remote.

Who are we?

As a Top-10 ENR Contractor, Gilbane is a family-owned business with 45 offices that has been shaping communities since 1870. Consistently recognized as one of the most reputable construction management firms in the country, Gilbane is committed to delivering projects safely and on-time. You will have the opportunity to build schools, labs, hospitals, corporate offices, sports arenas and more!

We are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

Who are you?

You are someone who acts inclusively, showing empathy and treating others with respect and dignity in order to uphold Gilbane’s core value of Caring and “People First” workplace culture. You seek to listen in order to understand and can convey information clearly. You’re a strong problem solver who can identify, prioritize, and implement alternatives for solutions, and you demonstrate adaptability by collaborating with others and supporting team members to achieve excellence. A self-starter who shows passion, commitment, and ownership all while delivering on business outcomes and driving results. You’re someone who identifies opportunities for new and improved ways of doing things that result in value-add solutions.

Your core values match Gilbane’s: Integrity, Caring, Teamwork, Toughmindedness, Dedication to Excellence, Discipline, Loyalty, and Entrepreneurship.

What’s in it for you?

Gilbane offers employees multi-dimensional training opportunities through a number of resources. While managing your responsibilities to projects, you will be able to enroll in trainings through our award-winning Gilbane University to build leadership and technical skills. In addition, you would work with an experienced team which provides you with the opportunity to learn new industry skills every day. You will protect and promote the interests of both Gilbane and the client in all matters as well as demonstrating the personal characteristics of a developing leader.

Responsibilities

  • Defines and maintains architecture principles, standards, reference architectures, reusable patterns, and technical guidance for assigned domains
  • Leads architecture and high-level design activities for strategic business and technology initiatives
  • Translates business capabilities, requirements, and constraints into practical architectures
  • Ensures architectures address key attributes such as scalability, security, reliability, interoperability, performance, maintainability, and supportability
  • Supports enterprise strategies and roadmaps by developing current-state, target-state, and transition architectures
  • Identifies relevant dependencies, risks, gaps, and opportunities across technology domains
  • Participates in architecture reviews, governance processes, portfolio planning, and the development of technology roadmaps
  • Provides architecture guidance throughout the delivery lifecycle to maintain alignment with approved designs and enterprise standards
  • Partners with business and technology stakeholders to understand strategic objectives, operational needs, and technology requirements; aligns architecture decisions with business priorities, enterprise capabilities, and long-term technology strategies
  • Communicates critical decision points such as options, tradeoffs, risks, and recommendations to technical and non-technical audiences; facilitates collaboration across business teams, product teams, delivery teams, security, operations, and vendors
  • Services as a trusted advisor for technology strategy solution design, and architectural decision-making
  • Promotes consistency and reuse across Business Units, applications, and technology initiatives
  • Coaches and mentors less experienced team members
  • Supports a positive and inclusive work environment

Experience/Education

 Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field; advanced degree preferred but not required
  • ?5+ years of experience in Solution Architecture, Application Architecture, Data Architecture, Enterprise Architecture, or related technical leadership roles
  • Certification or familiarity with architecture frameworks such as The Open Group Architecture Framework (TOGAF) or Zachman preferred
  • Relevant architecture, cloud, application, data, or technology certifications such as Azure Solutions Architect Expert, Certified Data Management Professional (CDMP), or comparable certification preferred
  • Or equivalent combination of education and experience

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

  • Experience designing enterprise-scale solutions across applications, data platforms, integrations, analytics, and cloud services
  • Experience evaluating packaged applications, cloud services, platform capabilities, and custom-development approaches to determine appropriate technology solutions
  • Strong knowledge of enterprise and data architecture, including data modeling, governance, information management, APIs, integration patterns, ETL/ELT, data lineage, access controls, and security principles
  • Understanding of application architecture principles, including service boundaries, scalability, resiliency, observability, interoperability, and lifecycle management
  • Ability to define architecture patterns and standards for APIs, events, messaging, data exchange, workflow orchestration, and system integration
  • Ability to translate business requirements and long-term objectives into scalable, secure, and sustainable technology solutions
  • Ability to architect solutions that balance governance, security, compliance, and data controls with innovation and agility
  • Strong problem-solving and collaboration skills, with the ability to identify root causes and build alignment across business, technology, and cross-functional teams
  • Ability to evaluate emerging technologies and capabilities for their potential to improve business outcomes, delivery effectiveness, and technology sustainability

Salary to be determined based on factors such as geographic location, skills, education, and/or experience of the applicant, as well as the internal equity and alignment with the team.

The pay ranges from $110,000-$155,000.00 plus benefits and retirement program.

Gilbane offers an excellent total compensation package which includes competitive health and welfare benefits and a generous profit-sharing/401k plan. We invest in our employees’ education and have built Gilbane University into a top training organization in the construction industry. Qualified applicants who are offered a position must pass a pre-employment substance abuse test.

Gilbane is an Affirmative Action/Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, color, national origin, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, protected veteran status, or disability status. Click here to view the physical demands and working conditions required to perform this role. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential job functions.

Note to Recruiters, Placement Agencies, and Similar Organizations: Gilbane does not accept unsolicited resumes from agencies. Please do not forward unsolicited agency resumes to our jobs alias, website, or to any Gilbane employee. Gilbane will not pay fees to any third party agency or firm and will not be responsible for any agency fees associated with unsolicited resumes. Unsolicited resumes received will be considered property of Gilbane and will be processed accordingly.

Job Description

As a Data Solutions Architect, you will lead the design of secure, reliable, and cost-conscious data and analytics solutions for clients. You will translate business goals and existing system constraints into target architectures, guide engineering teams through implementation while remaining hands-on in the development, and explain technical decisions and tradeoffs to client stakeholders. Your work will span data integration, storage, modeling, governance, and analytics across modern data platforms in Azure.

Key Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with clients and internal stakeholders to design and implement scalable data engineering solutions using the Microsoft Analytics ecosystem.
  • Lead discovery, select architecture patterns, document tradeoffs, guide implementations, and is accountable for the overall technical design.
  • Deliver current-state assessments, target architectures, integration patterns, data models, migration plans, estimates, and technical decision records.
  • Develop and maintain data pipelines, ensuring efficient extraction, transformation, and loading (ETL) processes for structured and unstructured data.
  • Apply best practices in dimensional modeling to create robust and scalable data models for analytics and reporting.
  • Leverage tools such as Python, dbt, and SQL to develop advanced data transformation and integration processes.
  • Optimize data storage and retrieval mechanisms to support high-performance analytics workloads.
  • Define approaches for access, sensitive data, data quality, lineage, deployment, monitoring, recovery, and capacity or cost.
  • Define hybrid analytics requirements, including connectivity and security, in partnership with cloud and security specialists.
  • Monitor and troubleshoot data pipelines and workflows to ensure accuracy, reliability, and performance.
  • Collaborate with analytics and BI teams to ensure seamless integration of data assets into Power BI and other reporting platforms.
  • Stay informed about emerging trends and technologies in data engineering and cloud analytics to enhance solution delivery.

Required Qualifications

  • At least 10 years of experience in data engineering, with deep expertise in the Microsoft Data and Analytics stack.
  • Multiple years of experience leading discovery, evaluating design tradeoffs, presenting recommendations, and guiding a delivery team.
  • Strong proficiency in SQL, Python, and data modeling techniques.
  • Working knowledge of data extraction patterns and best practices.
  • Experience with ETL tools and frameworks, such as dbt.
  • Solid understanding of dimensional modeling and its application in analytics.
  • Strong problem-solving skills with a focus on delivering scalable and efficient solutions.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with experience in client-facing roles.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Azure Cloud infrastructure, including hybrid analytics workload configurations and networking.
  • Certifications in Azure Engineering and Administration (e.g., Fabric Data Engineer Associate, Azure Administrator Associate, Azure Solutions Architect Expert).
  • Experience with Azure DevOps or GitHub for code repositories and deployment.
  • Experience with data vault modeling and data mesh architecture concepts preferred.
  • Familiarity with advanced analytics tools and concepts, including machine learning workflows.
  • Experience using approved AI-assisted development tools responsibly preferred.
  • Knowledge of additional data visualization tools such as Tableau, Qlik, or AWS Quicksight.
  • Experience with Agile methodologies for project management.

The pay range for this position is $100,000 to $182,400. This range represents a good-faith and reasonable estimate of the compensation the firm expects to pay for this position at the time of posting. Actual compensation will depend on a variety of relevant factors, including an applicant’s skills, experience, qualifications, professional certifications, work arrangements, geographic location, and other business and organizational needs. It is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range, and compensation decisions depend on the facts and circumstances of each case. Baker Tilly offers a compensation and benefits package to eligible employees.

At Crowe, you can build a meaningful and rewarding career. With real flexibility to balance work with life moments, you’re trusted to deliver results and make an impact. We embrace you for who you are, care for your well-being, and nurture your career. Everyone has equitable access to opportunities for career growth and leadership. Over our 80-year history, delivering excellent service through innovation has been a core part of our DNA across our audit, tax, and consulting groups. That’s why we continuously invest in innovative ideas, such as AI-enabled insights and technology-powered solutions, to enhance our services. Join us at Crowe and embark on a career where you can help shape the future of our industry.

Job Description:

What You’ll Do

Enterprise Information Architect & BIDW Leader will establish and deliver upon the enterprise information architecture vision for enterprise-level solutions. This role is responsible for the delivery of business Intelligence & data warehouse solutions to the firm, including the information architecture and management processes of the BI data warehouse and leading the BI function and team.

Responsibilities

LEADERSHIP

  • Ownership of and accountability for successful results of the Data Warehouse & Business Intelligence teams within Data Transformation.
  • Thought leadership in matters of enterprise data architecture, staying abreast of new technologies, patterns and methods which c an be applicable to Crowe data
  • Development of team strategy, creation and socialization of roadmaps, establishing and ensuring adherence to timelines, and resource assignment for the BIDW team
  • Seek opportunities to bring value to the Crowe business and/or its customers through innovative enterprise data and BI strategies to support strategic business goals
  • Develop quantifiable goals for the team which are aligned with Data Transformation’s strategic goals as well as Crowe’s strategic business initiatives
  • Mentor and coach developers, data engineers, managers, and other roles within team, intentionally managing career growth via mentorship and proactive planning
  • Actively participate in and collaborate with technical guilds to further expose and align the firm on best practices
  • Understand when to delegate; this role manages resources and owns the entire team’s success
  • Responsibility to track and maintain clear visibility into the value and delivery timing of BIDW team initiatives for Head of Data and business stakeholders

DEMAND MANAGEMENT & BUSINESS ENGAGEMENT

  • Collaboration with Head of Data and/or other firm leaders to understand strategic business needs and requirements, and planning team and technology capacity accordingly
  • Communication and engagement to ensure the business sees maximum value from its data warehouse and business intelligence investments
  • Develop and maintain an understanding of business needs, technical architecture and systems landscape, and the technology strategy of the business
  • Collaborate with both BIDW team and Data Transformation leaders to establish goals, plan capacity, support other Data Transformation initiatives, and leave margin for learning and unexpected shifts

PROGRAM DESIGN, DEVELOPMENT & DEPLOYMENT

  • Ultimate ownership for team delivery quality and schedule
  • Work closely with technology and business personnel to deliver value in a timely manner
  • Accountability for team using best practices for development and quality assurance aligned with firmwide standards, seeking opportunities to automate and improve
  • CONTINUOUS IMPROVEMENT
  • Champion a culture and mindset of excellence, collaboration, continuous improvement, design thinking and positivity
  • Establish metrics to monitor and tangibly demonstrate the value provided to the business via effectiveness, quality metrics, sensitive data monitoring as well as alert to any negative trends in these areas
  • Work with stakeholders to prioritize continuous improvement
  • Assess and recommend opportunities to retire/consolidate redundant legacy system assets
  • ADOPTION & VALUE REALIZATION
  • Work with team and business users to ensure successful adoption, usage, and benefit realization from solutions
  • Define and track KPIs and success metrics for adoption and value creation

Specific responsibility expectations by the components listed below –

Information Architecture Vision: Establish the Enterprise Information Architecture vision within the context of business strategy and in alignment with overall Technology & Strategy direction.

  • Translate strategic requirements into a usable enterprise information architecture, which may include an enterprise data model, common business vocabulary, ontology, and taxonomies, to guide enterprise solution development and achieve consistency of information assets.
  • Create an information architecture consistent with the business, application, and technical architectures.
  • Facilitate the mapping and traceability of information assets as they flow from source datastores to targets, thus ensuring optimal transparency, quality, consistency, and controlled redundancy.

Information Architecture Delivery: Work with and mentor delivery teams to provide data solutions that are in keeping with the enterprise information architecture. This may include:

  • Assessing suitability of vendor solutions to meet enterprise information requirements.
  • Construct, refine and maintain information models, as needed, to meet business requirements and drive data designs for operational and analytical solutions.
  • Facilitate the definition of integrative and canonical views of data or information across multiple content types to support convergence of information asset migration planning or impact analysis.
  • Ensure new development is consistent and well-integrated with the established enterprise information architecture, using metadata management and/or a repository to promote reuse and standards adoption.
  • Review corporate data sources for new business information and better data sources. Assist in post-implementation improvement efforts to enhance performance and provide increased functionality.
  • Participate in key project design reviews as part of the methodology process to ensure application designs adhere to enterprise information architecture guidelines.
  • Provide oversight for the BI Data Warehouse. Design an enterprise-wide integrated Data Warehouse for
  • Business Intelligence by modeling new and enhancing existing BIDW datamarts. Establish logical and physical models, maintain metadata, and guide integration engineers for the physical datamart schema and logical integration (ETL) processes. Assist, as required, with testing and issue resolution. Establish and enhance governance processes for the BI Data Warehouse (naming conventions, conformed dimensions and facts, meta-models, security configuration) to ensure a consistent implementation across all datamarts.
  • On large implementation projects, deliver project artifacts including: Data Integration Inventory, 360 Data Integration Diagram, Core structures diagram, Data Integration Requirements document and Test Plans, Report Inventory, Reporting Gap Analysis and Strategy, and Historical Data Strategy

Business Intelligence Team Leadership: Provide leadership, oversight, and quality assurance for BI Team and team deliverables. This may include:

  • Manage and coach BI team members in delivery of high-quality business intelligence solutions. Assist to estimate effort / duration for new requests and change orders. Track work queue, assign and adjust priorities and due dates based on client requirements and DT Leadership direction. Provide BI team with visibility to DT projects and project pipeline. Provide a forum for BI team collaboration on BI and Data Warehouse design and technical challenges.
  • Establish, document, and maintain best practices for Business Intelligence and Data Warehousing.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Analytics, Data/Information Science, Information Systems, Mathematics (or other related fields)
  • 6+ years of experience with SQL
  • 4+ years of experience in Business Intelligence, data analysis, and reporting
  • 4+ years of experience with Microsoft Power BI, including DAX, Power Query, and M language.
  • 2+ years of experience with Python (or other programming languages)
  • 4+ years of experience managing projects from inception to execution.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Microsoft Fabric Analytics Engineer certifications preferred.
  • Strong understanding of Data Warehousing and Business Intelligence concepts, Data Quality, and the related technology landscape, processes, and design principles
  • Proven track record in operating large data warehouse and business intelligence programs
  • Experience in managing enterprise data assets in a large, complex organization
  • Should be familiar with cloud and data management trends and methodologies
  • Ability to analyze complex situations and to derive workable actions
  • Ability to constructively challenge requirements and current state to increase overall value to the firm
  • Strong relationship building skills
  • Flexibility to adjust to multiple demands, shifting priorities, ambiguity, and rapid change
  • Good written and verbal communication
  • Strong analytical and time management skills
  • Strong facilitation skills with the ability to drive issues to closure
  • Self-motivated and able to handle tasks with minimal supervision or questions
  • Ability to compare technologies and make recommendations to senior members of the team
  • Understanding of privacy laws and regulations

#Remote

We expect the candidate to uphold Crowe’s values of Care, Trust, Courage, and Stewardship. These values define who we are. We expect all of our people to act ethically and with integrity at all times.

The application deadline for this role is 02/28/2027.

In compliance with federal law, all persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work in the United States and to complete the required employment eligibility verification form upon hire. Crowe is not sponsoring for work authorization at this time.

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Crowe, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $151,100.00 - $318,600.00 per year.

Our Benefits:

Your exceptional people experience starts here. At Crowe, we know that great people are what makes a great firm. We care about our people and offer employees a comprehensive total rewards package. Learn more about what working at Crowe can mean for you!

How You Can Grow:

We will nurture your talent in an inclusive culture that values diversity. You will have the chance to meet on a consistent basis with your Career Coach that will guide you in your career goals and aspirations. Learn more about where talent can prosper!

More about Crowe:

Crowe provides professional services through two separate entities: Crowe LLP delivers audit and attest services, and Crowe Advisory LLC provides tax, advisory, consulting, and other nonattest services.

The Crowe Global network consists of more than 300 independent accounting and advisory services firms in more than 150 countries around the globe, making it one of the largest accounting networks in the world*. As independent members of Crowe Global, Crowe LLP and Crowe Advisory LLC serve clients worldwide. (*As of July 2026)

Crowe LLP and Crowe Advisory LLC (and their respective subsidiary entities) provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetics, national origin, disability or protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

Crowe LLP and Crowe Advisory LLC (and their respective subsidiary entities) does not accept unsolicited candidates, referrals or resumes from any staffing agency, recruiting service, sourcing entity or any other third-party paid service at any time. Any referrals, resumes or candidates submitted to Crowe, or any employee or owner of Crowe without a pre-existing agreement signed by both parties covering the submission will be considered the property of Crowe, and free of charge.

Crowe will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance, San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, and the California Fair Chance Act.

Please visit our webpage to see notices of the various state and local Ban-the-Box laws and Fair Chance Ordinances, where applicable.

We are committed to a merit-based hiring process, evaluating all candidates consistently using objective, job-related criteria such as relevant experience, demonstrated skills, measurable impact, and alignment with the role’s responsibilities, and making employment decisions in a fair and inclusive manner free from discrimination.

If you are interested in applying for employment with Crowe and are in need of an accommodation or require special assistance to navigate our website or to complete your application, please visit our Applicant Assistance and Accommodations page for more information: https://careers.crowe.com/crowe-applicant-assistance-and-accommodation

Stay Alert: Avoid Recruitment Scams
 
Across industries, cybercriminals are posing as company recruiters using fake job postings and employment offers to trick people into providing personal information or payment. Be alert and never provide personal/financial information or payment to anyone claiming to offer a job opportunity. During the recruiting process, RSM US will never: 
 
	• Ask you for payment to process documents, purchase equipment, or for any other reason.
	• Request your banking or credit card information
	• Send you a check to purchase your own equipment 
 
If you believe you are a victim of a job scam, it’s recommended that you report it to law enforcement, contact your financial institution and notify the website in which the job was listed.

descriptionHtml:
We are the leading provider of professional services to the middle market globally, our purpose is to instill confidence in a world of change, empowering our clients and people to realize their full potential. Our exceptional people are the key to our unrivaled, culture and talent experience and our ability to be compelling to our clients. You’ll find an environment that inspires and empowers you to thrive both personally and professionally. There’s no one like you and that’s why there’s nowhere like RSM.

Solution Architect – Data Platforms

The Solution Architect - Data Platforms owns the current and target-state architecture for RSM's analytical and data platform ecosystem, servicing both our internal and client-facing business units. This role evolves the core data platform stack, partners with the Solution Architect - Data Solutions Architect on canonical models and inbound contracts and represents platform architecture in ARB and steering committee reviews.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the enterprise data platform architecture, including lakehouse/medallion (bronze/silver/gold) layering for the analytical platform serving Assurance, Consulting, Tax, and cross-LOB portfolios.
  • Evaluate and recommend platform technologies for storage, compute, and orchestration (e.g., Databricks, Snowflake, Azure Synapse/Fabric, ADLS), producing architecture decision records for steering committee review.
  • Design ingestion, ELT/ETL, and orchestration patterns spanning batch, micro-batch, and workloads.
  • Adhere to data governance and catalog architecture, partnering with data stewardship on lineage, classification, and data quality using Microsoft Purview.
  • Establish reference architecture and platform standards, including access controls, data residency, SOC 2 / SOX compliance, and IRS 7216 requirements.
  • Partner with the Solution Architect - Data Solutions Architect to align canonical data models, conformed dimensions, and integration contracts feeding the platform.
  • Guide build-vs-buy decisions and platform proof-of-concepts, comparing target architecture options (e.g., Medallion vs. Kimball, Inmon, Data Vault 2.0, Data Mesh) and documenting trade-offs.
  • Lead capacity and cost architecture for compute and storage, including FinOps considerations across cloud consumption.
  • Maintain platform documentation: reference architecture, data flow diagrams, architecture decision records.
  • Sponsor ARB submissions for platform-related initiatives and ensure adherence to enterprise architecture governance.

Qualifications & Experience

  • 8+ years of data/platform architecture experience, including at least 4 years designing enterprise-scale lakehouse or modern data warehouse platforms.
  • Deep hands-on expertise with one or more modern platform stacks (e.g., Microsoft Fabric, Databricks).
  • Strong understanding of medallion architecture, Data Mesh, and Data Vault 2.0 concepts and when each pattern applies.
  • Experience with data governance tooling (Microsoft Purview or comparable) for cataloging, lineage, and classification.
  • Familiarity with orchestration engines (e.g., ADF, Airflow) and streaming/change-data-capture approaches.
  • Knowledge of data platform security architecture (RBAC, row/column-level security, data residency).
  • Experience operating in regulated environments and adhering to SOC 2 / SOX control requirements.
  • Strong communication skills; ability to present architecture options and trade-offs to steering committees and leadership.
  • Prior experience partnering with integration and data modeling architects on canonical models and contracts.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related field, or equivalent experience.

At RSM, we offer a competitive benefits and compensation package for all our people. Learn more about our total rewards at https://rsmus.com/careers/working-at-rsm/benefits.

We believe flexibility and in-person connection both play an important role in how we work and grow. Most roles at RSM follow a hybrid workstyle, which means team members are aligned to an RSM office and come together in person when it best supports clients, teams, development or relationship-building. Some roles may be virtual or primarily on-site based on role requirements, team priorities and client needs.

All applicants will receive consideration for employment as RSM does not tolerate discrimination and/or harassment based on race; color; creed; sincerely held religious beliefs, practices or observances; sex (including pregnancy or disabilities related to nursing); gender; sexual orientation; HIV Status; national origin; ancestry; familial or marital status; age; physical or mental disability; citizenship; political affiliation; medical condition (including family and medical leave); domestic violence victim status; past, current or prospective service in the US uniformed service; US Military/Veteran status; pre-disposing genetic characteristics or any other characteristic protected under applicable federal, state or local law.

Accommodation for applicants with disabilities is available upon request in connection with the recruitment process and/or employment/partnership. RSM is committed to providing equal opportunity and reasonable accommodation for people with disabilities. If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete an application, interview, or otherwise participate in the recruiting process, please call us at 800-274-3978 or send us an email at careers@rsmus.com.

RSM does not intend to hire entry level candidates who will require sponsorship now OR in the future (i.e. F-1 visa holders). If you are a recent U.S. college / university graduate possessing 1-2 years of progressive and relevant work experience in a same or similar role to the one for which you are applying, excluding internships, you may be eligible for hire as an experienced associate.

RSM will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records. For those living in California or applying to a position in California, please click here for additional information.

At RSM, an employee’s pay at any point in their career is intended to reflect their experiences, performance, and skills for their current role. The salary range (or starting rate for interns and associates) for this role represents numerous factors considered in the hiring decisions including, but not limited to, education, skills, work experience, certifications, location, etc. As such, pay for the successful candidate(s) could fall anywhere within the stated range.

Compensation Range: $147,000 - $260,700

Individuals selected for this role will be eligible for a discretionary bonus based on firm and individual performance.

descriptionHtml:
WHAT MAKES US A GREAT PLACE TO WORK

We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world’s best places to work. We are currently the top ranked consulting firm on Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work list and have earned the #1 overall spot a record seven times. Extraordinary teams are at the heart of our business strategy, but these don’t happen by chance. They require intentional focus on bringing together a broad set of backgrounds, cultures, experiences, perspectives, and skills in a supportive and inclusive work environment. We hire people with exceptional talent and create an environment in which every individual can thrive professionally and personally.


WHO YOU'LL WORK WITH

You'll join our Architecture experts within the Applied Technology & AI. This team combines Bain’s strategy, industry, and transformation capabilities with deep technical expertise to solve clients’ most important business problems. Software, AI, and data engineers, data scientists, designers, product managers, and technical leads work with clients and Bain consultants to shape, build, deploy, and scale production-grade products and systems that create lasting competitive advantage.


WHAT YOU'LL DO (Essential Functions):

Shape Architecture and Technology Strategy 

  • Lead the definition of enterprise data architecture strategies, target states, and roadmaps aligned with client business priorities and transformation outcomes. 
  • Architect scalable, resilient, and secure enterprise data platforms and solutions across cloud, hybrid, and multi-cloud environments. 
  • Define organizational strategies and operating models for a modern Data Office, including governance, ownership, platform, and delivery capabilities. 
  • Develop as-is and to-be architectures, reference models, migration options, and transition roadmaps for complex data transformations. 
  • Define enterprise integration and data-sharing standards across APIs, event streaming, data pipelines, and microservices-aligned architectures. 
  • Shape the data foundations required for analytics and AI, including data engineering, feature engineering, model data pipelines, and MLOps enablement. 
  • Assess, select, and integrate modern data platforms, vendor solutions, and hyperscaler services, including Databricks, Snowflake, Microsoft Fabric, AWS, Azure, and GCP. 
  • Translate complex business and technical requirements into clear architecture decisions, investment priorities, and executable plans.


Advise and Influence Senior Leaders 

  • Serve as a trusted advisor to CISOs, CIOs, CTOs, Chief Architects, and senior executives on cyber security strategy, architecture decisions, and technology trade-offs. 
  • Establish executive-level credibility and communicate effectively with senior business and technology stakeholders as part of client project leadership teams. 
  • Act as an independent design authority by reviewing and validating data architecture proposals, evaluating options, and providing delivery assurance. 
  • Influence, coach, and mentor client data and technology leaders and Bain teams to build sustainable architecture and Data Office capabilities.


Enable Transformation at Scale

  • Lead high-impact data architecture workstreams within large-scale, multi-year transformation programs. 
  • Set direction and lead internal and external teams across complex, multi-million-dollar client engagements. 
  • Guide Bain consulting and client teams in executing architecture roadmaps, managing dependencies and risks, and embedding effective governance. 
  • Ensure architectures evolve through agile and MVP delivery while maintaining security, resilience, interoperability, scalability, and coherence. 
  • Partner with Bain consulting teams to integrate data architecture into broader business, technology, cloud, and AI transformations. 
  • Lead and mentor teams of architects and consultants to deliver secure, scalable, and high-performing enterprise data platforms aligned with client outcomes. 
  • Collaborate with leaders across Vector guilds to bring the optimal combination of expertise to clients. 
  • Support recruiting, onboarding, and people development, and help create an environment that attracts and develops great architects. 


Advance Bain’s Reputation and Growth 

  • Define and create demand by co-creating differentiated points of view and go-to-market offerings in enterprise data architecture, data modernization, Master Data Management, Data Office design, and AI-enabled transformation. 
  • Support proposals, pursuits, and account expansion by bringing data architecture expertise into client discussions and solution shaping. 
  • Maintain market and vendor awareness, collaborate with ecosystem partners, and continuously evolve Bain's enterprise data architecture point of view. 
  • Contribute actively to client cases, intellectual property, publications, and architecture community engagement. 
  • Build and sustain trusted relationships with senior stakeholders, sponsors, and architecture communities.


WHAT YOU'LL BRING (Qualifications):

  • 10+ years of experience in data architecture and technology leadership, including large-scale transformation programs. 
  • Deep enterprise data architecture expertise across multiple industries, such as financial services, consumer, and technology. 
  • Demonstrated track record shaping enterprise data strategies, target architectures, platform roadmaps, and operating models. 
  • End-to-end lifecycle experience leading large, complex, multi-year data transformation programs from strategy and architecture through implementation and migration. 
  • Deep understanding of how data enables AI, with delivery experience across data engineering, feature engineering, model data pipelines, and MLOps enablement. 
  • Hands-on architecture and delivery experience with modern data stacks and cloud data services, including Snowflake, Microsoft Fabric, and AWS, Azure, or GCP. 
  • Strong knowledge of data governance, metadata, data quality, Master Data Management, data integration, security, privacy, and responsible data use. 
  • Strong client leadership and business development experience, including pre-sales, go-to-market efforts, proposal shaping, and account expansion. 
  • Proven thought leadership in contemporary topics such as Master Data Management, data modernization, Data Office design, data products, and AI adoption. 
  • Exceptional communication and influencing skills, with the ability to explain complex solutions, algorithms, and trade-offs to business and technology audiences. 
  • High emotional intelligence and proven ability to lead, mentor, and inspire diverse, cross-functional, and multi-office teams. 
  • Curiosity, proactivity, critical thinking, and the ability to work independently and manage competing priorities in fast-paced, ambiguous environments.


U.S. Compensation Information 

Compensation for this role includes base salary, annual discretionary performance bonus, 401(k) plan with an annual employer contribution based on years of service and Bain’s best in class benefits package (details listed below).


Some local governments in the United States require a good-faith, reasonable salary range be included in job postings for open roles. The estimated annualized compensation for this role is as follows:


In the states of Georgia, Illinois, Massachusetts, and Texas, the good-faith, reasonable annualized full-time salary range for this role is between $168,500 - $206,000. In New York City, the good-faith, reasonable annualized full-time salary range for this role is between $191,000 - $234,500. Placement within these ranges will vary based on several factors including, but not limited to experience, education, licensure/certifications, training and skill level 


For all other locations, the good-faith, reasonable annualized full-time salary range for this role is commensurate with competitive geographic market rates for this role and will vary based on several factors including, but not limited to experience, education, licensure/certifications, training and skill level.  


  • Annual discretionary performance bonus  
  • This role may also be eligible for other elements of discretionary compensation 
  • 4.5% 401(k) company contribution, which increases after 3 years of service and is 100% vested upon start date 
  • Bain & Company's comprehensive benefits and wellness program is designed to help employees achieve personal independence, protection and stability in the areas most important to you and your family. 
  • Bain pays 100% individual employee premiums for medical, dental and vision programs, offering one of the most comprehensive medical plans for employees without impacting your paycheck 
  • Generous paid time off, including parental leave, sick leave and paid holidays 
  • Fully vested 401(k) company contribution 
  • Paid Life and Long-Term Disability insurance

Job Description:

What You’ll Do

Enterprise Information Architect & BIDW Leader will establish and deliver upon the enterprise information architecture vision for enterprise-level solutions. This role is responsible for the delivery of business Intelligence & data warehouse solutions to the firm, including the information architecture and management processes of the BI data warehouse and leading the BI function and team.

Responsibilities

LEADERSHIP

  • Ownership of and accountability for successful results of the Data Warehouse & Business Intelligence teams within Data Transformation.
  • Thought leadership in matters of enterprise data architecture, staying abreast of new technologies, patterns and methods which c an be applicable to Crowe data
  • Development of team strategy, creation and socialization of roadmaps, establishing and ensuring adherence to timelines, and resource assignment for the BIDW team
  • Seek opportunities to bring value to the Crowe business and/or its customers through innovative enterprise data and BI strategies to support strategic business goals
  • Develop quantifiable goals for the team which are aligned with Data Transformation’s strategic goals as well as Crowe’s strategic business initiatives
  • Mentor and coach developers, data engineers, managers, and other roles within team, intentionally managing career growth via mentorship and proactive planning
  • Actively participate in and collaborate with technical guilds to further expose and align the firm on best practices
  • Understand when to delegate; this role manages resources and owns the entire team’s success
  • Responsibility to track and maintain clear visibility into the value and delivery timing of BIDW team initiatives for Head of Data and business stakeholders

DEMAND MANAGEMENT & BUSINESS ENGAGEMENT

  • Collaboration with Head of Data and/or other firm leaders to understand strategic business needs and requirements, and planning team and technology capacity accordingly
  • Communication and engagement to ensure the business sees maximum value from its data warehouse and business intelligence investments
  • Develop and maintain an understanding of business needs, technical architecture and systems landscape, and the technology strategy of the business
  • Collaborate with both BIDW team and Data Transformation leaders to establish goals, plan capacity, support other Data Transformation initiatives, and leave margin for learning and unexpected shifts

PROGRAM DESIGN, DEVELOPMENT & DEPLOYMENT

  • Ultimate ownership for team delivery quality and schedule
  • Work closely with technology and business personnel to deliver value in a timely manner
  • Accountability for team using best practices for development and quality assurance aligned with firmwide standards, seeking opportunities to automate and improve
  • CONTINUOUS IMPROVEMENT
  • Champion a culture and mindset of excellence, collaboration, continuous improvement, design thinking and positivity
  • Establish metrics to monitor and tangibly demonstrate the value provided to the business via effectiveness, quality metrics, sensitive data monitoring as well as alert to any negative trends in these areas
  • Work with stakeholders to prioritize continuous improvement
  • Assess and recommend opportunities to retire/consolidate redundant legacy system assets
  • ADOPTION & VALUE REALIZATION
  • Work with team and business users to ensure successful adoption, usage, and benefit realization from solutions
  • Define and track KPIs and success metrics for adoption and value creation

Specific responsibility expectations by the components listed below –

Information Architecture Vision: Establish the Enterprise Information Architecture vision within the context of business strategy and in alignment with overall Technology & Strategy direction.

  • Translate strategic requirements into a usable enterprise information architecture, which may include an enterprise data model, common business vocabulary, ontology, and taxonomies, to guide enterprise solution development and achieve consistency of information assets.
  • Create an information architecture consistent with the business, application, and technical architectures.
  • Facilitate the mapping and traceability of information assets as they flow from source datastores to targets, thus ensuring optimal transparency, quality, consistency, and controlled redundancy.

Information Architecture Delivery: Work with and mentor delivery teams to provide data solutions that are in keeping with the enterprise information architecture. This may include:

  • Assessing suitability of vendor solutions to meet enterprise information requirements.
  • Construct, refine and maintain information models, as needed, to meet business requirements and drive data designs for operational and analytical solutions.
  • Facilitate the definition of integrative and canonical views of data or information across multiple content types to support convergence of information asset migration planning or impact analysis.
  • Ensure new development is consistent and well-integrated with the established enterprise information architecture, using metadata management and/or a repository to promote reuse and standards adoption.
  • Review corporate data sources for new business information and better data sources. Assist in post-implementation improvement efforts to enhance performance and provide increased functionality.
  • Participate in key project design reviews as part of the methodology process to ensure application designs adhere to enterprise information architecture guidelines.
  • Provide oversight for the BI Data Warehouse. Design an enterprise-wide integrated Data Warehouse for
  • Business Intelligence by modeling new and enhancing existing BIDW datamarts. Establish logical and physical models, maintain metadata, and guide integration engineers for the physical datamart schema and logical integration (ETL) processes. Assist, as required, with testing and issue resolution. Establish and enhance governance processes for the BI Data Warehouse (naming conventions, conformed dimensions and facts, meta-models, security configuration) to ensure a consistent implementation across all datamarts.
  • On large implementation projects, deliver project artifacts including: Data Integration Inventory, 360 Data Integration Diagram, Core structures diagram, Data Integration Requirements document and Test Plans, Report Inventory, Reporting Gap Analysis and Strategy, and Historical Data Strategy

Business Intelligence Team Leadership: Provide leadership, oversight, and quality assurance for BI Team and team deliverables. This may include:

  • Manage and coach BI team members in delivery of high-quality business intelligence solutions. Assist to estimate effort / duration for new requests and change orders. Track work queue, assign and adjust priorities and due dates based on client requirements and DT Leadership direction. Provide BI team with visibility to DT projects and project pipeline. Provide a forum for BI team collaboration on BI and Data Warehouse design and technical challenges.
  • Establish, document, and maintain best practices for Business Intelligence and Data Warehousing.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Analytics, Data/Information Science, Information Systems, Mathematics (or other related fields)
  • 6+ years of experience with SQL
  • 4+ years of experience in Business Intelligence, data analysis, and reporting
  • 4+ years of experience with Microsoft Power BI, including DAX, Power Query, and M language.
  • 2+ years of experience with Python (or other programming languages)
  • 4+ years of experience managing projects from inception to execution.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Microsoft Fabric Analytics Engineer certifications preferred.
  • Strong understanding of Data Warehousing and Business Intelligence concepts, Data Quality, and the related technology landscape, processes, and design principles
  • Proven track record in operating large data warehouse and business intelligence programs
  • Experience in managing enterprise data assets in a large, complex organization
  • Should be familiar with cloud and data management trends and methodologies
  • Ability to analyze complex situations and to derive workable actions
  • Ability to constructively challenge requirements and current state to increase overall value to the firm
  • Strong relationship building skills
  • Flexibility to adjust to multiple demands, shifting priorities, ambiguity, and rapid change
  • Good written and verbal communication
  • Strong analytical and time management skills

Job Description:

What You’ll Do

Enterprise Information Architect & BIDW Leader will establish and deliver upon the enterprise information architecture vision for enterprise-level solutions. This role is responsible for the delivery of business Intelligence & data warehouse solutions to the firm, including the information architecture and management processes of the BI data warehouse and leading the BI function and team.

Responsibilities

LEADERSHIP



- Ownership of and accountability for successful results of the Data Warehouse & Business Intelligence teams within Data Transformation. 
- Thought leadership in matters of enterprise data architecture, staying abreast of new technologies, patterns and methods which c an be applicable to Crowe data
- Development of team strategy, creation and socialization of roadmaps, establishing and ensuring adherence to timelines, and resource assignment for the BIDW team
- Seek opportunities to bring value to the Crowe business and/or its customers through innovative enterprise data and BI strategies to support strategic business goals
- Develop quantifiable goals for the team which are aligned with Data Transformation’s strategic goals as well as Crowe’s strategic business initiatives
- Mentor and coach developers, data engineers, managers, and other roles within team, intentionally managing career growth via mentorship and proactive planning
- Actively participate in and collaborate with technical guilds to further expose and align the firm on best practices
- Understand when to delegate; this role manages resources and owns the entire team’s success
- Responsibility to track and maintain clear visibility into the value and delivery timing of BIDW team initiatives for Head of Data and business stakeholders

DEMAND MANAGEMENT & BUSINESS ENGAGEMENT



- Collaboration with Head of Data and/or other firm leaders to understand strategic business needs and requirements, and planning team and technology capacity accordingly
- Communication and engagement to ensure the business sees maximum value from its data warehouse and business intelligence investments
- Develop and maintain an understanding of business needs, technical architecture and systems landscape, and the technology strategy of the business
- Collaborate with both BIDW team and Data Transformation leaders to establish goals, plan capacity, support other Data Transformation initiatives, and leave margin for learning and unexpected shifts

PROGRAM DESIGN, DEVELOPMENT & DEPLOYMENT



- Ultimate ownership for team delivery quality and schedule
- Work closely with technology and business personnel to deliver value in a timely manner
- Accountability for team using best practices for development and quality assurance aligned with firmwide standards, seeking opportunities to automate and improve
- CONTINUOUS IMPROVEMENT
- Champion a culture and mindset of excellence, collaboration, continuous improvement, design thinking and positivity
- Establish metrics to monitor and tangibly demonstrate the value provided to the business via effectiveness, quality metrics, sensitive data monitoring as well as alert to any negative trends in these areas
- Work with stakeholders to prioritize continuous improvement
- Assess and recommend opportunities to retire/consolidate redundant legacy system assets
- ADOPTION & VALUE REALIZATION
- Work with team and business users to ensure successful adoption, usage, and benefit realization from solutions
- Define and track KPIs and success metrics for adoption and value creation

Specific responsibility expectations by the components listed below –

Information Architecture Vision: Establish the Enterprise Information Architecture vision within the context of business strategy and in alignment with overall Technology & Strategy direction.



- Translate strategic requirements into a usable enterprise information architecture, which may include an enterprise data model, common business vocabulary, ontology, and taxonomies, to guide enterprise solution development and achieve consistency of information assets. 
- Create an information architecture consistent with the business, application, and technical architectures. 
- Facilitate the mapping and traceability of information assets as they flow from source datastores to targets, thus ensuring optimal transparency, quality, consistency, and controlled redundancy. 

Information Architecture Delivery: Work with and mentor delivery teams to provide data solutions that are in keeping with the enterprise information architecture. This may include:



- Assessing suitability of vendor solutions to meet enterprise information requirements. 
- Construct, refine and maintain information models, as needed, to meet business requirements and drive data designs for operational and analytical solutions. 
- Facilitate the definition of integrative and canonical views of data or information across multiple content types to support convergence of information asset migration planning or impact analysis. 
- Ensure new development is consistent and well-integrated with the established enterprise information architecture, using metadata management and/or a repository to promote reuse and standards adoption. 
- Review corporate data sources for new business information and better data sources. Assist in post-implementation improvement efforts to enhance performance and provide increased functionality. 
- Participate in key project design reviews as part of the methodology process to ensure application designs adhere to enterprise information architecture guidelines. 
- Provide oversight for the BI Data Warehouse. Design an enterprise-wide integrated Data Warehouse for
- Business Intelligence by modeling new and enhancing existing BIDW datamarts. Establish logical and physical models, maintain metadata, and guide integration engineers for the physical datamart schema and logical integration (ETL) processes. Assist, as required, with testing and issue resolution. Establish and enhance governance processes for the BI Data Warehouse (naming conventions, conformed dimensions and facts, meta-models, security configuration) to ensure a consistent implementation across all datamarts. 
- On large implementation projects, deliver project artifacts including: Data Integration Inventory, 360 Data Integration Diagram, Core structures diagram, Data Integration Requirements document and Test Plans, Report Inventory, Reporting Gap Analysis and Strategy, and Historical Data Strategy

Business Intelligence Team Leadership: Provide leadership, oversight, and quality assurance for BI Team and team deliverables. This may include:



- Manage and coach BI team members in delivery of high-quality business intelligence solutions. Assist to estimate effort / duration for new requests and change orders. Track work queue, assign and adjust priorities and due dates based on client requirements and DT Leadership direction. Provide BI team with visibility to DT projects and project pipeline. Provide a forum for BI team collaboration on BI and Data Warehouse design and technical challenges. 
- Establish, document, and maintain best practices for Business Intelligence and Data Warehousing. 

Qualifications



- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Analytics, Data/Information Science, Information Systems, Mathematics (or other related fields)
- 6+ years of experience with SQL
- 4+ years of experience in Business Intelligence, data analysis, and reporting
- 4+ years of experience with Microsoft Power BI, including DAX, Power Query, and M language. 
- 2+ years of experience with Python (or other programming languages)
- 4+ years of experience managing projects from inception to execution. 

Preferred Qualifications



- Microsoft Fabric Analytics Engineer certifications preferred. 
- Strong understanding of Data Warehousing and Business Intelligence concepts, Data Quality, and the related technology landscape, processes, and design principles
- Proven track record in operating large data warehouse and business intelligence programs
- Experience in managing enterprise data assets in a large, complex organization
- Should be familiar with cloud and data management trends and methodologies
- Ability to analyze complex situations and to derive workable actions
- Ability to constructively challenge requirements and current state to increase overall value to the firm
- Strong relationship building skills
- Flexibility to adjust to multiple demands, shifting priorities, ambiguity, and rapid change
- Good written and verbal communication
- Strong analytical and time management skills
- Strong facilitation skills with the ability to drive issues to closure
- Self-motivated and able to handle tasks with minimal supervision or questions
- Ability to compare technologies and make recommendations to senior members of the team
- Understanding of privacy laws and regulations

The Opportunity

As a Applied AI Health Data Architect you will shape data architecture solutions that support health services provider clients, bringing together data engineering, analytics, and AI to improve how information is structured, integrated, and used across cloud environments. As a Senior Manager you will lead large projects, bring strategic direction to complex data modernization efforts, and use sound judgment to guide teams and stakeholders through changing priorities and technical complexity. In this role at PwC, you will work within our Advisory practice and within our Data, Analytics & AI services to design data platforms, support cloud-native architecture decisions, and contribute to delivery across AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud Platform environments for health sector clients.

Responsibilities

  • Leading applied AI and health data architecture initiatives for provider data environments, translating business goals into scalable data solutions
  • Designing cloud-native data platforms, pipelines, and integration patterns across AWS, Azure, Databricks, and Snowflake
  • Developing data models, warehouse structures, and transformation logic that support analytics, AI workloads, and operational reporting
  • Guiding data modernization efforts that migrate legacy systems into modern architectures with improved performance, security, and usability
  • Overseeing data quality, validation, governance, and anonymization practices across sensitive health data domains
  • Applying data engineering methods to tune pipelines, optimize queries, and improve database and warehouse performance
  • Advising client stakeholders on data strategy, architecture decisions, and AI-ready platform design within complex provider environments
  • Leading teams through delivery planning, issue resolution, and technical coordination across multiple workstreams
  • Coaching practitioners on data engineering platforms, digital tooling, and AI-enabled solution delivery
  • Presenting solution options, tradeoffs, and implementation paths that support modernization priorities and future data capabilities

What You Must Have

  • At least a Bachelor's degree
  • At least 7 years of experience

What Sets You Apart

  • Preference for at least one of the following fields of study: Analytics/Data Science, Business Administration/Management, Computer Science/Information Systems, Economics, Engineering, Finance, Mathematics/Statistics, Operations/Supply Chain
  • Demonstrating data architecture leadership for healthcare provider modernization initiatives
  • Utilizing AWS, Azure, Databricks, or Snowflake for cloud data platforms
  • Applying AI fluency to data engineering and architecture decisions
  • Translating client needs into scalable data modernization roadmaps
  • Leading complex, multi-team delivery with composure and sound judgment

The salary range for this position is: $124,000 - $280,000. Actual compensation within the range will be dependent upon the individual's skills, experience, qualifications and location, and applicable employment laws. The Principal Cloud Data Architect serves as the architectural authority for Channels Data Platforms and Analytics. This leader defines the target state architecture, drives modernization from legacy technologies to cloud native platforms, and ensures security, resiliency, performance, and compliance across the data and analytics ecosystem. The role provides strategic and technical oversight for the Payment Tracker and guides the transformation of large scale engineering teams and platforms, including mainframe based reporting systems.

The Principal Cloud Data Architect will lead the architecture, modernization, and transformation of the Channels Data Platform, which today includes on prem data warehouses, Informatica ETL, Hadoop ecosystems, mission critical mainframe processing, and legacy reporting workloads. The role will evolve this platform toward a cloud native, scalable, resilient architecture leveraging Azure, Databricks, Snowflake, Kafka, APIs/microservices, and modern engineering patterns.

  • Define and communicate the solution intent and architectural vision across Business, Data, Application, and Technology domains.
  • Build and maintain a multi year modernization roadmap for Channels Data Platforms, including mainframe, Hadoop, ETL, and analytics components.
  • Establish target operating models, architectural patterns, and guardrails to support evolving capabilities and regulatory expectations.
  • Drive enterprise alignment by collaborating with Enterprise Architecture, Platform Architecture, Information Governance, Risk, and Product.
  • Lead transformation from Informatica, on prem databases, Hadoop, and mainframe based reporting into cloud native architectures (Azure, Databricks/Delta, Snowflake, Event Hubs/Kafka).

  • Implement CI/CD for data, Infrastructure as Code (Terraform/Bicep), observability (logs/metrics/traces), and cost/performance governance.
  • Ensure platform resiliency, scalability, and operational readiness (HA/DR, autoscaling, performance tuning, traffic management).
  • Provide end to end architectural oversight for Payment Tracker, including UI, APIs/microservices, data models, analytics layers, and dashboards.

  • Mentor engineers and elevate engineering excellence across Channels Technology.

  • 12+ years in data/software engineering with 8+ years designing enterprise data platforms or large distributed architectures.
  • Demonstrated leadership in cloud modernization (Azure preferred), including Databricks (Spark/Delta), Snowflake, Kafka/Event Hubs.
  • Strong background in modernizing legacy systems, including Informatica ETL, Hadoop/Big Data systems, and mainframe workloads (batch pipelines, reporting interfaces).
  • Deep expertise in NFR driven design: resiliency, security, performance, scalability, observability, and operational excellence.
  • Strong proficiency in SQL and Python (Scala or Java a plus).
  • Proven ability to influence senior leaders, drive enterprise alignment, and deliver outcomes in highly regulated environments.
  • Strong communication skills—capable of translating complex engineering concepts for executive, business, and technical audiences.
  • Strong background in modernizing legacy systems, including Informatica ETL, Hadoop/Big Data systems, and mainframe workloads (batch pipelines, reporting interfaces).
  • Experience with microservices, containers (Kubernetes/OpenShift), API gateways, and integration patterns.

Representative tools/technologies :

Azure (ADLS Gen2, Event Hubs, Key Vault), Databricks, Snowflake, Informatica, Kafka, Mainframe/Z Series job orchestration, Oracle/Postgres, Python, SQL, Java/Scala (optional), Git, Azure DevOps/Jenkins, Docker/Kubernetes/OpenShift, Collibra, AppDynamics/Splunk/Grafana.Starburst

Desired Qualifications

  • Experience in Payments, Channels, CashPro, or analytics driven applications.
  • Knowledge of semantic layers (dbt, LookML), data quality frameworks (Great Expectations/Deequ), and data governance (Purview, Collibra).
  • FinOps experience with cost optimization for cloud data workloads.
  • Advanced understanding of streaming, event driven architectures, and ML/AI integration.

descriptionHtml:
Looking for a rewarding career? Johnson Brothers is a leading family-owned distributor of wine, spirits, and beer, delivering exceptional service since 1953. We proudly represent the world’s top beverage brands and are committed to excellence, innovation, and growth. Johnson Brothers offers exciting opportunities in a variety of areas. Join our passionate team and help shape the future of the beverage industry!

Our enterprise data platform is evolving, our application landscape is changing, and our Enterprise Information Management (EIM) architecture practice is maturing along with it.

We are looking for a Senior Data Architect who wants to help shape the future of data and analytics at Johnson Brothers.

You will help establish the architectural principles, standards, patterns, and governance that guide how we manage and use data across the organization. You will also play a key role in defining our current, transition, and future-state architectures as we evolve from Azure Data Lake and Synapse toward Microsoft Fabric and OneLake, while integrating new enterprise platforms including Dynamics 365 F&O and Dataverse.

This is not an ivory-tower architecture role. We are looking for someone who has built and implemented solutions, earned broader architecture responsibility, and can translate architectural direction into practical guidance for experienced engineering and technology teams.

Job Description:

  • Establish and mature EIM architecture principles, standards, reference patterns, and lightweight governance.
  • Develop and maintain meaningful current-state, transition-state, and future-state architecture.
  • Create a practical architecture library covering key standards, patterns, decisions, and reference architectures.
  • Provide architectural direction as our data ecosystem evolves from Azure Data Lake and Synapse toward Microsoft Fabric, OneLake, and Fabric Data Warehouse.
  • Help define how Dynamics 365 F&O, Dataverse, Fabric, enterprise applications, integrations, and analytical platforms work together.
  • Guide architecture across data ingestion, storage, transformation, modeling, analytics, metadata, lineage, cataloging, and governance.
  • Provide architectural guidance for our developing Master Data Management and Data Quality capabilities, including technology evaluation and implementation.
  • Establish and promote data modeling standards and reusable patterns.
  • Partner with Data Engineers and other technology teams to translate architecture into implementable designs, review significant solutions, and resolve difficult technical problems.
  • Mentor experienced engineers and help strengthen architectural and engineering practices across the team.
  • Identify opportunities to simplify the technology landscape, encourage reuse, and reduce unnecessary complexity and technical debt.

Skills and Experience:

  • Demonstrated progression from hands-on solution development and implementation into architecture and technical leadership.
  • Strong experience designing enterprise data platforms, data warehouses, lakehouses, or similar large-scale data solutions.
  • Deep understanding of data architecture and modeling, including dimensional, relational, and enterprise/domain-oriented approaches.
  • Strong architecture experience within the Microsoft and Azure data ecosystem.
  • Experience translating business needs into information, application, and technology architectures.
  • Ability to define practical current-state, transition-state, and future-state architectures.
  • Working knowledge of modern integration architecture, APIs, pipelines, orchestration, and system-to-system data movement.
  • Understanding of enterprise data management disciplines including governance, metadata, lineage, data quality, master data, and reference data.
  • Strong systems thinking and architectural judgment, including balancing scalability, security, performance, maintainability, cost, and delivery realities.
  • Ability to influence technical decisions, mentor experienced engineers, and build consensus across teams.
  • Ability to communicate architecture effectively with audiences ranging from engineers to Directors and VPs.
  • Comfort operating in an environment where both the architecture practice and technology landscape are evolving.

Preferred Skills and Experience:

  • Microsoft Fabric, OneLake, Fabric Data Warehouse, or Lakehouse.
  • Dynamics 365 F&O and Dataverse architecture.
  • MDM or Data Quality platform implementation.
  • Metadata, catalog, lineage, or data governance technologies.
  • Enterprise integration or EDI/B2B architecture.
  • End-to-end analytics architecture, including semantic and Power BI consumption layers.
  • Architecture or data-management frameworks such as TOGAF or DAMA/DMBOK.
  • Cloud cost optimization or FinOps practices.
  • Technology/vendor evaluation and selection.
  • Technical team or formal people leadership.

Additional Job Description

The expected pay range for this role is $99,000- $168,000. It is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role. Actual placement within range will be contingent upon several factors, including but not limited to the candidate's qualifications, education, experience, internal equity, union status (where applicable) and alignment with market data. Johnson Brothers offers eligible team members and their dependents comprehensive health benefits and programs, which include medical, dental, vision, life insurance, health savings and flexible spending accounts. Other benefits for eligible team members include 401(k) with an employer match, short-term disability coverage, company-paid long-term disability insurance, generous paid time off (PTO) plans and paid parental leave.

Equal Opportunity Employer

Johnson Brothers is committed to providing equal employment opportunity and equal treatment in employment without regard to race, ethnicity, color, religion, gender/gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, national origin or ancestry, physical or mental disability, military status or any other basis in protected by applicable federal, state and local law. Johnson Brothers makes employment decisions based solely on the basis of qualifications for the job.

Johnson Brothers is an equal opportunity employer, committed to fair treatment and hiring based on qualifications. We prohibit discrimination based on race, color, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, disability, military status, or any other protected status under applicable laws.
