Job Description:

What You’ll Do

Enterprise Information Architect & BIDW Leader will establish and deliver upon the enterprise information architecture vision for enterprise-level solutions. This role is responsible for the delivery of business Intelligence & data warehouse solutions to the firm, including the information architecture and management processes of the BI data warehouse and leading the BI function and team.

Responsibilities

LEADERSHIP

  • Ownership of and accountability for successful results of the Data Warehouse & Business Intelligence teams within Data Transformation.
  • Thought leadership in matters of enterprise data architecture, staying abreast of new technologies, patterns and methods which c an be applicable to Crowe data
  • Development of team strategy, creation and socialization of roadmaps, establishing and ensuring adherence to timelines, and resource assignment for the BIDW team
  • Seek opportunities to bring value to the Crowe business and/or its customers through innovative enterprise data and BI strategies to support strategic business goals
  • Develop quantifiable goals for the team which are aligned with Data Transformation’s strategic goals as well as Crowe’s strategic business initiatives
  • Mentor and coach developers, data engineers, managers, and other roles within team, intentionally managing career growth via mentorship and proactive planning
  • Actively participate in and collaborate with technical guilds to further expose and align the firm on best practices
  • Understand when to delegate; this role manages resources and owns the entire team’s success
  • Responsibility to track and maintain clear visibility into the value and delivery timing of BIDW team initiatives for Head of Data and business stakeholders

DEMAND MANAGEMENT & BUSINESS ENGAGEMENT

  • Collaboration with Head of Data and/or other firm leaders to understand strategic business needs and requirements, and planning team and technology capacity accordingly
  • Communication and engagement to ensure the business sees maximum value from its data warehouse and business intelligence investments
  • Develop and maintain an understanding of business needs, technical architecture and systems landscape, and the technology strategy of the business
  • Collaborate with both BIDW team and Data Transformation leaders to establish goals, plan capacity, support other Data Transformation initiatives, and leave margin for learning and unexpected shifts

PROGRAM DESIGN, DEVELOPMENT & DEPLOYMENT

  • Ultimate ownership for team delivery quality and schedule
  • Work closely with technology and business personnel to deliver value in a timely manner
  • Accountability for team using best practices for development and quality assurance aligned with firmwide standards, seeking opportunities to automate and improve
  • CONTINUOUS IMPROVEMENT
  • Champion a culture and mindset of excellence, collaboration, continuous improvement, design thinking and positivity
  • Establish metrics to monitor and tangibly demonstrate the value provided to the business via effectiveness, quality metrics, sensitive data monitoring as well as alert to any negative trends in these areas
  • Work with stakeholders to prioritize continuous improvement
  • Assess and recommend opportunities to retire/consolidate redundant legacy system assets
  • ADOPTION & VALUE REALIZATION
  • Work with team and business users to ensure successful adoption, usage, and benefit realization from solutions
  • Define and track KPIs and success metrics for adoption and value creation

Specific responsibility expectations by the components listed below –

Information Architecture Vision: Establish the Enterprise Information Architecture vision within the context of business strategy and in alignment with overall Technology & Strategy direction.

  • Translate strategic requirements into a usable enterprise information architecture, which may include an enterprise data model, common business vocabulary, ontology, and taxonomies, to guide enterprise solution development and achieve consistency of information assets.
  • Create an information architecture consistent with the business, application, and technical architectures.
  • Facilitate the mapping and traceability of information assets as they flow from source datastores to targets, thus ensuring optimal transparency, quality, consistency, and controlled redundancy.

Information Architecture Delivery: Work with and mentor delivery teams to provide data solutions that are in keeping with the enterprise information architecture. This may include:

  • Assessing suitability of vendor solutions to meet enterprise information requirements.
  • Construct, refine and maintain information models, as needed, to meet business requirements and drive data designs for operational and analytical solutions.
  • Facilitate the definition of integrative and canonical views of data or information across multiple content types to support convergence of information asset migration planning or impact analysis.
  • Ensure new development is consistent and well-integrated with the established enterprise information architecture, using metadata management and/or a repository to promote reuse and standards adoption.
  • Review corporate data sources for new business information and better data sources. Assist in post-implementation improvement efforts to enhance performance and provide increased functionality.
  • Participate in key project design reviews as part of the methodology process to ensure application designs adhere to enterprise information architecture guidelines.
  • Provide oversight for the BI Data Warehouse. Design an enterprise-wide integrated Data Warehouse for
  • Business Intelligence by modeling new and enhancing existing BIDW datamarts. Establish logical and physical models, maintain metadata, and guide integration engineers for the physical datamart schema and logical integration (ETL) processes. Assist, as required, with testing and issue resolution. Establish and enhance governance processes for the BI Data Warehouse (naming conventions, conformed dimensions and facts, meta-models, security configuration) to ensure a consistent implementation across all datamarts.
  • On large implementation projects, deliver project artifacts including: Data Integration Inventory, 360 Data Integration Diagram, Core structures diagram, Data Integration Requirements document and Test Plans, Report Inventory, Reporting Gap Analysis and Strategy, and Historical Data Strategy

Business Intelligence Team Leadership: Provide leadership, oversight, and quality assurance for BI Team and team deliverables. This may include:

  • Manage and coach BI team members in delivery of high-quality business intelligence solutions. Assist to estimate effort / duration for new requests and change orders. Track work queue, assign and adjust priorities and due dates based on client requirements and DT Leadership direction. Provide BI team with visibility to DT projects and project pipeline. Provide a forum for BI team collaboration on BI and Data Warehouse design and technical challenges.
  • Establish, document, and maintain best practices for Business Intelligence and Data Warehousing.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Analytics, Data/Information Science, Information Systems, Mathematics (or other related fields)
  • 6+ years of experience with SQL
  • 4+ years of experience in Business Intelligence, data analysis, and reporting
  • 4+ years of experience with Microsoft Power BI, including DAX, Power Query, and M language.
  • 2+ years of experience with Python (or other programming languages)
  • 4+ years of experience managing projects from inception to execution.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Microsoft Fabric Analytics Engineer certifications preferred.
  • Strong understanding of Data Warehousing and Business Intelligence concepts, Data Quality, and the related technology landscape, processes, and design principles
  • Proven track record in operating large data warehouse and business intelligence programs
  • Experience in managing enterprise data assets in a large, complex organization
  • Should be familiar with cloud and data management trends and methodologies
  • Ability to analyze complex situations and to derive workable actions
  • Ability to constructively challenge requirements and current state to increase overall value to the firm
  • Strong relationship building skills
  • Flexibility to adjust to multiple demands, shifting priorities, ambiguity, and rapid change

Enterprise Information Architect & BIDW Leader will establish and deliver upon the enterprise information architecture vision for enterprise-level solutions. Responsibilities

LEADERSHIP



- Ownership of and accountability for successful results of the Data Warehouse & Business Intelligence teams within Data Transformation. 
- Thought leadership in matters of enterprise data architecture, staying abreast of new technologies, patterns and methods which c an be applicable to Crowe data

- Understand when to delegate; this role manages resources and owns the entire team’s success
- Responsibility to track and maintain clear visibility into the value and delivery timing of BIDW team initiatives for Head of Data and business stakeholders

DEMAND MANAGEMENT & BUSINESS ENGAGEMENT



- Collaboration with Head of Data and/or other firm leaders to understand strategic business needs and requirements, and planning team and technology capacity accordingly
- Communication and engagement to ensure the business sees maximum value from its data warehouse and business intelligence investments
- Develop and maintain an understanding of business needs, technical architecture and systems landscape, and the technology strategy of the business
- Collaborate with both BIDW team and Data Transformation leaders to establish goals, plan capacity, support other Data Transformation initiatives, and leave margin for learning and unexpected shifts

PROGRAM DESIGN, DEVELOPMENT & DEPLOYMENT



- Ultimate ownership for team delivery quality and schedule
- Work closely with technology and business personnel to deliver value in a timely manner
- Accountability for team using best practices for development and quality assurance aligned with firmwide standards, seeking opportunities to automate and improve

- Establish metrics to monitor and tangibly demonstrate the value provided to the business via effectiveness, quality metrics, sensitive data monitoring as well as alert to any negative trends in these areas
- Work with stakeholders to prioritize continuous improvement
- Assess and recommend opportunities to retire/consolidate redundant legacy system assets
- ADOPTION & VALUE REALIZATION
- Work with team and business users to ensure successful adoption, usage, and benefit realization from solutions
- Define and track KPIs and success metrics for adoption and value creation

- Assessing suitability of vendor solutions to meet enterprise information requirements.

- 6+ years of experience with SQL
- 4+ years of experience in Business Intelligence, data analysis, and reporting
- 4+ years of experience with Microsoft Power BI, including DAX, Power Query, and M language. 
- 2+ years of experience with Python (or other programming languages)
- 4+ years of experience managing projects from inception to execution.

- Experience in managing enterprise data assets in a large, complex organization

- Ability to constructively challenge requirements and current state to increase overall value to the firm

- Flexibility to adjust to multiple demands, shifting priorities, ambiguity, and rapid change

Job Number: R0247168

Data Architect, Senior

The Opportunity:

As organizations increasingly depend on cloud platforms, analytics, and AI/ML to drive mission outcomes, the integrity of the data foundation underneath them has never mattered more. We are looking for a Data Architect to own the design, governance, and continued evolution of the enterprise data architecture that powers analytics, reporting, and operational insight across our organization and for our DoW clients.

As a Data Architect, you'll be the go-to expert for data modeling, governance, and architecture across stakeholders, making sure every data asset we build is well-modeled, documented, discoverable, and trustworthy. You set the standards, and you help the team hold to them from design through deployment.

This is a hands-on technical role. Our architecture, pipelines, and tooling are built on modern Python frameworks. You'll be designing schemas, optimizing queries, and making data modeling decisions that the rest of the team builds on every day.

The role also carries meaningful project leadership and client-facing responsibility. You'll lead client data maturity assessments from start to finish, scoping the engagement against the statement of work, evaluating client data systems, modeling their current-state architecture, and delivering actionable recommendations and roadmaps on schedule. You'll work in a fast-paced, agile environment where deliverables are requirements-driven and schedule-bound, partnering closely with team leads, engineers, analysts, and stakeholders to maintain high quality and timeliness of deliverables.

What You'll Work On:

  • Own the enterprise data model, ensuring all production data assets are properly modeled, documented, and governed, with complete schemas and lineage.
  • Design and enforce data governance standards, including assisting with naming conventions, quality controls, access policies, and metadata management, and hold the deployment gate so new assets meet standards before reaching production.
  • Define and maintain the data catalog so every team knows what data exists, where it lives, and how to use it.
  • Lead data quality monitoring, including owning the rules, thresholds, and remediation process, and driving issues to resolution within defined service levels.
  • Support new client intake by engaging with prospective and new customers to understand their data environment, coordinating with squad leads and analysts on what's feasible, and applying critical thinking to model and design data solutions tailored to each customer's needs.
  • Lead client-facing data maturity assessments end to end, including plan and manage the engagement timeline, evaluate client data systems, score maturity, and deliver recommendations and actionable roadmaps.
  • Communicate clearly in both directions, including presenting architecture findings and recommendations to clients, and coordinating across the team so engineers and analysts have what they need to execute.
  • Support cross-functional mission teams by validating data model decisions, reviewing architecture choices, and ensuring governance compliance.
  • Design and build data solutions using Python and SQL.
  • Evaluate and recommend data tools, storage strategies, and architectural patterns as the team scales, delivering recommendations with cost or benefit analysis.


Join us. The world can’t wait.

You Have:  

  • 5+ years of experience in data architecture, data engineering, or analytics engineering, including ownership of enterprise or program-level data models
  • Experience with SQL, including data modeling, such as dimensional modeling, normalization, or schema design, query optimization, and working with relational databases and cloud data platforms
  • Experience with Python data frameworks for data processing, transformation, and automation
  • Experience in assisting with establishing and enforcing data governance practices, data quality frameworks, metadata management, data cataloging, lineage, and access policies
  • Experience with project management, including planning and delivering schedule-bound technical engagements or assessments against a statement of work or charter
  • Ability to use critical thinking and solution-design to take an unfamiliar customer data environment, model it, and shape a practical architecture and roadmap
  • Ability to obtain a Top Secret clearance
  • Bachelor's degree


Nice If You Have:  

  • Experience designing and governing data architectures in AWS-based environments
  • Experience with AWS data services such as S3, Glue, Redshift, Athena, or Lake Formation
  • Experience with ETL and ELT processes and modern data pipeline architectures
  • Experience conducting data maturity, readiness, or current-state architecture assessments for external clients
  • Experience with data governance and catalog tooling, including data catalogs, lineage tools, or metadata management platforms
  • Experience mentoring engineers or analysts on data modeling and governance practices
  • Knowledge of AI and ML workflows, and the data architecture patterns that support them
  • Possession of strong client-facing communication skills, to engage new customers, present findings and recommendations to senior technical and non-technical stakeholders, and coordinate across internal teams
  • Top Secret clearance


Clearance: 

Applicants selected will be subject to a security investigation and may need to meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information.

Compensation

At Booz Allen, we celebrate your contributions, provide you with opportunities and choices, and support your total well-being. Our offerings include health, life, disability, financial, and retirement benefits, as well as paid leave, professional development, tuition assistance, work-life programs, and dependent care. Our recognition awards program acknowledges employees for exceptional performance and superior demonstration of our values. Full-time and part-time employees working at least 20 hours a week on a regular basis are eligible to participate in Booz Allen’s benefit programs. Individuals that do not meet the threshold are only eligible for select offerings, not inclusive of health benefits. We encourage you to learn more about our total benefits by visiting the Resource page on our Careers site and reviewing Our Employee Benefits page.

Salary at Booz Allen is determined by various factors, including but not limited to location, the individual’s particular combination of education, knowledge, skills, competencies, and experience, as well as contract-specific affordability and organizational requirements. The projected compensation range for this position is $86,800.00 to $198,000.00 (annualized USD). The estimate displayed represents the typical salary range for this position and is just one component of Booz Allen’s total compensation package for employees. This posting will close within 90 days from the Posting Date.

Identity Statement

As part of the hiring process, we will ask you to complete an identity verification process that leverages advanced biometrics and artificial intelligence to ensure authenticity and protect against identity fraud. You are expected to be on camera during interviews and assessments. We reserve the right to take your picture to verify your identity and prevent fraud.

Candidate AI Usage Policy

AI is a part of our daily work at Booz Allen, and we are committed to the responsible and ethical use of AI tools. However, we want to ensure a fair candidate process based on your own skills and knowledge. As part of this commitment, the use of artificial intelligence (AI) or other tools to assist with responses during interviews (whether in-person or virtual) is prohibited unless permission is explicitly provided.

Work Model

Our people-first culture prioritizes the benefits of collaboration, whether it occurs in person or virtually. To support engagement and effective communication, employees working virtually are generally expected to have their cameras on during meetings.

  • Remote: If this position is listed as remote, there may still be occasions when you are required to work in person at a Booz Allen or customer facility.
  • Hybrid: If this position is listed as hybrid, you will be expected to work from a Booz Allen facility frequently, in alignment with leadership expectations and the needs of the role. You may also be required to work from or visit a customer facility.
  • Onsite: If this position is listed as onsite, work will primarily be performed at a Booz Allen office or customer facility, where employees will collaborate directly with colleagues and customers as required by the role.


Commitment to Non-Discrimination

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to disability, status as a protected veteran or any other status protected by applicable federal, state, local, or international law.

Introduction

A career in IBM Consulting is built on long-term client relationships and close collaboration worldwide. You'll work with leading companies across industries, helping them shape their hybrid cloud and AI journeys. With support from our strategic partners, robust IBM technology, and Red Hat, you'll have the tools to drive meaningful change and accelerate client impact. At IBM Consulting, curiosity fuels success. You'll be encouraged to challenge the norm, explore new ideas, and create innovative solutions that deliver real results. Our culture of growth and empathy focuses on your long-term career development while valuing your unique skills and experiences.

Your Role And Responsibilities

As a Business Transformation Consultant specializing in Data Platforms, you will plan, design, manage, and implement core components of Watson Service Offerings and Digital Insights Platforms, as well as other similar non-IBM solutions. This role involves creating solutions that deliver significant and lasting business improvements for clients.

Your Primary Responsibilities Will Include

  • Design Solution Architecture: Provide expert architecture, design, and implementation support for solutions in virtualized and cloud-based environments, including both hosted and on-premise solutions.
  • Implement Data Platforms: Plan, manage, and implement core components of Watson Service Offerings and Digital Insights Platforms to deliver significant business improvements for clients.
  • Support Sales and Delivery: Define solutions and present a point of view for these offerings' services to clients, collaborating with Sales and Delivery teams.
  • Develop Cloud-Based Solutions: Create solutions in virtualized and cloud-based environments, leveraging expertise in architecture, data lake, design, and implementation.
  • Drive Business Transformation: Deliver lasting business improvements for clients through the implementation of Data Platforms and Watson Service Offerings.
  • This job can be performed from anywhere in the US.

Preferred Education

Master's Degree

Required Technical And Professional Expertise

  • Deep Expertise in Data Platforms: Proven experience in planning, designing, managing, and implementing core components of data platforms, Snowflake, Databricks and Digital Insights Platforms, to deliver significant business improvements for clients.
  • Experience with Cloud-Based Solutions: Skilled in creating solutions in virtualized and cloud-based environments, including both hosted and on-premise solutions, leveraging expertise in architecture, data lake, design, and implementation.
  • Proficiency in Solution Architecture: Experienced in providing expert architecture, design, and implementation support for solutions in complex environments, ensuring seamless integration and effective solution delivery.

descriptionHtml:
Count on us. Our "we-care" culture is more than just a motto; it's a promise. From day one, we prioritize your growth, well-being, and success. You can count on us to support your career journey and help you achieve your professional goals. Join us.

Your Role.

  • Partner with business stakeholders, technology teams, and leadership to understand objectives, define business and data challenges, and align on practical data and analytics solutions.
  • Lead discovery and solution design efforts, including defining requirements, risks, dependencies, success criteria, target-state architecture, data flows, integration approaches, and implementation roadmaps.
  • Design scalable, secure, and governed enterprise data architectures using Microsoft Fabric, Azure Data Services, Databricks, Power BI, and related modern data platform technologies.
  • Establish and reinforce architecture standards, Medallion Architecture patterns, development practices, data modeling approaches, CI/CD processes, testing, observability, and operational support expectations.
  • Provide technical leadership across multiple concurrent initiatives, translating architecture designs into executable delivery plans and guiding teams through design, build, testing, deployment, and handoff.
  • Evaluate technical tradeoffs related to scalability, performance, maintainability, cost, security, governance, and long-term supportability while ensuring alignment with enterprise standards.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor and escalation point for complex solution decisions, helping stakeholders navigate ambiguity, balance competing priorities, and reach consensus on the path forward.
  • Mentor and supervise a small team of data engineers while modeling accountability, collaboration, continuous improvement, and responsible use of AI-assisted productivity tools.

The Qualifications.

  • Bachelor's degree in Software Engineering, Computer Science, Data Science, or related area required.
  • 5-8 years of experience in data architecture, data engineering, analytics engineering, business intelligence, or related technical roles.
  • Proven experience designing and delivering enterprise-scale data and analytics solutions from discovery through implementation and production support.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft Fabric, including Lakehouse, Data Engineering, Data Factory, OneLake, and semantic model concepts.
  • Experience designing modern lakehouse, warehouse, and data integration architectures using Microsoft Fabric, Azure Data Services, Databricks, and Power BI.
  • Strong working knowledge of Azure Data Factory, Azure Data Lake Storage, Azure SQL, SQL/T-SQL, PySpark, and Spark-based processing.
  • Deep understanding of data warehousing, dimensional modeling, Medallion Architecture, data lifecycle management, and pipeline reliability.
  • Experience establishing engineering standards for data pipelines, source control, CI/CD, testing, pull request reviews, observability, and operational support.
  • Familiarity with GitHub, GitHub Actions, API integrations, data governance and lineage concepts, and legacy data platforms such as Informatica and SSIS.

What makes us different?

On the surface, we’re one of the nation’s largest audit, tax, consulting, and wealth management firms. But dig a little deeper, and you’ll see what makes us different: we’re a relatively jerk-free firm (hey, nobody ‘s perfect) with a world-class culture, consistent recognition as one of Fortune Magazine’s “100 Best Companies to Work For,” and an endless array of opportunities.  At Plante Moran, diversity, equity and inclusion means that all staff members have equitable and fair opportunities to succeed, in an inclusive environment, with their individual, unique identities. So, what are you waiting for? Apply now.

Plante Moran enjoys a “Workplace for Your Day” model which, simply put, means we strive for flexibility and balance while staying true to our principally in-person model. We believe that face-to-face interactions are paramount for individual and collective development, but also encourage individuals to work with their supervisor and team to determine their optimal working environment each day.  

Plante Moran is committed to a diverse workplace. We strive to create a culture where each person feels accepted and valued. We believe that each person’s ultimate potential begins with first acknowledging their inherent dignity. When we can recognize — and celebrate — our many human differences, we’re able to create a workplace where all staff feel a sense of belonging and an opportunity to succeed. This allows us to attract and retain the best talent, serve clients through diverse thinking, and better represent and support the various communities in which we live and work. Plante Moran is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Plante Moran maintains a drug-free workplace.

Interested applicants must submit their resume for consideration using our applicant tracking system. Due to the high volume of interest in our positions, only candidates selected for interviews will be contacted. Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the United States without sponsorship, with the exception of qualified candidates who are bilingual in either Japanese and English or Chinese and English. Unsolicited resumes from search firms or employment agencies, or similar, will not be paid a fee and become the property of Plante Moran.   

The specific statements above are not intended to be all-inclusive.

We are pleased to offer eligible staff a robust benefits package. Eligibility and contribution requirements for some of these benefits vary based on the number of hours staff work per week. Highlights include health, dental, vision, disability, and life insurance. In addition to this, eligible staff are able to take advantage of our Flexible Time Off and various pre-determined holidays, as well as a 401(k) plan, flexible benefits plans, business-related travel expense, lodging, and meal reimbursement for business-related use. A pension plan is also available for eligible administrative and paraprofessional staff. A discretionary bonus plan is available for eligible staff. Plante Moran also offers some contingent staff positions the option to elect health insurance in addition to limited paid sick time.

The compensation range reflects the base salary we reasonably expect to pay for this position across our offices in the following regions: CO, IL, OH, and MA. Please review the position description for the applicable geographic location. Generally, experienced hires are not hired at or near the maximum salary range, as compensation decisions take into account a wide variety of factors, including but not limited to: responsibilities, education, experience, knowledge, skills, and geography. For early career roles, including campus hires, we offer standardized, market-based starting salaries among individuals within the same hiring group. This approach ensures fairness and reflects current industry benchmarks for entry-level talent.

Under Colorado’s Job Application Fairness Act, you have the right to redact, from any documents that you submit in connection with your application, information that identifies your age, date of birth, or dates of attendance at or graduation from an educational institution. Should you wish to exercise your right to redact such information, please redact it prior to submitting documentation.

The compensation range for this role in CO, IL, OH, and MA is: $110,000.00-$181,000.00

This application window is a good-faith estimate of the time that this posting will remain open. This deadline will be promptly updated if the deadline is extended.

descriptionHtml:
Description

About Peregrine

Peregrine Advisors is a rapidly growing AI and data innovation hub helping government solve hard problems and deliver better outcomes. We work across the full lifecycle—from strategy and governance through architecture, engineering, analytics, AI, visualization, and training—for clients including the SEC, PCAOB, DDOT, and DCAA.

Our clients describe our support as “absolutely excellent” and our people as “instrumental to organization’s success.” Winner of the United Nations COP27 Datathon, our work has earned all Exceptional CPARS ratings, SEC Chair’s Awards, the SEC Vision Award, and recognition from FDA leadership.

We are also built differently. Peregrine is the first and only social enterprise organized as a Benefit Corporation and SBA 8(a) company focused on AI and data for government. We believe business success should create client value, social value, and opportunity for our people.

As we enter our next stage of growth, we need dependable, motivated, and skilled people who have a combination of intellectual curiosity and intellectual courage. With new clients, larger programs, and expanding responsibilities, the people joining Peregrine now will have the opportunity to help shape the company we become.

People first. Ownership always.

We solve problems through people, process, and technology—in that order. Technology matters, but people make transformation happen. That principle defines our culture. Trust and motivation are the foundational pillars of delivery on which our skills stand. We hire people we can trust, who care deeply about what they do, take ownership, learn quickly, help one another, and refuse to walk past a problem because it belongs to someone else.

At Peregrine, you are not joining simply to fill a position. You are joining a team, taking ownership of a mission, and helping build a company. If that excites you, we should talk.

At Peregrine Advisors, you will design the data models and architecture for a large federal data-lake platform on Amazon Web Services (AWS). But we hire people, not seats. As the work evolves, you will move to where the hardest problems are.

This is a hybrid work arrangement based in the Washington, DC metropolitan area, and the commuting cadence varies by assignment. The initial engagement requires United States citizenship and the ability to obtain a Public Trust determination.

Your first project

Your First Project Will Likely Have You Shaping How a Federal Data Lake And Its Data Stores Fit Together. Depending On The Assignment, You May

  • Design clean data models and schemas across the data lake and its stores: Amazon Simple Storage Service (S3) with Apache Iceberg tables, Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL, and Amazon DynamoDB.
  • Set the models and schemas that new and migrated data sources land in, so the data comes together in one architecture.
  • Restructure the existing data ecosystem to remove redundancy and protect the integrity and accessibility of the data.
  • Keep all of it under governed access.

You help deliver a data architecture that brings new and existing sources together cleanly, built for a regulated environment where accuracy and auditability are not optional.

This is where you start, not the shape of your career here.

Requirements

  • 4+ years of data architecture and data modeling experience
  • 4+ years of cloud data architecture on AWS, including AWS Glue, Amazon EMR, and AWS Lambda
  • Bachelor's degree
  • Schema design across a data lake and relational stores, including S3 with Apache Iceberg tables, Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL, and Amazon DynamoDB
  • Data governance and security, with Apache Ranger or comparable access controls
  • Data modeling tools, for example ER/Studio or IBM InfoSphere
  • Communication with technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Proficiency in writing, PowerPoint, and Excel

Preferred

  • Master's degree in a relevant field
  • Hadoop or Spark
  • Breadth across the data lifecycle: data engineering, data product, data science, or data management
  • Federal information technology experience
  • Familiarity with AI-assisted developer tools

Who You Are

You see the whole data system and care how each piece fits. You model precisely, you can explain a design to an engineer or an executive, and you leave every data estate in better shape than you found it. You experiment, fail, learn, and repeat quickly. You would rather own an outcome than be handed a task.

What You Bring

  • Deep skill in data modeling and schema design, across both a data lake and relational stores on AWS.
  • The tools of the architect's trade, including cloud data services, governed access, and modeling tools, plus the judgment to restructure a live data ecosystem without breaking it.
  • The communication skills to win support for a design from technical and non-technical stakeholders, in a regulated environment where accuracy and auditability are not optional.

When we talk

Be prepared to discuss a difficult problem you worked through, the decisions you made, what happened, and what you learned.

Benefits

This is a full-time W-2 position with a salary of $112,000 to $170,000 per year.

Benefits include medical, dental, and vision insurance with the employee premium fully paid and half of dependent premiums; employer-paid life, accidental death, and short-term and long-term disability insurance; a 401(k) with an employer match of up to 4% of salary; unlimited paid time off; and sponsored professional certifications and continuing education.

What We Offer

You will work alongside developers, engineers, data scientists, architects, and strategists, on work ranging from strategy to implementation. We support your development across assignments and clients through extensive onboarding, sponsored professional certifications such as the Data Management Capability Assessment Model (DCAM) and AWS technical certifications, and rotation across functions to expand your skills and perspective. The mission is real, the problems are hard, and you own what you ship.

What We Commit To

As a Benefit Corporation, our commitment runs three ways: real, measurable value for our clients; government that works better for the public; and a team that makes everyone in it better.

We hire people who want to help build the firm, not just work at it. If that is you, apply.

Peregrine Advisors is an equal opportunity employer.

Peregrine exclusively works with OPEN Data Jobs to recruit our team. Register with OPEN Data Jobs to be considered for this and future openings.

Business Intelligence Architect

Competitive Rate

Who We Are…

At Fenner Precision Polymers, a Michelin Group company, we’re committed to delivering high-performance solutions that power critical applications across industries. Our culture is built on safety, innovation, continuous improvement, and a shared dedication to excellence. We value teamwork, adaptability, and a positive work environment where every employee plays a vital role in our success.

What We Offer…

At Fenner, you’re more than just an employee, you’re part of a global team that values your voice, supports your growth, and celebrates your contributions. We offer:

  • Competitive pay with annual bonus potential
  • Day-one Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage
  • 401(k) match immediately vested with the company
  • 100% Paid Parental Leave
  • Michelin Stock Purchase Program
  • Michelin Tire Rebate Program
  • Career Development in a Global Organization
  • Personal Development and Career Progression
  • A Culture Built on Trust, Respect, and Empowerment

Be part of a company that values your contribution and invests in your future.

What You’ll Be Doing…

The Senior Business Intelligence Architect is a hands-on technical leader who will shape Fenner’s data and analytics strategy and help reinforce the 3 pillars of Fenner’s Digital Transformation – Tools+Data+People. This role will turn complex business challenges into scalable solutions using Azure, Databricks, Power BI, automation, and AI, while setting technical direction, strengthening data governance, and coaching the BI team.

Key Responsibilities

Enterprise Data Architecture and Strategy

  • Lead the design and evolution of Fenner’s enterprise BI, data warehouse, and analytics architecture.
  • Develop scalable architecture that supports structured and unstructured data from multiple business systems.
  • Establish technical roadmaps, architecture standards, and design patterns for data ingestion, transformation, storage, modeling, and visualization.
  • Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend solutions that improve scalability, reliability, security, and business value.
  • Ensure analytics architecture aligns with broader IT, cybersecurity, and business strategies.

Data Engineering and Platform Management

  • Provide technical oversight for the daily operation, performance, and reliability of the Fenner Data Warehouse and analytics ecosystem.
  • Architect and develop robust data pipelines that integrate ERP, manufacturing, financial, commercial, supply chain, and other enterprise data sources.
  • Design, optimize, and govern ETL and ELT processes across Azure, Databricks, SQL Server, and related platforms.
  • Lead performance tuning, troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, and platform optimization.
  • Implement monitoring and controls that support accurate, complete, secure, and timely data delivery.

Data Modeling and Analytics Solutions

  • Design dimensional, semantic, and enterprise data models that provide consistent definitions and high-performance analytics.
  • Translate complex business needs into technical requirements, solution designs, and actionable implementation plans.
  • Lead the development of advanced reports, dashboards, data products, and self-service analytics capabilities.
  • Establish standards for Power BI development, including data models, DAX, security, performance, usability, and deployment.
  • Ensure analytics solutions deliver clear, meaningful, and actionable business insights.

Data Governance, Quality, and Security

  • Partner with business and technology leaders to establish data ownership, stewardship, governance, and accountability.
  • Define and enforce standards for data quality, documentation, lineage, access, retention, and security.
  • Ensure compliance with internal requirements, applicable regulations, and data-protection practices.
  • Develop testing and validation frameworks that support reliable and consistent analytics solutions.
  • Ensure adherence to configuration management, change control, release management, and development standards.

Technical Leadership and Mentorship

  • Serve as a senior technical resource for BI Analysts, data professionals, application teams, and business users.
  • Mentor team members in data modeling, pipeline development, visualization, testing, documentation, and BI best practices.
  • Lead architecture reviews and provide guidance on complex technical and functional decisions.
  • Promote consistent development practices, reusable solutions, and knowledge sharing across the organization.
  • Build trust in data and analytics by communicating technical concepts clearly to both technical and nontechnical audiences.

Digital Transformation

  • Be a force for change, driving data elements of Fenner's Digital Transformation initiative.
  • Partner with business leaders to understand, challenge, and redesign business processes, not simply automate the way they work today.
  • Identify opportunities to use data, analytics, automation, AI, and modern digital technologies to improve business performance.
  • Turn business problems into practical digital solutions, from idea and architecture through implementation and adoption.
  • Act as a bridge between business and technology, helping users understand what is possible and translating opportunities into actionable solutions.
  • Champion self-service analytics and data-driven decision-making, while maintaining appropriate data architecture, governance, and standards.
  • Help drive adoption of new technologies by educating, demonstrating, prototyping, and influencing, not simply delivering technical solutions.
  • Foster a culture of curiosity, experimentation, and continuous improvement around data and digital technology.

Business Partnership and Continuous Improvement

  • Collaborate with Finance, Operations, Supply Chain, Commercial, Quality, HR, and other functions to understand business processes and analytics needs.
  • Identify opportunities to improve data capture, automate manual processes, and accelerate access to actionable information.
  • Lead discovery sessions and translate business challenges into prioritized analytics use cases.
  • Measure the effectiveness and adoption of BI solutions and recommend opportunities for improvement.
  • Support Lean Continuous Improvement through data-driven analysis and scalable digital solutions.

General

  • Perform additional responsibilities as assigned.
  • Model and uphold Fenner Precision Polymers’ Values and Behaviors at all times.

Qualifications

Education

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Data Engineering, Business Intelligence, Analytics, or a related field.
  • Master's degree in a related discipline is preferred.
  • An equivalent combination of education and directly relevant experience may be considered.

Experience

  • 7 or more years of progressive experience in business intelligence, data architecture, data engineering, analytics, or enterprise data warehousing.
  • At least 3 years of experience leading complex BI architecture or data engineering initiatives.
  • Demonstrated experience designing scalable enterprise data models, data pipelines, and analytics platforms.
  • Experience mentoring technical professionals and influencing cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Experience supporting manufacturing, supply chain, finance, or other enterprise business functions is strongly preferred.

Technical Qualifications

  • Advanced experience with Microsoft Azure data and analytics services.
  • Strong experience with Databricks, data lakes, lakehouse architecture, or comparable modern data platforms.
  • Expert-level SQL development and performance tuning capabilities.
  • Advanced experience with Power BI, semantic modeling, DAX, data visualization, and enterprise deployment practices.
  • Experience with Microsoft SQL Server technologies, including SSIS, SSAS, and SSRS.
  • Strong knowledge of dimensional modeling, data warehouse architecture, ETL/ELT design, and data integration.
  • Experience implementing data governance, quality, lineage, security, and access-control standards.
  • Familiarity with DevOps, source control, automated testing, deployment pipelines, and change-management practices.
  • Experience integrating ERP, manufacturing, financial, and other enterprise systems is preferred.

Leadership Competencies

  • Ability to establish technical direction and execute against it.
  • Strong coaching skills to help less-experienced team members grow.
  • Strong analytical, conceptual, and problem-solving capabilities.
  • Excellent communication, facilitation, and presentation skills.
  • Ability to explain complex technical concepts to business stakeholders.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence decisions without direct authority.
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage competing priorities.
  • Collaborative, customer-focused approach with a commitment to quality and continuous improvement.

Growth Opportunities…

This role offers a clear path for advancement. High-performing individuals will have the opportunity to grow at Fenner Precision Polymers, taking on greater responsibility, strategic influence, and leadership within the IT team.

Ready to Take the Next Step in Your Career?

Apply today and become part of a team that’s manufacturing more than products—we’re manufacturing a better future.

descriptionHtml:
T-Rex Solutions is seeking a qualified Data Architect to support the 2028 Census Test program, an end-to-end dry run of the operations in preparation for the 2030 Decennial Census. During the test both the enterprise processes and data systems will be verified and fine-tuned to ensure the success of the large-scale national survey. Specifically relevant to this position, the solution will be a data-centric system with a data lake using Redshift on AWS at its core. This solution is expected to transform the processing within the system from what was historically a batch processing system to a more incremental one that processes individual responses as they are collected. Additionally, the Census Bureau intends to increase the usage of Administrative Data during this processing. As such, the data structures used within this data lake must be efficiently defined to maximize the flexibility for the potential use and addition of administrative data as well as facilitate incremental and large-scale statistical processing.

Responsibilities:

  • Hands-on design of the data architecture to be used within the Census Enterprise Data Lake for 2030 Census processing. This structure will compose data from 350+ million person records, 18-+ million address records, and other associated administrative data.
  • Perform analysis on data workflow and detail requirements to map them into big data artifacts in Cloud environment
  • Review the high-level design of the entire decennial data architecture across 50+ different enterprise systems
  • Produce data architecture artifacts such as decennial-wise conceptual, logical, and lineage data models for both management and technical users
  • Work with system owners to identify key data entities and relationships on the basis of business context
  • Build data architecture prototypes to demonstrate the effectiveness and efficiency of the big data design approach
  • Review Census data sets and conduct empirical studies as needed to build an optimal data infrastructure to support the mission
  • Identify the complex relationships within various data sets and define corresponding data objects for incremental processing
  • Frequently coordinate and collaborate with the various system teams and other contractors that will populate and use data via these structures to efficiently build the structures to facilitate their update, maintenance, ability to search, and ability to compare to administrative data for QA and other purposes.
  • Frequently coordinate and collaborate with the various statistical organizations that will analyze this data to efficiently build the structures to facilitate this analysis.
  • Coordination with the Census Bureau data architect to drive alignment with the Enterprise Master Data Model.
  • Be in a highly visible position to work with client team closely to understand the business needs and identify the key solution areas.
  • Provides technical/management leadership on major tasks or technology assignments. Establishes goals and plans that meet project objectives.
  • Develop roadmaps and provide technical strategy directions for the development and delivery of a new enterprise data framework.
  • Transform business requirements into data driven solutions including architectural design, component standardization, technical process flow, and cost-effective implementation approaches.
  • Participate as needed in all aspects of software development with emphasis on the planning, analysis, design, integration, and presentation.
  • Apply principles, design methods and data architecture knowledge to specific requirements in the context of a complex, large-scale enterprise data framework.
  • Coordinate with senior management on project activities including business analysis, client collaboration, product provisions, and project staffing.
  • Provide high-level support for system design, development, integration, and coordination.

Requirements:

  • 7+ years of experience developing data architecture and data engineering solutions at enterprise scale
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related field
  • Expertise in using Amazon Web Services (AWS) environment and/or other Cloud environments
  • Expertise in using data warehouses such as Redshift, Snowflake, or similar technologies
  • Expertise in a wide range of cloud data services and data structures (in addition to data warehouse), such as data lake, Iceberg table, document DB, key-value DB, and time-series DB
  • Strong general data engineering knowledge, including data transformation, data loading, data procedure writing, and data querying
  • Solid skills in distributed and concurrent data processing, including the use of data partitions and indexes for performance enhancement
  • Strong background in various types of data infrastructure and services such as AWS EMR clusters, AWS RDS, EC2, and S3.
  • Ability to design data models that are scalable in a hybrid environment of big data platforms and traditional databases
  • Ability to evaluate design and implementation from data security perspective
  • Strong data management and transformation skills to provide efficient solutions to business outcomes
  • Strong, hands-on working knowledge of data fabric architectures, data meshes, data analytics, big data platforms, and data visualization
  • Solid understanding of software engineering principles, design methodologies, technology architecture, and best practices in IT industry
  • Solid understanding of Agile methodologies, with strong background working in an Agile development environment, collaborating with development and architecture teams
  • Ability to obtain Public Trust (MBI) Clearance

Desired Skills:

  • Expertise recommending analytical and reporting tools in the federal market.
  • Expertise with Data Transformation and migration using AWS technologies and open-source tools.
  • Experience in adopting AI/ML technologies and applying them to enterprise data sets.
  • Hands-on experience with other Data Engineering and data science development efforts such as Data Ingestion, Cleansing, and Transformation.

T-Rex Overview

Established in 1999, T-Rex Solutions, LLC is a proven mid-tier business providing data-centric mission services to the Federal government as it increasingly tries to secure and leverage the power of data. We design, integrate, secure, and deploy advanced technical solutions for our customers so they can efficiently fulfill their critical objectives. T-Rex offers both IT and professional services to numerous Federal agencies and is a leader in providing high quality and innovative solutions in the areas of Cloud and Infrastructure Services, Cyber Security, and Big Data Engineering.

T-Rex is constantly seeking qualified people to join our growing team. We have built a broad client base through our devotion to delivering quality products and customer service, and to do that we need quality individuals. But more than that, we at T-Rex are committed to creating a culture that supports the development of every employee's personal and professional lives. T-Rex has made a commitment to maintain the status of an industry leader in compensation packages and benefits which includes competitive salaries, performance bonuses, training and educational reimbursement, Transamerica 401(k) and Cigna healthcare benefits.

T-Rex is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, sex (including pregnancy and sexual orientation), parental status, national origin, age, disability, family medical history or genetic information, political affiliation, military service, or other non-merit based factors.

In compliance with pay transparency guidelines, the annual base salary range for this position is $150,000 - $195,000. Please note that the salary information is a general guideline only. T-Rex considers factors such as (but not limited to) scope and responsibilities of the position, candidate's work experience, education/training, key skills, internal peer equity, as well as market and business considerations when extending an offer.

T-Rex offers a diverse and collaborative work environment, exciting opportunities for professional growth, and generous benefits, including: PTO available to use immediately upon joining (prorated based on start date), paid parental leave, individual and family health, vision, and dental benefits, annual budget for training, professional development and tuition reimbursement, and a 401(k) plan with company match fully vested after 60 days of employment among other benefits.

Operating with significant autonomy, the Technical Fellow provides technical leadership across multiple business units and disciplines, drives innovation through advanced analytics and AI readiness initiatives, and influences executive decision-making through deep expertise and strategic vision. Essential Functions

Enterprise Data Strategy & Architecture

  • Define and maintain PACCAR's enterprise data architecture vision, strategy, standards, and technology roadmap.
  • Establish architectural principles, governance frameworks, and technical standards for enterprise data management, analytics, AI, machine learning, and cloud platforms.
  • Lead the design of complex, scalable data ecosystems encompassing data warehousing, lakehouse architectures, real-time integration, master data management, and business intelligence solutions.
  • Evaluate emerging technologies and provide strategic recommendations regarding future enterprise investments.

Technical Leadership

  • Serve as the organization's foremost technical expert in data architecture and advanced analytics.
  • Provide technical direction and architectural oversight for enterprise-wide initiatives spanning multiple business units and technology domains.
  • Lead resolution of the company's most complex architectural and data-related challenges.
  • Guide senior technical professionals, architects, engineers, and technology leaders through mentoring, consultation, and technical reviews.
  • Establish best practices and influence technical decision-making across global teams.

Innovation & Transformation

  • Drive enterprise modernization initiatives involving cloud platforms, data governance, artificial intelligence, predictive analytics, automation, and digital transformation.
  • Identify opportunities to leverage data as a strategic business asset and translate business needs into long-term architectural solutions.
  • Champion AI readiness and advanced analytics capabilities while ensuring scalability, security, compliance, and data quality.
  • Lead proof-of-concept initiatives and emerging technology evaluations with enterprise-wide implications.

Governance & Business Partnership

  • Partner with executive leadership to align technology strategy with business objectives.
  • Establish and maintain enterprise governance models for data quality, security, privacy, metadata management, and regulatory compliance.
  • Influence organizational priorities through thought leadership, technical expertise, and strategic consultation.

Leadership Expectations

Responsibilities

  • Define enterprise technical direction.
  • Influence executive and senior leadership decision-making.
  • Mentor senior architects and technical professionals.
  • Lead cross-functional initiatives spanning multiple business units.
  • Establish policies, standards, and practices affecting the enterprise.

Scope & Impact

  • Enterprise-wide influence across multiple PACCAR divisions and functions.
  • Decisions have long-term impact on technology strategy, investment priorities, risk management, innovation, and business capability development.

descriptionHtml:
Description

Reporting to the Chief Architect, Technology, and partnering closely with league, product, operations, marketing, ticketing, finance, and partnership teams across TMRW Sports’ properties — TGL, WTGL, and the upcoming pro flag football league — the Data Architect will design, build, and govern the TMRW Lakehouse — the company’s shared data foundation and central data library — that powers competition, broadcast, fan engagement, ticketing and match-night reporting, sponsorship analytics, and league operations from launch through future seasons.

TMRW Sports operates as a portfolio of leagues, each with its own ecosystem of vendor systems — competition and scoring platforms, broadcast and streaming partners, tracking and biometric providers, ticketing platforms, point-of-sale and F&B, finance, email marketing, sales leads, e-commerce, social and audience measurement, customer data, sponsorship measurement, and digital products. The Data Architect will consolidate these fragmented sources into the Lakehouse — a unified, governed platform; define repeatable integration patterns for onboarding new vendors and properties; and establish the foundation for AI/ML, AI data analyst agents, self-service analytics, and a single fan view that spans every TMRW Sports league.

This is a hands-on, builder-architect role. The Data Architect will set technical standards across data modeling, governance, security, and privacy; partner with vendors on API design, schema versioning, and SLAs; and remain in the modern data stack day to day, working with a lean in-house data engineering team and consulting partners and using AI to accelerate how quickly new sources are onboarded. This role requires occasional travel to venues during build phases and live competition windows.

Responsibilities

Data Platform Architecture & Delivery

  • Own the architecture and day-to-day delivery of the TMRW Lakehouse — a governed foundation organized as a medallion architecture that serves analytics, ML, and operational use cases across the portfolio.
  • Run the data-source onboarding roadmap with domain data owners — prioritizing which sources, definitions, and reports come into the Lakehouse first based on business value, and delivering against gated milestones where each phase proves value before the next begins.
  • Define standardized integration patterns — batch, streaming, and change data capture — for onboarding new vendor systems, third-party feeds, and TMRW Sports properties.
  • Design and maintain the canonical data model, semantic layer, and metric catalog that give every league a consistent, trusted view of fans, athletes, partners, and competition.
  • Lead the modernization of legacy point-to-point integrations and manual, spreadsheet-driven reporting toward automated ELT pipelines and event-driven streaming where real-time matters — match-night reporting, game-day operations, venue IoT, broadcast, and digital products.
  • Manage the economics of the data stack — consumption-based spend, third-party platform licenses, and consulting-partner capacity — and identify where in-house capabilities can reduce external agency and software costs.

Multi-Vendor Integration & the Single Fan View

  • Consolidate fragmented data from competition systems, ticketing, customer data, POS, sponsorship measurement, broadcast/OTT, and digital products into a single source of truth.
  • Build the identity resolution and fan intelligence foundation that powers marketing, ticketing, partnership activation, and league operations across TMRW Sports properties.
  • Incorporate third-party data augmentation (e.g., demographic and household appends) with clear rules for how external attributes are validated, governed, and reconciled with first-party data.
  • Evaluate, select, and onboard third-party data providers and feeds; partner with vendors on API design, schema versioning, data quality, and SLAs, and hold providers accountable to agreed data dictionaries and complete, timely delivery.
  • Govern data contracts, data quality checks, and pipeline monitoring between producer systems and downstream consumers so the platform stays reliable and trusted as the league portfolio grows.

Governance, Security & AI/ML Enablement

  • Establish and enforce data governance — cataloging, lineage, role-based access, PII handling, consent and preference management, GDPR/CCPA compliance — appropriate for a multi-league, multi-tenant environment.
  • Operationalize TMRW’s hub-and-spoke data operating model: help business leaders and maintain shared business definitions, KPI/metric calculations, and a searchable data catalog business users can find and trust.
  • Enable AI/ML and agentic AI use cases — including in-house AI data analyst agents that let employees ask questions of governed data in plain language — by designing the semantic and agent-connectivity layers (e.g., MCP), feature store, vector/embedding infrastructure, and RAG/LLM patterns the leagues will rely on for personalization, content, and operations.
  • Partner with security, legal, and privacy on data classification, masking, and access policy across leagues, partners, and rights holders.

Cross-Functional Partnership & Cross-TMRW Alignment

  • Partner with the enterprise Analytics & Insights function and embedded league analysts to design and deliver the business intelligence platforms, semantic models, and governed datasets that enable trusted, self-service analytics across the organization — and drive adoption so dashboards replace manual, spreadsheet-based reporting.
  • Raise data literacy across the organization through enablement, documentation, and common tooling, so business users can self-serve without deep technical skills.
  • Translate business problems from ticketing, marketing, partnerships, competition, and broadcast teams into clean, well-owned data products.
  • Drive alignment with cross-TMRW Sports architectures, leveraging common solutions across properties for scale and expediency.
  • Communicate status, risks, tradeoffs, and decisions to executive leadership with clarity and urgency in a fast-paced, high-visibility environment — including the business value delivered (revenue enablement, cost avoidance, and time returned to teams) at each investment gate.

Requirements

  • 10+ years of data engineering or data architecture experience, with 3+ years in a lead or architect role.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related technical field.
  • Hands-on production experience building on consumption based platforms, including medallion-style data organization, plus modern transformation and orchestration tooling.
  • Strong dimensional modeling foundation; data vault familiarity a plus.
  • Cloud fluency in AWS, including streaming and event-driven patterns.
  • Demonstrated experience integrating fragmented data across multiple SaaS and vendor platforms and establishing repeatable onboarding patterns.
  • Demonstrated experience standing up data governance with business data owners and stewards — shared definitions, metric catalogs, lineage, and PII/privacy controls.
  • Experience leading delivery through a lean in-house team plus consulting partners — setting technical direction, reviewing partner work, and managing scope and cost.
  • Experience designing semantic models and self-service BI that non-technical users adopt.

Preferred

  • Experience in sports, sports media, sports betting/integrity, or live-event environments where reliability on a fixed schedule is critical.
  • Hands-on experience enabling ML/AI workloads — feature stores, vector databases, RAG, agentic AI/LLM agents for analytics (including MCP-style tool integration), AI-assisted data engineering, and modern MLOps tooling.
  • Experience with master data management, composable (warehouse-native) CDPs, reverse ETL, and third-party data enrichment.
  • Experience in a startup or zero-to-one environment where the data platform is being built, not maintained.

You’ll Be Successful If You

  • Make complex data concepts relatable to any audience — translating architecture into plain language instead of getting hung up on jargon.
  • Are very hands on when needed, empowering when not, and know instinctively when to switch between the two.
  • Are naturally optimistic and infect others with your optimism to collectively achieve great outcomes.
  • Are collaborative with all stakeholders.
  • Build a solid plan, often without all the necessary data, and lead a cross-discipline team to achieve the goal.
  • Pivot from the plan when required to secure the overall outcome.
  • Change your mind when new information is discovered.
  • Inspire those around you to achieve greatness.
  • Build team morale and maintain it even when the going gets tough.
  • Treat data as a product — prioritize by business value, measure adoption, and retire reports no one uses.
  • And have fun while doing it all.

Benefits

  • Equity ownership opportunities to allow employees to share in the company’s growth
  • Unlimited discretionary time off along with 15 paid holidays per year (including the week of Independence Day)
  • Comprehensive health insurance options, including a 100% contribution Employee coverage option
  • Additional employee and family insurance coverage options with company contribution, including dental and vision
  • FSA, HSA, and DCHSA opportunities including contribution matches
  • Retirement options, including traditional 401(k) and Roth IRA plans
  • Benefits are subject to change at the company’s discretion.

TMRW Sports is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, age, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other factor protected by applicable law. This applies to all employment practices within our organization, including hiring, recruiting, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leave of absence, compensation, benefits, and training.

TMRW Sports expressly prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind based on race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, age, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws.

No matter what background you bring with you, if you are committed to excellence and good at what you do, we welcome you to apply to join us and encourage you to come as you are.

About TMRW Sports (pronounced “tomorrow Sports”)

TMRW Sports is focused on building modern approaches in sports, media, and entertainment. By creating new leagues for a new age, TMRW Sports is forging pathways and experiences for generations of fans. TMRW Sports’ first project, TGL presented by SoFi, is a primetime team golf league in partnership with the PGA TOUR that reaches 152 countries and territories worldwide and has been described as a “high-energy arena spectacle” by Vanity Fair, “pure entertainment” by GQ, and “golf’s boldest new venture” by Fast Company. Targeting a winter 2026-27 launch, WTGL will feature teams of the world’s best women golfers in partnership with the LPGA and has attracted investment from Alex Morgan’s Trybe Ventures. TMRW Sports is also developing plans for men’s and women’s professional flag football leagues in partnership with the National Football League and 32 Equity, the league’s collective investment vehicle. Founded by Tiger Woods, Rory McIlroy, and sports executive Mike McCarley, TMRW Sports is supported by an influential and diverse investor group of athletes, celebrities and business leaders from the worlds of sports, media, technology and finance. For more, visit TMRWSportsGroup.com.

Job Description

Senior Architect – Data Engineering

Role Overview

We are seeking a visionary and hands-on Senior Data Engineering Architect to design, scale, and optimize our enterprise data platform. In this role, you will define the blueprints for our data estate, leveraging a modern stack centered on Databricks, dbt, and Apache Airflow. You will bridge the gap between complex business strategy and technical implementation, ensuring our data pipelines are scalable, resilient, and cost-effective.

Key Responsibilities

🏢 Architecture & Platform Design

  • Design end-to-end lakehouse architectures on Databricks utilizing Delta Lake and Unity Catalog.
  • Establish robust governance, schema evolution, and fine-grained data security patterns.
  • Formulate standard frameworks for data modeling (e.g., Kimball dimensional modeling, Data Vault 2.0).
  • Optimize infrastructure for optimal price-to-performance across batch and streaming workloads.

⚙️ Data Pipeline & Orchestration Engineering

  • Architect modular, reusable transformation frameworks using dbt Core/Cloud integrated with Databricks.
  • Standardize data processing patterns using PySpark, Delta Live Tables (DLT), and Spark SQL.
  • Build highly observable, dynamic orchestration workflows using Apache Airflow.
  • Design cross-DAG dependency models, custom providers, and robust error-handling mechanisms.

🚀 DataOps & Engineering Excellence

  • Drive DataOps maturity by implementing CI/CD pipelines via GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or Azure DevOps.
  • Deploy infrastructure-as-code patterns using Terraform and Databricks Asset Bundles (DABs).
  • Embed automated data quality testing directly into the dbt and Airflow lifecycle.
  • Define service-level indicators (SLIs) and objectives (SLOs) for pipeline uptime and data freshness.

👥 Leadership & Stakeholder Management

  • Serve as the principal technical authority and escalation point for data engineering teams.
  • Mentor senior and mid-level data engineers through code reviews and architectural workshops.
  • Collaborate with product managers, data scientists, and business leaders to solve data gaps.

Required Qualifications

  • Overall 15+ Years of experience
  • 10+ years of total experience in data engineering, data warehousing, and distributed systems.
  • 4+ years of dedicated experience architecting production environments within the modern data stack.

Technical Proficiencies

  • Databricks: Advanced mastery of Photon engine, Unity Catalog, Delta Lake optimization (Z-order, Liquid Clustering), and DLT.
  • dbt: Expert-level proficiency with compl ex macro development, custom materializations, and multi-project dbt mesh architectures.
  • Airflow: Deep understanding of Airflow scheduling, custom operators, dynamic task mapping, and infrastructure scaling.
  • Languages: Elite proficiency in Python (PySpark) and advanced SQL.
  • Cloud Infrastructure: Strong experience with at least one major cloud ecosystem provider: AWS, Azure, or GCP.

Soft Skills

  • Strong technical communication skills to distill complex infrastructure designs for non-technical stakeholders.
  • Natural ability to lead by influence and drive cross-functional engineering initiatives.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Official Databricks certifications (e.g., Databricks Certified Data Engineer Professional or Solutions Architect).
  • Active contributor to open-source data communities (dbt, Airflow, or Apache Spark).
  • Solid foundation in streaming data technologies like Apache Kafka or AWS

Salary Range- $150,000-$240,000 a year

Job Description

A career with us is a journey, not a destination. This could be the next best step in your technical career. Join us.

As a Lead Architect at JPMorganChase within Corporate Technology with in the Corporate Data Analytics, you will define and deliver the target-state architecture for enterprise data interoperability and consumption across modern data platforms and on‑premises sources. You will set secure, reusable integration patterns for vendor data consumption with a focus on artificial intelligence and business intelligence use cases, aligned to cybersecurity, identity and access controls, and architecture governance. You will partner closely with engineering, security, and governance teams to turn architectural standards into shipped capabilities that scale across multiple lines of business.

Job Responsibilities

  • Define and continuously evolve an inter-lake interoperability architecture blueprint spanning Databricks, Snowflake, enterprise data lake platforms, and on‑premises sources.
  • Produce hands-on architecture deliverables, including reference architectures, sequence and flow diagrams, decision records, and non-functional requirements.
  • Establish secure and reusable patterns for data movement and access, including batch, streaming, and change data capture where applicable.
  • Design vendor data consumption integration patterns into artificial intelligence and business intelligence platforms, focusing on usability, repeatability, and control alignment.
  • Specify authentication and authorization models that enforce least privilege, clear access boundaries, and auditable entitlements.
  • Define platform onboarding requirements, including security controls, governance readiness, operational support, service-level objectives, and monitoring expectations.
  • Lead assessments of new platform and product capabilities for internal and external data consumption applications, documenting trade-offs, risks, and remediation actions.
  • Facilitate Architecture Review Board intake, reviews, decisions, and action tracking to closure, maintaining reusable artifacts and outcomes.
  • Build and maintain knowledge assets such as playbooks, onboarding guides, templates, decision trees, and frequently asked questions to accelerate adoption.

Required Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills

  • Formal training or certification on architecture concepts and 5+ years applied experience
  • Eight years of experience in solution architecture, data architecture, or platform architecture, owning end-to-end target-state designs and delivery outcomes.
  • Hands-on architecture experience with Databricks and/or Snowflake, including interoperability and integration with enterprise data lake or lakehouse ecosystems.
  • Demonstrated expertise designing secure enterprise integrations, including authentication, authorization, encryption, audit logging, and monitoring.
  • Proven ability to define reference architectures, reusable patterns, and onboarding standards that are adopted by engineering teams.
  • Experience leading architecture governance processes and influencing decisions across engineering, cybersecurity, identity and access management, governance, and line-of-business stakeholders.
  • Ability to translate complex technical topics into clear, actionable guidance for both senior stakeholders and engineers.
  • Experience designing for scalability, resiliency, performance, and cost, including documenting measurable non-functional requirements.

Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills

  • Experience enabling artificial intelligence, machine learning, and business intelligence consumption at scale, including data serving patterns, semantic layers, or consumption APIs.
  • Familiarity with data governance capabilities such as metadata management, lineage, data classification, retention, and auditability.
  • Experience building standardized self-service onboarding experiences and reusable components for data consumers.
  • Experience with vendor data integration and third-party risk or security considerations in regulated environments.
  • Background partnering with platform teams to deliver reusable services that enable cross-domain data sharing with consistent guardrails.

The north star

The platform exists to deliver three enterprise views, on one AI-ready foundation, built iteratively.

  • Event 360 — every live event, broadcast and activation on one spine: venue, gate, attendance, rights, sponsorship, hospitality and media performance, at the grain each business needs.
  • Customer 360 — the B2B side of TKO: rights holders, sponsors, partners, hospitality buyers and agency clients across IMG and On Location, resolved to golden records and linked to the events and fans they touch.
