The enterprise data framework and roadmap. Define the target-state architecture and the published roadmap from today's estate to the north star. Set the reference patterns for how data is ingested (batch, CDC, streaming, API), how it is curated through the medallion from landing to marts, how it is served to BI, agents and applications, and how data science and ML consume it (feature-ready datasets, training and retrieval pipelines, in-platform serving). Define the environments and promotion path from development to production, and the standards each layer must meet to pass. Engineering builds the pipelines, Product owns the data products, Data Science builds the models; your framework is what they all build against.

The canonical enterprise model. Define the dimensional and conformed-dimension standards that govern how raw data becomes curated data: grain, conformance, slowly changing dimension handling, surrogate and business keys, and the shared dimensions that must mean the same thing in every brand. Design for modularity, so that the fifth domain costs less than the first and new properties, partnerships and source systems are absorbed rather than re-engineered.

Master data design. Design the master data architecture across fan, event, rights holder, sponsor and partner, employee and vendor, in partnership with Master Data Management and Governance, which owns the policy, stewardship and governance framework your designs implement. Choose and justify the implementation style per domain. Design entity resolution as a cascade — deterministic, probabilistic, machine-learned, human-stewarded — with attribute-level survivorship, versioned match rules, and merges that are defensible and reversible. Treat consent state, opt-out signals and retention obligations as master data carried with identity across brands.

The semantic layer and its hierarchy. Own the enterprise-certified definitions for the concepts the whole company shares — fan, event, attendance, revenue, engagement, rights — and the domain models that inherit from and extend them. Set the metric tiers, the certification bar at each tier, and the promotion path from exploratory to certified. Decide where each definition physically lives across Snowflake semantic views, dbt, the BI semantic layer and the Open Semantic Interchange specification, and keep those representations in sync. TKO already runs conversational analytics agents in production for business users; the accuracy of every one of them is bounded by this model.

Governance made enforceable in the platform. You do not own governance. You design the architecture that makes it real: how the catalog is populated and kept current, how lineage is captured from source through transformation to semantic layer to agent, where data quality rules execute and how results surface, what observability every data product carries by default, and how classification and access boundaries travel with the data into every tool and agent. Convert standards into automated checks — model contracts, linting, pre-merge data diffs, quality thresholds — so governance happens by rule rather than by inspection.

Architecture decisions and the paved road. Establish the architecture decision record practice, stored with the code. Run an advisory forum rather than an approval board. Publish and maintain the reference implementations, templates and modeling patterns that make the standard the path of least resistance. Define the target model for each domain before its migration wave, and the parity criteria that decide whether a cutover is complete.

How You Will Work

The role reports to the VP, Data Engineering & Science within TKO's Enterprise Data organization and works across four partnerships, each with a deliberate boundary.

Data Governance & MDM: Partner owns policy, stewardship, standards, data ownership, and the governance framework. You own the models those policies govern and the platform design that makes them enforceable.

Data Product Management: Partner owns what gets built, for whom, and in what order; the data product backlog and outcomes. You own how it is modeled, what reuse it must honor, and the architecture it must land on.

Data Engineering & Platform: Partner owns pipelines, infrastructure, orchestration, delivery, and the agent runtime. You own the framework, standards, and target model they build against, as well as the design review of what ships.

Data Science & ML: Partner owns models, features, experiments, and evaluation. You own the feature-ready and retrieval-ready substrate, and the environments ML runs in.

Application Teams: Partner owns the systems of record for data created in the organization. You own alignment on data movement patterns and publish/subscribe models, data lineage, and quality frameworks.

You influence without line authority. Engineers, analytics engineers and the global delivery partners supporting the brand and IMG estates adopt your standards because the reference implementations work and the decisions are written down. You raise architectural issues early and in writing, including unpopular ones, and own the trade-off conversation with engineering and business leadership. You explain to non-engineers what a decision costs, what it buys and what it forecloses. You mentor engineers in dimensional modeling, semantic design and master data practice as a discipline distinct from pipeline engineering.

What Success Looks Like

By 6 months. The target-state framework is published and adopted as the standard for the platform unification program: ingest, curation, serving and ML patterns; environments and promotion path; modeling standards; the architecture decision record practice. The first conformed dimensions (fan, event, date, venue, brand) are in production and used by more than one domain. The semantic metric tiers and certification process are defined and the first enterprise-certified metrics are live in the agent estate.

By 12 months. One 360 has a usable production slice: a resolved entity graph with defensible merges, consent lineage, and at least one cross-brand question answerable through governed definitions rather than hand-built SQL. Lineage, catalog coverage and quality checks are automated for every certified data product. Each domain migrating onto the unified platform has a target model defined before its wave begins, and parity criteria that go beyond a green pipeline.

By 18 months. All three 360s have production increments, and the fifth domain onboarded demonstrably cost less than the first. The global delivery partners build to the standard without escalation. Executive-facing numbers from conversational agents trace to certified definitions, and the failure mode for an unanswerable question is a refusal rather than a plausible wrong answer.

What You Bring

Must have

  • 12+ years in data architecture and engineering, with a substantial portion as a named architect accountable for enterprise-wide design across multiple business units or operating companies, adopted without line authority over the teams adopting it.
  • Deep dimensional modeling expertise at enterprise scale: conformed dimensions, grain discipline, slowly changing dimensions, and the judgment to know when a star schema is the wrong answer.
  • Hands-on master data architecture across multiple domains: implementation-style selection, entity resolution, survivorship and golden-record design, including what breaks at scale and what it costs to unmerge.
  • Production ownership of a semantic layer used by more than one team: metric definition ownership, certification, and the organizational work of collapsing competing definitions of the same number into one.
  • Deep, current Snowflake architecture experience: medallion design, role and access taxonomy, tag-driven masking and row-access policies, and the cost consequences of modeling decisions.
  • Strong dbt: project and mesh structure, macros, contracts, versions, testing, and the judgment to consolidate overlapping projects.
  • Experience architecting through a platform migration or consolidation of real scope, including the parity validation that determined whether it succeeded.
  • Practical command of governance from a semantics perspective — glossaries, metric definitions, lineage, data contracts, classification and access models — and how they become enforceable in a platform.
  • Exceptional written communication. This role is judged on design documents, standards and decision records that hold up after the author has moved on.

Strongly Preferred

  • Direct experience making enterprise data consumable by AI systems: semantic models exposed as agent tools, retrieval-ready and context-rich datasets, and a clear view of where generated SQL is appropriate and where it is not.
  • Identity graph, Customer 360 or Fan 360 design experience, and working knowledge of consumer privacy regimes (CCPA, GDPR) and consent management as a modeling input.
  • Designing the data substrate for ML: feature stores, training and retrieval pipelines, in-platform serving.
  • Experience in media, sports, entertainment, live events, ticketing or consumer and fan data environments.
  • Familiarity with open semantic interchange, open catalog and metadata standards, and the vendor landscape around them.
  • Experience working alongside offshore and partner delivery teams and raising their output to an architecture's standard

descriptionHtml:
In an increasingly challenging environment marked by disruptive tech like AI, market uncertainty, and regulatory change, finance and global business services leaders recognize the opportunity to better serve the enterprise, shareholders, customers, and regulators.

Deloitte helps navigate this complexity by bringing deep industry insights and integrated solutions to achieve business objectives. From strategy to technology to operations, and across workforce, risk, assurance, and tax, Deloitte helps drive value along the Finance Transformation journey.

Recruiting for this role ends on 12/01/2026

Work you'll do

As a Finance Data & AI Manager specializing in Snowflake, you'll lead teams that design end-to-end solutions from ingestion through trusted data products, AI, and reporting. You will connect finance outcomes to target architecture and guide delivery from strategy through production.

  • Lead engagements or workstreams that define end-to-end Snowflake architectures across integration, engineering, storage, security, semantic modeling, AI, and finance consumption
  • Guide batch and streaming pipeline design using SQL, Python, Snowpark, Snowpipe, dynamic tables, streams, tasks, and orchestration tools
  • Establish governance, lineage, access controls, data quality, observability, service-level objectives, and remediation patterns
  • Define reusable finance data products, canonical models, semantic views, APIs, and sharing for planning, close, profitability, treasury, and reporting
  • Architect production ML and generative and agentic AI with Cortex AI, MLOps and LLMOps, evaluation, monitoring, and responsible AI controls
  • Manage client relationships, estimates, design reviews, deployment, performance and cost outcomes; mentor teams and support demonstrations, proposals, and RFP responses
  • Agentic Redesign of Finance data and processes such as planning, forecasting, close, profitability, treasury, or reporting

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Ability to translate finance outcomes into clear architecture decisions
  • Effective written, verbal, and executive communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to mentor and provide clear guidance to others

The team

Deloitte's Finance Transformation offering helps finance and global business services leaders navigate an increasingly challenging environment marked by disruptive tech like AI, market uncertainty, and regulatory change, and recognize the opportunity to better serve the enterprise, shareholders, customers, and regulators.

Within the Finance Transformation offering, our Business Finance team drives strategic value through planning, forecasting, and analytics. We design trusted finance data products, modern platforms, and AI-enabled solutions that deliver timely, actionable insights.

Qualifications

Required:

  • 6+ years of experience architecting enterprise data, analytics, or AI solutions in a corporate or consulting environment
  • 4+ years of experience designing Snowflake solutions with SQL and Python across data engineering, security, performance, and multi-environment deployment
  • 4+ years of experience with finance data and processes such as planning, forecasting, close, profitability, treasury, or reporting
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Information Systems, Finance, Accounting, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field
  • Ability to travel 50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
  • Limited immigration sponsorship may be available.

Preferred:

  • Experience with Snowpark, Snowpipe, dynamic tables, streams and tasks, Cortex AI, semantic views, secure sharing, governance, and data quality
  • Experience with data observability, lineage, testing, CI/CD, infrastructure as code, and Snowflake cost/performance management
  • Experience deploying ML, retrieval-augmented generation, or agentic AI with evaluation, monitoring, and responsible AI controls
  • Experience integrating SAP, Oracle, Workday, Anaplan, or OneStream and delivering Power BI or Tableau semantic models and reporting
  • SnowPro certification or a master's degree in a related business or technical field
  • 2+ years of experience supporting pre-sales, proposals, RFP responses, and mentoring data and AI delivery teams

Job Description

Reports to the VP of Technology. Designs and builds Alto-Shaam's cloud data platform as a hands-on role: makes the design decisions for how data is modeled, secured, tested, promoted to production and delivered to the business, and then builds them. Alto-Shaam has aligned on a data platform consisting of Fivetran, Snowflake and Claude, and now seeks a qualified individual to own, deploy, and build out that platform. As the first dedicated data role on the platform, also handles day-to-day pipeline monitoring and data support, and helps shape how manufacturing execution systems, connected-equipment data and new applications fit together as the company expands.

The ideal candidate for a Data Architect would be able to do the following:

  1. Designs and builds the platform's data model, including dimensional models and conformed dimensions shared across finance, manufacturing, sales and service (customer, item, location, fiscal calendar).
  2. Documents design decisions as architecture decision records so the platform's design is written down and repeatable.
  3. Owns ingestion from Oracle Fusion Cloud, CRM, connected-equipment data and file-based feeds, including connector setup, monitoring and pipeline health.
  4. Designs role-based access and data security, dev/test/production environments, CI/CD and orchestration, and warehouse cost management.
  5. Puts data quality and governance in place early: data contracts and automated testing (for example, dbt tests), lineage, and master and reference data practices.
  6. Builds and extends the semantic layer that dashboards and AI tools query directly.
  7. Leads the migration of historical data from legacy business systems into the new platform, reconciling it with current ERP data and documenting legacy business rules and lineage.
  8. Translates business requirements into data models and presents design trade-offs to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  9. Partners with the integration team on how data moves between systems (Oracle Integration Cloud or similar) and helps design the data and integration approach for new manufacturing systems, connected-equipment data and future applications.
  10. Coaches colleagues who do part-time data work and sets the standards, documentation and onboarding materials for future team members.





Qualifications

For a candidate to be successful as a Data Architect they must have:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent experience, with 5–8 years (6+ preferred) in data engineering, analytics engineering or similar.
  • Demonstrated experience owning the design of a production data warehouse model spanning 3 or more source systems.
  • Expert SQL and strong Python; hands-on dimensional modeling (Kimball or similar) in production.
  • Production experience on a cloud data platform (Snowflake or similar, such as Databricks, Fabric or BigQuery) and with ELT and transformation tools (Fivetran, dbt or similar).
  • Experience with version control, CI/CD and automated data testing.
  • Oracle Fusion Cloud data experience (BICC and BI Publisher extracts, Fusion data structures, ideally Fusion Data Intelligence) or deep experience with another large ERP, and ERP finance or supply chain data modeling, is strongly preferred.
  • Manufacturing or MES data familiarity; semantic-layer tools (Snowflake semantic views, Cortex or similar); cloud services (AWS or similar) and integration platforms (Oracle Integration Cloud or similar); streaming, IoT or equipment telemetry data; cloud data platform certification (SnowPro Core or similar); and experience building data for AI and LLM consumers are desirable.
  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain technical trade-offs to non-technical leaders.

Additional Information

For more information about our benefits, job duties, and company values, go to

https://www.alto-shaam.com/en

National Interstate is a member of Great American Insurance Group. As one of the leading commercial transportation insurers in the nation, we offer risk financing solutions in all 50 states tailored to meet the needs of a wide variety of transportation classes. Our offerings include traditional insurance and innovative alternative risk transfer (ART) programs, including more than a dozen group captive programs catering to niche wheels markets. We are proud to be a multiple Northcoast 99 winner and Cleveland Plain Dealer Top Workplace in Northeast Ohio. It is because of our talented and dedicated team that we are able to live out our company values of integrity, transparency, fairness, accountability, empowerment and collaboration with each transaction we make. If you are ready to join an engaging and driven team such as ours, we would love to hear from you!

At Great American, we value and recognize the benefits derived when people with different backgrounds and experiences work together to achieve business results. Our goal is to create a workplace where all employees feel included, empowered, and enabled to perform at their best.

This position is not eligible for employment visa sponsorship. Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States without the need for current or future sponsorship.

Since 1989, National Interstate has specialized in serving the insurance needs of the wheels-based transportation industry. Our steadfast focus on developing niche expertise in product design, loss control and claim services has made National Interstate one of the most respected names in commercial transportation insurance today. (https://natl.com/)

National Interstate is looking for a Data Engineer to join their team. This individual will either work hybrid from the Richfield, OH office 3 days per week.

National Interstate’s culture is built on connection, shared learning, and strong relationships. To support this, employees in this role are expected to be on-site a minimum of three days a week, with the potential to work two days remotely. Core in‑office days are Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday but will be determined by business needs.

Essential Job Functions And Responsibilities

  • Defines and governs the enterprise data architecture, including conceptual, logical, and physical models, data flows, and integration strategies that support business objectives.
  • Leads the design and governance of data integration solutions and oversees the optimization of databases, data warehouses, and analytical environments to ensure performance, scalability, and resilience.
  • Establishes and enforces enterprise standards for data modeling, metadata, and governance, including policies and controls to ensure data quality, security, and regulatory compliance.
  • Conducts analysis to define requirements for data acquisition, access, and usage, enabling informed, data-driven decisions. Leads the development and of data governance policies and controls, ensuring data quality, security, and regulatory compliance.
  • Evaluates and recommends emerging data technologies and practices to enhance architecture and analytics capabilities.
  • Oversees the creation and maintenance of comprehensive documentation for data architecture, standards, and governance processes.
  • Collaborates with senior stakeholders across business and technology teams, influencing strategic initiatives and ensuring data architecture supports enterprise priorities.
  • Provides thought leadership through workshops, advisory sessions, and guidance on enterprise data architecture and strategy.
  • May have responsibility for performance and coaching of staff and may have a participatory role in decisions regarding talent selection, development, and performance management for direct reports.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

Job Requirements

Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in information technology, Computer Science or a related field.

Prefer: Informatica Cloud, Snowflake, ODS, ETO experience

Experience: Generally, a minimum of 14 years of experience in data architecture, data management, or a related field. Completion of or continuing progress toward a professional designation preferred, such as Certified Data Management Professional (CDMP) or AWS Certified Big Data – Specialty.

Scope of Job/Qualifications: Defines and leads the development of enterprise data architectures that align with organizational strategy, business objectives, and governance requirements. Demonstrated proficiency in data modeling, database design, SQL, ETL processes, and data integration tools. Experience with cloud data platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, Google Cloud). Solves highly technical and complex problems based on multiple projects and provides consultative support to internal staff. Works on multiple projects as a project leader or as a subject matter expert. Demonstrates the ability to analyze complex data requirements and design effective data solutions. Meticulous in ensuring data accuracy and integrity. Works on projects/issues of moderate to high complexity that requires in-depth knowledge across multiple technical areas and business segments. Performs work under limited supervision. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Excellent stakeholder engagement and communication skills, with the ability to influence at all levels. Ability to lead data architecture initiatives and mentor junior team members. Recognized as a subject matter expert across the organization.

Company

NIIC National Interstate Insurance Company

Benefits

We offer competitive benefits packages for full-time and part-time employees*. Full-time employees have access to medical, dental, and vision coverage, wellness plans, parental leave, adoption assistance, and tuition reimbursement. Full-time and eligible part-time employees also enjoy Paid Time Off and paid holidays, a 401(k) plan with company match, an employee stock purchase plan, and commuter benefits.

Compensation varies by role, level, and location and is influenced by skills, experience, and business needs. Your recruiter will provide details about benefits and specific compensation ranges during the hiring process. Learn more at http://www.gaig.com/careers.

  • Excludes seasonal employees and interns.

descriptionHtml:
Brief Description

About Us

At FreshDirect, we are reinventing the grocery experience.

Since day one, our mission has been simple: bring the best, freshest food directly from the farm to people’s homes — faster, fresher, and smarter than anyone else.

We’re not just a food company. We’re a technology-powered, customer-obsessed team building one of the most innovative end-to-end food supply chains in the industry. From proprietary routing systems to our state-of-the-art fulfillment center, every part of our business is designed to deliver unmatched quality, convenience, and care.

We partner directly with farmers, fishermen, and artisans to source the highest quality ingredients — then use smart data, automation, and logistics to deliver them at peak freshness.

It’s grocery shopping reimagined — and we’re just getting started.

If you’re passionate about innovation, care deeply about what people eat, and want to help build the future of food, we’d love to meet you.

The Role

GCP Cloud Data Architect with foundational experience in cloud data platforms and a strong interest in building expertise in BigQuery, AlloyDB, Data pipelines, and modern data processing tools.

In this role, you will support the development of scalable data solutions on GCP, assist with cloud migration initiatives, and contribute to building pipelines using technologies such as Dataflow, Dataproc, dbt and Cloud Composer. You will also gain exposure to data transformation frameworks like Dataform and AI/ML use cases.

As a Data Architect, you will help enable:

  • Advanced Supply Chain Intelligence: Support development of scalable pipelines using BigQuery, AlloyDB, Cloud Storage, Dataflow, Dataproc and Dbt for processing large-scale batch and streaming data used in inventory and forecasting.
  • Customer 360 & Personalization: Assist in integrating transactional and behavioral data using Pub/Sub and Dataflow and help prepare datasets for downstream analytics and personalization.
  • Real-time Operational Intelligence: Contribute to event-driven pipelines and workflow orchestration using Cloud Composer for operational reporting and KPI tracking.
  • Strategic Data Products: Help build and maintain data models and curated datasets that support analytics and reporting across business teams

This is a hands-on role designed to help you grow into a senior architect by working on real-world data challenges in a modern cloud environment.

What You’ll Do

  • Assist in designing and implementing data warehouse solutions on GCP using BigQuery, AlloyDB, Cloud Storage, Dataflow, Dbt and Dataproc
  • Support cloud migration activities, including data validation, testing, and pipeline development
  • Develop and optimize SQL queries for analytics and reporting
  • Build and maintain batch and streaming data pipelines using Dataflow and Pub/Sub
  • Support workflow orchestration and scheduling using Cloud Composer (Airflow)
  • Contribute to data transformation and modeling using Dataflow, Dataproc, Dataform , Dbt or similar tools
  • Assist in building and maintaining data models for analytics and reporting
  • Support data governance initiatives such as data quality checks, metadata tagging, and access controls
  • Assist with preparing datasets and pipelines for AI/ML use cases using Vertex AI
  • Collaborate with engineering, data, and product teams to understand and implement data requirements
  • Monitor and troubleshoot data pipelines to ensure reliability and performance

Document data processes, workflows, and architecture components.

What You’ll Bring

  • 2–5 years of experience in data engineering, data analytics, or cloud-based data platforms
  • Strong SQL skills and experience working with large datasets
  • Experience in GCP services such as BigQuery, AlloyDB, Dataflow, Dataproc, Cloud Storage, Dataform, Dbt or Pub/Sub
  • Exposure to Python or similar programming language
  • AI/GenAI for Data Engineering: Experience leveraging LLM-based tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, or Gemini to enhance productivity in GCP data engineering workflows—e.g., generating SQL/BigQuery queries, writing Dataflow or Dataproc pipelines, optimizing Dbt/Dataform transformations, automating documentation, troubleshooting data quality issues, and accelerating code development. Skilled in prompt engineering and validating AI-generated outputs for correctness, performance, and adherence to data governance and security standards
  • Familiarity with ETL/ELT processes and data pipeline development
  • Understanding of data modeling concepts (e.g., star schema, normalization, Dimensional Models)
  • Understanding of modern data architecture patterns, including Medallion Architecture (Bronze/Silver/Gold layers) and other data warehousing paradigms
  • Basic understanding of workflow orchestration tools (e.g., Airflow / Cloud Composer)
  • Interest in cloud data architecture and AI/ML technologies
  • Strong problem-solving skills and willingness to learn and ability to work in a fast-paced collaborative environment
  • Experience or exposure to eCommerce or retail data use cases (e.g., customer analytics, personalization, inventory, order or supply chain data)
  • GCP certification (Associate Cloud Engineer or Data Engineer).
  • Familiarity with BI tools such as Power BI or similar tools (e.g. looker)
  • Basic understanding of data governance, data quality, or metadata management
  • Exposure machine learning concepts or tools such as Vertex AI
  • Exposure to data quality tools, lineage tracking, or real-time observability stacks
  • Good communication and collaboration skills

Our Values at FreshDirect

We live these values every day:

A Passion for our customers

Our customers are at the heart of everything we do. We listen, innovate, and act quickly to exceed expectations with every order and interaction.

One team, one mission

Everyone contributes & every role matters. We break silos, lift each other up, and share a relentless focus on delivering results. That way, we win together.

Delivering excellence, every time

We take pride in the quality of our food, service, and the experience we create. Our team goes above and beyond to earn trust and guarantee 100% freshness.

Act with integrity

We operate with honesty, respect, and accountability in how we treat our customers, teammates, and partners. We own our outcomes and always do what’s right, even when no one is watching.

Make fast, bold decisions

We challenge the status quo, embrace technology, and take smart risks to build a better future. At the same time, we stay true to our NYC roots and care for our community.

We love food. Yes, literally all of us.

What You’ll Love About Working Her

  • A fast-paced, innovative environment where ideas turn into action
  • Opportunities for growth — many of our leaders have risen through the ranks
  • Direct impact on how thousands of customers experience food every day

Salary

$122,000.00 – $155,000.00

Total Rewards & Benefits

  • Competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits
  • PTO, Safe & Sick Time, and Paid Holidays
  • Medical, Vision, Dental, and Voluntary Disability coverage
  • 401(k) with employer match and Life Insurance
  • State-of-the-art Bronx campus with on-site basketball court, cafeteria, and employee market
  • Onsite FREE parking
  • FREE employee shuttle bus service from nearby Subway station
  • Training, leadership development, and tuition discount at local colleges
  • 20% employee discount on FreshDirect online orders and Brooklyn wine store
  • Minimum 50% employee discount at our onsite employee market
  • Mobile phone discounts through partnerships with T-Mobile and Verizon
  • Gym membership discounts through NYSC

Our Culture

We embrace an in-office culture, composed of individuals who thrive on the collaboration and energy that comes from working together in a shared space. We are looking for people who excel in this environment, where physical presence enhances connections and engagement. At FreshDirect, we've created an environment that thrives on teamwork, where associates can innovate, grow, and have successful careers. Many of our leaders have successfully come up through our ranks. Because of our team's extraordinary efforts, we are a leading innovator in the e-commerce and grocery industries.

Equal Opportunity

We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. Fresh Direct, LLC and its affiliates do not discriminate against applicants or employees because of their race, color, citizenship status, national origin, ancestry, gender, disability, sexual orientation, age, religion, creed, marital status, veteran status, domestic violence victim status, political affiliation, or any other factor protected by federal, state, or local law.

The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by the Team member(s) assigned to this position. They are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, and skills required of individuals in this position. Position expectations may be subject to change as the needs of the organization changes.

*Open to Remote/Hybrid Candidates*

The Senior Principal Enterprise Data Architect – AI Data Transformation will serve as a strategic partner and governance leader within the Enterprise Architecture (EA) team of our global enterprise. This role combines advanced enterprise data architecture discipline with deep expertise in Artificial Intelligence infrastructure and Data Science enablement to plan, design, deploy, and execute technology solutions aligned to the organization's strategic roadmap.

The incumbent will be instrumental in operationalizing complex initiatives by significantly enhancing, evolving, and optimizing the enterprise data layer to make every data asset—across our global operations, supply chain, customer touchpoints, and connected products—AI-ready, AI-consumable, and AI-trustworthy. This role will champion EA and AI data governance frameworks, drive Hoshin goal attainment, and serve as a key liaison between IT, business operations, product engineering, data science teams, and the EA team to ensure technology investments are aligned to enterprise standards and strategic AI objectives.

Position

Senior Principal Enterprise Data Architect, AI Data Transformation

Location

USA, Louisville, KYOther AL US, Other CT US, Other DC US, Other DE US, Other FL US, Other GA US, Other IL US, Other IN US, Other NC US, Other NE US, Other NH US, Other NJ US, Other NY US, Other OH US

How You'll Create Possibilities

AI Data Layer Enhancement & Transformation (40%)

  • Lead the architectural enhancement and evolution of the enterprise data layer, applying AI-first design principles to unify data across the enterprise value chain (R&D, supply chain, operations, and customer experience).
  • Define, publish, and maintain the Enterprise AI Data Architecture Blueprint—the authoritative reference governing how data flows from source systems (e.g. ERP, CRM, PLM, IoT platforms) through transformation layers to AI models and business outcomes.
  • Design and operationalize an Enterprise AI Data Readiness Framework that continuously assesses, scores, and improves data assets across five core dimensions: Completeness, Consistency, Timeliness, Representativeness, and Fairness.
  • Architect and deploy enterprise-grade vector database infrastructure and build enterprise embedding pipelines that transform structured records, enterprise documents, product manuals, and operational logs into high-quality vector representations.
  • Define the complete data architecture for Large Language Model (LLM) integration, including Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architecture to support enterprise copilots, customer service, and operational workflows.
  • Design ultra-low latency data serving architectures and event-driven AI data pipelines that feed live AI models in production (e.g., real-time operational analytics, predictive maintenance, and customer insights).
  • Establish an enterprise Synthetic Data Generation capability to augment scarce datasets, generate privacy-safe alternatives to sensitive data, and simulate operational edge cases.


Enterprise Architecture Strategy & Governance (35%)

  • Serve as a strategic partner and governance leader within the EA team, applying and evolving enterprise architecture frameworks (TOGAF, Zachman) with AI-era extensions tailored for a large-scale, complex enterprise environment.
  • Architect modern cloud data warehouse and Lakehouse solutions (e.g. BigQuery) as the unified, ACID-compliant foundation for both analytical and AI/ML workloads on a single governed storage layer.
  • Define and enforce data contracts between data producers (e.g., business operations, product engineering) and AI consumers across all domains to ensure schema, quality, freshness, and semantic consistency.
  • Lead Master Data Management (MDM) strategy with AI entity resolution, enrichment, and disambiguation capabilities embedded in the MDM layer (covering Product, Material, Supplier, and Customer domains).
  • Govern metadata management, data cataloging, and data lineage (e.g. Collibra) and design semantic/context data layers/Knowledge Graph infrastructure to map complex relationships between enterprise assets, suppliers, and business processes.
  • Facilitate Architecture Review Board (ARB) processes for data and AI initiatives, ensuring alignment between project delivery and architectural intent.
  • Align all data architecture decisions with regulatory and compliance requirements without compromising AI agility.


Data Science Enablement & Stakeholder Engagement (15%)

  • Apply statistical expertise to validate data representativeness, distributions, class balance, and sampling strategies for AI training datasets (e.g., ensuring datasets accurately represent real-world operational realities).
  • Serve as a trusted advisor and primary point of contact for business and IT stakeholders on AI data-governed initiatives.
  • Build and maintain effective working relationships at all levels of DT Staff, Extended DT Staff, and business leadership.
  • Proactively identify risks, issues, dependencies, and bottlenecks; implement mitigation strategies to keep teams moving forward.
  • Partner with functional/business teams, DT teams, and other team members to solve problems collaboratively and deliver project objectives.


Data Engineering Oversight & Standards (10%)

  • Provide architectural oversight and define enterprise standards for AI/ML-optimized data pipelines, guiding data engineering delivery teams from raw ingestion through feature engineering.
  • Define the architecture and integration patterns for the Enterprise Feature Store as the central hub of reusable, versioned ML features.
  • Establish DataOps and pipeline governance frameworks, guiding delivery teams on best practices for CI/CD, automated data quality testing gates, and infrastructure-as-code.
  • Define architectural patterns for streaming and event-driven technologies to support high-velocity enterprise and IoT telemetry data.
  • Elicit detailed business and architecture requirements, translating them into clear architectural guidelines and actionable work items for data engineering teams.


What You'll Bring to Our Team

Education:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Information Systems, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related technical field required.
  • Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, or a related field strongly preferred.


Experience and Qualifications:

  • 15+ years of progressive experience in data-related roles, with a minimum of 5 years in Enterprise Data Architecture at enterprise scale.
  • 3+ years of experience designing and architecting AI/ML data infrastructure (feature stores, vector databases, model serving layers, semantic layers).
  • Proven track record of leading enterprise data transformation programs with measurable AI and ML outcomes delivered in production environments.
  • Enterprise Industry Experience: Prior experience architecting data solutions involving complex supply chains, ERP (SAP/Oracle), PLM, or large-scale IoT/telemetry is preferred.
  • Excellent oral and written presentation Skills
  • Works independently with limited supervision and operates autonomously
  • Working knowledge of enterprise architecture frameworks (e.g., TOGAF, Zachman)


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working in both Agile and Waterfall delivery environments
  • Project Management Professional (PMP) certification preferred
  • TOGAF or other EA framework certification preferred


Our Culture

Our work is centered on our People and Culture as reflected in our Zero Distance philosophy and we recognize the importance of reaffirming our commitment to inclusion and diversity (I&D). This underscores our commitment to fostering an environment where every individual feels valued, connected, and empowered to contribute, while positioning our organization to adapt seamlessly to the evolving needs of our workforce and communities.

This reflects our dedication to creating solutions that: Empower colleagues by fostering an environment where all voices are heard, valued, and encouraged to contribute. Strengthen communities where we live and work. Reinforce a culture of belonging, purpose, and engagement. Reflect the diversity of the communities we serve through our workforce, products, and practices.

By further embedding Zero Distance into our People and Culture framework, we will continue to build a deeply connected organization. We are cultivating a culture of engagement, belonging, and connection, because while attracting new talent remains a priority, retention is a cornerstone of our strategy.

TITLE: Sr. ERP Enterprise Data Architect

Direct Hire

No Sponsorship

Hybrid - Ft. Worth, Texas


Our client is investing significantly in the modernization of its enterprise data ecosystem and is seeking a Sr. ERP Enterprise Data Architect to help shape that transformation. The successful candidate will have broad influence over how enterprise data is architected, governed, secured, integrated, and consumed across the organization. The ideal candidate understands big-picture strategy and has technical depth to remain close to the technology.


Requirements:

  • 7–10+ years of progressive technology experience with approximately 3–5+ years in data architecture, enterprise architecture or senior-level data engineering.
  • ERP implementation experience combined with data architecture and integration.
  • Strong experience designing enterprise-scale data architectures within AWS.
  • Deep knowledge of data modeling, schema design, data lineage, governance and enterprise data-management principles.
  • Hands-on architectural experience with AWS technologies such as Redshift, Glue, DynamoDB, S3, Lambda, EMR and Lake Formation.
  • Strong understanding of modern data lake, data warehouse and cloud data-platform architecture.
  • Comfortable at both defining the enterprise strategy and technical architecture levels.
  • Experience designing scalable data integration and pipeline patterns.
  • Understanding of real-time, batch and event-driven data architectures.
  • Ability to architect for data security, access control, encryption, governance and regulatory requirements.
  • Experience collaborating across data engineering, application development, cybersecurity, integration and cloud infrastructure teams.
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear architectural direction for both technical and business stakeholders.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence technology decisions across teams without relying solely on direct authority.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering or a related discipline, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience.

Responsibilities:

  • Own and evolve conceptual, logical and physical enterprise data models across core business domains.
  • Lead architecture for AWS-based enterprise data platforms utilizing technologies such as AWS Glue, Redshift, Lambda, EMR, Lake Formation, DynamoDB and S3.
  • Establish enterprise data architecture standards, taxonomy, naming conventions, governance practices, retention policies and data-lineage frameworks.
  • Define scalable architecture patterns supporting analytical, operational and integration workloads.
  • Partner with cybersecurity teams to establish appropriate identity, access control, audit logging and encryption strategies across data platforms.
  • Design architectural patterns supporting real-time, batch and event-driven integrations utilizing technologies such as Kinesis, Kafka and EventBridge.
  • Guide the architecture of enterprise analytical ecosystems supporting business intelligence, machine learning, advanced analytics and reporting.
  • Partner with platform engineering teams on infrastructure automation, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), CI/CD and data-pipeline observability.
  • Collaborate with application and integration teams to improve data consistency and interoperability across enterprise systems.
  • Lead architecture reviews and provide technical direction for large-scale programs and strategic data initiatives.
  • Evaluate emerging AWS data and analytics technologies and make recommendations regarding adoption and implementation.
  • Mentor data architects and engineers while helping mature the organization's enterprise data architecture capabilities.

Particularly Valuable Experience

Experience in several of the following areas would be highly desirable but not a hard requirement:

  • AWS Step Functions and/or Apache Airflow
  • Kafka, Kinesis or other event-streaming technologies
  • Hybrid cloud/on-premise data connectivity
  • Machine learning and advanced analytics data environments
  • Infrastructure as Code and automated cloud deployment
  • Building or maturing enterprise data architecture standards and practices
  • AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Professional or AWS data/analytics credentials

Comprehensive Benefits Provided

About the role:

We are seeking a senior leader to drive the vision, architecture, and delivery of the client's next-generation Enterprise Data, Analytics, and AI ecosystem. The ideal candidate will blend strategic consulting, enterprise architecture, data platform engineering, and AI solution delivery expertise to establish a scalable, business-aligned data and AI foundation.

This leader will be responsible for defining and implementing the enterprise Data & AI strategy, designing and standing up modern data platforms, enabling domain-oriented Data Products using Data Mesh principles, establishing semantic layers, and accelerating business value through advanced analytics and AI use cases.

The candidate should possess deep expertise in the GCP ecosystem, experience with Databricks Lakehouse and Palantir, and a strong understanding of EPC business processes and operational data domains.


What you will do at Sogeti:

Enterprise Data, Analytics & AI Strategy

  • Define Enterprise Data, Analytics, and AI Strategy aligned with business objectives.
  • Develop multi-year Data & AI roadmaps, platform modernization strategies, and governance frameworks.
  • Define operating models for enterprise-scale Data Products and AI Products.
  • Establish business-case-driven investment strategies and value realization frameworks.
  • Collaborate with business leaders to identify and prioritize high-value analytics and AI opportunities.


Data Platform Architecture

  • Architect and implement enterprise-scale modern data platforms on Google Cloud.
  • Define enterprise data architecture standards, reference architectures, and integration patterns.
  • Lead platform modernization initiatives spanning cloud, analytics, AI, governance, and metadata management.
  • Design scalable architectures supporting structured, unstructured, and operational workloads.


Data Mesh & Data Products

descriptionHtml:
The Cloud Data Architect is a senior member of the BI & Analytics team and will be responsible for architecting, designing, and governing enterprise-scale cloud data platforms, including cloud data lakes and cloud data warehouses, to support reporting, analytics, and advanced data use cases.

This role will lead the data architecture strategy for the organization’s analytics modernization journey, defining scalable, secure, and high‑performance cloud data solutions.

The Cloud Data Architect will partner closely with IT leadership, business stakeholders, and analytics teams to enable a standardized, best‑in‑class analytics ecosystem across all TAH entities. This role requires strong experience with cloud-native data architecture, data modeling, and large-scale analytics platforms. Experience with Azure and Databricks is strongly preferred, though candidates with comparable experience on other cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Snowflake, etc.) will be considered.


Job Details/Responsibilities

Define and Own Enterprise Cloud Data Architecture and Strategy for Analytics

  • Own and lead enterprise cloud data architecture across BI/EDW, analytics, and AI/ML, including Databricks Lakehouse, Delta Lake, and Medallion patterns for all data types.
  • Set architectural standards and drive delivery end‑to‑end—from design through production—through reviews, documentation, and informed technical decision‑making.

Lead Analytics Modernization and Legacy EDW Migration

  • Define target-state architectures and phased migration strategies using Databricks, Lakehouse, and cloud data warehouse pattern
  • Provide architectural leadership for migration and modernization, including data refactoring, integration patterns, and adoption of cloud‑native capabilities with strong security and performance controls.
  • Partner with business and analytics stakeholders to manage risk and ensure migrated solutions meet reporting, analytics, and long‑term enterprise standards.

Architect and Govern the Enterprise Data Platform

  • Provide architectural leadership for engineering, operations, and production support, including Databricks platform administration, CI/CD automation, performance optimization, cost management, and adherence to SLAs.

Establish Data Governance, Security, and Platform Standards

  • Ensure strong data governance and analytics enablement, enforcing security, quality, and compliance standards while enabling self‑service analytics through trusted data products, documentation, and stakeholder collaboration

Provide Technical Leadership and Architectural Guidance

  • Lead and provide day‑to‑day technical direction, task prioritization and architectural guidance to a small team of data engineers, including internal shared‑services resources and vendor partners, to deliver enterprise cloud data platforms and analytics solutions.

Enable Advanced Analytics and AI/ML Capabilities

  • Continuously assess and integrate evolving Azure, Databricks, Machine Learning, and AI capabilities into the enterprise roadmap where they deliver measurable business value.
  • Support responsible adoption of next‑generation AI approaches by enabling secure, governed access to enterprise data and strengthening metadata, lineage, and traceability foundations.

Incumbent must follow all established Environmental Health & Safety and Quality System policies, programs, rules and practices, including but not limited to product and patient safety, the health and safety of all associates as well as the environment and community at large.


Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

  • Strong expertise in cloud data architecture, including Lakehouse and cloud data warehouse patterns, supporting BI/EDW, analytics, and AI/ML workloads
  • Hands-on experience with Azure Databricks and Delta Lake (Medallion architecture)
  • Advanced proficiency in SQL, Python, PySpark, and Spark SQL
  • Experience designing enterprise-scale batch and real-time data solutions
  • Strong understanding of data governance, security, compliance, and data quality
  • Proven ability to lead design discussions, conduct architectural reviews, and guide teams on technical decisions and tradeoffs
  • Strong analytical and communication skills, translating business needs into scalable architectures
  • Experience supporting analytics and BI consumption patterns
  • Familiarity with SAP ERP analytics integration (S/4HANA or ECC), including source system processes and analytical data extraction, is a strong asset
  • Experience with BI and visualization tools such as Power BI or Tableau is a plus
  • Strong ability to operate in a fast‑paced, evolving environment, balancing priorities while maintaining architectural rigor
  • Keen sense of maturity, judgment and diligence required to:
  1. Secure company’s financial interests
  2. Avoid exposures to expensive delays and cost overruns
  3. Ability to cope with stress and continuously changing demands/priorities
  4. Willingness to learn new skills/techniques/processes


Qualifications/Background Experiences

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related fields, or combination of equivalent experience
  • 10 years of experience designing and delivering enterprise data and analytics platforms
  • Proven experience architecting cloud-based data platforms, including Lakehouse and cloud data warehouse solutions
  • Experience with modern cloud data platforms such as Azure Databricks
  • Strong experience with Azure data services (experience with Microsoft Fabric is a plus)
  • Demonstrated experience modernizing or migrating legacy Enterprise Data Warehouses to cloud platforms
  • Experience supporting analytics and reporting for ERP systems (SAP preferred; Oracle, JD Edwards, or similar acceptable)
  • Track record of delivering large, complex BI and analytics initiatives at enterprise scale
  • Experience in the medical devices, life sciences, or pharmaceutical industries is a strong plus

This role involves creating solutions that deliver significant and lasting business improvements for clients.

From its founding in 1777 as California's first city, San José has been a leader driven by its spirit of innovation. Today, San José stands as the largest city in Northern California and the Capital of Silicon Valley—the world's leading center of technology innovation.  San José is the 13th largest in the U.S., and is committed to remaining a top-ranked place to do business, work, live, play and learn.

San José is located in Santa Clara County at the southern edge of the San Francisco Bay, about 50 miles south of San Francisco, 390 miles north of Los Angeles. The local weather is hard to beat with moderate year-round temperatures. Residents enjoy 300 days of sunshine each year and an average annual temperature of 70 degrees.

The City of San José operates under the council-manager form of government, a system that combines the policy leadership of elected officials in the form of a city council, with the managerial expertise of an appointed city manager.

About The Department

The City of San José innovates to provide exceptional civic services using advanced technologies to help our community thrive.

As one of the largest cities in the nation, the City manages a large set of services and assets and operates on a budget of $5.9 billion, with approximately 7,000 employees, serving about 1 million residents and 80,000 businesses in the heart of Silicon Valley.

The Information Technology Department’s (ITD) mission is to enrich the quality of life in San José through innovation, collaboration, and engagement. ITD enables that mission through business and infrastructure systems, cybersecurity, data management and analysis, responsible use of Artificial Intelligence (AI), productivity and collaboration tools, the San José 311 resident experience platform, data equity and privacy programs, and strategic planning. San José is powered by truly great people, a robust technology environment, and a strong sense of purpose.

The IT department is a leader in innovation, embracing cutting-edge technologies and pioneering solutions to enhance efficiency and quality of life in San José. As part of this effort, the City leads a national initiative for AI through the GovAI Coalition, which was established to give local governments a voice in shaping the future of AI, ensuring it is developed responsibly and for the public good.

Promoting the City’s commitment to equity and inclusion, we believe that all members of the community, regardless of background, have access to the tools and resources needed to thrive in the digital age. San José is in the heart of Silicon Valley, which boasts a rich history in technology, education, and agriculture. Over half of San José residents speak a language other than English at home, highlighting the importance of language accessibility in all City services. By fostering inclusivity, promoting digital literacy, and building accessible platforms, we are advancing technology while creating a more equitable future for everyone.

At the City of San José, we promote work-life alignment and a focus on growth to bring out the best in our people. Come join us in making San José the most vibrant, equitable, sustainable, and innovative city in the nation! Visit the Information Technology Department’s website to learn about our culture, vision, leadership, and innovative initiatives.

The Information Technology Department is seeking an experienced and collaborative Data Architect to lead the City's enterprise data infrastructure initiatives. This is a senior technical leadership role that combines deep expertise in data architecture with the ability to manage and develop a small team of technical professionals. This position will report directly to the Enterprise Data Governance Lead in the Information Technology Department (ITD).

We are seeking an individual with a willingness to adapt to an ever-changing business environment as well as an ever-changing technical environment. The ideal candidate combines hands-on technical skills with people management experience and can design sophisticated data solutions and explain their value clearly to technical and non-technical audiences. The ideal candidate must also influence strategic decisions and take full ownership of projects through completion. This includes staying current on industry trends and standards and integrating them with the organization’s existing IT best practices for operations and security. A team leader, team player, and positive attitude are essential to this position.

Key responsibilities include but not limited to the following:

  • Lead the design, development, and implementation of enterprise data architecture including cloud-based data lakes, on-premises data warehouses, and analytics platforms across multiple departments and stakeholders.
  • Provide technical guidance and hands-on support for the team’s on-premises SQL environment including database design, query optimization, performance tuning, and data modeling across both on-premises and cloud platforms.
  • Develop and maintain enterprise ETL frameworks, data integration patterns, and reusable pipeline components that ensure consistency and scalability across projects.
  • Provide technical direction to the team on Power BI and Tableau report and dashboard development including data modeling best practices, performance optimization, and visualization standards.
  • Lead the expansion and governance of the City’s Data Catalog and provide technical direction on data governance, security, and access management practices across enterprise data environments.
  • Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend solutions that align with the City’s data modernization efforts and enterprise architecture standards.
  • Collaborate with departments across the City, manage competing priorities and dependencies, and proactively communicate risks to ensure sustained stakeholder engagement and successful project delivery.
  • Communicate technical concepts clearly to a broad range of audiences and represent the data and analytics team in cross-departmental working groups, governance forums, and citywide technology initiatives.
  • Directly manage a team of technical staff providing day-to-day oversight, performance management, professional development guidance, and growth opportunities through delegation, cross-training, and mentoring.
  • Foster a collaborative and inclusive team environment where all team members are engaged, valued, and contribute to their full potential.



Please note that the Data Architect position is eligible for a hybrid telework schedule, which is subject to change. The City is currently on a 32-hour onsite workweek.

Salary Information: The final candidate’s qualifications and experience shall determine the actual salary. In addition to the starting salary, employees in the Enterprise Principal Technology Analyst classification shall also receive an approximate five percent (5%) ongoing non-pensionable compensation pay.

  • Salary Range (including the 5% NPWI): $167,927.76-$204,487.92.



The EPTA classification is represented by the City Association of Management Personnel (CAMP) bargaining unit.

This position requires a disclosure of outside investments, real property interest, income, and business positions. You must complete and file an “Assuming Office Form 700” with the City Clerk’s Office within the first 30 days of employment with the office.

Minimum Qualifications

Education and Experience: A Bachelor’s Degree from an accredited college or university in a relevant field AND five (5) years of increasingly responsible professional/ level experience in computer applications, systems, networks, or telecommunications work, of which at least two (2) years include responsibility in the development, implementation, and maintenance of electronic business systems/solutions, or application development and/or support.

Acceptable Substitution:

  • Additional years of increasingly responsible directly related work experience may be substituted for education on a year-for-year basis up to two (2) years.
  • Completion of a Master's Degree in a relevant field from an accredited college or university may be substituted for one year of the required two (2) year of experience in the development, implementation, and maintenance of electronic business systems/solutions, or application development and/or support.



Competencies:

The ideal candidates will possess the following competencies, as demonstrated in past and current employment history.

Job Expertise – Demonstrates knowledge of and experience with applicable professional/technical principles and practices, Citywide and departmental procedures/policies and federal and state rules and regulations.

Problem Solving – Approaches a situation or problem by defining the problem or issue; determines the significance of problem; collects information; uses logic and intuition to arrive at decisions or solutions to problems that achieve the desired outcome

Conflict Management – Uses appropriate interpersonal styles and methods to reduce tension or conflict between two or more people, by presenting the facts, analysis, and conclusions or solutions that show command of content and perspectives and interests of the audience.

Project Management – Ensures support for projects and implements agency goals and strategic objectives.

Analytical Thinking – Approaches a problem or situation by using a logical, systematic, sequential approach.

Supervision – Sets effective long and short-term goals based on a good understanding of management practices; establishes realistic priorities within available resources; provides motivational support; empowers others; assigns decision-making and work functions to others in an appropriate manner to maximize organizational and individual effectiveness

Communication Skills – Effectively conveys information and expresses thoughts and facts clearly, orally and in writing; demonstrates effective use of listening skills; displays openness to other people's ideas and thoughts.

Other Qualifications

Selection Process:

The selection process will consist of an evaluation of the applicant's training and experience based on the application and responses to all the job specific questions. Only those candidates whose backgrounds best match the position will be invited to proceed in the selection process. Additional phases of the selection process will consist of one or more interviews.

If you have questions about the duties of these positions, the selection or hiring processes, please contact Felipa Perez at Felipa.perez@sanjoseca.gov.

Additional Information:

Employment Eligibility: Federal law requires all employees to provide verification of their eligibility to work in this country. Please be informed that the City of San Jose will NOT sponsor, represent or sign any documents related to visa applications/transfers for H1-B or any other type of visa which requires an employer application.

You must answer all job-specific questions to be considered for this vacancy or your application will be deemed incomplete and withheld from further consideration. Applicants are expected to write their own essays/responses.

Please note that applications are currently not accepted through CalOpps or any other third party job board application system.

This recruitment may be used to fill multiple positions in this, or other divisions or departments. If you are interested in employment in this classification, you should apply to ensure you are considered for additional opportunities that may utilize the applicants from this recruitment.

Please allow adequate time to complete the application and submit before the deadline or the system may not save your application. If your online application was successfully submitted, you will receive an automatic confirmation email to the email address you provided. IF YOU DO NOT RECEIVE THE CONFIRMATION, please email CityCareers@sanjoseca.gov and we will research the status of your application.

AI and the Hiring Process

We recognize that Artificial Intelligence (AI) is becoming part of daily life and can be a valuable tool for learning, research, and professional growth. We encourage candidates to use AI responsibly as a support in preparing application materials, live assessments, and interviews. However, we value authenticity, accuracy and truthfulness. Application responses and interview answers must reflect your own knowledge, skills, and experiences. While AI can supplement preparation, it cannot replace the originality and judgment we look for in our employees. This ensures fairness, transparency, and equity for all applicants in the hiring process.

A team leader, team player, and positive attitude are essential to this position.

Key responsibilities include but not limited to the following:



- Lead the design, development, and implementation of enterprise data architecture including cloud-based data lakes, on-premises data warehouses, and analytics platforms across multiple departments and stakeholders. 
- Provide technical guidance and hands-on support for the team’s on-premises SQL environment including database design, query optimization, performance tuning, and data modeling across both on-premises and cloud platforms. 
- Develop and maintain enterprise ETL frameworks, data integration patterns, and reusable pipeline components that ensure consistency and scalability across projects. 
- Provide technical direction to the team on Power BI and Tableau report and dashboard development including data modeling best practices, performance optimization, and visualization standards. 
- Lead the expansion and governance of the City’s Data Catalog and provide technical direction on data governance, security, and access management practices across enterprise data environments. 
- Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend solutions that align with the City’s data modernization efforts and enterprise architecture standards. 
- Collaborate with departments across the City, manage competing priorities and dependencies, and proactively communicate risks to ensure sustained stakeholder engagement and successful project delivery. 
- Communicate technical concepts clearly to a broad range of audiences and represent the data and analytics team in cross-departmental working groups, governance forums, and citywide technology initiatives. 
- Directly manage a team of technical staff providing day-to-day oversight, performance management, professional development guidance, and growth opportunities through delegation, cross-training, and mentoring. 
- Foster a collaborative and inclusive team environment where all team members are engaged, valued, and contribute to their full potential.  


Please note that the Data Architect position is eligible for a hybrid telework schedule, which is subject to change. The City is currently on a 32-hour onsite workweek.

Salary Information: The final candidate’s qualifications and experience shall determine the actual salary. In addition to the starting salary, employees in the Enterprise Principal Technology Analyst classification shall also receive an approximate five percent (5%) ongoing non-pensionable compensation pay.



- Salary Range (including the 5% NPWI): $167,927.76-$204,487.92.  


The EPTA classification is represented by the City Association of Management Personnel (CAMP) bargaining unit.

This position requires a disclosure of outside investments, real property interest, income, and business positions. You must complete and file an “Assuming Office Form 700” with the City Clerk’s Office within the first 30 days of employment with the office.

Minimum Qualifications

Education and Experience: A Bachelor’s Degree from an accredited college or university in a relevant field AND five (5) years of increasingly responsible professional/ level experience in computer applications, systems, networks, or telecommunications work, of which at least two (2) years include responsibility in the development, implementation, and maintenance of electronic business systems/solutions, or application development and/or support.

Acceptable Substitution: 



- Additional years of increasingly responsible directly related work experience may be substituted for education on a year-for-year basis up to two (2) years. 
- Completion of a Master's Degree in a relevant field from an accredited college or university may be substituted for one year of the required two (2) year of experience in the development, implementation, and maintenance of electronic business systems/solutions, or application development and/or support.  


Competencies:

The ideal candidates will possess the following competencies, as demonstrated in past and current employment history.

Job Expertise – Demonstrates knowledge of and experience with applicable professional/technical principles and practices, Citywide and departmental procedures/policies and federal and state rules and regulations.

Problem Solving – Approaches a situation or problem by defining the problem or issue; determines the significance of problem; collects information; uses logic and intuition to arrive at decisions or solutions to problems that achieve the desired outcome

Conflict Management – Uses appropriate interpersonal styles and methods to reduce tension or conflict between two or more people, by presenting the facts, analysis, and conclusions or solutions that show command of content and perspectives and interests of the audience.

Project Management – Ensures support for projects and implements agency goals and strategic objectives.

Analytical Thinking – Approaches a problem or situation by using a logical, systematic, sequential approach.

Supervision – Sets effective long and short-term goals based on a good understanding of management practices; establishes realistic priorities within available resources; provides motivational support; empowers others; assigns decision-making and work functions to others in an appropriate manner to maximize organizational and individual effectiveness

Communication Skills – Effectively conveys information and expresses thoughts and facts clearly, orally and in writing; demonstrates effective use of listening skills; displays openness to other people's ideas and thoughts.

Other Qualifications

Selection Process: 

The selection process will consist of an evaluation of the applicant's training and experience based on the application and responses to all the job specific questions. Only those candidates whose backgrounds best match the position will be invited to proceed in the selection process. Additional phases of the selection process will consist of one or more interviews.

If you have questions about the duties of these positions, the selection or hiring processes, please contact Felipa Perez at Felipa.perez@sanjoseca.gov.

Additional Information:

Employment Eligibility: Federal law requires all employees to provide verification of their eligibility to work in this country. Please be informed that the City of San Jose will NOT sponsor, represent or sign any documents related to visa applications/transfers for H1-B or any other type of visa which requires an employer application.

You must answer all job-specific questions to be considered for this vacancy or your application will be deemed incomplete and withheld from further consideration. Applicants are expected to write their own essays/responses.

Please note that applications are currently not accepted through CalOpps or any other third party job board application system.

This recruitment may be used to fill multiple positions in this, or other divisions or departments. If you are interested in employment in this classification, you should apply to ensure you are considered for additional opportunities that may utilize the applicants from this recruitment.

Please allow adequate time to complete the application and submit before the deadline or the system may not save your application. If your online application was successfully submitted, you will receive an automatic confirmation email to the email address you provided. IF YOU DO NOT RECEIVE THE CONFIRMATION, please email CityCareers@sanjoseca.gov and we will research the status of your application.

We recognize that Artificial Intelligence (AI) is becoming part of daily life and can be a valuable tool for learning, research, and professional growth. We encourage candidates to use AI responsibly as a support in preparing application materials, live assessments, and interviews. However, we value authenticity, accuracy and truthfulness. Application responses and interview answers must reflect your own knowledge, skills, and experiences. While AI can supplement preparation, it cannot replace the originality and judgment we look for in our employees. This ensures fairness, transparency, and equity for all applicants in the hiring process.
