Job Description

As a Data Solutions Architect, you will lead the design of secure, reliable, and cost-conscious data and analytics solutions for clients. You will translate business goals and existing system constraints into target architectures, guide engineering teams through implementation while remaining hands-on in the development, and explain technical decisions and tradeoffs to client stakeholders. Your work will span data integration, storage, modeling, governance, and analytics across modern data platforms in Azure.

Key Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with clients and internal stakeholders to design and implement scalable data engineering solutions using the Microsoft Analytics ecosystem.
  • Lead discovery, select architecture patterns, document tradeoffs, guide implementations, and is accountable for the overall technical design.
  • Deliver current-state assessments, target architectures, integration patterns, data models, migration plans, estimates, and technical decision records.
  • Develop and maintain data pipelines, ensuring efficient extraction, transformation, and loading (ETL) processes for structured and unstructured data.
  • Apply best practices in dimensional modeling to create robust and scalable data models for analytics and reporting.
  • Leverage tools such as Python, dbt, and SQL to develop advanced data transformation and integration processes.
  • Optimize data storage and retrieval mechanisms to support high-performance analytics workloads.
  • Define approaches for access, sensitive data, data quality, lineage, deployment, monitoring, recovery, and capacity or cost.
  • Define hybrid analytics requirements, including connectivity and security, in partnership with cloud and security specialists.
  • Monitor and troubleshoot data pipelines and workflows to ensure accuracy, reliability, and performance.
  • Collaborate with analytics and BI teams to ensure seamless integration of data assets into Power BI and other reporting platforms.
  • Stay informed about emerging trends and technologies in data engineering and cloud analytics to enhance solution delivery.

Required Qualifications

  • At least 10 years of experience in data engineering, with deep expertise in the Microsoft Data and Analytics stack.
  • Multiple years of experience leading discovery, evaluating design tradeoffs, presenting recommendations, and guiding a delivery team.
  • Strong proficiency in SQL, Python, and data modeling techniques.
  • Working knowledge of data extraction patterns and best practices.
  • Experience with ETL tools and frameworks, such as dbt.
  • Solid understanding of dimensional modeling and its application in analytics.
  • Strong problem-solving skills with a focus on delivering scalable and efficient solutions.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with experience in client-facing roles.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Azure Cloud infrastructure, including hybrid analytics workload configurations and networking.
  • Certifications in Azure Engineering and Administration (e.g., Fabric Data Engineer Associate, Azure Administrator Associate, Azure Solutions Architect Expert).
  • Experience with Azure DevOps or GitHub for code repositories and deployment.
  • Experience with data vault modeling and data mesh architecture concepts preferred.
  • Familiarity with advanced analytics tools and concepts, including machine learning workflows.
  • Experience using approved AI-assisted development tools responsibly preferred.
  • Knowledge of additional data visualization tools such as Tableau, Qlik, or AWS Quicksight.
  • Experience with Agile methodologies for project management.

The pay range for this position is $100,000 to $182,400. This range represents a good-faith and reasonable estimate of the compensation the firm expects to pay for this position at the time of posting. Actual compensation will depend on a variety of relevant factors, including an applicant’s skills, experience, qualifications, professional certifications, work arrangements, geographic location, and other business and organizational needs. It is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range, and compensation decisions depend on the facts and circumstances of each case. Baker Tilly offers a compensation and benefits package to eligible employees.

Interested in joining us on our journey?

*Open to Remote/Hybrid Candidates*

The Senior Principal Enterprise Data Architect – AI Data Transformation will serve as a strategic partner and governance leader within the Enterprise Architecture (EA) team of our global enterprise. This role combines advanced enterprise data architecture discipline with deep expertise in Artificial Intelligence infrastructure and Data Science enablement to plan, design, deploy, and execute technology solutions aligned to the organization's strategic roadmap.

The incumbent will be instrumental in operationalizing complex initiatives by significantly enhancing, evolving, and optimizing the enterprise data layer to make every data asset—across our global operations, supply chain, customer touchpoints, and connected products—AI-ready, AI-consumable, and AI-trustworthy. This role will champion EA and AI data governance frameworks, drive Hoshin goal attainment, and serve as a key liaison between IT, business operations, product engineering, data science teams, and the EA team to ensure technology investments are aligned to enterprise standards and strategic AI objectives.

Position

Senior Principal Enterprise Data Architect, AI Data Transformation

Location

USA, Louisville, KYOther AL US, Other CT US, Other DC US, Other DE US, Other FL US, Other GA US, Other IL US, Other IN US, Other NC US, Other NE US, Other NH US, Other NJ US, Other NY US, Other OH US

How You'll Create Possibilities

AI Data Layer Enhancement & Transformation (40%)

  • Lead the architectural enhancement and evolution of the enterprise data layer, applying AI-first design principles to unify data across the enterprise value chain (R&D, supply chain, operations, and customer experience).
  • Define, publish, and maintain the Enterprise AI Data Architecture Blueprint—the authoritative reference governing how data flows from source systems (e.g. ERP, CRM, PLM, IoT platforms) through transformation layers to AI models and business outcomes.
  • Design and operationalize an Enterprise AI Data Readiness Framework that continuously assesses, scores, and improves data assets across five core dimensions: Completeness, Consistency, Timeliness, Representativeness, and Fairness.
  • Architect and deploy enterprise-grade vector database infrastructure and build enterprise embedding pipelines that transform structured records, enterprise documents, product manuals, and operational logs into high-quality vector representations.
  • Define the complete data architecture for Large Language Model (LLM) integration, including Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architecture to support enterprise copilots, customer service, and operational workflows.
  • Design ultra-low latency data serving architectures and event-driven AI data pipelines that feed live AI models in production (e.g., real-time operational analytics, predictive maintenance, and customer insights).
  • Establish an enterprise Synthetic Data Generation capability to augment scarce datasets, generate privacy-safe alternatives to sensitive data, and simulate operational edge cases.


Enterprise Architecture Strategy & Governance (35%)

  • Serve as a strategic partner and governance leader within the EA team, applying and evolving enterprise architecture frameworks (TOGAF, Zachman) with AI-era extensions tailored for a large-scale, complex enterprise environment.
  • Architect modern cloud data warehouse and Lakehouse solutions (e.g. BigQuery) as the unified, ACID-compliant foundation for both analytical and AI/ML workloads on a single governed storage layer.
  • Define and enforce data contracts between data producers (e.g., business operations, product engineering) and AI consumers across all domains to ensure schema, quality, freshness, and semantic consistency.
  • Lead Master Data Management (MDM) strategy with AI entity resolution, enrichment, and disambiguation capabilities embedded in the MDM layer (covering Product, Material, Supplier, and Customer domains).
  • Govern metadata management, data cataloging, and data lineage (e.g. Collibra) and design semantic/context data layers/Knowledge Graph infrastructure to map complex relationships between enterprise assets, suppliers, and business processes.
  • Facilitate Architecture Review Board (ARB) processes for data and AI initiatives, ensuring alignment between project delivery and architectural intent.
  • Align all data architecture decisions with regulatory and compliance requirements without compromising AI agility.


Data Science Enablement & Stakeholder Engagement (15%)

  • Apply statistical expertise to validate data representativeness, distributions, class balance, and sampling strategies for AI training datasets (e.g., ensuring datasets accurately represent real-world operational realities).
  • Serve as a trusted advisor and primary point of contact for business and IT stakeholders on AI data-governed initiatives.
  • Build and maintain effective working relationships at all levels of DT Staff, Extended DT Staff, and business leadership.
  • Proactively identify risks, issues, dependencies, and bottlenecks; implement mitigation strategies to keep teams moving forward.
  • Partner with functional/business teams, DT teams, and other team members to solve problems collaboratively and deliver project objectives.


Data Engineering Oversight & Standards (10%)

  • Provide architectural oversight and define enterprise standards for AI/ML-optimized data pipelines, guiding data engineering delivery teams from raw ingestion through feature engineering.
  • Define the architecture and integration patterns for the Enterprise Feature Store as the central hub of reusable, versioned ML features.
  • Establish DataOps and pipeline governance frameworks, guiding delivery teams on best practices for CI/CD, automated data quality testing gates, and infrastructure-as-code.
  • Define architectural patterns for streaming and event-driven technologies to support high-velocity enterprise and IoT telemetry data.
  • Elicit detailed business and architecture requirements, translating them into clear architectural guidelines and actionable work items for data engineering teams.


What You'll Bring to Our Team

Education:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Information Systems, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related technical field required.
  • Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, or a related field strongly preferred.


Experience and Qualifications:

  • 15+ years of progressive experience in data-related roles, with a minimum of 5 years in Enterprise Data Architecture at enterprise scale.
  • 3+ years of experience designing and architecting AI/ML data infrastructure (feature stores, vector databases, model serving layers, semantic layers).
  • Proven track record of leading enterprise data transformation programs with measurable AI and ML outcomes delivered in production environments.
  • Enterprise Industry Experience: Prior experience architecting data solutions involving complex supply chains, ERP (SAP/Oracle), PLM, or large-scale IoT/telemetry is preferred.
  • Excellent oral and written presentation Skills
  • Works independently with limited supervision and operates autonomously
  • Working knowledge of enterprise architecture frameworks (e.g., TOGAF, Zachman)


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working in both Agile and Waterfall delivery environments
  • Project Management Professional (PMP) certification preferred
  • TOGAF or other EA framework certification preferred


Our Culture

Our work is centered on our People and Culture as reflected in our Zero Distance philosophy and we recognize the importance of reaffirming our commitment to inclusion and diversity (I&D). This underscores our commitment to fostering an environment where every individual feels valued, connected, and empowered to contribute, while positioning our organization to adapt seamlessly to the evolving needs of our workforce and communities.

This reflects our dedication to creating solutions that: Empower colleagues by fostering an environment where all voices are heard, valued, and encouraged to contribute. Strengthen communities where we live and work. Reinforce a culture of belonging, purpose, and engagement. Reflect the diversity of the communities we serve through our workforce, products, and practices.

By further embedding Zero Distance into our People and Culture framework, we will continue to build a deeply connected organization. We are cultivating a culture of engagement, belonging, and connection, because while attracting new talent remains a priority, retention is a cornerstone of our strategy.

GE Appliances is a trust-based organization. It is important we offer our employees the flexibility they need to do their best work while balancing the needs of the business and individuals. When you join GE Appliances, you will have the opportunity to work with your leader to create a flexible work arrangement that balances the needs of the individual, team, and organization.

GE Appliances is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law.

GE Appliances participates in E-Verify and will provide the federal government with your Form I-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the U.S

If you are an individual with a disability and need assistance or an accommodation to use our website or to apply, please send an e-mail to ask.recruiting@geappliances.com

- Build and maintain effective working relationships at all levels of DT Staff, Extended DT Staff, and business leadership.
- Proactively identify risks, issues, dependencies, and bottlenecks; implement mitigation strategies to keep teams moving forward.
- Partner with functional/business teams, DT teams, and other team members to solve problems collaboratively and deliver project objectives.

- Provide architectural oversight and define enterprise standards for AI/ML-optimized data pipelines, guiding data engineering delivery teams from raw ingestion through feature engineering.

- Establish DataOps and pipeline governance frameworks, guiding delivery teams on best practices for CI/CD, automated data quality testing gates, and infrastructure-as-code.

Education:



- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Information Systems, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related technical field required.
- Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, or a related field strongly preferred.


Experience and Qualifications:



- 15+ years of progressive experience in data-related roles, with a minimum of 5 years in Enterprise Data Architecture at enterprise scale.
- 3+ years of experience designing and architecting AI/ML data infrastructure (feature stores, vector databases, model serving layers, semantic layers).
- Proven track record of leading enterprise data transformation programs with measurable AI and ML outcomes delivered in production environments.
- Enterprise Industry Experience: Prior experience architecting data solutions involving complex supply chains, ERP (SAP/Oracle), PLM, or large-scale IoT/telemetry is preferred.
- Excellent oral and written presentation Skills
- Works independently with limited supervision and operates autonomously
- Working knowledge of enterprise architecture frameworks (e.g., TOGAF, Zachman)


Preferred Qualifications



- Experience working in both Agile and Waterfall delivery environments
- Project Management Professional (PMP) certification preferred
- TOGAF or other EA framework certification preferred

descriptionHtml:
Exp: 10+ years in IT, with at least 5+ years specializing in data architecture, data warehousing, and large-scale data engineering.

We are seeking a visionary and hands-on Senior Data Architect to spearhead the design, development, and optimization of our enterprise data ecosystem on AWS. In this role, you will bridge the gap between complex business requirements and robust, scalable cloud infrastructure. You will architect enterprise-grade data pipelines, modern data lakes/warehouses, and real-time streaming architectures that power our core enterprise applications and analytics platforms.

Key Responsibilities

Requirements Translation & Business Partnership

Partner closely with business stakeholders and technical SMEs to identify required data, locate source systems, and translate complex business rules into clear, actionable data requirements and robust solution designs.

Cloud Data Architecture & Scalability

Design and evaluate scalable cloud data structures and warehousing solutions on AWS that expertly support application needs, current data volumes, and long-term future growth.

Modernize legacy on-premises data systems and monolithic databases into cloud-native, microservices-friendly data stores.

Data Integration & Process Design

Define how data is collected, transformed, stored, and kept current across the enterprise.

Leverage deep experience in ETL automation and orchestration to build reliable, maintainable, and high-performance data pipelines.

Technical Execution & Guidance (SQL & Python)

Bring practical, hands-on experience manipulating data and implementing complex transformation logic.

Provide the technical depth needed to validate results, troubleshoot complex data issues, and guide developers through hands-on implementation.

Governance, Security, & Collaboration

Establish enterprise-wide data governance, metadata management, and compliance controls (GDPR, CCPA, SOC2) using tools like AWS Lake Formation and the Glue Data Catalog.

Collaborate with Enterprise Architects, Software Engineers, and DevOps to align data patterns with application requirements and CI/CD pipelines.

Required Qualifications & Skills

Experience: 10+ years in IT, with at least 5+ years specializing in data architecture, data warehousing, and large-scale data engineering.

AWS Expertise: Deep, hands-on experience designing architectures using core AWS data services:

Storage & Warehousing: Amazon Redshift, Amazon S3, Amazon DynamoDB, Amazon Aurora / RDS.

Processing & Ingestion: AWS Glue, Amazon Kinesis, Amazon EMR, AWS Lambda, MSK (Managed Streaming for Apache Kafka).

Governance & Security: AWS Lake Formation, IAM, KMS.

Technical Stack:

Advanced proficiency in SQL and programming languages like Python (or Scala) for data manipulation and transformation logic.

Experience with orchestration tools (e.g., Apache Airflow, AWS Step Functions) and Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, AWS CloudFormation).

Certifications: AWS Certified Data Analytics - Specialty or AWS Certified Solutions Architect (Professional preferred).

Bain & Company is a global management consulting firm. We work alongside leaders around the world to solve their hardest problems and achieve results that last.

Since 1973, we’ve partnered with clients, including private equity firms and their portfolio companies, to build the capabilities that keep them ahead of change and help them redefine their industries. We’ve led large-scale transformations through every technology wave, and today technology and AI are in everything we do. We help clients see where AI changes how they compete, then create the advantage: the strategy, the engineering to build it, and the change leadership to make it hold in a real organization with real constraints. We measure our success by our clients’ success, and our client advocacy is the highest in our field.

We’re consistently recognized as one of the best places to work in the world. Across 67 cities in 40 countries, we operate as one global team, uniting strategists, industry and functional experts, engineers, AI experts, data scientists, designers, and advisors with a vibrant ecosystem of technology partners. 

Analysts rank us as a Leader across major categories, including digital business, innovation, strategy, experience design, customer experience, and carbon-zero transformation.
descriptionHtml:
WHAT MAKES US A GREAT PLACE TO WORK

We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world’s best places to work. We are currently the top ranked consulting firm on Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work list and have earned the #1 overall spot a record seven times. Extraordinary teams are at the heart of our business strategy, but these don’t happen by chance. They require intentional focus on bringing together a broad set of backgrounds, cultures, experiences, perspectives, and skills in a supportive and inclusive work environment. We hire people with exceptional talent and create an environment in which every individual can thrive professionally and personally.


WHO YOU'LL WORK WITH

You'll join our Architecture experts within the Applied Technology & AI. This team combines Bain’s strategy, industry, and transformation capabilities with deep technical expertise to solve clients’ most important business problems. Software, AI, and data engineers, data scientists, designers, product managers, and technical leads work with clients and Bain consultants to shape, build, deploy, and scale production-grade products and systems that create lasting competitive advantage.


WHAT YOU'LL DO (Essential Functions):

Shape Architecture and Technology Strategy 

  • Lead the definition of enterprise data architecture strategies, target states, and roadmaps aligned with client business priorities and transformation outcomes. 
  • Architect scalable, resilient, and secure enterprise data platforms and solutions across cloud, hybrid, and multi-cloud environments. 
  • Define organizational strategies and operating models for a modern Data Office, including governance, ownership, platform, and delivery capabilities. 
  • Develop as-is and to-be architectures, reference models, migration options, and transition roadmaps for complex data transformations. 
  • Define enterprise integration and data-sharing standards across APIs, event streaming, data pipelines, and microservices-aligned architectures. 
  • Shape the data foundations required for analytics and AI, including data engineering, feature engineering, model data pipelines, and MLOps enablement. 
  • Assess, select, and integrate modern data platforms, vendor solutions, and hyperscaler services, including Databricks, Snowflake, Microsoft Fabric, AWS, Azure, and GCP. 
  • Translate complex business and technical requirements into clear architecture decisions, investment priorities, and executable plans.


Advise and Influence Senior Leaders 

  • Serve as a trusted advisor to CISOs, CIOs, CTOs, Chief Architects, and senior executives on cyber security strategy, architecture decisions, and technology trade-offs. 
  • Establish executive-level credibility and communicate effectively with senior business and technology stakeholders as part of client project leadership teams. 
  • Act as an independent design authority by reviewing and validating data architecture proposals, evaluating options, and providing delivery assurance. 
  • Influence, coach, and mentor client data and technology leaders and Bain teams to build sustainable architecture and Data Office capabilities.


Enable Transformation at Scale

  • Lead high-impact data architecture workstreams within large-scale, multi-year transformation programs. 
  • Set direction and lead internal and external teams across complex, multi-million-dollar client engagements. 
  • Guide Bain consulting and client teams in executing architecture roadmaps, managing dependencies and risks, and embedding effective governance. 
  • Ensure architectures evolve through agile and MVP delivery while maintaining security, resilience, interoperability, scalability, and coherence. 
  • Partner with Bain consulting teams to integrate data architecture into broader business, technology, cloud, and AI transformations. 
  • Lead and mentor teams of architects and consultants to deliver secure, scalable, and high-performing enterprise data platforms aligned with client outcomes. 
  • Collaborate with leaders across Vector guilds to bring the optimal combination of expertise to clients. 
  • Support recruiting, onboarding, and people development, and help create an environment that attracts and develops great architects. 


Advance Bain’s Reputation and Growth 

  • Define and create demand by co-creating differentiated points of view and go-to-market offerings in enterprise data architecture, data modernization, Master Data Management, Data Office design, and AI-enabled transformation. 
  • Support proposals, pursuits, and account expansion by bringing data architecture expertise into client discussions and solution shaping. 
  • Maintain market and vendor awareness, collaborate with ecosystem partners, and continuously evolve Bain's enterprise data architecture point of view. 
  • Contribute actively to client cases, intellectual property, publications, and architecture community engagement. 
  • Build and sustain trusted relationships with senior stakeholders, sponsors, and architecture communities.


WHAT YOU'LL BRING (Qualifications):

  • 10+ years of experience in data architecture and technology leadership, including large-scale transformation programs. 
  • Deep enterprise data architecture expertise across multiple industries, such as financial services, consumer, and technology. 
  • Demonstrated track record shaping enterprise data strategies, target architectures, platform roadmaps, and operating models. 
  • End-to-end lifecycle experience leading large, complex, multi-year data transformation programs from strategy and architecture through implementation and migration. 
  • Deep understanding of how data enables AI, with delivery experience across data engineering, feature engineering, model data pipelines, and MLOps enablement. 
  • Hands-on architecture and delivery experience with modern data stacks and cloud data services, including Snowflake, Microsoft Fabric, and AWS, Azure, or GCP. 
  • Strong knowledge of data governance, metadata, data quality, Master Data Management, data integration, security, privacy, and responsible data use. 
  • Strong client leadership and business development experience, including pre-sales, go-to-market efforts, proposal shaping, and account expansion.

The Enterprise Data Architecture and Data Platform team is a central organization built to establish enterprise-wide standards and capabilities as scalable solutions to be used across the enterprise. This team defines and manages enterprise data architectures and AI data readiness working with Enterprise Architecture that ensures consistency, scale, controls and compliance to how data is managed. This organization is also responsible for enterprise capabilities including vendor solutions as product owners.

Role Summary

As a Senior Enterprise AI Data Architect, you will lead the design, governance, and evolution of enterprise data and AI architecture capabilities across the firm. This role is responsible for defining reference architectures, guiding implementation patterns, and ensuring scalable, secure, and governed solutions that enable enterprise data and AI outcomes.

The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in modern cloud data platforms, AI/ML architecture, and enterprise integration patterns, along with strong communication and stakeholder management skills. This is a highly hands-on, full-stack architecture role spanning data ingestion, transformation, semantic and consumption layers, model orchestration, application integration, and production deployment patterns. The role includes both strategic architecture leadership and practical execution, including prototyping and proof-of-concept development to validate new capabilities.

We are seeking an energetic, creative, and technically strong architect who enjoys solving complex enterprise problems and building reusable frameworks, standards, and patterns that scale data and AI capabilities across the organization.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the architecture, design, and selective hands-on implementation of enterprise data and AI solutions from concept through production.
  • Define end-to-end architecture patterns covering data ingestion, transformation, semantic modeling, retrieval, model orchestration, inference, integration, and deployment.
  • Build prototypes and proof-of-concepts to validate architecture decisions, evaluate emerging technologies, and accelerate adoption of new data and AI capabilities.
  • Establish reusable design patterns for agentic, analytical, and model-driven workflows using cloud-native and enterprise data platforms.
  • Design and guide integration of AI capabilities with enterprise applications, APIs, and data platforms such as Snowflake.
  • Partner with engineering teams to ensure architecture patterns are implemented in a scalable, secure, and supportable manner.
  • Define standards for metadata, lineage, governance, observability, and lifecycle management across data and AI solutions.
  • Evaluate tradeoffs across tools, models, platforms, and integration approaches, and recommend solutions aligned to enterprise strategy and business needs.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to align architecture, platform capabilities, and delivery roadmaps.
  • Drive adoption of enterprise architecture standards, reusable frameworks, and best practices across data and AI initiatives.

Qualifications

Required:

We Are Looking For An Experienced Architect With a Passion For Data And a Talent For Driving Technical Consensus. We Value Your Background And We Place a High Emphasis On Your Ability To Continuously Learn And Master New Technologies. The Ideal Candidate Will Have

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • 5+ years of experience in data, platform, or solution architecture, including experience designing and delivering enterprise-scale cloud data and AI solutions.
  • Hands-on experience with generative AI, machine learning, or advanced analytics solutions, including at least one use case delivered end-to-end into production.
  • Strong experience with AWS and Snowflake, including architecture and implementation patterns for governed data access, analytics, and AI integration; experience with Amazon Bedrock Agent Core and Snowflake Cortex strongly preferred.
  • Deep understanding of modern data architecture, including data ingestion, transformation, semantic modeling, metadata, lineage, data quality, governance, and production deployment patterns.
  • Strong technical skills in Python or another modern programming language, along with experience in APIs, orchestration patterns, CI/CD, infrastructure as code, and operational best practices.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence architecture decisions, work across technical and business teams, and operate effectively in a fast-evolving environment.

Preferred

  • A Bachelor's or Master's degree in a technical, 5 years of experiences working in Asset Management or a related financial services or highly regulated industry.

This role is eligible for hybrid work, with up to three days per week from home.

Role Overview

We are looking for an experienced Data Architect with a strong background in SQL Server-based data architecture and data warehousing, along with current Microsoft Fabric experience.

The role will support the modernization of an existing enterprise data environment, including architecture assessment, solution design, legacy platform rationalization, and transition to Fabric.

This is an architecture and design role, not a Data Engineering position. The architect should be technically strong enough to troubleshoot issues and guide implementation teams without being responsible for building production pipelines, notebooks, or code.

Key Responsibilities
  • Assess existing SQL Server data warehouses, data marts, integrations, and data flows.
  • Define current-state and target-state architecture.
  • Provide architecture guidance across Microsoft Fabric and SQL Server environments.
  • Design solutions using OneLake, Lakehouse, Warehouse, and Fabric integration patterns.
  • Support modernization and rationalization of legacy data platforms.
  • Develop/review HLDs, LLDs, architecture diagrams, data flows, and integration designs.
  • Apply conceptual, logical, physical, and dimensional data modeling.
  • Provide guidance around integration, governance, security, data quality, and MDM.
  • Troubleshoot architecture/design issues and guide technical teams through implementation.
  • Work independently with business and technical stakeholders in a lean environment.
Required Experience
  • 8 10+ years of Data Architecture/Data Warehouse experience.
  • Strong SQL Server, enterprise data warehouse, and data mart background.
  • Current Microsoft Fabric experience required.
  • Experience with OneLake, Lakehouse/Warehouse, and data integration patterns.
  • Legacy/on-prem to cloud modernization and migration experience.
  • Strong data modeling and enterprise data integration experience.
  • Working SQL/T-SQL knowledge for design reviews and troubleshooting.
  • Experience producing HLDs, LLDs, and data-flow/architecture diagrams.
  • Understanding of data governance, security, MDM, and data quality.

Nice to have: Broader Enterprise Architecture and Azure data platform experience.

Title: Senior Snowflake Data Architect

Employment Type: Full-time

Industry: Wholesale

Location: Memphis, TN


Role Description:

We are seeking a Senior Snowflake Data Architect with 10 years of experience to serve as the strategic lead for our Master Data Management (MDM) team. You will be responsible for the end-to-end architectural vision, aligning Snowflake's capabilities with the enterprise-wide goal of creating a single source of truth. This role requires a high-level strategist capable of translating complex business requirements into scalable, secure, and actionable technical roadmaps that support analytics and retail services.

Minimum Requirements:

  • Minimum 7+ years of hands-on experience in Snowflake or comparable cloud-based data platforms.
  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field.
  • Expert-level understanding of data warehousing concepts, MDM lifecycle, and database design.
  • Expert-level SQL and Python for building automated, scalable data pipelines.
  • Advanced proficiency in Tableau to translate raw data into actionable insights.
  • Deep familiarity with CRM data structures and extraction methodologies.
  • Ability to resolve systemic, multi-layered technical challenges.
  • Effective communication skills to align diverse stakeholders with the MDM strategy.

Responsibilities:

  • Lead the long-term evolution and maintenance of the Snowflake cloud platform to support enterprise-level MDM implementation.
  • Design complex data schemas (Star/Snowflake) and master data domains that unify fragmented data from sources like Salesforce.
  • Act as the primary technical bridge to BI, Retail Services, and cross-functional teams to elicit high-level business requirements.
  • Convert enterprise goals into a prioritized backlog of technical tasks and architectural blueprints for the implementation team.
  • Configure and manage enterprise-grade security, including advanced Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) and data masking within Snowflake.
  • Implement and enforce security best practices to meet strict global compliance and data privacy requirements.
  • Manage and optimize the Snowflake environment to ensure high-performance delivery for business intelligence initiatives.
  • Oversee the integration of the complete data analytics stack, ensuring seamless flow between Snowflake, Python-based automation, and Tableau.
  • Serve as the final escalation point for complex technical issues and data stack downtime.
  • Guide and mentor junior to mid-level developers on data warehousing concepts and database design.

Job Number: R0253631

Data Strategist

The Opportunity:

As organizations increasingly depend on cloud platforms, analytics, and AI/ML to drive mission outcomes, the integrity of the data foundation underneath them has never mattered more. We are looking for a Data Architect to own the design, governance, and continued evolution of the enterprise data architecture that powers analytics, reporting, and operational insight across our organization and for our DoD clients.

As a Data Architect, you'll be the go-to expert for data modeling, governance, and architecture across stakeholders, making sure every data asset we build is well-modeled, documented, discoverable, and trustworthy. You set the standards, and you help the team hold to them from design through deployment.

This is a hands-on technical role. Our architecture, pipelines, and tooling are built on modern Python frameworks. You'll be designing schemas, optimizing queries, and making data modeling decisions that the rest of the team builds on every day.

The role also carries meaningful project leadership and client-facing responsibility. You'll play a key part in new client intake, engaging directly with prospective and new customers to understand their data landscape, asking the right questions, and applying critical thinking to model their environment and shape data solutions that fit their mission. You'll also lead client data maturity assessments from start to finish, scoping the engagement against the statement of work, evaluating client data systems, modeling their current-state architecture, and delivering actionable recommendations and roadmaps on schedule. You'll work in a fast-paced, agile environment where deliverables are requirements-driven and schedule-bound, partnering closely with team leads, engineers, analysts, and stakeholders to maintain high quality and timeliness of deliverables.

What You'll Work On:

  • Own the enterprise data model, ensuring all production data assets are properly modeled, documented, and governed, with complete schemas and lineage.
  • Design and enforce data governance standards, including assisting with naming conventions, quality controls, access policies, and metadata management, and hold the deployment gate so new assets meet standards before reaching production.
  • Define and maintain the data catalog so every team knows what data exists, where it lives, and how to use it.
  • Lead data quality monitoring, including owning the rules, thresholds, and remediation process, and driving issues to resolution within defined service levels.
  • Support new client intake by engaging with prospective and new customers to understand their data environment, coordinating with squad leads and analysts on what's feasible, and applying critical thinking to model and design data solutions tailored to each customer's needs.
  • Lead client-facing data maturity assessments end-to-end, including planning and managing the engagement timeline, evaluating client data systems, scoring maturity, and delivering recommendations and actionable roadmaps.
  • Communicate clearly in both directions, including presenting architecture findings and recommendations to clients, and coordinating across the team so engineers and analysts have what they need to execute.
  • Support cross-functional mission teams by validating data model decisions, reviewing architecture choices, and ensuring governance compliance.
  • Design and build data solutions using Python and SQL.
  • Evaluate and recommend data tools, storage strategies, and architectural patterns as the team scales, delivering recommendations with cost or benefit analysis.
  • Participate in quarterly technical debt reviews and security and compliance audits, helping ensure architecture health and DoD compliance requirements are met.


Join us. The world can’t wait.

You Have:

  • 5+ years of experience in data architecture, data engineering, analytics engineering, or data science or analysis
  • Experience with SQL and databases, including data modeling such as dimensional modeling, normalization, or schema design, query optimization, and working with relational databases and cloud data platforms
  • Experience with Python data frameworks for data processing, transformation, and automation
  • Experience designing and governing data architectures in AWS-based environments
  • Experience assisting with establishing and enforcing data governance practices, data quality frameworks, metadata management, data cataloging, lineage, and access policies
  • Experience with ETL and ELT processes and modern data pipeline architectures
  • Experience with project management, including planning and delivering schedule-bound technical engagements or assessments against a statement of work or charter
  • Ability to use critical thinking and solution design to take an unfamiliar customer data environment, model it, and shape a practical architecture and roadmap
  • Ability to obtain a Secret clearance
  • Bachelor's degree


Nice If You Have:

  • Experience supporting DoD test and evaluation (T&E) programs or similar requirements-driven delivery environments
  • Experience with AWS data services such as S3, Glue, Redshift, Athena, or Lake Formation
  • Experience conducting data maturity, readiness, or current-state architecture assessments for external clients
  • Experience with data governance and catalog tooling, including data catalogs, lineage tools, or metadata management platforms
  • Experience with data warehouse or Lakehouse architectures, and orchestration or transformation frameworks such as Airflow or dbt
  • Experience mentoring engineers or analysts on data modeling and governance practices
  • Knowledge of AI/ML workflows and the data architecture patterns that support them
  • Possession of strong client-facing communication skills, to engage new customers, present findings and recommendations to senior technical and non-technical stakeholders, and coordinate across internal teams
  • Top Secret clearance


Clearance:

Applicants selected will be subject to a security investigation and may need to meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information.

Compensation

At Booz Allen, we celebrate your contributions, provide you with opportunities and choices, and support your total well-being. Our offerings include health, life, disability, financial, and retirement benefits, as well as paid leave, professional development, tuition assistance, work-life programs, and dependent care. Our recognition awards program acknowledges employees for exceptional performance and superior demonstration of our values. Full-time and part-time employees working at least 20 hours a week on a regular basis are eligible to participate in Booz Allen’s benefit programs. Individuals that do not meet the threshold are only eligible for select offerings, not inclusive of health benefits. We encourage you to learn more about our total benefits by visiting the Resource page on our Careers site and reviewing Our Employee Benefits page.

Salary at Booz Allen is determined by various factors, including but not limited to location, the individual’s particular combination of education, knowledge, skills, competencies, and experience, as well as contract-specific affordability and organizational requirements. The projected compensation range for this position is $86,800.00 to $198,000.00 (annualized USD). The estimate displayed represents the typical salary range for this position and is just one component of Booz Allen’s total compensation package for employees. This posting will close within 90 days from the Posting Date.

Identity Statement

As part of the hiring process, we will ask you to complete an identity verification process that leverages advanced biometrics and artificial intelligence to ensure authenticity and protect against identity fraud. You are expected to be on camera during interviews and assessments. We reserve the right to take your picture to verify your identity and prevent fraud.

Candidate AI Usage Policy

AI is a part of our daily work at Booz Allen, and we are committed to the responsible and ethical use of AI tools. However, we want to ensure a fair candidate process based on your own skills and knowledge. As part of this commitment, the use of artificial intelligence (AI) or other tools to assist with responses during interviews (whether in-person or virtual) is prohibited unless permission is explicitly provided.

Work Model

Our people-first culture prioritizes the benefits of collaboration. To support engagement and effective communication, employees working virtually are generally expected to have their cameras on during meetings.

  • Remote: If this position is listed as remote, there may still be occasions when you are required to work in person at a Booz Allen or customer facility.
  • Hybrid: If this position is listed as hybrid, you will be expected to work from a Booz Allen or customer facility, in alignment with your leadership's expectations and the needs of the role.
  • Onsite: If this position is listed as onsite, work will primarily be performed full-time at a customer facility, where employees will collaborate directly with colleagues and customers as required by the role.


Commitment to Non-Discrimination

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to disability, status as a protected veteran or any other status protected by applicable federal, state, local, or international law.

Introduction

Welcome to Gallagher - a global community of people who bring bold ideas, deep expertise, and a shared commitment to doing what’s right. We help clients navigate complexity with confidence by empowering businesses, communities, and individuals to thrive. At Gallagher, you’ll find more than a job; you’ll find a culture built on trust, driven by collaboration, and sustained by the belief that we’re better together. Whether you join us in a client-facing role or as part of our brokerage division, our benefits and HR consulting division, or our corporate team, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, make an impact, and be part of something bigger. Experience a workplace where you’re encouraged to be yourself, supported to succeed, and inspired to keep learning. That’s what it means to live The Gallagher Way.

How You'll Make An Impact

The Data Architect is a hands-on technical leader responsible for designing the data architecture, models, standards, and patterns that enable scalable, trusted, and reusable enterprise data solutions at Gallagher.

You will lead the architecture and design of complex data initiatives spanning operational, analytical, master, and reference data. This includes defining end-to-end data flows, developing conceptual and logical data models, establishing integration and modeling patterns, evaluating solution designs, and ensuring data platforms are designed for scalability, reliability, governance, security, and long-term maintainability.

This is an individual contributor role with technical leadership responsibilities and no direct people management. You will work closely with data engineers, solution and enterprise architects, product teams, analytics, data science, governance, business stakeholders, and technology teams to translate business capabilities and data requirements into practical enterprise data architectures.

How you'll make an impact

Data Architecture & Modeling

  • Design end-to-end data architectures spanning source systems, ingestion, transformation, integration, master data, data lakes, warehouses, and downstream consumption.
  • Develop and maintain conceptual and logical data models that accurately represent business domains, entities, relationships, and data requirements.
  • Define reusable data architecture and modeling patterns that promote consistency across domains and technology platforms.
  • Establish clear source-to-target architectures and data flows, including system-of-record, mastering, distribution, and consumption patterns.
  • Guide the design of analytical, operational, master, and reference data solutions based on business and technical requirements.
  • Define architecture for structured, semi-structured, and unstructured enterprise data.
  • Ensure designs support scalability, interoperability, performance, reliability, security, and maintainability.

Technical & Architecture Leadership

  • Lead architecture and technical design for complex, cross-domain data initiatives.
  • Translate business requirements and capabilities into practical and scalable data architectures.
  • Establish and promote standards for data architecture, modeling, integration, metadata, lineage, naming, documentation, and design.
  • Conduct architecture and design reviews and ensure solutions align with enterprise standards and target-state architecture.
  • Provide architectural direction to data engineering teams throughout design and implementation.
  • Identify architectural risks, dependencies, technical debt, and opportunities to simplify or modernize existing solutions.
  • Influence technical decisions across teams without direct management responsibility.
  • Mentor engineers and other technical professionals on data architecture and modeling practices.

Data Platform & Integration Architecture

  • Define architecture patterns across modern cloud data platforms, including Snowflake, Azure, Databricks, ADLS Gen2, Azure Data Factory, and SQL-based platforms.
  • Design scalable data lake, data warehouse, data integration, and data product architectures.
  • Define patterns for batch, near-real-time, API, event-driven, and file-based data integration where appropriate.
  • Partner with engineering teams to ensure architecture can be implemented efficiently and operated reliably in production.
  • Define patterns that reduce point-to-point integrations, duplicate data processing, unnecessary data movement, and tightly coupled solutions.
  • Evaluate existing platforms and solutions and develop target-state and transition architectures to support modernization.
  • Ensure architecture considers performance, resilience, recoverability, observability, and cloud cost.

Data Governance & Management

  • Embed data governance requirements into data architecture and solution design.
  • Define architecture patterns supporting data ownership, data quality, metadata, lineage, security, privacy, retention, and access management.
  • Partner with data governance and business teams to establish consistent definitions and models for critical enterprise data.
  • Support master and reference data management strategies, including definition of authoritative sources, mastering, reconciliation, and distribution patterns.
  • Ensure architecture clearly documents data movement, transformation, ownership, and consumption.
  • Promote discoverable, governed, and reusable enterprise data products.

Business, Engineering & AI Partnership

  • Partner with business, product, analytics, data science, security, engineering, governance, and technology teams to develop data solutions aligned to business priorities.
  • Facilitate architecture discussions and drive decisions across teams with different technical and business perspectives.
  • Communicate architecture decisions, risks, dependencies, and tradeoffs clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Build data foundations that support analytics, AI, machine learning, and other advanced data use cases.
  • Ensure AI and analytics solutions are supported by well-designed, governed, and trusted data foundations.
  • Balance strategic architecture direction with practical delivery needs, helping teams move toward the target state incrementally.

About You

Required:

  • Typically requires a University Degree and minimum 3 years of prior relevant experience, or equivalent experience.
  • Our ideal candidate will have a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Data Management, or related field.
  • 7+ years of experience working with enterprise data platforms, data engineering, data modeling, or data architecture, including significant experience in a data architecture or senior technical design role.
  • Proven experience designing enterprise data architectures across complex data ecosystems.
  • Strong experience with conceptual and logical data modeling, including defining business entities, relationships, domains, and canonical models.
  • Strong understanding of data lake, data warehouse, lakehouse, data integration, master data, and modern data platform concepts.
  • Experience designing solutions on modern cloud data platforms such as Snowflake, Azure, Databricks, ADLS Gen2, Azure Data Factory, and SQL-based platforms.
  • Strong understanding of ETL/ELT, APIs, event-driven integration, and other enterprise data integration patterns.
  • Experience establishing data architecture, modeling, integration, and documentation standards.
  • Strong understanding of data governance, metadata, lineage, data quality, security, and data ownership concepts.
  • Ability to translate complex business requirements into clear data architectures and technical designs.
  • Ability to lead architecture initiatives and influence engineering and technology teams without direct management authority.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder-management skills.

Compensation And Benefits

At Gallagher, we believe supporting our colleagues goes far beyond the role itself. For more information, visit our Benefits page.

  • Competitive compensation
  • Comprehensive benefits programs designed to support your well-being
  • Career development opportunities and ongoing learning
  • A collaborative, people-first culture with accessible leadership
  • The opportunity to do meaningful work with global reach and local impact

At Gallagher, we are dedicated to building an inclusive and authentic workplace. If your past experience doesn’t align perfectly, we encourage you to join our Talent Community to stay connected to additional career opportunities. At times, we will consider transferable skills from previous roles.

Gallagher is an affirmative action/equal opportunity employer (Minorities/Females/Veterans/Disabled)

We are launching a multi‑year transformation from SAP ECC to SAP S/4HANA, and Raytheon’s Data, Analytics and AI organization is looking for a Senior S/4 Transition Data Architect to help shape the enterprise data foundation that will enable this journey. In this role, you will define and evolve the data architecture that supports seamless reporting and insight generation across both ECC and S/4HANA as they run in parallel during our migration. You will design canonical data models, integration patterns, and a bridge‑reporting strategy that brings together data from migrated and non‑migrated business areas—ensuring leaders and frontline teams have timely, trustworthy insights.

This senior individual contributor role partners closely with product managers, enterprise architects, business stakeholders, and delivery teams to set direction, establish standards, and guide solution teams across the full lifecycle—from strategic planning and design through deployment and ongoing operations.

You will apply formal architecture and strategy methods, such as TOGAF, to articulate business strategy, challenges, needs, and structure ahead of solution design. You will also own the continuous development of reference architectures, data models, personas, use cases, landscape views, and knowledge repositories that accelerate future architecture work and support a consistent, enterprise‑wide approach.

What You Will Do

  • Own the enterprise data architecture for the ECC → S/4HANA transition, defining principles, reference architectures, and guardrails for data domains (Finance, Supply Chain, Order‑to‑Cash, Procure‑to‑Pay, etc.).
  • Design the bridge reporting strategy that harmonizes ECC and S/4HANA datasets to produce consistent KPI definitions and cross‑system analytics (e.g., consolidated financials, inventory, order fulfillment), including semantic layers and data virtualization/replication as appropriate.
  • Model canonical and system‑specific data (conceptual, logical, physical) and establish golden sources, conformed dimensions, data standards, and naming/versioning conventions.
  • Define integration patterns (e.g., SLT/ODP/CDC, APIs, files, events) between SAP and the analytical stack, balancing latency, cost, reliability, and data quality.
  • Enable analytics & planning in SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC)—curate models, measures, and calculations; design security and data‑access patterns; guide dashboard/story design standards.
  • Oversee ETL/ELT pipelines using SAP BusinessObjects Data Services (BODS) and modern orchestration patterns; define error handling, lineage, and observability.
  • Create and maintain architecture artifacts (capability maps, value streams, domain models, roadmaps, standards) aligned to TOGAF ADM phases A–D and communicate them to technical and business stakeholders.
  • Coach delivery teams and provide architectural reviews to ensure solutions conform to strategy while meeting near‑term milestones during the phased migration.

Qualifications You Must Have

  • Typically requires a University Degree or equivalent experience and minimum 10 years prior relevant experience, or An Advanced Degree in a related field and minimum 7 years' experience
  • Deep expertise in the SAP ECC and SAP S/4HANA data models, including CDS views, embedded analytics concepts, and differences from ECC.
  • Leverage tools such as SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC), Snowflake, SAP Business Data Cloud, and BusinessObjects Data Services (BODS) to support data modeling, integration, governance and and reporting needs.
  • Proven track record designing bridge/transition architectures that support multi‑system reporting during large transformations.
  • Strong grounding in data modeling, data warehousing, and data integration techniques.
  • The ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. government issued security clearance is required. U.S. citizenship is required, as only U.S. citizens are eligible for a security clearance.

Qualifications We Prefer

  • TOGAF‑certified; practiced in using the TOGAF framework to build and communicate architecture to business and technical stakeholders.
  • 8–12+ years in data architecture/engineering with end‑to‑end ownership of enterprise data platforms.
  • Experience with SAP in an Aerospace and defense environment.
  • Experience with formal architecture modeling (UML, BPMN, SysML, ArchiMate).
  • Executive presence and strong communication skills; comfortable leading change across large initiatives and organizations.
  • Ability to dive deep into how the business creates value and translate that into data architectures and roadmaps.
  • Experience across the full IT lifecycle (planning, design, deployment, operations) and with cross‑functional delivery teams.
  • Demonstrated ability to use abstraction and simplification to communicate complex systems to different audiences.
  • Strong influencing and relationship skills to develop and maintain key partnerships.

What We Offer

Our values drive our actions, behaviors, and performance with a vision for a safer, more connected world. At RTX we value: Safety, Trust, Respect, Accountability, Collaboration, and Innovation.

Learn More & Apply Now!

Job Description:

WHY THIS ROLE MATTERS

SkinHealth Systems' analytics and data platform spans Snowflake, dbt, Power BI, and multiple ERP, CRM, and SaaS source systems — and the Sr Data Architect is the enterprise owner of the architectural standards, data models, and governance frameworks that make that ecosystem coherent, scalable, and trustworthy. This role defines how data is ingested, transformed, stored, and consumed across the organization, providing architectural leadership to data engineering, BI, and business systems teams to ensure every major data initiative aligns with long-term platform strategy.

What You’ll Do

  • Define and maintain the enterprise data architecture blueprint across operational and analytical domains, ensuring alignment between business strategy, data capabilities, and technology platforms.
  • Establish and govern architecture standards for modern data platforms including Snowflake, dbt, and associated integration layers — ensuring consistency in how data is ingested, transformed, stored, and consumed.
  • Design scalable, reusable architecture patterns that support analytics, reporting, and BI consumption, optimized for performance, maintainability, and enterprise-wide reuse.
  • Lead the development of the enterprise data platform roadmap, translating business growth, modernization initiatives, and emerging analytics requirements into a coherent architectural evolution strategy.
  • Define enterprise-wide conceptual, logical, and dimensional data models across key business domains, ensuring consistency in how data entities, relationships, and metrics are structured across systems.
  • Establish canonical definitions for critical business entities and metrics, ensuring a single source of truth for reporting, analytics, and decision-making across all functional areas.
  • Design and standardize dimensional modeling approaches — facts, dimensions, and data marts — that support both operational reporting and advanced analytics use cases.
  • Define integration architecture patterns across ERP, CRM, SaaS, APIs, and internal applications, ensuring data is reliably and securely ingested and made available across operational and analytical environments.
  • Architect batch and near real-time data ingestion frameworks; define best practices for transformation architecture within Snowflake and dbt.
  • Establish architectural standards for BI semantic layers, ensuring alignment between enterprise data models and Power BI consumption layers while standardizing metric definitions and calculation logic.
  • Own enterprise data governance architecture including metadata management, data lineage, quality frameworks, and compliance alignment.
  • Provide architectural leadership through design reviews, technical guidance, and mentorship across data engineering, BI, and business systems teams.
  • Develop and maintain enterprise architecture documentation, reference models, and standardized design patterns; lead architecture review processes for all major data initiatives.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.


Required

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field.
  • 7+ years of experience in data architecture, data engineering, or enterprise data platform roles.
  • Strong experience designing enterprise-scale data platforms and analytics architectures.
  • Deep expertise in data modeling including conceptual, logical, and dimensional approaches.
  • Hands-on experience with cloud data platforms — Snowflake strongly preferred; AWS, Azure, or GCP acceptable.
  • Strong understanding of modern data transformation tools such as dbt or equivalent.
  • Experience designing data integration patterns across multiple enterprise systems.
  • Experience working with BI semantic layers such as Power BI datasets or similar.
  • Strong knowledge of data governance, metadata, and data lineage principles.
  • Flexible hybrid work arrangement.


Preferred

  • Master's degree in a related field.
  • Experience architecting modern cloud data stacks combining Snowflake, dbt, and BI tooling.
  • Exposure to enterprise ERP and CRM systems such as SAP, Oracle, Salesforce, or NetSuite.
  • Experience in global or multi-entity enterprise environments.
  • Familiarity with DevOps concepts applied to data platforms.
  • Architecture certifications such as TOGAF or equivalent.
  • Experience supporting AI/ML or advanced analytics platforms.


Physical Requirements Of The Job

  • Primarily office-based role with extended periods of sedentary computer work.
  • Standard mobility required for architecture reviews, cross-functional meetings, and stakeholder presentations.
  • Work Arrangement: Hybrid (2 days per week in office).


We mean it when we say you’ll LOVE this role.

Base Pay: $121,000 - $140,000 + Bonus

An employee’s pay position within the salary range will be based on several factors including, but not limited to, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, seniority, geographic location, performance, travel requirements, revenue-based metrics, any contractual agreements, and business or organizational needs. The range listed is just one component of Hydrafacial's total rewards package for our employees. Other rewards may include annual bonuses, long-term incentives based on level, paid time off, and region-specific benefits. Come grow and GLOW with us!

What else can you expect with Hydrafacial?

PERKS! Benefits include: Medical insurance, dental insurance, vision insurance, FSAs, HSAs, accident insurance, pet insurance, company-paid life and AD&D insurance, company-paid long-term and short-term disability insurance, 401(k) with employer match, paid time off (PTO), and paid holidays.

Hydrafacial is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind based on race, sex, religion, sexual orientation, national origin, gender identity, gender expression, age, disability, genetic information, pregnancy or any other protected characteristic as outlined by color, federal, state or local laws. We are committed to working with and providing accommodation to applicants with physical and mental disabilities.

Hydrafacial does not accept unsolicited assistance or resumes/CVs from third party search firms. No fee will be paid in the event a candidate is hired by our company as a result of an agency referral or CV/resume submitted by a search firm to any employee at our company without a valid written search agreement. If we need additional support, we will be sure to reach out directly to one of our preferred providers. Please no phone calls or emails.

As a recognized subject matter expert, you will establish the long-term vision, standards, reference models, and architectural patterns that guide how data is ingested, integrated, stored, modeled, governed, and delivered across the organization. You will partner with business leaders, Data Engineering, Analytics, Security, and Governance teams to design and implement scalable, secure, and reusable data solutions. This role will guide modernization, shape enterprise data products, and present new or revised architecture standards to senior leadership to support a more optimized, secure, and stable data environment.

What does an Enterprise Data Architect do?

  • Define and govern the enterprise data architecture vision, principles, roadmaps, reference models, and design standards.
  • Design scalable, secure, and resilient enterprise data platforms using Snowflake, Azure Data Factory, Azure Data Lake, Azure Synapse, SQL Server, Kafka, and cloud-agnostic technologies.
  • Establish solution patterns for batch, streaming, real-time, and event-driven data pipelines that support analytics and operational use cases.
  • Lead conceptual, logical, and physical data modeling strategies to strengthen consistency, performance, and reuse.
  • Set architecture and governance standards for metadata, lineage, data quality, security, access controls, semantic models, enterprise datasets, and self-service analytics.
  • Provide design reviews and technical guidance to Data Engineering teams while driving modernization, platform optimization, cost efficiency, and reduction of technical debt.
  • Communicate architecture direction, standards, and technical trade-offs to senior leaders, engineers, analysts, and business stakeholders.
  • Mentor junior architects and engineers while promoting consistent architecture practices across the organization..

What is required?

Education:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field required.

Experience:

  • 10+ years of professional data engineering experience.
  • 10+ years of experience in an enterprise Data Architect role, with responsibility for architecture strategy, standards, reference models, design patterns, or technical roadmaps.
  • 5+ years of experience with Snowflake, Azure Data Factory, Azure Synapse, and SQL Server.
  • 5+ years of experience with streaming, replication, or event-driven data technologies, such as Kafka, Openflow, Snowpipe, or comparable platforms.
  • 5+ years of experience with Power BI and Tableau, including enterprise reporting architecture, semantic modeling, dataset design, dashboard governance, or analytics enablement.
  • Strong experience designing secure, scalable, reliable, and cost-efficient cloud data platforms.
  • Strong data governance experience involving metadata management, lineage, data quality, security, access controls, and regulatory compliance.
  • Experience applying DevOps methodologies, CI/CD workflows, ITIL practices, and Git-based development within enterprise data environments.
  • Experience communicating architecture standards, recommendations, and technical trade-offs to senior leadership and technical teams.

Other skills and abilities:

  • Familiarity with Terraform or other infrastructure-as-code tools.
  • Knowledge of containerization and orchestration technologies, including Docker and Kubernetes.
  • Exposure to data science workflows, machine learning platforms, or ML model integration.
  • Strategic and systems-level thinking with the ability to connect business priorities to enterprise data architecture.
  • Strong knowledge of modern data architecture, cloud platforms, data integration, modeling, analytics, and reporting.
  • Ability to design and implement solution patterns and reusable data products across enterprise environments.
  • Strong architecture review, technical decision-making, and problem-solving capabilities.
  • Ability to evaluate emerging technologies based on business value, risk, scalability, security, and cost.
  • Strong communication and presentation skills, including the ability to explain complex architecture concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Ability to influence decisions, establish alignment, and lead cross-functional teams without direct authority.
  • Ability to mentor junior architects and engineers and strengthen architecture practices across teams.

What else do you need to know?

  • Hybrid
  • Excellent benefits package medical & dental, vision insurance, life insurance, short-term and long-term disability insurance.
  • Parental Leave Policy
  • 401K + Company Match
  • PTO Plan + Paid Company determined Holidays.

All offers are contingent upon a successful background investigation (including employment, education, criminal and DMV verification- when applicable) and a pre-employment drug test with results satisfactory to GAINSCO.
